translations.translation: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta Geophysical Agency, no tsunami warning will be issued as the earthquake did not meet the 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.

translations.source: सुनामी का कोई खतरा नहीं होने के बावजूद भी निवासियों को जान जाने का डर था. इस वजह से उन्होंने अपने कारोबार और घरों को छोड़ना शुरू कर दिया.
translations.translation: Despite the fact that there was no tsunami threat, the inhabitants were afraid of being killed, so they began to abandon their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.

translations.source: हालाँकि विदाई के समय विन्फ़्रे की आँखों में आँसू थे उन्होंने अपने प्रशंसकों को स्पष्ट किया कि वे वापस आएँगी.
translations.translation: Although there were tears in Winfrey 's eyes at the time of her departure, she made it clear to her fans that she would return.
translations.reference: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.

translations.source: “यह खत्म होने नहीं जा रहा है। यह एक अध्याय का समापन और एक नए अध्याय का उद्घाटन है।”
translations.translation: It is not going to end. It is the end of a chapter and the opening of a new chapter.
translations.reference: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."

translations.source: नाम्बियाई राष्ट्रपति और संसदीय चुनावों के अंतिम नतीजों से यह संकेत मिले हैं कि पदासीन राष्ट्रपति हिफ़िकेपून्ये पोहाम्बा बड़े अंतर से दोबारा चुने गए हैं.
translations.translation: The final results of the Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections indicate that incumbent President Hifkepunye Pohamba has been re-elected by a wide margin.
translations.reference: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.

translations.source: सत्ताधारी दल साउथ वेस्ट अफ्रीका पीपल आर्गेनाइजेशन (स्वापो) ने संसदीय चुनाव में बहुमत पाया.
translations.translation: The ruling party, the South West Africa People 's Organization (SWAPO), won a majority in the parliamentary election.
translations.reference: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.

translations.source: संयुक्त सेना और अफगान सैनिक समूह साइट को सुरक्षित करने के लिए इलाके में चले गए और दूसरी संयुक्त सेना विमानों को सहायता के लिए भेजा गया.
translations.translation: Joint Army and Afghan troop groups moved into the area to secure the site and other Joint Army aircraft were dispatched for assistance.
translations.reference: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.

translations.source: पहाड़ी इलाकों में ज़्यादा दुर्घटना हुई. इसकी वजह आपसी दुश्मनी को माना जाता है.
translations.translation: More accidents occurred in mountainous areas. This is believed to have been caused by mutual hostility.
translations.reference: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.

translations.source: खराब मौसम और कठोर इलाकेे में दुर्घटना स्थल की तलाश के प्रयास किए जा रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Efforts are being made to locate the crash site in bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.

translations.source: मेडिकल चैरिटी मैंगोला, मेडिसिन सेंस फ़्रंटियर और विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन का कहना है कि यह देश में दर्ज सबसे ख़राब प्रकोप है.
translations.translation: Medical charity Mangola, Medicine Sense Frontier and the World Health Organization say it is the worst outbreak ever recorded in the country.
translations.reference: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.

translations.source: मेडिसिनेस सेंस फ्रोंटियर के प्रवक्ता रिचर्ड वीरमन ने कहा: “अंगोला में महामारी फैलने की रफ़्तार अब तक के सबसे बुरे दौर में पहुँच गई है और वहाँ के हालात बहुत खराब हैं.”
translations.translation: Richard Verman, spokesman for Medicines Sense Frontier, said: "The pace of the pandemic in Angola has reached its worst point ever and the conditions there are very bad.
translations.reference: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.

translations.source: खेल सुबह 10:00 बजे बहुत बढ़िया मौसम के साथ शुरू हुआ और सुबह-सुबह की रिमझिम फुहारें, जो जल्दी ही ख़त्म हो गई थीं, के अलावा यह 7वे रग्बी के लिए शानदार दिन था.
translations.translation: The game started at 10:00 a.m. with great weather and the early morning rush hour, which ended soon after, was a great day for 7th Rugby.
translations.reference: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.

translations.source: टूर्नामेंट के शीर्ष सीड्स दक्षिण अफ़्रीका ने सही नोट पर शुरू किया, जब उनके पास 5वीं वरीयता प्राप्त ज़ांबिया के ख़िलाफ़ 26 - 00 की आसान जीत थी.
translations.translation: The tournament's top seeds South Africa started on the right note, with an easy 26 - 00 victory over fifth-placed Zambia.
translations.reference: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.

translations.source: अपनी सदर्न सिस्टर्स के खिलाफ़ खेल में निर्णायक रूप से कमज़ोर दिखाई दे रही, फिर भी लगातार दक्षिण अफ़्रीका ने टूर्नामेंट के आगे बढ़ने पर सुधार किया है.
translations.translation: Despite showing a decisive weakness in the game against their Southern sisters, South Africa has consistently improved on the progress of the tournament.
translations.reference: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.

translations.source: उनकी अनुशासित रक्षा, गेंदबाजी की कला और टीम के अच्छे काम ने उन्हें बाहर खड़ा कर दिया और अब यह साफ हो गया था की ये टीम टक्कर देगी ।
translations.translation: His disciplined defense, bowling skills and good teamwork made him stand out and now it was clear that this team would compete.
translations.reference: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.

translations.source: एम्स्टर्डम शहर और ऐनी फ्रैंक संग्रहालय राज्य के अधिकारियों का कहना है कि पेड़ एक कवक से संक्रमित है और एक सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य खतरा पैदा करता है क्योंकि उनका तर्क है कि उसके गिरने का पूरा खतरा था।
translations.translation: Officials from the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank State Museum say the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health threat because they argue there was a complete risk of it falling.
translations.reference: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.

translations.source: इसे मंगलवार को काटना तय किया गया था, लेकिन एक आपातकालीन अदालत के फ़ैसले के बाद इसे बचा लिया गया था.
translations.translation: It was scheduled to be cut off on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.

translations.source: सभी गुफाओं, जिनका नाम “सात बहनें” रखा गया, में घुसने की जगह का डायमीटर कम से कम 100 से 250 मीटर (328 से 820 फ़ीट) है.
translations.translation: All the caves, named after the Seven Sisters, have an entrance diameter of at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet).
translations.reference: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.

translations.source: इन्फ़्रारेड चित्र दिखाते हैं कि रात और दिन के बदले तापमान से वे कुछ-कुछ गुफ़ाएँ जैसी हैं.
translations.translation: Infrared images show that at night and day temperatures, they are somewhat like caves.
translations.reference: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.

translations.source: “दिन में ये आस-पास की सतहों से ज़्यादा ठंडी और रात में गर्म होती हैं.
translations.translation: During the day they are colder than the surrounding surfaces and hotter at night.
translations.reference: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.

translations.source: उनका ऊष्मीय व्यवहार पृथ्वी की बड़ी गुफाओं जैसा स्थिर नहीं है जो अक्सर काफी स्थिर तापमान बनाए रखती हैं, लेकिन यह जमीन के इन गहरे छेद के अनुरूप है,” यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स जियोलॉजिकल सर्वे (यूएसजीएस) की भूगर्भीय टीम और फ्लैगस्टाफ, एरिजोना में स्थित उत्तरी एरिजोना विश्वविद्यालय के ग्लेन कुशिंग ने कहा।
translations.translation: Their thermal behavior is not as stable as Earth's large caves that often maintain fairly steady temperatures, but it is consistent with these deep holes in the ground, said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) geological team and Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: फ्रांस में, मतदान परंपरागत रूप से एक कम तकनीक वाला अनुभव रहा है: मतदाता खुद को बूथ में अलग-थलग कर लेते हैं, एक कागज की एक पूर्व-मुद्रित शीट डालते हैं जो लिफाफे में उनकी पसंद के उम्मीदवार को दर्शाती है।
translations.translation: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: Voters isolate themselves in the booth, putting a pre-printed sheet of paper in the envelope depicting the candidate of their choice.
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.

translations.source: जब अधिकारी मतदाता की पहचान की पुष्टि कर लेते हैं, तब मतदाता लिफ़ाफ़े को बैलट बॉक्स में डालता है और वोटिंग रोल पर हस्ताक्षर कर देता है.
translations.translation: When the officials confirm the identity of the voter, the voter puts the envelope in the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.

translations.source: फ़्रांस का चुनावी कानून, कार्यवाही को सख्ती से सांकेतिक शब्दों में बदलता है.
translations.translation: France 's electoral law strictly translates the procedure into symbolic terms.
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.

translations.source: 1988 के बाद से, मतपेटियांपारदर्शी होनी चाहिए थीं ताकि मतदाता और पर्यवेक्षक यह देख सकें कि मत के शुरू होने से पहले मतपेटी में कोई लिफ़ाफ़ा तो मौजूद नहीं है और वैध मतों के अलवा कोई अन्य मत तो नहीं दिया गया है.
translations.translation: Since 1988, ballot papers had to be transparent so that voters and observers could see that no envelope was present on the ballot before the start of voting and no other votes were given except legitimate votes.
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.

translations.source: उम्मीदवार प्रक्रिया के हर हिस्से को देखने के लिए प्रतिनिधि भेज सकते हैं. शाम को, स्वयंसेवकों द्वारा विशिष्ट प्रक्रियाओं का पालन करते हुए कड़ी निगरानी में मतों की गिनती की जाती है.
translations.translation: In the evening, votes are counted in strict monitoring by volunteers following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.

translations.source: बचत और सुविधा को ध्यान में रखते हुए, ASUS Eee PC को दुनियाभर में पेश किया गया, यह बात 2007 ताइपे आईटी महीने में चर्चा में रही.
translations.translation: With savings and convenience in mind, ASUS Eee PC was introduced worldwide, a topic discussed at the 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.

translations.source: लेकिन लैपटॉप कंप्यूटर पर उपभोक्ता बाज़ार मौलिक रूप से विविधतापूर्ण होगा और चीनी गणराज्य के कार्यकारी युआन द्वारा 2007 में ASUS को ताइवान सस्टैनबल अवॉर्ड से सम्मानित किए जाने के बाद बदल जाएगा.
translations.translation: But the consumer market for laptop computers will be fundamentally diverse and will change after ASUS was awarded the Taiwan Sustainability Award in 2007 by the executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.

translations.source: स्टेशन की वेबसाइट ने शो को “नए और ख़राब तरीके से अव्यवस्थित घुमाव के साथ पुराने समय के रेडियो थिएटर” के रूप में बताया है.
translations.translation: The station 's website describes the show as an old - time radio theater with a new and poorly organized turn.
translations.reference: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"

translations.source: इसके शुरुआती दिनों में, इस शो को केवल लंबे समय तक चलने वाली इंटरनेट रेडियो साइट TogiNet रेडियो, टॉक रेडियो पर केंद्रित एक साइट पर फ़ीचर किया गया था.
translations.translation: In its early days, the show was only featured on the long-running Internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on Talk Radio.
translations.reference: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.

translations.source: 2015 के आखिर में, TogiNet ने एक सहयोगी स्टेशन के रूप में AstroNet रेडियो की स्थापना की.
translations.translation: At the end of 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as an affiliate station.
translations.reference: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.

translations.source: शो में मूल रूप से पूर्वी टैक्सास के स्थानीय शौकिया वॉइस एक्टर्स को शामिल किया गया है.
translations.translation: The show primarily features local amateur voice actors from East Texas.
translations.reference: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.

translations.source: चूँकि बिशकेक की गलियों में कानून लागू करने वाले अधिकारी मौजूद नहीं थे, तो पूरी रात बड़े पैमाने पर लूट जारी रहने की सूचना मिली है.
translations.translation: Since no law enforcement officers were present on the streets of Bishkek, large - scale looting was reported to have continued throughout the night.
translations.reference: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.

translations.source: एक विश्लेषक के अनुसार बिश्केक अराजकता में जा रहा है, क्योंकि लोगों के झुंड सड़कों पर दुकानें लूट रहे हैं.
translations.translation: According to one analyst, Bishkek is going into chaos because crowds of people are robbing shops on the streets.
translations.reference: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.

translations.source: कई बिश्केक निवासियों ने दक्षिण के प्रदर्शनकारियों को इस अराजकता के लिए दोषी ठहराया।
translations.translation: Many Bishkek residents blamed southern protesters for the chaos.
translations.reference: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.

translations.source: साउथ अफ्रीका के रस्टेनबर्ग स्थित रॉयल बेफोकेंग स्टेडियम में एक रग्बी यूनियन ट्राई नेशन्स मैच में साउथ अफ्रीका ने ऑल ब्लैक्स (न्यूज़ीलैंड) को हराया है.
translations.translation: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union tri - nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rastenberg, South Africa.
translations.reference: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.

translations.source: अंतिम स्कोर एक अंक की जीत थी, 21 और 20, ऑल ब्लैक्स का 15 गेम लगातार जीतने का सिलसिला समाप्त हुआ ।
translations.translation: The final score was a one - point win, 21 and 20, ending the All Blacks ' 15-game winning streak.
translations.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.

translations.source: स्प्रिंगबोक्स के लिए, इसने पांच-मैचों की हार का सिलसिला समाप्त कर दिया.
translations.translation: For the Springboks, it ended a five-game losing streak.
translations.reference: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.

translations.source: अभी दो हफ़्ते पहले ही इस ट्रॉफ़ी को अपने नाम कर चुकी 'ऑल ब्लैक्स' टीम का यह फ़ाइनल मैच था.
translations.translation: This was the final match of the All Blacks team that had just won the trophy two weeks earlier.
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.

translations.source: इस सीरीज़ का फ़ाइनल मैच स्प्रिंगबोक्स और ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बीच, अगले हफ़्ते जोहान्सबर्ग के एलिस पार्क में खेला जाएगा.
translations.translation: The final match of the series will be played between Springboks and Australia next week at Alice Park in Johannesburg.
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.

translations.source: सोमवार, 10:08 बजे एक मामूली भूकंप ने पश्चिमी मोंटाना को हिला दिया।
translations.translation: Monday, 10:08 a.m., a minor earthquake shook western Montana.
translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.

translations.source: यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स जियोलॉजिकल सर्वे (यूएसजीएस) और इसके नेशनल अर्थक्वेक इंन्फ़ॉर्मेशन सेंटर द्वारा नुकसान की कोई तत्काल रिपोर्ट नहीं मिली है.
translations.translation: There have been no immediate reports of damage by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.

translations.source: भूकंप डिलन के उत्तर-उत्तर पूर्व में लगभग 20 किमी (15 मील) और ब्यूट के दक्षिण में लगभग 65 किमी (40 मील) की दूरी पर केंद्रित था.
translations.translation: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 mi) northeast of Dillon and about 65 km (40 mi) south of Butte.
translations.reference: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.

translations.source: H5N1, मनुष्यों को बर्ड फ्लू के घातक होने की पुष्टि की गई है, जो सोमवार को फ्रांस के पूर्व में ल्योन के पास दलदली भूमि में पाया गया है।
translations.translation: H5N1, deadly to humans, has been confirmed from bird flu, which was found in swampy ground near Lyon in eastern France on Monday.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.

translations.source: ऑस्ट्रेलिया, जर्मनी, स्लोवेनिया, बुल्गारिया, ग्रीस और इटली के बाद फ़्रांस यूरोपियन संघ का सातवाँ देश है, जो इस वायरस की मार झेल रहा है.
translations.translation: After Australia, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy, France is the seventh country in the European Union to be affected by the virus.
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.

translations.source: क्रोएशिया और डेनमार्क में H5N1 के संदिग्ध मामले अपुष्ट बने हुए हैं.
translations.translation: Suspicious cases of H5N1 remain unconfirmed in Croatia and Denmark.
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.

translations.source: चैंबर्स ने “व्यापक मौत, विनाश और पृथ्वी के लाखों निवासी पर आतंक के लिए भगवान पर मुकदमा चलाया था।”
translations.translation: The Chambers had sued God for widespread death, destruction and terror to millions of Earth's inhabitants.
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."

translations.source: एक संशयवादी चेंबर्स की दलील थी कि उसका मुकदमा “तुच्छ” है और “कोई भी किसी पर भी मुकदमा ठोंक सकता है”.
translations.translation: A suspicious Chambers argued that his trial was futile and that anyone could sue anyone.
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."

translations.source: केमिली सेंट-सेंस द्वारा, फ्रेंच ऑपेरा में प्रस्तुत कहानी, एक कलाकार की है “जिसका जीवन ड्रग्स के लिए प्यार और जापान से दर्शाया जाता है।”
translations.translation: The story, by Camille Saint-Saëns, presented in the French opera, is of an artist whose life is depicted by his love of drugs and Japan.
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."

translations.source: जिसके परिणामस्वरूप, मंच पर कलाकार गांजे भरी सिगरटें पीते हैं और ये थिएटर खुद दर्शकों को भी इसमें साथ शामिल होने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं.
translations.translation: As a result, the performers on the stage drink marijuana-filled cigarettes and these theatres themselves encourage the audience to join in.
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.

translations.source: पूर्व हाउस स्पीकर न्यूट गिंग्रिच, टेक्सास के गर्वनर रिक पैरी, और कांग्रेसवुमन मिशेल बैचमैन ने क्रमश: चौथा, पाँचवाँ और छठा स्थान हासिल किया.
translations.translation: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas Governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michelle Bachman finished fourth, fifth, and sixth, respectively.
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.

translations.source: नतीजा आने के बाद गिंगरिच ने सेंटोरम की तारीफ की, लेकिन रोमनी की निंदा की जिनकी ओर से आयोवा में गिंगरिच के खिलाफ दुष्प्रचार किया गया था.
translations.translation: After the results came, Gingerrich praised Centorum, but condemned Romney, who had campaigned against Gingerrich in Iowa.
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.

translations.source: पैरी ने कहा था कि वे “यह आकलन करने टैक्सास लौटेंगे कि आज के कॉकस के क्या परिणाम हैं, ताकि वे यह निर्धारित कर सकें कि इस दौड़ में उनके खुद के लिए आगे क्या राह है”, लेकिन बाद में उन्होंने कहा कि वे दौड़ में बने रहेंगे और 21 जनवरी को मुख्य रूप से साउथ कैरोलिना में मुकाबला करेंगे.
translations.translation: Perry had said that he would return to Texas to assess the results of today's caucuses, so that he could determine what path he had ahead of him in this race, but he later said that he would remain in the race and compete on January 21 mainly in South Carolina.
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.

translations.source: अगस्त में ऐम्स स्ट्रॉ पोल को जीतने वाली बेकमन ने अपना कैंपेन खत्म करने का फ़ैसला लिया.
translations.translation: Beckman, who won the AIIMS Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.

translations.source: फ़ोटोग्राफ़र को रोनाल्ड रीगन यूसीएलए मेडिकल सेंटर ले जाया गया, जहाँ बाद में उसकी मौत हो गई.
translations.translation: The photographer was taken to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he later died.
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.

translations.source: कहा जाता है कि वह 20 साल की उम्र में ही जीर्ण हो गया था। एक बयान में बीबर ने कहा, “हांलांकि मैं मौजूद नहीं था और न ही सीधे इस दुखद दुर्घटना से जुड़ा हुआ था, मेरी संवेदनाएं और प्रार्थनाएं पीड़ित के परिवार के साथ हैं।”
translations.translation: In a statement, Bieber said, "Although I was not present or directly involved in this tragic accident, my condolences and prayers are with the family of the victim".
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."

translations.source: एंटरटेनमेंट न्यूज़ वेबसाइट TMZ का मानना है कि फ़ोटोग्राफर ने अपना वाहन सेपुलवेडा बुलेवार्ड की दूसरी तरफ रोका था और सड़क पार करने और जारी रखने से पहले पुलिस स्टॉप की फ़ोटो लेने की कोशिश की. कैलिफोर्निया हाईवे पेट्रोल पुलिस अधिकारी ने ट्रैफिक स्टॉप का संचालन करते हुए उसे रोकने के लिए दो बार आदेश दिया.
translations.translation: The entertainment news website TMZ believes that the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and tried to take a photo of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing.
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.

translations.source: पुलिस के मुताबिक, फ़ोटोग्राफर को टक्कर मारने वाले वाहन चालक पर आपराधिक आरोप लगने की संभावना बहुत कम है.
translations.translation: According to the police, a driver who crashed into a photographer is unlikely to be charged with a criminal offence.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.

translations.source: एक दिन में केवल अठारह मैडल उपलब्ध होने के कारण, कई देश मैडल पोडियम पर चढ़ने में विफल रहे.
translations.translation: With only eighteen medals available in one day, many countries failed to climb the medal podium.
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.

translations.source: वे नीदरलैंड में शामिल हैं, जो अन्ना जोचेमसेन के साथ कल सुपर-जी में महिलाओं के स्टैंडिंग क्लास में नौवें स्थान पर रहा और फ़िनलैंड उसी प्रतियोगिता में काटजा सरीनन के साथ दसवें स्थान पर रहा.
translations.translation: They include the Netherlands, which finished ninth in the women's standing class in Super-G yesterday alongside Anna Jochemsen and Finland finished tenth with Katja Sarinen in the same competition.
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.

translations.source: पुरुषों के स्टैंडिंग सुपर-जी में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के मिशेल गौरले ग्यारहवें स्थान पर रहे. चेक प्रतियोगी ओल्डरिच जेलिनेक पुरुषों के सिटिंग सुपर-जी में सोलहवें स्थान पर रहे.
translations.translation: In the men's Standing Super-G, Australia's Michel Gurle finished eleventh. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's Standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.

translations.source: पुरुषों के सिटिंग सुपर-जी में मैक्सिको के अर्ली वेलास्केज़ पंद्रहवें स्थान पर रहे. पुरुषों के स्टैंडिंग सुपर-जी में न्यूज़ीलैंड के एडम हॉल नौवें स्थान पर रहे.
translations.translation: In the men's sitting super-G, Early Velázquez of Mexico finished fifteenth. In the men's standing super-G, Adam Hall of New Zealand finished ninth.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.

translations.source: पोलैंड निवासी नेत्रहीन पुरुष, मैकीज क्रेज़ेल और उनकी गाइड ऐना ऑगर्ज़िनस्का ने सुपर-जी मुकाबले में तेरहवाँ स्थान हासिल किया. इसके अलावा, दक्षिण कोरिया के जोंग सिऑर्क पार्क इस मुकाबले में चौबीसवें स्थान पर रहे.
translations.translation: The Polish-born blind man, Mackie's Krazel and his guide Anna Ogrzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G competition. In addition, Jung Siork Park, South Korea, finished twenty-fourth in the competition.
translations.reference: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.

translations.source: 2010 के भूकंप के बाद हैती में पहुँचे संयुक्त राष्ट्र के शांति सैनिकों को उस बीमारी को फैलाने के लिए दोषी ठहराया जा रहा है जो सेना के शिविर के पास शुरू हुई थी.
translations.translation: UN peacekeepers who arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake are being blamed for spreading the disease that started near the army camp.
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.

translations.source: मुकदमे के अनुसार, संयुक्त राष्ट्र के शिविर से निकलने वाले कचरे को अच्छी तरह से साफ़ नहीं किया गया था, जिस कारण बैक्टीरिया हैती की सबसे बड़ी, आर्टिबोनिट नदी की सहायक नदी में प्रवेश कर गया.
translations.translation: According to the lawsuit, the garbage coming out of the UN camp was not properly cleaned, causing the bacteria to enter the tributary of Haiti's largest, the Artibonite River.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.

translations.source: टुकड़ियों के पहुँचने से पहले, 1800 के दशक से हैती का कभी-भी बीमारियों से जुड़ी समस्याओं से सामना नहीं हुआ था.
translations.translation: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had never faced disease-related problems since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.

translations.source: हैतियन इंस्टीट्यूट फ़ॉर जस्टिस एंड डेमोक्रेसी ने स्वतंत्र अध्ययनों का हवाला देते हुए सुझाव दिया है कि नेपाली संयुक्त राष्ट्र शांति रक्षा बटालियन अनजाने में हैती में बीमारी लेकर आई है.
translations.translation: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy, citing independent studies, suggests that a Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion has unwittingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.

translations.source: इस बीमारी पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र के विशेषज्ञ डेनिएल लैंटगेन ने कहा कि इसका प्रकोप का कारण शांति रखने वाले हैं |
translations.translation: The United Nations expert on the disease, Daniel Lantgen, said that the cause of the outbreak was peaceful people.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.

translations.source: हैमिल्टन ने पुष्टि की कि हॉवर्ड यूनिवर्सिटी अस्पताल ने मरीज को स्थिर हालत में भर्ती किया।
translations.translation: Hamilton confirmed that Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.

translations.source: मरीज नाइजीरिया गया था, जहाँ इबोला वायरस के कुछ मामले सामने आए हैं.
translations.translation: The patient had traveled to Nigeria, where some cases of Ebola virus have been reported.
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.

translations.source: अस्पताल ने संक्रमण नियंत्रण के लिए नियमों का पालन किया है, इन नियमों में दूसरों के संभावित संक्रमण को रोकने के लिए रोगी को दूसरों से अलग करना शामिल है।
translations.translation: The hospital has followed the rules for infection control, these rules include isolating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.

translations.source: द सिंपसन के पहले साइमन ने कई शोज़ के कई पोज़िशन्स में काम किया था.
translations.translation: Prior to The Simpsons, Simon had acted in a number of television shows.
translations.reference: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.

translations.source: 1980 के दशक के दौरान उन्होंने टैक्सी, चीयर्स, और द ट्रेसी उल्मैन शो जैसे शो में काम किया था.
translations.translation: During the 1980s, she worked in shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: 1989 में उसने ब्रुक्स और ग्रोएनिंग के साथ द सिम्पसन को रचने में मदद की और वह शो की पहली राइटिंग टीम को नियुक्त करने के लिए उत्तरदायी था.
translations.translation: In 1989 she helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening and was responsible for appointing the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.

translations.source: 1993 में शो छोड़ने के बाद भी वे एग्जीक्यूटिव प्रोड्यूसर के पद पर बने रहे और हर सीज़न में लाखों-करोड़ों डॉलर की रॉयल्टी लेते रहे.
translations.translation: Even after leaving the show in 1993, he remained as executive producer and took royalties of millions and millions of dollars each season.
translations.reference: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.

translations.source: इससे पहले चीनी समाचार एजेंसी शिन्हुआ ने एक विमान के अपहरण की सूचना दी थी.
translations.translation: Earlier, the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported the hijacking of a plane.
translations.reference: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.

translations.source: फिर बाद की रिपोर्ट्स में कहा गया था कि प्लेन को बम के ख़तरे की जानकारी मिली थी और उसे अफ़गानिस्तान की तरफ़ मोड़कर कांधार में उतारा गया था.
translations.translation: Later reports said that the plane was aware of the bomb threat and was diverted to Afghanistan and landed in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.

translations.source: शुरुआती रिपोर्ट कहती है कि उरूमकी में आपातकालीन लैंडिंग से इनकार कर देने के बाद विमान को अफ़गानिस्तान वापस ले जाया गया था.
translations.translation: Initial reports say the plane was taken back to Afghanistan after refusing an emergency landing in Urumqi.
translations.reference: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.

translations.source: इरान में हवाई दुर्घटनाएँ सामान्य हैं, जिसके पास बरसों पुराने हवाई जहाज़ हैं जिनका सिविल और मिलिट्री ऑपरेशन्स में सही तरीके से मेनटेन नहीं किया गया.
translations.translation: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has decades-old aircraft that have not been properly maintained in civilian and military operations.
translations.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.

translations.source: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिबंधों का मतलब है कि नए विमान नहीं खरीदे जा सकते.
translations.translation: International restrictions mean that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.

translations.source: इस हफ्ते की शुरुआत में, एक पुलिस हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटना में तीन लोगों की मौत हो गई और तीन और घायल हो गए.
translations.translation: Earlier this week, three people died and three others were injured in a police helicopter crash.
translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.

translations.source: पिछले महीने ईरान में कई वर्षो बाद एक बेहद खराब हवाई हादसा हुआ, जब आर्मीनिया जा रहा एक विमान दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हो गया था, जिस पर सवार 168 लोगों की मौत हो गयी.
translations.translation: Last month, Iran suffered a devastating air disaster several years later, when a plane bound for Armenia crashed, killing 168 people on board.
translations.reference: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.

translations.source: उसी महीने एक अन्य विमान मशहद के एक रनवे से आगे निकल गया और एक दीवार से टकरा गया, जिसमें सत्रह की मौत हो गई।
translations.translation: In the same month another plane overtook a runway in Mashhad and collided with a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.

translations.source: एरोस्मिथ ने अपने दौरे के अपने शेष संगीत कार्यक्रमों को रद्द कर दिया है.
translations.translation: Aerosmith has canceled the remainder of his concert tour.
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.

translations.source: 16 सितंबर तक रॉक बैंड को अमेरिका और कनाडा की यात्रा करनी थी.
translations.translation: By September 16, the rock band had to tour the United States and Canada.
translations.reference: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.

translations.source: 5 अगस्त को प्रदर्शन के दौरान प्रमुख गायक स्टीवन टायलर के मंच से गिर कर घायल होने के बाद उन्होंने दौरे को रद्द कर दिया है.
translations.translation: He cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured in a fall from the stage during a performance on August 5.
translations.reference: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.

translations.source: सेट में एक-एक सर्विस दोनों पुरुषों के पास रहने के बाद मरे टाई ब्रेकर में पहला सेट हार गया.
translations.translation: The first set was lost in the Murray tie breaker after the two men had one-on-one service in the set.
translations.reference: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.

translations.source: डेल पोत्रो के पास दूसरे सेट की शुरुआत में एडवांटेज था, लेकिन 6-6 पर पहुँचने के बाद इसमें भी टाई ब्रेक की आवश्यकता थी.
translations.translation: Del Potro had an advantage at the start of the second set, but after reaching 6-6, he also needed a tie break.
translations.reference: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.

translations.source: पोट्रो ने इस पॉइंट पर अपने कंधे का इलाज करवाया लेकिन खेल में वापसी करने में कामयाब रहे.
translations.translation: Potro had his shoulder treated at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.

translations.source: कार्यक्रम सुबह 8:30 बजे शुरू हुआ था। स्थानीय समय (15.00 UTC)।
translations.translation: The event started at 8:30 am local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: देशभर के लोकप्रिय गायक श्री श्याम के चरणों में भजन या भक्तिगीत पेश करते हैं.
translations.translation: Popular singers from all over the country perform hymns or devotional songs on the steps of Shri Shyam.
translations.reference: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.

translations.source: गायक संजू शर्मा ने शाम की शुरुआत की, उसके बाद जय शंकर चौधरी ने छप्पन भोग भजन भी गाया, गायक, राजू खंडेलवाल ने उनका साथ दिया।
translations.translation: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, after which Jay Shankar Chaudhary also sang the Chhappan Bhoj Bhajan, singer, Raju Khandelwal accompanied him.
translations.reference: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.

translations.source: फिर, लक्खा सिंह ने भजन गायकी की कमान संभाली.
translations.translation: Then, Lakkha Singh took over the command of the Bhajan singer.
translations.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.

translations.source: बाबा श्याम को छप्पन भोग (हिंदू धर्म में, 56 अलग-अलग खाद्य पदार्थ, जैसे, मिठाई, फल, मेवा, व्यंजन आदि जो देवता को चढ़ाए जाते हैं) की 108 थाली परोसी गईं.
translations.translation: Baba Shyam was served 108 plates of Chappan Bhoga (in Hinduism, 56 different foods, such as sweets, fruits, mevas, dishes etc. that are offered to the god).
translations.reference: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.

translations.source: लक्खा सिंह ने छप्पन भोग भजन भी प्रस्तुत किया। गायक, राजू खंडेलवाल उनके साथ थे।
translations.translation: Lakkha Singh also performed the Chhappan Bhoj Bhajan. The singer, Raju Khandelwal was with him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.

translations.source: टोक्यो गेम शो में गुरूवार को निन्टेन्डो के अध्यक्ष सटोरू इवाता ने कंपनी के रिवोल्यूशन कंसोल के लिए कंट्रोलर डिजाइन का अनावरण किया.
translations.translation: At the Tokyo Game Show on Thursday, Nintendo President Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's Revolution console.
translations.reference: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.

translations.source: टेलीविज़न रिमोट से मिलता-जुलता, कंट्रोलर तीन-आयामी स्पेस में अपनी स्थिति को त्रिभुजाकार बनाने के लिए उपयोगकर्ता के टेलीविज़न के पास रखे गए दो सेंसर का उपयोग करता है.
translations.translation: Similar to a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed next to the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.

translations.source: यह डिवाइस को हवा में मूव करके खिलाड़ियों को एक्शन और मूवमेंट कंट्रोल करने की अनुमति देगा.
translations.translation: It will allow players to control action and movement by moving the device in the air.
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.

translations.source: जियानकार्लो फिशिचेला ने अपनी कार पर नियंत्रण खो दिया और शुरू करने के कुछ समय बाद ही दौड़ समाप्त कर दी.
translations.translation: Giancarlo Fischerella lost control of his car and finished the race shortly after starting.
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.

translations.source: उनकी टीम के साथी फ़र्नांडो अलोंसो अधिकांश दौड़ में आगे थे, लेकिन अपने अल्प-विराम के ठीक बाद इसे रोक दिया, शायद इसलिए क्योंकि सामने वाला पहिया बुरी तरह से सिकुड़ गया था.
translations.translation: His teammate Fernando Alonso was ahead in most races, but stopped shortly after his break, probably because the front wheel had shrunk badly.
translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.

translations.source: माइकल शूमाकर ने अलोंसो के कुछ समय बाद ही अपनी रेस समाप्त कर दी थी कयोंकि रेस के दौरान कई संघर्षों में सस्पेंशन को क्षति पहुँची थी।
translations.translation: Michael Schumacher had finished his race shortly after Alonso as the suspension was damaged in several clashes during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.

translations.source: “उन्होंने न्यूज़ कॉन्फ़्रेंस की एक ट्रांसक्रिप्ट में कहा कि वह बहुत प्यारी है और काफी अच्छा गाती भी है.”
translations.translation: She said in a transcript of a news conference that she is very cute and also sings very well.
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.

translations.source: “हर बार जब हम इस पर अभ्यास करते थे, तो मैं अपने दिल से भावविभोर हो जाता था।”
translations.translation: "Every time we practiced it, I was heartbroken. "
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."

translations.source: लॉन्च के लगभग 3 मिनट बाद, एक ऑन-बोर्ड कैमरा ने ईंधन टैंक से इन्सुलेशन फ़ोम के कई टुकड़े दिखाए.
translations.translation: About 3 minutes after launch, an on-board camera showed several pieces of insulation foam from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.

translations.source: हालाँकि, उन्होंने शटल में किसी तरह के नुकसान होने के बारे में नहीं सोचा.
translations.translation: However, they did not think of any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.

translations.source: नासा के शटल कार्यक्रम के प्रमुख एन. वेन हेल जूनियर ने कहा कि “जिस समय की हम चिंता कर रहे थे”, उसके बाद फोम गिरा था।
translations.translation: N. Wayne Hale, Jr., head of NASA's shuttle program, said foam fell after the time we were worried about.
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."

translations.source: प्रदर्शन चालू होने के पाँच मिनट में हवा शुरू हो जाती है, लगभग एक मिनट बाद, हवा 70 किमी/घंटा तक पहुँच रही है... फिर बारिश आती है, लेकिन इतनी तेज़ और इतनी बड़ी बूँदें कि यह आपकी त्वचा को सुई की तरह चुभती है, फिर आकाश से ओले गिरते हैं, लोग घबराते हैं, चिल्लाते हैं और अफरातफरी मच जाती है।
translations.translation: Five minutes into the performance, the wind starts blowing, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70 km/h... then it rains, but drops so fast and so big that it sucks your skin like a needle, then wet falls from the sky, people panic, scream and melt overnight.
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.

translations.source: आर्मंड वर्सास ने कहा, मैंने अपनी बहन और उसकी दोस्त को खो दिया, और रास्ते में व्हीलचेयर में दो दिव्यांग लोग थे, और लोग उनपर उछल रहे थे और उन्हें धक्का दे रहे थे”।
translations.translation: Armand Versace said, "I lost my sister and her friend, and along the way there were two disabled people in a wheelchair, and people were jumping on them and pushing them.
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.

translations.source: एनएचके ने भी सूचना दी कि निगाता प्रांत में काशीवाज़की करिवा परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र सामान्य रूप से काम कर रहा था.
translations.translation: NHK also reported that Kashivazki Kariva Nuclear Power Plant in Nigata Prefecture was functioning normally.
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.

translations.source: होकूरिकू इलेक्ट्रिक पॉवर कंपनी ने रिपोर्ट दी कि भूकंप का कोई असर नहीं हुआ है. यह भी बताया कि इसके शिका न्यूक्लियर पावर प्लांट के रिएक्टर नंबर 1 और 2 बंद कर दिए गए थे.
translations.translation: Hokkaido Electric Power Company reported that there was no impact of the earthquake. It also reported that the reactors No. 1 and No. 2 of its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.

translations.source: एक रिपोर्ट मे बताया गया है कि इस क्षेत्र 9400 घर पानी की कमी से जूझ रहे है और लगभग 100 बिजली की कमी से ।
translations.translation: According to one report, 9400 households in the region are struggling with water shortages and about 100 are struggling with electricity shortages.
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.

translations.source: कुछ सड़कें क्षतिग्रस्त हो गई हैं, प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में रेल सेवा बाधित हुई, और इशिकावा प्रांत में नोटो हवाई अड्डा बंद है.
translations.translation: Some roads have been damaged, rail services have been disrupted in the affected areas, and Noto Airport in Ishikawa Province has been closed.
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.

translations.source: एक बम गवर्नर जनरल के कार्यालय के बाहर फटा था.
translations.translation: A bomb exploded outside the Governor General's office.
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.

translations.source: दो घंटों में सरकारी इमारतों के पास दो बम विस्फोट हुए.
translations.translation: Two bombs exploded near government buildings in two hours.
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.

translations.source: कुछ रिपोर्ट आधिकारिक मृत्यु दर आठ बताती हैं, और आधिकारिक रिपोर्टों से पुष्टि होती है कि 30 तक घायल हुए हैं; लेकिन अंतिम संख्या अभी तक ज्ञात नहीं हैं।
translations.translation: Some reports indicate an official death rate of eight, and official reports confirm as many as 30 wounded; but the final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.

translations.source: सायन्यूरिक एसिड और मेलामाइन दोनों ही पालतू जानवरों के मूत्र के नमूनों में पाए गए जो दूषित पालतू भोजन के सेवन के बाद मर गए.
translations.translation: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples of pets who died after ingesting contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.

translations.source: विश्वविद्यालय के शोधकर्ताओं ने कहा कि दो कम्पाउन्ड एक दूसरे के साथ मिलकर क्रिस्टल बनाते हैं जो किडनी की कार्यप्रणाली को रोक कर सकते हैं.
translations.translation: Researchers at the university said that two compounds combine to form crystals that can inhibit the functioning of the kidneys.
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.

translations.source: शोधकर्ताओं ने मेलामाइन और सियानुरिक एसिड को मिलाने से बिल्ली के मूत्र में क्रिस्टल्स को बनते देखा.
translations.translation: Researchers saw crystals forming in the cat 's urine by mixing melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: जब इंफ्रारेड स्पेक्ट्रोस्कोपी (ऍफ़टीआईआर) से इन क्रिस्टलों की संरचना की तुलना की गई, तो वे प्रभावित पालतू जानवरों के मूत्र में पाए क्रिस्टल से मेल खाते हैं।
translations.translation: When the composition of these crystals was compared with infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), they matched the crystals found in the urine of the affected pets.
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: मुझे नहीं पता आपने इसपर ध्यान दिया है कि नहीं लेकिन, सेंट्रल अमेरिका से इस देश में आए ज़्यादातर प्रोडक्ट पर टैक्स नहीं लगाया जाता.
translations.translation: I don't know if you've noticed this, but most products coming into this country from Central America aren't taxed.
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.

translations.source: जबकी हमारे माल के अस्सी प्रतिशत पर केंद्रीय अमेरिकन देशों द्वारा कर लगाया गया। फिर भी हम आपका इलाज करते हैं।
translations.translation: While 80 percent of our goods are taxed by Central American countries, we still treat you.
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.

translations.source: यह मुझे समझ में नहीं आया; यह निश्चित रूप से उचित नहीं था।
translations.translation: I didn't understand; it certainly wasn't appropriate.
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.

translations.source: सभी लोगों से मेरा बस यही कहना है की आप हमारे साथ वैसा ही व्यवहार करें जैसा हम आपसे करते हैं |
translations.translation: All I want to say to everyone is treat us the same way we treat you.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.

translations.source: कैलिफोर्निया के गवर्नर अर्नोल्ड श्वार्ज़नेगर ने कानून में एक बिल पर हस्ताक्षर किए, जो नाबालिगों को हिंसक वीडियो गेम उन्हें बेचने या किराये पर देने से प्रतिबंध लगाता है।
translations.translation: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a bill into law that prohibits minors from selling or renting violent video games to them.
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: बिल के अनुसार कैलिफोर्निया राज्य में बेचे जाने वाले हिंसक वीडियो गेम को “18” की डीकैल रीडिंग से लेबल किया जाए और यह उनकी बिक्री नाबालिग को किए जाने को 1000 डॉलर प्रति अपराध के हिसाब से दंड योग्य बनाता है।
translations.translation: According to the bill, violent video games sold in the state of California should be labeled with a decal reading of 18 and this makes their sale to minors punishable by a fine of $1,000 per crime.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.

translations.source: लोक अभियोजन निदेशक, केइर स्टारर क्यूसी ने आज सुबह एक बयान दिया, जिसमें फोन और मूल्य दोनों पर मुकदमा चलाने की घोषणा की गई।
translations.translation: Director of Public Prosecutions, Kair Starrer QC made a statement this morning announcing that both the phone and the price would be prosecuted.
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.

translations.source: हुन ने इस्तीफा दे दिया है. मंत्रिमंडल में उनकी जगह सांसद एड डेवी लेंगे. सांसद नॉर्मन लैंब के व्यापार मंत्री बनने की उम्मीद है. यह पद डेवी के मंत्रिमंडल में जाने की वजह से खाली हुई है.
translations.translation: Hoon has resigned. He will be replaced by MP Ed Davey in the Cabinet. MP Norman Lamb is expected to become Minister of Commerce.
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.

translations.source: हुन और प्राइस को 16 फरवरी को वेस्टमिंस्टर मजिस्ट्रेट कोर्ट में पेश होना है.
translations.translation: Hoon and Price are due to appear in the Westminster Magistrates Court on 16 February.
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.

translations.source: मरने वालों में 25 साल का निकोलस एल्डन और 21 साल का ज़ेचरी कडबैक शामिल था. कडबैक ड्राइवर था.
translations.translation: Among the dead were 25-year-old Nicholas Eldon and 21-year-old Zachary Cadback, who was a Cadback driver.
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.

translations.source: एडगर वेगुइला के हाथ और जबड़े जख्मि हो गये, जबकि क्रिस्टोफ़र श्नाइडर को चेहरे की पुनर्निर्माण सर्जरी की आवश्यकता थी।
translations.translation: Edgar Weguila's hands and jaws were injured, while Christopher Schneider needed facial reconstruction surgery.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.

translations.source: उका का हथियार तब विफल हो गया जब पाँचवें व्यक्ति के सिर पर निशाना लगया. श्नाइडर को दर्द बना हुआ है, एक आँख में अंधापन, खोपड़ी का एक गायब भाग और टाइटेनियम से एक चेहरा फिर से बनाया गया है.
translations.translation: His weapon failed when a fifth person was shot in the head. Schneider remains in pain, blindness in one eye, a missing part of the skull and a face reconstructed from titanium.
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.

translations.source: श्नाइडर ने अपनी मातृभूमि में एक USAF बेस से वीडियो लिंक के माध्यम से गवाही दी.
translations.translation: Schneider testified via video link from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.

translations.source: बुधवार के आयोजन के बाद, कारपानेडो ने चैंपियनशिप में दो इंडिविज़ुअल रेस में हिस्सा लिया.
translations.translation: After Wednesday's event, Carpanedo took part in two individual races in the championship.
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.

translations.source: उसका पहला स्लैलम था, जहाँ उसने अपने पहले चक्र मे दौड़ को पूरा ना कर सका ।इस दौड़ में 116 प्रतियोगियों में से 36 खिलाड़ियों ने एक ही स्थान प्राप्त किया ।
translations.translation: His first was a slalom, where he failed to finish the race in his first cycle. 36 of the 116 contestants in this race won the same place.
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.

translations.source: उनकी दूसरी दौड़, विशाल स्लैलम, महिलाओं के समूह में 4: 41.30, 2: 11.60 मिनट के संयुक्त कार्यावधि के साथ पहले स्थान के फ़िनिशर ऑस्ट्रियन क्लाउडिया लोएश की तुलना में और 1: 09.02 मिनट हंगरी के नौवें स्थान के फ़िनिशर ग्नोगी दानी से दसवें स्थान पर धीमी गति से समाप्त हुई.
translations.translation: Her second race, the giant slalom, ended slowly in the women's group with a combined time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes compared to the first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and the ninth place finisher Hungarian Gnogi Dani in 1:09.02 minutes.
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.

translations.source: महिलाओं के वर्तमान समूह में चार स्कीयर अपना रन पूरा करने में असफल रहे और जायंट स्लैलम में कुल 117 में से 45 स्कीयर इस रेस में स्थान पाने में असफल रहे.
translations.translation: Four skiers in the current women 's group failed to complete their runs and 45 skiers out of a total of 117 in the giant slalom failed to qualify for this race.
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.

translations.source: मध्य प्रदेश पुलिस ने चोरी हुए लैपटॉप और मोबाइल फ़ोन हासिल किए.
translations.translation: Madhya Pradesh Police recovered stolen laptops and mobile phones.
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.

translations.source: डिप्टी इंस्पेक्टर डी के आर्य ने कहा, “हमने स्विस महिला के साथ बलात्कार करने वाले पाँच लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है और उनसे उस महिला का मोबाइल और लैपटॉप बरामद किया है”.
translations.translation: Deputy Inspector D K Arya said, "We have arrested five men who raped a Swiss woman and confiscated her mobile phone and laptop from them.
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".

translations.source: आरोपियों के नाम बाबा कंजर, भूथा कंजर, रामप्रो कंजर, गाज़ा कंजर और विष्णु कंजर हैं।
translations.translation: The names of the accused are Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: पुलिस अधीक्षक चंद्र शेखर सोलंकी ने कहा कि आरोपी ढके हुए चेहरे के साथ अदालत में पेश हुए थे.
translations.translation: Police Superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said that the accused had appeared in court with his face covered.
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.

translations.source: हालांकि तीन लोग घर के अन्दर थे फिर भी जब कार टकराई तब किसी को भी चोट नहीं आई।
translations.translation: Although three people were inside the house, no one was injured when the car collided.
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.

translations.source: हालाँकि, ड्राइवर के सिर में गंभीर चोटें आई थी.
translations.translation: However, the driver suffered serious head injuries.
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.

translations.source: जिस सड़क पर दुर्घटना हुई उसे कुछ समय के लिए बंद कर दिया गया था, जबकि आपाताकालीन सेवाओं ने ड्राइवर को लाल रंग की Audi TT से निकाल दिया था.
translations.translation: The road where the accident occurred was closed for a while, while the emergency services removed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.

translations.source: पहले उसे ग्रेट यारमोथ के जेम्स पैगट अस्पताल में भर्ती किया गया था.
translations.translation: He had previously been admitted to the James Pagot Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: बाद में उन्हें कैम्ब्रिज में एडेनब्रुक के अस्पताल में स्थानांतरित कर दिया गया.
translations.translation: He was later transferred to the Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

translations.source: तब से एडेकोया अपने बेटे की हत्या के आरोप में एडिनबर्ग शेरिफ कोर्ट में है।
translations.translation: Since then Adeccoya has been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with the murder of her son.
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.

translations.source: वह अभियोग और मुकदमा लंबित है, लेकिन किसी भी चश्मदीद गवाह को प्रभावित किया जा सकता है, क्योंकि उसकी छवि व्यापक रूप से प्रकाशित हुई है.
translations.translation: He is pending prosecution and trial, but any eyewitness can be affected because his image has been widely published.
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.

translations.source: यह ब्रिटेन में कहीं और आम बात है लेकिन स्कॉटिश न्याय अलग तरीके से काम करता है और अदालतों ने तस्वीरों के प्रकाशन को संभावित नुक़सानदेह के रूप मे देखा हैं |
translations.translation: It's common elsewhere in the UK, but Scottish justice works differently, and the courts have seen the publication of photographs as potentially harmful.
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.

translations.source: यूनिवर्सिटी ऑफ़ डंडी के प्रोफ़ेसर पामेला फ़र्ग्यूसन लिखते हैं, “अगर संदिग्धों के फ़ोटो आदि प्रकाशित होते हैं तो पत्रकारों को यह ख़तरनाक मार्ग पर चलना लगता है”.
translations.translation: Pamela Ferguson, a professor at the University of Dundee, writes, "If photos of suspects are published, journalists take this dangerous path".
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."

translations.source: क्राउन ऑफिस, जो कि अभियोग पक्ष के लिए ज़िम्मेदार है, ने पत्रकारों को संकेत दिया है कि कम से कम अभियोग लगने तक कोई टिप्पणी नहीं की जाएगी।
translations.translation: The Crown Office, which is responsible for the prosecution, has indicated to journalists that no comment will be made until at least an indictment is filed.
translations.reference: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.

translations.source: लीक के अनुसार, दस्तावेज़, सीमा विवाद को संदर्भित करेगा, जो फ़िलिस्तीन 1967 के मध्यपूर्व युद्ध से पहले सीमाओं के आधार पर चाहता है.
translations.translation: According to Leak, the document will refer to the border dispute that Palestine sought based on borders prior to the 1967 Middle East war.
translations.reference: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर शामिल किए गए अन्य विषयों में यरुशलम की भविष्य की स्थिति शामिल है जो दोनों देशों और जॉर्डन घाटी समस्या के लिए पवित्र है.
translations.translation: Other topics reportedly covered include the future status of Jerusalem which is sacred to both countries and the Jordan Valley problem.
translations.reference: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.

translations.source: किसी समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर होने के बाद इज़राइल, वर्तमान सैन्य स्थिति को अगले दस सालों तक बनाए रखने की मांग करता है, जबकि पीए वर्तमान सैन्य स्थिति को केवल पांच साल तक जारी रखने के लिए सहमत है।
translations.translation: Following the signing of an agreement, Israel seeks to maintain the current military status for the next ten years, while PA agrees to continue the current military status for only five years.
translations.reference: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.

translations.source: जैसा कि परीक्षण की निगरानी की गई थी और इसकी प्रभावशीलता का मूल्यांकन किया गया था, उसी तरह पूरक कीट नियंत्रण परीक्षण में निशानेबाज़ों की रेंजरों द्वारा बारीकी से निगरानी की जानी थी.
translations.translation: Just as the test was monitored and its effectiveness assessed, the target rangers in the supplemental pest control test had to be closely monitored.
translations.reference: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.

translations.source: NPWS और ऑस्ट्रेलिया के स्पोर्टिंग शूटर्स एसोसिएशन (NSW) के बीच साझेदारी में टैलेंट हंटिंग शो के तहत काबिल स्वयंसेवकों की भर्ती की गई थी.
translations.translation: Qualified volunteers were recruited under the Talent Hunting Show in partnership between NPWS and Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW).
translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.

translations.source: NPWS के उद्यान संरक्षण और विरासत के कार्यवाहक निदेशक, मिक ओफ्लिन के अनुसार, शूटिंग ऑपरेशन के लिए चुने गए पहले चार निशानेबाजों को सुरक्षा और प्रशिक्षण से जुड़े व्यापक निर्देश मिले हैं.
translations.translation: According to NPWS's Acting Director of Garden Conservation and Heritage, Mick O'Flin, the first four shooters selected for the shooting operation have received extensive instructions related to safety and training.
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.

translations.source: मार्टेली ने कल नौ सदस्यों के एक नए अनंतिम चुनाव परिषद (CEP) में शपथ ली.
translations.translation: Martelli was sworn in yesterday in a new nine-member provisional election council (CEP).
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.

translations.source: चार साल में यह मार्टेली का पांचवां सीईपी है।
translations.translation: This is Martelli 's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.

translations.source: पिछले महीने एक प्रेसिडेंशियल कमीशन ने देश को नए चुनावों की ओर बढ़ने के उपाय के पैकेज के एक हिस्से के रूप में सीईपी के पूर्व त्यागपत्र की अनुशंसा की.
translations.translation: Last month a Presidential Commission recommended the former resignation of CEP as part of the package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.

translations.source: अक्टूबर में शुरू हुए व्यापक शासन विरोधी प्रदर्शनों के लिए आयोग का गठन मार्टेली की प्रतिक्रिया स्वरूप हुआ था.
translations.translation: The commission was formed in response to Martelli's massive anti-government protests that began in October.
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.

translations.source: 2011 के बाद से, कभी-कभी चुनाव कराने में रहने की वजह से हिंसक विरोध शुरू हो गया था.
translations.translation: Since 2011, there have been violent protests occasionally due to staying in elections.
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.

translations.source: आईपॉड ओवरहीटिंग में खराबी के लगभग 60 मामले सामने आए हैं, जिससे कुल छह बार आग लगी और चार लोग मामूली रूप से जल गए।
translations.translation: Approximately 60 cases of malfunction in iPod overheating have been reported, resulting in a total of six fires and four minor burns.
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.

translations.source: जापान के अर्थव्यवस्था, व्यापार और उद्योग मंत्रालय (METI) ने कहा कि उसे उपकरणों से संबंधित 27 दुर्घटनाओं की जानकारी थी.
translations.translation: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said it was aware of 27 equipment-related accidents.
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.

translations.source: पिछले हफ्ते, METI ने घोषणा की कि Apple ने 34 ओवरहीटिंग के मामले सामने आये है , जिसे कंपनी ने गंभीरता से नहीं लिया ।
translations.translation: Last week, METI announced that Apple had reported 34 cases of overheating, which the company did not take seriously.
translations.reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."

translations.source: मंत्रालय ने एप्पल की रिपोर्ट के स्थगन को यह कहते हुए प्रतिक्रिया दी है कि वह “यकीनन पछतावे के योग्य है.”
translations.translation: The Ministry has responded to the postponement of Apple 's report by saying that it is certainly regrettable.
translations.reference: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."

translations.source: मारियाना में भूकंप का झटका स्थानीय समयानुसार सुबह 07:19 बजे (09:19 बजे जीएमटी शुक्रवार) आया।
translations.translation: The quake in Mariana occurred at 07:19 am local time (09:19 GMT Friday).
translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).

translations.translation: Of those, 34 percent voted in favour of making Queen Elizabeth II the last Queen of Australia.

translations.translation: Hydrogen ions are the protons whose electrons have removed them (because the hydrogen atom is made up of a proton and an electron combined).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).

translations.source: दोनों सूखे चूर्णों को एक साथ मिला लें और फिर साफ़ गीले हाथों से, एक गोले में निचोड़ लें.
translations.translation: Mix the two dried slices together and then squeeze them into a ball with clean, wet hands.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

translations.source: आपके हाथों की नमी बाहरी परतों के साथ क्रिया करेगी, जो अजीब महसूस करेगी और एक तरह का आवरण बनाएगी.
translations.translation: The moisture in your hands will interact with the outer layers, which will make you feel strange and form a kind of covering.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.

translations.source: हड़प्पा और मोहन-जोदड़ो के शहरों में लगभग हर घर में एक फ़्लश शौचालय था, जो एक परिष्कृत सीवेज सिस्टम से जुड़ा था.
translations.translation: Nearly every house in the towns of Harappa and Mohan - Joddo had a flush toilet connected to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.

translations.source: ग्रीस में मिनोअन सिटीज़ ऑफ़ क्रेटे एंड सांटोरिनी के घरों में सिवेज सिस्टम्स के अवशेष पाए गए हैं.
translations.translation: Remnants of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan Cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

translations.source: प्राचीन मिस्र, पर्शिया और चीन में शौचालय भी थे. रोमन सभ्यता में शौचालय स्नान घरों का हिस्सा होते थे, जिन्हें पुरुष और महिलाएँ दोनों ही समूह में एक साथ इस्तेमाल करते थे.
translations.translation: In ancient Egypt, Persia, and China, toilets were also used. In Roman civilization, toilets were part of bathhouses, used by both men and women together in groups.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.

translations.source: हज़ारों मील दूर किसी को कॉल करने के लिए, आप सैटेलाइट इस्तेमाल करते हैं.
translations.translation: To call someone thousands of miles away, you use a satellite.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

translations.source: अंतरिक्ष में उपग्रह को कॉल मिलता है और फिर इसे वापस नीचे, उसी समय परावर्तित करता है.
translations.translation: The satellite in space receives the call and then reflects it back down, at the same time.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.

translations.source: उपग्रह को एक रॉकेट से अंतरिक्ष में भेजा गया था. वैज्ञानिक अंतरिक्ष में दूरबीनों का उपयोग करते हैं क्योंकि पृथ्वी का वायुमंडल हमारे कुछ प्रकाश और दृश्य को अशुद्ध करता है.
translations.translation: The satellite was launched from a rocket into space. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth's atmosphere pollutes some of our light and view.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.

translations.source: स्पेस में सैटेलाइट या दूरबीन रखने के लिए 100 फ़ीट से ज़्यादा ऊँचे बड़े रॉकेट की ज़रूरत होती है.
translations.translation: A rocket greater than 100 feet in height is needed to carry a satellite or telescope into space.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.

translations.source: पहिये ने विश्व को असाधारण रूप से बदला है. सबसे बड़ी बात यह है कि पहिये ने हमें ज़्यादा आसान और तेज़ ट्रांस्पोर्टेशन देने का काम किया है.
translations.translation: The wheels have changed the world tremendously. The most important thing is that they have made transportation easier and faster.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.

translations.source: इसने हमें ट्रेन, कार और इसी प्रकार के कई अन्य परिवहन के साधन दिए हैंं।
translations.translation: It has given us trains, cars and many other similar means of transportation.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.

translations.source: उनके अंतर्गत अधिक मध्यम आकार की बिल्लियाँ होती हैं जो खरगोशों से लेकर मृगों और हिरणों तक के मध्यम आकार के शिकार खाती हैं.
translations.translation: They have more medium - sized cats that feed on medium - sized prey from rabbits to rabbits and deer.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.

translations.source: अंत में, कई ऐसी छोटी बिल्लियाँ (लूज़ पेट कैट्स सहित) हैं जो कीट, रोडंट्स, छिपकलियों और पक्षियों जैसे कई छोटे जीवों को खाती हैं.
translations.translation: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat many small organisms such as insects, rodents, lizards and birds.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.

translations.source: प्रत्येक बिल्ली के पास एक ख़ास काम रहता है जो उसे दूसरों के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करने से रोकता है.
translations.translation: Each cat has a specific function that prevents it from competing with others.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.

translations.source: शेर प्राइड नामक बड़े समूहों में रहने वाली सबसे बड़ी सामाजिक बिल्लियाँ हैं.
translations.translation: Lions Pride are the largest social cats that live in large groups.
