translations.source: यूनिवर्सिटी ऑफ़ मिशिगन के विशेषज्ञ टिफ़नी एनजी ने इस बात पर भी गौर किया कि यह दुनिया का पहला घंटा था जिसे अश्वेत संगीतकार डियोनिसियो ए. लिंड द्वारा बजाया गया, वे 18 साल पहले रिवरसाइड चर्च में एक बहुत बड़ा घंटा बजाते थें।
translations.translation: Tiffany Ng., an expert at the University of Michigan, also noted that this was the world's first clock to be played by the black musician Dionisio A. Lind, who played a very large clock 18 years ago at Riverside Church.
translations.reference: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.

translations.source: मि. मेर्रीवेदर ने बताया कि सेंट मार्टिन में उनकी जगह किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति को नहीं रखा गया।
translations.translation: Mr. Meriwether reported that no other person was placed in his place at St. Martin.
translations.reference: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.

translations.source: पिछले कुछ महीनों में सेंट मार्टिन में जो कुछ भी हुआ, वह शिल्पकारों और ठेकेदारों की जटिल कहानी बन गई, इनमें से कुछ को चर्च के आम लीडरों द्वारा नियुक्त किया गया और बाकी को धर्म से जुड़े प्रांतों द्वारा।
translations.translation: What has happened in St. Martin over the past few months has become a complex story of craftsmen and contractors, some of whom have been appointed by the general leaders of the church and the rest by the religious provinces.
translations.reference: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.

translations.source: वेस्ट्री (जहां पूजा का सामान रखा जाता है) पर आम लीडरों से बने पैरिश (इलाके के पादरियों) का अधिकार हो गया - जुलाई में प्रांत में इस बात पर चिंता जताई गई कि प्रांत वेस्ट्री के लिए "लागतों को पूरा करने की मांग करेगा”, भले ही वेस्ट्री प्रांत में नियुक्त किए गए शिल्पकारों और ठेकेदारों को नियुक्त करने में शामिल हो या नहीं।
translations.translation: The vestry (where the objects of worship are kept) came under the authority of a parish made up of common leaders - in July the province expressed concern that the province would "seek to cover the costs" for vestry, whether or not vestry was involved in the recruitment of craftsmen and contractors appointed in the province.
translations.reference: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.

translations.source: इलाके के कुछ पादरियों ने प्रांत की ओर से स्पष्टता की कमी के लिए शिकायत की।
translations.translation: Some local priests complained of a lack of clarity on the part of the province.
translations.reference: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.

translations.source: केकड़ा पकड़ने के लिए गोताखोरी करते हुए एक 13 वर्षीय किशोर शार्क द्वारा किए गए हमले से घायल हो गया
translations.translation: A 13-year-old teenager was injured by a shark attack while diving to catch cockroaches
translations.reference: Shark injures 13-year-old on lobster dive in California

translations.source: अधिकारियों का कहना है कि शनिवार को 13 वर्षीय किशोर पर एक शार्क ने हमला करके उसे घायल कर दिया, उस समय वह लॉबस्टर सीजन के उद्घाटन दिवस पर कैलिफोर्निया में गोता लगाते हुए केकड़ा पकड़ रहा था।
translations.translation: Officials say the 13-year-old was attacked and injured by a shark on Saturday while he was snorkeling in California on the opening day of the lobster season.
translations.reference: A shark attacked and injured a 13-year-old boy Saturday while he was diving for lobster in California on the opening day of lobster season, officials said.

translations.source: हमला सुबह 7 बजे से पहले एंसिनिटास के बीकन बीच के पास हुआ।
translations.translation: The attack took place just before 7 am near Beacon Beach in Encinitas.
translations.reference: The attack occurred just before 7 a.m. near Beacon's Beach in Encinitas.

translations.source: सैन डिएगो के KSWB-TV से चैड हम्मेल ने कहा कि शनिवार की सुबह वह करीब आधे घंटे से दोस्तों के साथ गोते लगा रहा था, उसी समय उसे मदद के लिए चिल्लाते हुए किसी लड़के की आवाज़ सुनाई दी और उसके बाद वह एक समूह के साथ उसे पानी से बाहर निकालने के लिए पहुंचा।
translations.translation: Chad Hummel of San Diego's KSWB-TV said that on Saturday morning he had been diving with friends for about half an hour, at the same time he heard a boy screaming for help and then he reached out with a group to get him out of the water.
translations.reference: Chad Hammel told KSWB-TV in San Diego he had been diving with friends for about half an hour Saturday morning when he heard the boy screaming for help and then paddled over with a group to help pull him out of the water.

translations.source: हम्मेल ने बताया कि पहले उसे ऐसा लगा लड़के ने केकड़ा पकड़ने के उत्साह में आवाज़ लगाई है, लेकिन फिर उसने महसूस किया कि वह चिल्ला रहा था, 'मुझे कुछ काट रहा है!
translations.translation: Hummel said that at first he felt that the boy had sounded enthusiastic about catching a cockroach, but then he realized that he was shouting, 'Something is biting me!
translations.reference: Hammel said at first he thought it was just excitement of catching a lobster, but then he "realized that he was yelling, 'I got bit!

translations.source: मुझे कुछ काट रहा है!'
translations.translation: Something is cutting me!'
translations.reference: I got bit!'

translations.source: हम्मेल ने बताया कि जब उसने लड़के को देखा तो उसने पाया कि लड़के की पूरी कंठास्थि फट गई थी।
translations.translation: Hummel said that when he looked at the boy he found that the boy 's entire collarbone had exploded.
translations.reference: His whole clavicle was ripped open," Hammel said he noticed once he got to the boy.

translations.source: हम्मेल ने कहा, "मैंने सभी की आवाज़ लगाई कि वे पानी से बाहर निकल जाएं: पानी में एक शार्क है!''
translations.translation: Hummel said, "I called everyone out of the water: there is a shark in the water!"
translations.reference: "I yelled at everyone to get out of the water: 'There's a shark in the water!'" Hammel added.

translations.source: सैन डिएगो के रेडी चिल्ड्रन हॉस्पिटल में किशोर को भर्ती कराया गया जहां उसकी हालत गंभीर बताई जा रही है।
translations.translation: The teenager was admitted to Reddy Children's Hospital in San Diego where his condition is described as critical.
translations.reference: The boy was airlifted to Rady Children's Hospital in San Diego where he is listed in critical condition.

translations.source: हमला करने वाले शार्क की प्रजाति का पता नहीं लग पाया है।
translations.translation: The species of the attacking shark has not been identified.
translations.reference: The species of shark responsible for the attack was unknown.

translations.source: लाइफगार्ड कैप्टन लैरी गिल्स ने मीडिया के साथ हुई एक वार्ता में बताया कि कुछ हफ़्ते पहले इलाके में एक शार्क के होने का पता लगाया गया था, लेकिन यह पाया गया था कि यह शार्क की खतरनाक प्रजाति नहीं है।
translations.translation: Lifeguard Captain Larry Giles said in a conversation with the media that a shark was spotted in the area a few weeks ago, but it was found that it is not a dangerous species of shark.
translations.reference: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles said at a media briefing that a shark had been spotted in the area a few weeks earlier, but it was determined not to be a dangerous species of shark.

translations.source: गिल्स ने आगे बताया कि पीड़ित के धड़ की ऊपरी जगह गंभीर रूप से घायल है।
translations.translation: Gilles further reported that the upper part of the victim 's torso is severely injured.
translations.reference: Giles added the victim sustained traumatic injuries to his upper torso area.

translations.source: जांच और सुरक्षा उद्देश्य से अधिकारियों ने 48 घंटे के लिए कैसब्लाड के पोंटो बीच से लेकर एसिनिटास के स्वामिस बीच तक बीच एक्सेस को रोक दिया है।
translations.translation: For investigative and security purposes, officers have blocked beach access from Ponto Beach, Caseblad to Swamis Beach, Asinitas for 48 hours.
translations.reference: Officials shut down beach access from Ponto Beach in Casablad to Swami's in Ecinitas for 48 hours for investigation and safety purposes.

translations.source: गिल्स ने बताया कि इलाके में 135 से ज़्यादा शार्क प्रजातियां हैं, लेकिन उनमें से ज़्यादातर को खतरनाक नहीं माना जाता है।
translations.translation: According to Giles, there are more than 135 species of sharks in the area, but most of them are not considered dangerous.
translations.reference: Giles noted that there are more than 135 shark species in the area, but most are not considered dangerous.

translations.source: यूके ब्यूटी मार्केट में जाने के लिए Sainsbury's की योजनाएं
translations.translation: Sainsbury's plans to go to the UK beauty market
translations.reference: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market

translations.source: Sainsbury's ब्यूटी प्रोडक्ट वाले विशेषज्ञ सहायकों को नियुक्त करके डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर स्टाइल वाले Boots, Superdrug और Debenhams को शामिल करने जा रहा है।
translations.translation: Sainsbury's is going to hire expert assistants with beauty products to include department store style Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams.
translations.reference: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.

translations.source: फ़ैशन के सामान और घर के सामान की बिक्री में गिरावट के जारी रहने के बावजूद यह अच्छी मात्रा के साथ यूके के 2.8 बिलियन पाउंड वाले ब्यूटी मार्केट में शामिल होने जा रहा है, इन वृहद मात्रा में ब्यूटी उत्पादों की जांच देश भर के 11 स्टोरों में की जाएगी और अगर यह योजना सफल रही, तो अगले साल अधिक स्टोर पर कारोबार को बढ़ाया जाएगा।
translations.translation: Despite the continued decline in sales of fashion and household goods, it is well on its way to joining the UK's £2.8 billion beauty market, these large quantities of beauty products will be tested in 11 stores across the country and if the scheme is successful, the turnover in more stores will be increased next year.
translations.reference: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.

translations.source: ब्यूटी में किया जाने वाला निवेश सुपरमार्केट में किया जा रहा है, जिसका उद्देश्य टीवी, माइक्रोवेव और घर के सामानों को लाने के बाद मार्केट में अपनी जगह का पता लगाना है।
translations.translation: The investment in beauty is being made in the supermarket, which aims to find its place in the market after the introduction of TVs, microwaves and household appliances.
translations.reference: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.

translations.source: Sainsbury's ने बताया कि इससे पहली बार 3,000 उत्पादों तक को लाने से इसके पेश किए जाने वाले उत्पाद दोगुने हो जाएंगे इसमें पहली बार Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman और Dr. PawPaw जैसे ब्रांड को शामिल किया जा रहा है।
translations.translation: Sainsbury's reported that this will double its product offerings by bringing up to 3,000 products for the first time, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.
translations.reference: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.

translations.source: L'Oreal, Maybelline और Burt's Bees के मौजूदा उत्पादों को भी Boots जैसी शॉप में पाए जाने वाले ब्रांडेड उत्पादों के साथ ज़्यादा मौके मिलेंगे।
translations.translation: Existing products from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also have more opportunities with branded products found in shops like Boots.
translations.reference: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.

translations.source: सुपरमार्केट भी अपने बुटीक मेकअप उत्पादों को फिर से शुरू कर रहा है, ताकि ज़्यादातर उत्पाद वीगन-फ्रेंडली हों - इससे छोटे-मोटे दुकानदारों में इसकी मांग कुछ हद तक तेज़ी से बढ़ेगी।
translations.translation: Supermarkets are also reintroducing their boutique make-up products, so that most products are vegan-friendly - this will somewhat accelerate the demand for it among small shoppers.
translations.reference: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.

translations.source: इसके अतिरिक्त, परफ्यूम रिटेलर फ्रैगरेंस शॉप भी Sainsbury's के दो स्टोरों में विशेष सुविधा की जांच करेगी, जिनमें से पहला पिछले हफ़्ते क्रॉयडन, साउथ लंदन में खुला था और दूसरा इस साल के अंत में सेली ओक, बर्मिंघम में खुलने वाला है।
translations.translation: In addition, the fragrance retailer Fragrance Shop will also check out the special feature at two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened last week in Croydon, South London and the second is due to open in Selby Oak, Birmingham later this year.
translations.reference: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.

translations.source: ऑनलाइन शॉपिंग और स्थानीय सुविधा स्टोर यानी सुपरमार्केट में हर रोज़ खाद्य पदार्थों की बिकने वाली मात्रा के कम होने वाले शिफ्ट में लोगों के विज़िट को बढ़ाने के लिए ज़्यादा-से-ज़्यादा कोशिशें की जा रही हैं।
translations.translation: More and more efforts are being made to increase people's visits to online shopping and local convenience stores, i.e. supermarkets, in the shrinking daily shifts of food sales.
translations.reference: Online shopping and a shift towards buying small amounts of food daily at local convenience stores means supermarkets are having to do more to persuade people to visit.

translations.source: Sainsbury's के चीफ एग्जीक्यूटिव, माइक कूप ने बताया कि आउटलेट पर डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर की तरह लोग ज़्यादा तेज़ी से आएंगे क्योंकि सुपरमार्केट चेन ज़्यादा सेवाओं और गैर-खाद्य पदार्थों वाले छूटदाताओं Aldiऔर Lidl से भिड़ने की कोशिश कर रही है।
translations.translation: Mike Coop, chief executive of Sainsbury's, said that people will come to the outlet more quickly, like department stores, as supermarket chains try to compete with discount providers Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food items.
translations.reference: Mike Coupe, the chief executive of Sainsbury's, has said the outlets will look increasingly like department stores as the supermarket chain tries to fight back against the discounters Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food.

translations.source: Sainsbury's सैकड़ों स्टोर में Argos के आउटलेट लगा रहा है और दो साल पहले जब से यह दोनों चैन को लेकर आया है, तब से इसने कई स्टोर भी खोलें हैं, जिससे यह पता चलता है कि किराने सामान की बिक्री को बढ़ावा दिया गया है और सौदे को ज़्यादा फ़ायदेमंद बनाया गया है।
translations.translation: Sainsbury's has installed Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also opened several stores since it introduced both chains two years ago, suggesting that grocery sales have been boosted and the deal has become more profitable.
translations.reference: Sainsbury's has been putting Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also introduced a number of Habitats since it bought both chains two years ago, which it says has bolstered grocery sales and made the acquisitions more profitable.

translations.source: सुपरमार्केट द्वारा ब्यूटी और फ़ार्मेसी उत्पादों को फिर से बाज़ार में लाने के पिछले प्रयास में विफलता मिली थी।
translations.translation: Previous efforts by supermarkets to bring beauty and pharmacy products back to market had failed.
translations.reference: The supermarket's previous attempt to revamp its beauty and pharmacy departments ended in failure.

translations.source: Sainsbury's ने 2000 के दशक की शुरुआत में Boots के साथ मिलकर व्यवसाय किया था, लेकिन अपने सुपरमार्केट में दवाई की दुकानों से मिलने वाले आयों में विभाजन के तरीके की वजह से इस मिले-जुले व्यवसाय को खत्म करना पड़ा था।
translations.translation: Sainsbury's had a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the merger had to be terminated due to the way in which revenues from pharmacies in its supermarket were divided.
translations.reference: Sainsbury's tested a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the tie-up ended after a row over how to split the revenues from the chemist's stores in its supermarkets.

translations.source: तीन साल पहले, Sainsbury's ने फ़ार्मेसी व्यवसाय के 281 स्टोर को 125 मिलियन पाउंड में Lloyds फ़ार्मेसी चेन के मालिक सेलेसियो को बेचा, उसके बाद नई रणनीति सामने आई।
translations.translation: Three years ago, Sainsbury's sold 281 stores of the pharmacy business to Lloyds Pharmacy chain owner Cellacio for £125 million, followed by a new strategy.
translations.reference: The new strategy comes after Sainsbury's sold its 281-store pharmacy business to Celesio, the owner of the Lloyds Pharmacy chain, for £125m, three years ago.

translations.source: इसमें बताया गया कि Lloyds चार स्टोर में La Roche-Posay और Vichy के साथ-साथ कई बेहतरीन लक्जरी स्किनकेयर ब्रांडों को जोड़कर योजना में अहम भूमिका निभाएगा।
translations.translation: It said that Lloyds will play a key role in the scheme by merging La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores as well as several top luxury skincare brands.
translations.reference: It said Lloyds would play a role in the plan, by adding an extended range of luxury skincare brands including La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores.

translations.source: Sainsbury's के कमर्शियल डायरेक्टर, पॉल मिल्स-हिक्स ने कहा: “हम अपने ब्यूटी उत्पादों के रूप-रंग को बदल दिया है, ताकि अपने ग्राहकों के लिए परिवेश को बढ़ा सकें।
translations.translation: Paul Mills-Hicks, Commercial Director of Sainsbury's, said: "We have changed the look and colour of our beauty products to enhance the environment for our customers.
translations.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, Sainsbury's commercial director, said: "We've transformed the look and feel of our beauty aisles to enhance the environment for our customers.

translations.source: हमने खास तौर पर उन प्रशिक्षित सहकर्मियों को भी जोड़ा है जो सलाह देने में हमारी सहायता करेंगे।
translations.translation: We have also specially trained colleagues who will assist us in advising.
translations.reference: We've also invested in specially trained colleagues who will be on hand to offer advice.

translations.source: हमने अपने ब्रांड के दायरे को हर व्यक्ति की ज़रूरत और आकर्षक परिवेश  के हिसाब से और सुविधाजनक स्थानों पर बनाया है, जिसका मतलब है कि हम ब्यूटी उत्पादों के लिए आकर्षक गंतव्य तक पहुँच चुके हैं जो खरीदारी के पुराने तरीके को चुनौती देते हैं।"
translations.translation: We have adapted our brand scope to everyone's needs and attractive environments and convenient locations, which means we have reached an attractive destination for beauty products that challenge the old fashioned way of shopping".
translations.reference: Our range of brands is designed to suit every need and the alluring environment and convenient locations mean we're now a compelling beauty destination which challenges the old way of shopping."

translations.source: 11 मिलियन पाउंड के सौदे से होली विलुबी के अलग होने पर पीटर जोन्स ने ‘नाराज़गी’ जाहिर की
translations.translation: Peter Jones expressed his displeasure at Holly Willoughby's departure from the £11m deal.
translations.reference: Peter Jones 'furious' after Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal

translations.source: Marks & Spencer और ITV के साथ अपने नए कॉन्ट्रैक्ट पर फ़ोकस करने के लिए जब टीवी प्रेजेंटर होली बिलुबी ने Dragons Den के स्टार पीटर जोन्स के लाइफ़स्टाइल ब्रांड व्यवसाय के लिए 11 मिलियन पाउंड के सौदे से अलग होने का फ़ैसला लिया, तो पीटर जोन्स ने इस पर ‘नाराज़गी’ दिखाई।
translations.translation: In order to focus on his new contract with Marks & Spencer and ITV, when TV presenter Holly Biluby decided to part ways with Dragons Den star Peter Jones' £11 million deal for the lifestyle brand business, Peter Jones expressed displeasure.
translations.reference: Dragons Den star Peter Jones left 'furious' after TV presenter Holly Willoughby pulls out of £11million deal with his lifestyle brand business to focus on her new contracts with Marks and Spencer and ITV

translations.source: बिलुबी के पास अपने होमवियर और एक्सेसरीज़ ब्रांड Truly के लिए बिल्कुल भी समय नहीं है।
translations.translation: Bilubi has absolutely no time for his homewear and accessories brand Truly.
translations.reference: Willoughby has no time for their homewear and accessories brand Truly.

translations.source: इन दोनों के कारोबार की तुलना ग्वेनेथ पाल्ट्रो के ब्रांड Goop से की जा रही थी।
translations.translation: The two businesses were being compared to Gwyneth Paltrow 's Goop brand.
translations.reference: The pair's business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand.

translations.source: इस 37 वर्षीय मॉर्निंग प्रेजेंटर ने Instagram पर अलग होने की घोषणा की।
translations.translation: The 37 - year - old morning presenter announced his split on Instagram.
translations.reference: This Morning presenter, 37, took to Instagram to announce she is leaving.

translations.source: होली बिलुबी ने Dragons Den के स्टार पीटर जोन्स के साथ आखिरी क्षण में अपने आकर्षक लाइफ़स्टाइल ब्रांड के कारोबार से खुद को अलग कर लिया - ताकि वह Marks & Spencer और ITV के साथ अपने नए बेहतरीन कॉन्ट्रैक्ट पर पूरा फ़ोकस कर सके।
translations.translation: Holly Bilubi separated herself from her charming lifestyle brand business with Dragons Den star Peter Jones at the last minute - so that she could fully focus on her new best contract with Marks & Spencer and ITV.
translations.reference: Holly Willoughby has left Dragons" Den star Peter Jones fuming by pulling out of their lucrative lifestyle brand business at the last minute - to focus on her own new bumper contracts with Marks & Spencer and ITV.

translations.source: सूत्रों से पता चला है कि जब टीवी की गोल्डेन गर्ल ने मंगलवार को मार्लो, बकिंघमशायर में स्थित जोन्स के कारोबार के हेडक्वार्टर में तनावपूर्ण बैठक के दौरान इस बात को स्वीकार किया कि वह उसके नए सौदे - जिसकी कीमत 1.5 मिलियन पाउंड है - से अलग हो रही है, तो जोन्स ने इस पर नाराज़गी जाहिर की, इसका मतलब यह है कि अब बिलुबी के पास उनके होमवियर और एक्सेसरीज़ ब्रांड Truly को देने के लिए पर्याप्त समय नहीं है।
translations.translation: Sources have revealed that when TV's Golden Girl admitted during a stressful meeting at Jones's business headquarters in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, on Tuesday that she was breaking away from her new deal - worth £1.5million - Jones expressed resentment over it, meaning that now Biluby does not have enough time to give up her homewear and accessories brand Truly.
translations.reference: Sources say Jones was "furious" when TV's golden girl admitted during a tense meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of his business empire in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, that her new deals - worth up to £1.5 million - meant she no longer had enough time to devote to their homewear and accessories brand Truly.

translations.source: कारोबार की तुलना ग्वेनेथ पाल्ट्रो के ब्रांड Goop से की जा रही थी और इसे विलुबी द्वारा दिए जाने वाले अनुमानित 11 मिलियन पाउंड से दोगुना बढ़ाने पर विचार किया जा रहा था।
translations.translation: The turnover was being compared to Gwyneth Paltrow 's brand Goop and was being considered to double from the estimated £11 million given by Willubi.
translations.reference: The business had been likened to Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop brand and was tipped to double Willoughby's estimated £11 million fortune.

translations.source: 37 वर्षीय विलुबी ने Instagram पर यह घोषणा की कि वह Truly से अलग हो रही है, उसके बाद जोन्स अपने एक हॉलिडे होम में जाने के लिए ब्रिटेन से चले गए।
translations.translation: 37-year-old Wilubie announced on Instagram that she was separating from Truly after Jones moved from Britain to move into one of her holiday homes.
translations.reference: As Willoughby, 37, took to Instagram to announce she was leaving Truly, Jones jetted out of Britain to head for one of his holiday homes.

translations.source: एक सूत्र ने बताया: "होली की प्राथमिकताओं में Truly कभी सबसे ऊपर था।
translations.translation: One source reported: "Truly was once at the top of Holi's priorities.
translations.reference: A source said: "Truly was by far the top of Holly's priorities.

translations.source: इसे उसका लॉन्ग-टर्म भविष्य माना जा रहा था जिससे यह ब्रांड अगले कुछ दशकों में बहुत आगे बढ़ने वाला था।
translations.translation: It was seen as its long-term future and the brand was going to go a long way in the next few decades.
translations.reference: It was going to be her long-term future that would see her through the next couple of decades.

translations.source: उसके फ़ैसले ने इस कारोबार से जुड़े हर व्यक्ति को चौंका दिया।
translations.translation: His decision shocked everyone involved in the business.
translations.reference: Her decision to pull out left everyone involved absolutely stunned.

translations.source: मंगलवार को जो हुआ, इस बात पर कोई भी व्यक्ति यकीन नहीं कर सकता था, यह शुरू होने के बहुत करीब था।
translations.translation: No one could believe what happened on Tuesday, it was very close to beginning.
translations.reference: Nobody could believe what was happening on Tuesday, it was so close to the launch.

translations.source: मार्लो हेडक्वार्टर में स्थित गोदाम ऐसे सामानों से भरा पड़ा है, जिनकी बिक्री की जानी है।"
translations.translation: The warehouse at Marlowe's headquarters is full of items to be sold".
translations.reference: There is a warehouse full of goods at the Marlow HQ which are ready to be sold."

translations.source: विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि ब्रिटेन की सबसे ज़्यादा अमीर स्टार इस मॉर्निंग प्रेजेंटर के अलग हो जाने से फ़र्म को कई मिलियन का नुकसान हो सकता है क्योंकि इसने कुशन और मोमबत्तियों से लेकर कपड़ों और होमवियर जैसे उत्पादों में बहुत ज़्यादा निवेश किया है और इस बात की संभावना भी जताई जा रही है इसे शुरू होने में भी देरी हो सकती है।
translations.translation: Experts believe that the departure of Britain's richest star this morning presenter could cost the firm several million dollars as it has invested heavily in products ranging from cushions and candles to clothing and homewares, and it is also expected to delay its launch.
translations.reference: Experts believe the departure of the This Morning presenter, who is among Britain's most bankable stars, could cost the firm millions due to hefty investment in products ranging from cushions and candles to clothing and homewear, and the potential for further delays to its launch.

translations.source: साथ ही, इससे एक लंबी दोस्ती भी समाप्त हो सकती है।
translations.translation: At the same time, it can also end a long friendship.
translations.reference: And it could mean the end of a long friendship.

translations.source: बिलुबी के तीन बच्चे और पति डैन बाल्डविन पिछले दस सालों से जोन्स और उनकी पत्नी तारा कैप के काफ़ी करीब रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Biloubi's three children and husband Dan Baldwin have been very close to Jones and his wife Tara Cap for the past ten years.
translations.reference: Mother-of-three Willoughby and husband Dan Baldwin have been close to Jones and his wife Tara Capp for ten years.

translations.source: विलुबी ने 2016 में कैप के साथ मिल कर Truly की शुरुआत की थी और मार्च में 52 वर्षीय जोन्स चेयरमैन के तौर पर इससे जुड़े थे।
translations.translation: Willoughby co-founded Truly with Cap in 2016 and joined as Chairman in March at the age of 52.
translations.reference: Willoughby set up Truly with Capp in 2016 and Jones, 52, joined as chairman in March.

translations.source: बाल्डविन की टीवी प्रोडक्शन फ़र्म में मिल कर छुट्टियां बिताने वाले जोड़े और जोन्स की हिस्सेदारी 40 प्रतिशत है।
translations.translation: Holiday couples and Jones have a 40 percent stake in Baldwin 's TV production firm.
translations.reference: The couples holiday together and Jones has a 40 per cent stake in Baldwin's TV production firm.

translations.source: बिलुबी अब M&S की ब्रांड एंबेसडर बन गई हैं और उन्हें ITV की I'm A Celebrity में होस्ट करने के लिए ऐंट मैकपार्टलिन की जगह पर रखा जाएगा।
translations.translation: Biloubi has now become M&S's brand ambassador and will be replaced by Ant McPartlin to host ITV's I'm A Celebrity.
translations.reference: Willoughby is to become a brand ambassador for M&S and will replace Ant McPartlin as host of ITV's I'm A Celebrity.

translations.source: कल रात को जोन्स के एक करीबी सूत्र ने बताया, "हम उनके कारोबारी मामले पर कोई बात नहीं करना चाहेंगे।"
translations.translation: A source close to Jones said last night, "We don't want to talk about his business affairs".
translations.reference: A source close to Jones said last night "We wouldn't comment on his business affairs."

translations.source: गंभीर वार्ता 'और फिर हम सहमत हुए'
translations.translation: Serious conversation 'and then we agreed'
translations.reference: Tough talk 'and then we fell in love'

translations.source: उन्होंने आलोचना का मजाक उड़ाते हुए कहा कि न्यूज़ मीडिया उन पर टिप्पणी करती रहेगी, कुछ लोग इसे “राष्ट्रपति पद से अलग काम” मानेंगे और उत्तर कोरियाई नेता को लेकर बहुत ज़्यादा सकारात्मक हो जाएंगे।
translations.translation: He joked about the criticism that the news media would continue to comment on him, that some people would consider this to be different from the presidency and that they would be overly positive about the North Korean leader.
translations.reference: He joked about criticism he would get from the news media for making a comment some would consider "unpresidential" and for being so positive about the North Korean leader.

translations.source: इतना ज़्यादा त्याग राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने क्यों किया है?
translations.translation: Why has President Trump made so many sacrifices?
translations.reference: Why has President Trump given up so much?

translations.source: ट्रम्प ने अपने दिखावटी "न्यूज़ एंकर" वॉयस में बताया।
translations.translation: Trump said in his "News Anchor" voice.
translations.reference: Trump said in his mock "news anchor" voice.

translations.source: "मैंने कोई भी त्याग नहीं किया।"
translations.translation: "I have not given up any".
translations.reference: "I didn't give up anything."

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि जून में सिंगापुर में हुई अपनी पहली मीटिंग के बाद किम की रुचि दूसरी मीटिंग में है, पहली मीटिंग में ट्रम्प द्वारा उत्तर कोरिया को परमाणु मुक्त बनाने के लिए एक बड़ा कदम उठाया गया।
translations.translation: He said Kim is interested in a second meeting after his first meeting in Singapore in June, the first meeting marked a major step by Trump to make North Korea nuclear free.
translations.reference: He noted that Kim is interested in a second meeting after their initial meeting in Singapore in June was hailed by Trump as a big step toward denuclearization of North Korea.

translations.source: लेकिन, परमाणु मुक्त बातचीत को रोक दिया गया।
translations.translation: But nuclear - free talks were halted.
translations.reference: But denuclearization negotiations have stalled.

translations.source: सिंगापुर में जून में हुए शिखर सम्मेलन के तीन महीने से ज़्यादा समय बीतने के बाद, उत्तर कोरिया के शीर्ष राजनयिक री योंग हो ने शनिवार को यू.एन. जनरल असेंबली में दुनिया भर के नेताओं से कहा कि नॉर्थ उत्तर कोरिया के शुरूआती निरस्त्रीकरण कदमों के लिए यू.एस. के "संगत जवाब" की प्रतीक्षा नहीं कर रहा है।
translations.translation: More than three months after the June summit in Singapore, North Korean top diplomat Lee Yong Ho told world leaders at the UN General Assembly on Saturday that North Korea is not waiting for a "consistent response" from the US to North Korea's initial disarmament steps.
translations.reference: More than three months after the June summit in Singapore, North Korea's top diplomat Ri Yong Ho told world leaders at the U.N. General Assembly Saturday that the North doesn't see a "corresponding response" from the U.S. to North Korea's early disarmament moves.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि इसके बजाय प्रतिबंधों को बनाए रखने के लिए यू.एस. ने दबाव बनाना जारी रखा है।
translations.translation: Instead, he said, the U.S. has continued to press for sanctions to be maintained.
translations.reference: Instead, he noted, the U.S. is continuing sanctions aimed at keeping up pressure.

translations.source: ट्रम्प के रैली भाषण में उनका बहुत ज़्यादा आशावादी दृष्टिकोण देखा गया।
translations.translation: Trump's rally speech showed a very optimistic attitude.
translations.reference: Trump took a much more optimistic view in his rally speech.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “हम उत्तर कोरिया के साथ अच्छे संबंध बनाने में लगे हुए हैं।”
translations.translation: "We are engaged in building good relations with North Korea", he said.
translations.reference: "We're doing great with North Korea," he said.

translations.source: “हम उत्तर कोरिया के साथ लड़ाई करने जा रहे थे।
translations.translation: We were going to war with North Korea.
translations.reference: "We were going to war with North Korea.

translations.source: जिसमें लाखों लोगों की हत्या हो जाती।
translations.translation: which would have killed millions of people.
translations.reference: Millions of people would have been killed.

translations.source: अब हमारे संबंध बहुत बढ़िया हो गए हैं।”
translations.translation: Now our relationship has improved greatly.
translations.reference: Now we have this great relationship."

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि किम के साथ संबंधों को बेहतर बनाने की उनकी कोशिशें सकारात्मक नतीज़े लेकर आई हैं - जिसमें रॉकेट टेस्ट को पूरा करना, बंधकों को मुक्त करने में मदद करना और बचे हुए अमेरिकी सैनिकों को वापस उनके घर पहुंचाना शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: He said his efforts to improve relations with Kim have yielded positive results - including completing rocket tests, helping to free hostages and returning survivors to their homes.
translations.reference: He said his efforts to improve relations with Kim have brought positive results - ending rocket tests, helping free hostages and getting the remains of American servicemen returned home.

translations.source: साथ ही, किम के साथ संबंधों पर बातचीत करने में उन्होंने अपने असामान्य दृष्टिकोण का बचाव किया।
translations.translation: At the same time, he defended his unusual approach in discussing relations with Kim.
translations.reference: And he defended his unusual approach in talking about relations with Kim.

translations.source: अपने सामने मौजूद भीड़ की ओर प्रत्यक्ष रूप से इशारा करते हुए ट्रम्प ने कहा, "राष्ट्रपति पद पर बने रहना बहुत आसान है, लेकिन देश के बाहर के 10,000 लोग इस इलाके में शामिल होने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं, उन्हें रोकने के लिए हमारे पास करीब 200 लोग ही होंगे।"
translations.translation: Pointing directly to the crowd in front of him, Trump said, "It's very easy to stay in the presidency, but 10,000 people outside the country are trying to join the area, we'll only have about 200 people to stop them".
translations.reference: "It's so easy to be presidential, but instead of having 10,000 people outside trying to get into this packed arena, we'd have about 200 people standing right there," Trump said, pointing at the crowd directly in front of him.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया में आई सुनामी और भूकंप से एक द्वीप तहस-नहस हो गया, सैकड़ों लोग मरे
translations.translation: A tsunami and earthquake devastated an island in Indonesia, killing hundreds
translations.reference: Indonesia Tsunami and Quake Devastate an Island, Killing Hundreds

translations.source: लोम्बोक में हुए भूकंप के बाद, घटना के लिए विदेशी गैर सरकारी संगठनों से कहा गया कि उन्हें उनकी ज़रूरत नहीं थी।
translations.translation: After the earthquake in Lombok, foreign NGOs were told that they did not need them for the event.
translations.reference: In the aftermath of the Lombok earthquake, for instance, foreign nongovernmental organizations were told they were not needed.

translations.source: लोम्बोक की 10 प्रतिशत से ज़्यादा आबादी के तहस-नहस होने के बावजूद, किसी भी राष्ट्रीय आपदा की घोषणा नहीं की गई, साथ ही, अंतरराष्ट्रीय मदद देने के लिए एक शर्त भी रखी गई।
translations.translation: Despite the destruction of more than 10 percent of Lombok's population, no national disaster was declared, as was a condition for international aid.
translations.reference: Even though more than 10 percent of Lombok's population had been dislocated, no national disaster was declared, a prerequisite for catalyzing international aid.

translations.source: मिस. सुम्बु ने कहा, “कई स्थितियों में, दुर्भाग्यवश, उन्हें यह साफ़ तौर दिख रहा था कि वे अंतरराष्ट्रीय मदद नहीं मांग रहे है, इसलिए यह कुछ ज़्यादा ही चुनौतीपूर्ण हो गया।”
translations.translation: Ms. Sumbu said, "In many situations, unfortunately, they were clearly seeing that they were not seeking international help, so it became a bit more challenging".
translations.reference: "In many cases, unfortunately, they've been very clear that they're not requesting international assistance, so it's a bit challenging," Ms. Sumbung said.

translations.source: फिर भी, सेव द चिल्ड्रन ने एक टीम के साथ मिल कर पालू का दौरा किया, लेकिन अभी तक यह पक्का नहीं हो पाया है कि दूसरे देश के कर्मचारी यहां सहायता देने के लिए आ सकते हैं या नहीं।
translations.translation: Nevertheless, Save the Children visited Palau together with a team, but it is still unclear whether workers from other countries can come here to help.
translations.reference: While Save the Children is putting together a team to travel to Palu, it is not yet sure whether foreign staff can work on the ground.

translations.source: नेशनल डिजास्टर एजेंसी के प्रवक्ता मि. सुतोपो का कहना है कि इंडोनेशियाई अधिकारी पालू की स्थिति का जायजा ले रहे थे, वे देख रहे थें कि अंतरराष्ट्रीय एजेंसियों से सहायता प्रयास के योगदान की अनुमति मिलेगी या नहीं।
translations.translation: National Disaster Agency spokesman Mr. Sutopo said that Indonesian officials were reviewing the status of Palu to see if international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the relief effort.
translations.reference: Mr. Sutopo, the national disaster agency spokesman, said Indonesian officials were assessing the situation in Palu to see whether international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the aid effort.

translations.source: बार-बार इंडोनेशिया में आने वाली ऐसी स्थितियों को देखते हुए, ऐसा लग रहा कि इस देश में प्रकृति के प्रकोप के लिए बिल्कुल भी तैयारी नहीं की जा रही है।
translations.translation: Given the repeated situation in Indonesia, it seems that the country is not preparing for a natural disaster at all.
translations.reference: Given the earth shaking that Indonesia constantly endures, the country remains woefully underprepared for nature's wrath.

translations.source: हालांकि, ऐच में सुनामी से पीड़ित लोगों के लिए आश्रयगृह बनाए गए हैं, लेकिन वे दूसरे समुद्र तटों पर लगने वाले आश्रयगृह की तरह नहीं हैं।
translations.translation: Although shelters have been set up for tsunami victims in Ach, they are not like shelters on other beaches.
translations.reference: While tsunami shelters have been built in Aceh, they are not a common sight on other coastlines.

translations.source: पालू में सुनामी के लिए चेतावनी देने के सायरन में कमी देखी गई है, चाहे वह चेतावनी कितनी भी नुकसानदेह क्यों न हो, इससे जीवन की क्षति के बढ़ने की संभावना है।
translations.translation: A decrease in tsunami warning sirens has been observed in Palau, no matter how damaging the warning may be, it is likely to increase the loss of life.
translations.reference: The apparent lack of a tsunami warning siren in Palu, even though a warning had been in effect, is likely to have contributed to the loss of life.

translations.source: चाहे घूमने-फिरने के लिए सबसे बढ़िया समय समय ही क्यों न हो, इंडोनेशिया के कई द्वीपों के बीच पर जाना चुनौतीपूर्ण ही होता है।
translations.translation: Whether or not it is the best time to go for a walk, traveling between many of Indonesia 's islands is challenging.
translations.reference: At the best of times, traveling between Indonesia's many islands is challenging.

translations.source: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से कमर्चारियों और माल की व्यवस्था करना हमेशा ही जटिल रहता है।
translations.translation: It is always complicated to arrange merchants and goods from natural disasters.
translations.reference: Natural disasters make logistics even more complicated.

translations.source: भूकंप के पीड़ितों को उपचार के लिए लोम्बोक में मौजूद एक अस्पताल में लाया जा रहा है जो पालू से काफ़ी दूर है और नई आपदा स्थल से यहां पहुंचने में कम से कम तीन दिन लगते हैं।
translations.translation: The victims of the earthquake are being transported to a hospital in Lombok for treatment which is very far from Palau and takes at least three days to reach from the new disaster site.
translations.reference: A hospital ship that had been stationed in Lombok to treat earthquake victims is making its way to Palu, but it will take at least three days to reach the site of the new calamity.

translations.source: राष्ट्रपति जोको विडोडो ने अपने चुनाव अभियान के लिए इंडोनेशिया के बहुत बुरे बुनियादी ढांचे को मुद्दा बनाया और उन्होंने सड़कों और रेलवे को बेहतर बनाने के लिए काफ़ी धन खर्च किए।
translations.translation: President Joko Widodo made the very poor infrastructure of Indonesia an issue for his election campaign and he spent a lot of money to improve roads and railways.
translations.reference: President Joko Widodo made improving Indonesia's tattered infrastructure a centerpiece of his election campaign, and he has lavished money on roads and railways.

translations.source: लेकिन, मि. जोको का प्रशासन फंड की कमी की वजह से तितर-बितर हो गया क्योंकि अगले साल फिर से चुनाव होने वाला है।
translations.translation: However, the administration of Mr. Joko was dispersed due to lack of funds as next year's re-election is scheduled.
translations.reference: But funding shortfalls have plagued Mr. Joko's administration as he faces re-election next year.

translations.source: मि. जोको पर इंडोनेशिया में हो रहे संप्रदायवादी तनाव का दबाव भी है, जहां मुस्लिम मेजोरिटी वाले सदस्यों ने धार्मिक विचारधारा को ज़्यादा रूढ़िवादी बना दिया है।
translations.translation: Mr. Joko is also under pressure from sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have made religious ideology more conservative.
translations.reference: Mr. Joko is also facing pressure from lingering sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have embraced a more conservative form of the faith.

translations.source: 1,000 से ज़्यादा लोगों की मृत्यु हो गई और दस हज़ार से ज़्यादा लोग बेघर हो गए, क्योंकि छुरे, धनुष तथा तीर और दूसरे खतरनाक हथियारों का उपयोग करके ईसाई और मुस्लिम गिरोह सड़कों पर एक-दूसरे से लड़ रहे थे।
translations.translation: More than 1,000 people died and more than 10,000 were left homeless as Christian and Muslim gangs fought each other in the streets using knives, bows, arrows and other dangerous weapons.
translations.reference: More than 1,000 people were killed and tens of thousands dislocated from their homes as Christian and Muslim gangs battled on the streets, using machetes, bows and arrows, and other crude weapons.

translations.source: देखें: लिवरपूल के डैनियल स्टुरिज ने रहस्यपूर्ण तरीके से झुक कर चेल्सिया के साथ बराबरी की
translations.translation: See: Daniel Sturridge of Liverpool mysteriously bowed down to Chelsea
translations.reference: Watch: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea

translations.source: शनिवार को लंदन के स्टैमफ़ोर्ड ब्रिज़ में डैनियल स्टुरिज ने 89वें मिनट में स्कोर करके लिवरपूल को प्रीमियर लीग से बाहर होने से बचाया।
translations.translation: At Stamford Bridge in London on Saturday, Daniel Sturridge scored in the 89th minute to save Liverpool from relegation from the Premier League.
translations.reference: Daniel Sturridge saved Liverpool from a Premier League loss to Chelsea with a score in the 89th minute on Saturday at Stamford Bridge in London.

translations.source: लगभग 30 गज की दूरी से स्टुरिज को ज़ेरदान शकीरी से पास मिला, उस समय उनकी टीम चेल्सिया गोल से 1-0 से पीछे चल रही थी।
translations.translation: From a distance of about 30 yards, Sturridge was passed by Zerdane Shakiri, at the time his team was 1-0 behind Chelsea on goal.
translations.reference: Sturridge received a pass from Xherdan Shaqiri while about 30 yards out from the Chelsea goal with his team trailing 1-0.

translations.source: उन्होंने फार पोस्ट की शॉट बनाने से पहले अपने बाएं पैर से बॉल को मारा।
translations.translation: He hit the ball with his left foot before making the Far Post shot.
translations.reference: He tapped the ball to his left before scooping a shot toward the far post.

translations.source: उनका यह प्रयास बॉक्स के ऊपर ऊंचाई के साथ नेट के दाएं शीर्ष कोने की ओर चला गया।
translations.translation: His attempt went to the top right corner of the net with the height above the box.
translations.reference: The attempt sailed high above the box as it drifted toward the right top corner of the net.

translations.source: आखिरकार बॉल केपा आरिजाबलागा की पकड़ से बाहर गिर और नेट में चली गई।
translations.translation: Eventually the ball fell out of Kappa Arisabalaga 's grasp and went into the net.
translations.reference: The ball eventually dropped over a leaping Kepa Arrizabalaga and fell into the net.

translations.source: स्टुरिज ने LiverpoolFC.com से कहा, “यह सिर्फ़ उस स्थिति में पहुँचने का प्रयास था, ताकि बॉल के संपर्क में आया जा सके और शाक जैसे खिलाड़ियों से इसे जितना संभव हो सके उतना दूर ले जाया जा सके, इसलिए मैंने सिर्फ़ खुद के लिए जितना संभव हो पाया उतना समय लेने का प्रयास किया।”
translations.translation: Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com, "It was just an attempt to get into that position so that the ball could come into contact and get as far away from players like Shaq as possible, so I tried to take as much time as possible for myself".
translations.reference: "It was just trying to get into that position, to get on the ball and players like Shaq always play it forward as much as possible, so I just tried to create myself as much time as possible," Sturridge told LiverpoolFC.com.

translations.source: "मैंने देखा कि कांते आ रहे थे और एक बार टच किया और इस बारे में बहुत ज़्यादा नहीं सोचा और सिर्फ़ शॉट मारा।"
translations.translation: "I saw the spurs coming and I touched it once and didn't think much about it and just shot".
translations.reference: "I saw Kante coming and took one touch and didn't think about it too much and just took the shot on."

translations.source: बेल्जियम के बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी एडेन हैजर्ड द्वारा 25वें मिनट में स्कोर करने के बाद हाफटाइम में चेल्सिया 1-0 से आगे चल रही थी।
translations.translation: Chelsea were leading 1-0 in halftime after the best player from Belgium, Aiden Hazard, scored in the 25th minute.
translations.reference: Chelsea led 1-0 at halftime after getting a score in the 25th minute from Belgian star Eden Hazard.

translations.source: इससे पहले कि बॉल मिडफील्ड के नज़दीक पहुंचती और लिवरपूल हाफ गेम तक पहुँचते, ब्लूज़ के स्ट्राइकर ने उस खेल में माटेओ कोवासिक को पास दे दिया।
translations.translation: Before the ball came close to the midfield and reached the Liverpool half, the Blues striker passed Matteo Kovacic in that game.
translations.reference: The Blues striker heeled a pass back to Mateo Kovacic on that play, before spinning off near midfield and sprinting into the Liverpool half.

translations.source: कोवासिक ने मिडफील्ड में बहुत जल्दी बॉल को पहुंचाया।
translations.translation: Kovashik delivered the ball very quickly in the midfield.
translations.reference: Kovacic did a quick give-and-go at midfield.

translations.source: फिर, उन्होंने खूबसूरती से बॉल पर शॉट लगाया, जिससे हज़ार्ड बॉक्स में चले गए।
translations.translation: Then, he shot the ball beautifully, leading Hazard into the box.
translations.reference: He then fired a beautiful through ball, leading Hazard into the box.

translations.source: हज़ार्ड डिफेंस से बाहर निकल गए और लिवरपूल के एलिसन बेकर के पीछे से बाएं पैर से शॉट मारकर नेट से दूर भेजा।
translations.translation: Hazard pulled out of the defence and shot off the net with his left foot from the back of Liverpool's Allison Baker.
translations.reference: Hazard outran the defense and finished into the far post netting with a left footed shot past Liverpool's Alisson Becker.

translations.source: लिवरपूल अब बुधवार को दोपहर 3 बजे नेपल्स, इटली के स्टैडियो सान पाओलो में चैंपियंस लीग के ग्रुप स्टेज में नेपोली से भिड़ेगा।
translations.translation: Liverpool will now face Napoli at 3pm on Wednesday in the Champions League group stage at the Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.
translations.reference: Liverpool battles Napoli in the group stage of the Champions League at 3 p.m. on Wednesday at Stadio San Paolo in Naples, Italy.

translations.source: चेल्सिया का सामना गुरुवार को लंदन में दोपहर 3 बजे यूईएफए यूरोपा लीग में वीडियोटॉन से होगा।
translations.translation: Chelsea will face VideoTone in the UEFA Europa League on Thursday at 3pm in London.
translations.reference: Chelsea faces Videoton in the UEFA Europa Leaguge at 3 p.m. on Thursday in London.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया सुनामी की वजह से मृतकों की संख्या बढ़कर 832 हो गई
translations.translation: The death toll from the Indonesian tsunami has risen to 832
translations.reference: Death toll from Indonesia tsunami rises to 832

translations.source: रविवार की सुबह-सुबह देश की डिजास्टर एजेंसी ने बताया कि इंडोनेशिया में आए भूकंप और सुनामी की वजह से मृतकों की संख्या 832 हो गई है।
translations.translation: On Sunday morning, the country's Disaster Agency reported that the death toll from the earthquake and tsunami in Indonesia has risen to 832.
translations.reference: The death toll in Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami has climbed to 832, the country's disaster agency said early Sunday.

translations.source: एजेंसी के प्रवक्ता सुतोपो पुरवो नुगरोहो ने न्यूज़ कांफ्रेंस में बताया कि शुक्रवार को आए 7.5 तीव्रता वाले भूकंप और 20 फ़ीट ऊंची सुनामी की वजह से कई लोगों के मलबे में फंसने की सूचना मिली है।
translations.translation: Agency spokesman Sutopo Purvo Nugroho told a news conference that a 7.5 magnitude earthquake and a 20-foot high tsunami on Friday left many people trapped in the rubble.
translations.reference: Many people were reported trapped in the rubble of buildings brought down in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake which struck Friday and triggered waves as high as 20 feet, agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho told a news conference.

translations.source: 380,000 से ज़्यादा की आबादी वाले पालू के शहर में कई इमारतों ढह गए थी, जिससे यह शहर मलबे से भर गया था।
translations.translation: In the city of Palú, with a population of more than 380,000, many buildings collapsed, filling the city with rubble.
translations.reference: The city of Palu, which has more than 380,000 people, was strewn with debris from collapsed buildings.

translations.source: पुलिस ने 32 वर्षीय व्यक्ति को हिरासत में लिया, उस पर संदेह है कि उसने चाकू घोंपकर एक महिला की हत्या की है
translations.translation: Police arrested a 32-year-old man suspected of stabbing a woman to death
translations.reference: Police arrest man, 32, on suspicion of murder after woman is stabbed to death

translations.source: आज सुबह बिरकेनहेड, मर्सीसाइड में एक महिला का शव बरामद करने के बाद हत्या की जांच शुरू की गई।
translations.translation: A murder investigation was launched this morning after a woman's body was recovered in Birkenhead, Merseyside.
translations.reference: A murder investigation has been launched after woman's body was found in Birkenhead, Merseyside this morning.

translations.source: 44 वर्षीय महिला का शव सुबह 7.55 बजे  ग्रेसन म्यूज़ के जॉन स्ट्रीट में पाया गया, उसके शव पर चाकू घोंपने के निशान मिले हैं, इस संदर्भ में एक 32 वर्षीय व्यक्ति पर इस कारनामे का संदेह है जिसे हिरासत में ले लिया गया।
translations.translation: The body of a 44 - year - old woman was found at 7.55 am in John Street, Grayson Museum, with marks of knife-wielding on her body, in this context a 32-year - old man suspected of this exploit who was taken into custody.
translations.reference: The 44-year-old was found at 7.55am with stab wounds on Grayson Mews on John Street, with a 32-year-old man being arrested on suspicion of murder.

translations.source: पुलिस ने इलाके में रहने वाले लोगों से पूछताछ की और पता लगाने की कोशिश की कि किसी व्यक्ति ने इस सन्दर्भ में कुछ देखा या सुना हो।
translations.translation: Police interviewed people living in the area and tried to find out if anyone saw or heard anything in this context.
translations.reference: Police have urged people in the area who saw or heard anything to come forward.

translations.source: डिटेक्टिव इंस्पेक्टर ब्रायन ओ'हागन ने बताया: 'जांच की शुरुआत हो चुकी है, लेकिन मैं उन लोगों से अपील करना चाहूँगा जो बिरकेहेड के जॉन स्ट्रीट के आसपास के इलाके में घटना के समय मौजूद थे, अगर उनमें से किसी को भी इस घटना के बारे में देखने या सुनने का संदेह है, तो वे हमसे संपर्क करें।
translations.translation: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation has already begun, but I would like to appeal to those who were present in the area around John Street in Birkhead at the time of the incident, if any of them are suspicious of seeing or hearing about the incident, to contact us.
translations.reference: Detective Inspector Brian O'Hagan said: 'The investigation is in the early stages but I would appeal to anyone who was in the vicinity of John Street in Birkenhead who saw or heard anything suspicious to contact us.

translations.source: मैं उन लोगों से भी अपील करना चाहूँगा, खास तौर पर टैक्सी ड्राइवरों से, जिन्होंने हमसे संपर्क करने के लिए डैशकैम फुटेज पर किसी भी बात को कैप्चर किया होगा क्योंकि उनके पास ऐसी जानकारी हो सकती है जो हमारी जांच के लिए ज़रूरी है।'
translations.translation: I would also like to appeal to people, especially taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on the dashcam footage to contact us because they may have information that is necessary for our investigation.'
translations.reference: I would also appeal to anyone, particularly taxi drivers, who may have captured anything on dashcam footage to contact us as they may have information which is vital to our investigation.'

translations.source: एक पुलिस प्रवक्ता ने उस महिला की पुष्टि की है जिसका शव बिरकेनहेड के स्थानीय इलाके से बरामद किया गया था और वह एक प्रॉपर्टी के अंदर पाई गई थी।
translations.translation: A police spokesperson has confirmed that the woman whose body was recovered from the local area of Birkenhead was found inside a property.
translations.reference: A police spokesman has confirmed the woman whose body was found is local to Birkenhead and she was found inside a property.

translations.source: आज दोपहर महिला के जानने वाले लोग घटनास्थल पर पहुंचे और पूछा कि इस सुबह उसका शव कहां मिला।
translations.translation: People who knew the woman arrived at the scene this afternoon and asked where her body was found this morning.
translations.reference: This afternoon friends who believe they know the woman have arrived at the scene to ask questions about where she was found this morning.

translations.source: पुलिस इस घटना की जांच कर रही है और उनका कहना है कि वे जल्द ही पीड़ित के परिजनों को इस बात की जानकारी दे देंगे।
translations.translation: Police are investigating the incident and say they will inform the victim's family soon.
translations.reference: Investigations are ongoing as police have said they are in the process of informing the victim's next of kin.

translations.source: ग्रेसन म्यूज़ में रहने वाले एक टैक्सी ड्राइवर ने अभी-अभी अपने फ्लैट को खाली करने की कोशिश कर रहा है, लेकिन पुलिस ने बताया है कि बिल्डिंग के अंदर या बाहर किसी भी व्यक्ति के प्रवेश की अनुमति नहीं है।
translations.translation: A taxi driver living in Grayson Museum is just trying to clear his flat, but police say no one is allowed inside or outside the building.
translations.reference: A taxi driver who lives in Grayson Mews has just tried to get back into his flat but is being told by police no one is allowed in or out of the building.

translations.source: जब उसे घटना का पता चला, तो वह चुप हो गया।
translations.translation: When he found out about the incident, he was silent.
translations.reference: He was speechless when he discovered what happened.

translations.source: आस-पास रहने वाले लोगों से अब यह कहा जा रहा है कि पुरानी स्थिति पर वापस आने में कुछ घंटे लगेंगे।
translations.translation: People living nearby are now being told that it will take a few hours to get back to normal.
translations.reference: Residents are now being told it will be hours until they are allowed back in.

translations.source: एक पुलिस अधिकारी ने एक व्यक्ति से यह सुना कि पूरा इलाका अब क्राइम करने की जगह माना जा रहा है।
translations.translation: A police officer heard from one person that the whole area is now considered a crime scene.
translations.reference: A police officer was heard telling one man that the entire area is now being treated as a crime scene.

translations.source: रोती हुई एक महिला घटना-स्थल पर आई।
translations.translation: A woman came to the scene crying.
translations.reference: A woman appeared at the scene in tears.

translations.source: वह बार-बार यही कह रही थी कि 'यह बहुत भयानक है'।
translations.translation: She kept saying, 'This is terrible.'
translations.reference: She keeps repeating 'it's so awful'.

translations.source: दोपहर 2 बजे पुलिस से भरी दो वैन घेरे के अंदर गई जबकि एक दूसरी वैन घेरे के बाहर खड़ी थी।
translations.translation: At 2 p.m. two vans full of police entered the circle while another van stood outside the circle.
translations.reference: At 2pm two police vans were inside the cordon with another van just outside.

translations.source: कई अधिकारी फ्लैट्स के ब्लॉक पर निगरानी के लिए बनाए गए घेरे के अंदर खड़े थे।
translations.translation: Several officers stood inside the circles set up to monitor the blocks of flats.
translations.reference: A number of officers were stood inside the cordon monitoring the block of flats.

translations.source: अगर किसी व्यक्ति को कोई जानकारी है, तो वह डीएम को @MerPolCC पर बता सकता है, या 101 पर कॉल कर सकता है, या 30 सितंबर के लॉग 247 का संदर्भ देकर 0800 555 111 पर अनाम रूप से संपर्क कर सकता है।
translations.translation: If an individual has any information, he can inform the DM at @MerPolCC, or call 101 or contact anonymously at 0800 555 111 by referring to log 247 dated 30 September.
translations.reference: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.

translations.source: संसद के सामने बनी क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति हाल ही में सबसे मशहूर स्मारक बन गई, इसे ‘इतिहास’ में फिर से दर्ज़ किया गया
translations.translation: The statue of Cromwell in front of Parliament has recently become one of the most famous monuments, it was re-recorded in history.
translations.reference: Parliament's statue of Cromwell becomes latest memorial hit by 'rewriting history' row

translations.source: इसका निर्वासन उनके कट्टरपंथी प्यूरिंटन अनुयायियों द्वारा बनाई गई इंग्लैंड की कई सारी सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक कलाकृतियों के उसके तालिबान जैसे विनाश के लिए आदर्श न्याय होगा।
translations.translation: Its expulsion would be the perfect justice for the destruction of many of England 's cultural and religious artifacts created by its radical Puritan followers, such as its Taliban.
translations.reference: Its banishment would be poetic justice for his Taliban-like destruction of so many of England's cultural and religious artefacts carried out by his fanatical Puritan followers.

translations.source: लेकिन, क्रॉमवेल सोसायटी ने "मूर्खतापूर्ण" और "इतिहास को दुबारा लिखने की कोशिश" के तौर पर मि. क्रिक के सुझाव के बारे में बताया।
translations.translation: But the Cromwell Society described Mr. Crick's suggestion as "stupid" and "an attempt to rewrite history".
translations.reference: But the Cromwell Society described Mr Crick's suggestion as "folly" and "attempting to rewrite history."

translations.source: क्रॉमवेल सोसायटी के चेयरमैन जॉन गोल्डस्मिथ ने कहा: "मूर्तियों को हटाने पर चल रही मौजूदा बहस में इस बात की पूरी आशंका थी कि पैलेस ऑफ़ वेस्टमिंस्टर के बाहर ओलिवर क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति को निशाना बनाया जाएगा।
translations.translation: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "The ongoing debate over the removal of the statues was full of fears that the statue of Oliver Cromwell would be targeted outside the Palace of Westminster.
translations.reference: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "It was inevitable in the present debate about the removal of statues that the figure of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster would become a target.

translations.source: इंग्लिश सिविल वार के प्रतीक चिह्न के लिए न तो कोई आदेश दिया गया था और न ही क्रॉमवेल ने इसे बनवाया।
translations.translation: The emblem of the English Civil War was neither ordered nor built by Cromwell.
translations.reference: The iconoclasm of the English civil wars was neither ordered nor carried out by Cromwell.

translations.source: यह गलत हो सकता है कि पिछली सदी में अपने पूर्वज थॉमस के कामों के लिए क्रॉमवेल ने त्याग किया होगा।
translations.translation: It may be wrong that Cromwell sacrificed himself in the last century for the works of his ancestor Thomas.
translations.reference: Perhaps the wrong Cromwell would be sacrificed for the actions of his ancestor Thomas in the previous century.

translations.source: सर विलियम हेमो थोरोक्रॉफ्ट के अनुसार क्रॉमवेल का बेहतरीन प्रतिनिधित्व 19वीं सदी के विचार और एक ऐसी मूर्ति के इतिहास के भाग का साक्ष्य है, जिसे कई लोग अभी भी प्रशंसा करने योग्य मानते हैं।
translations.translation: According to Sir William Hemo Thorcroft, the best representation of Cromwell is evidence of the 19th century idea and part of the history of a statue that many still consider admirable.
translations.reference: Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft's magnificent representation of Cromwell is evidence of 19th century opinion and part of the historiography of a figure who many believe is still worth celebrating.

translations.source: द संडे टेलीग्राफ को मि. गोल्डस्मिथ ने बताया: "क्रॉमवेल का सम्मान कई लोग करते हैं, शायद इसी वजह से ज़्यादातर लोग आज भी 19वीं सदी के अंत में राजशाही के मामले में उन्हें बाहरी दबावों के विरुद्ध खड़े संसद के रक्षक के तौर पर जानते हैं।
translations.translation: "Cromwell is respected by many", Mr. Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph, "and perhaps that is why most people still know him today as the protector of Parliament against external pressures in the late 19th century when it came to monarchy.
translations.reference: Mr Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell is regarded by many, perhaps more in the late 19th century than today, as a defender of parliament against external pressure, in his case of course the monarchy.

translations.source: फिर भी, उन्हें बिल्कुल सटीक प्रतिनिधि माना जाता है, जो ऐतिहासिक रूप से बहस का विषय बना हुआ है।
translations.translation: Nevertheless, they are considered perfectly accurate representatives, which has historically been the subject of debate.
translations.reference: Whether that is a wholly accurate representation is the subject of continuing historical debate.

translations.source: यह तो जाहिर है कि 17वीं सदी के मध्य में हुए संघर्ष के बाद से हमारे राष्ट्र का विकास होता आ रहा है, और क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति निजी पहचान बनी हुई है जिसमें उस विभाजन के एक पक्ष की झलक दिखती है।
translations.translation: It is clear that our nation has been evolving since the conflict in the mid-17th century, and Cromwell's statue remains a personal identity that reflects one side of that division.
translations.reference: What is certain is that the conflict of the mid 17th century has shaped the subsequent development of our nation, and Cromwell is an individual recognisable figure who represents one side of that divide.

translations.source: लॉर्ड प्रोटेक्टर के तौर पर उनकी उपलब्धियां प्रशंसनीय और याद रखने योग्य हैं।”
translations.translation: His achievements as Lord Protector are commendable and memorable.
translations.reference: His achievements as Lord Protector are also worth celebrating and commemorating."

translations.source: घातक सूअर ने चाइनीज़ किसान पर हमला किया जिससे किसान की मौत हो गई
translations.translation: A deadly pig attacked a Chinese farmer, killing the farmer
translations.reference: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death

translations.source: स्थानीय मीडिया रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, दक्षिण-पश्चिमी चीन के एक मार्केट में सूअर ने एक किसान पर हमला कर दिया जिससे किसान की मौत हो गई।
translations.translation: According to local media reports, a pig attacked a farmer in a market in southwestern China, killing the farmer.
translations.reference: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.

translations.source: रविवार को साउथ चाइना मॉर्निंग पोस्ट में बताया गया कि उस व्यक्ति की पहचान के तौर पर सिर्फ़ उसके उपनाम "युआन" का पता लगाया गया है, उसके शव पर गंभीर जख्म पाए गए, गुइझोऊ प्रांत के लिउपांसुई के मार्केट में सूअर-बाड़े के पास उसका शव खून से लथपथ पाया गया।
translations.translation: The South China Morning Post reported on Sunday that only his surname "Yuan" has been identified as the identity of the person, his body was found severely wounded, his body was found covered in blood near a pig barn at a market in Liupansui, Guizhou Province.
translations.reference: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.

translations.source: 30 मई, 2005 को चीन के किन्हाई प्रांत के ज़िनिंग में एक सूअर पालने वाले वाला किसान सूअर-बाड़े में सूअरों को टीका लगाने की तैयारी कर रहा था।
translations.translation: On May 30, 2005, a pig farmer in Xining, Kinhai Province, China, was preparing to vaccinate pigs in a pig barn.
translations.reference: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर वह बुधवार को पास के युन्नान प्रांत में रहने वाले अपने कज़न के साथ मार्केट में 15 सूअरों को बेचने के लिए आया था।
translations.translation: He reportedly came to the market on Wednesday with his cousin living in nearby Yunnan province to sell 15 pigs.
translations.reference: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.

translations.source: अगली सुबह, उसके कज़न की मृत्यु हो गई और पाया गया कि पास में ही एक सूअर-बाड़े का दरवाज़ा खुला हुआ था।
translations.translation: The next morning, his cousin died and it was discovered that the door of a pig 's lair had been opened nearby.
translations.reference: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.

translations.source: उसने बताया कि सूअर-बाड़े में एक काफ़ी बड़ा नर सूअर दिखा जिसके मुंह पर खून लगा हुआ था।
translations.translation: He said that he saw a large male pig in the pig 's den with blood on his mouth.
translations.reference: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.

translations.source: रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, एक फोरेंसिक जांच में इस बात की पुष्टि हुई कि 550 पाउंड वजन वाले एक सूअर ने किसान पर हमला करके उसे मार डाला।
translations.translation: According to the report, a forensic investigation confirmed that a pig weighing 550 pounds attacked the farmer and killed him.
translations.reference: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.

translations.source: गुइयांग इवनिंग न्यूज के अनुसार, “वु” उपनाम वाले उसके कज़न ने कहा, "मेरे कज़न के पैर खून से लथपथ और पूरी तरह से जख्मी थे।”
translations.translation: According to Guyang Evening News, his cousin, nicknamed वु, said, "My cousin's legs were stained with blood and completely injured.
translations.reference: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.

translations.source: सिक्योरिटी कैमरा फुटेज में देखा गया कि युआन गुरुवार को सुबह 4.40 बजे अपने सूअरों को चारा देने के लिए मार्केट में आया था।
translations.translation: Security camera footage showed that Yuan came to the market to feed his pigs at 4.40 am on Thursday.
translations.reference: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.

translations.source: उसका शव लगभग एक घंटे बाद बरामद किया गया।
translations.translation: His body was recovered about an hour later.
translations.reference: His body was found about an hour later.

translations.source: व्यक्ति पर हमला करके उसे मारने वाला सूअर युआन या उसके कज़न का नहीं था।
translations.translation: The pig who attacked the person and killed him was not Yuan or his cousin.
translations.reference: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.

translations.source: ईवनिंग न्यूज को एक मार्केट मैनेजर ने बताया कि सूअर को बंद करके रखा गया था, ताकि यह किसी व्यक्ति पर हमला न कर पाए, हालांकि पुलिस ने घटना-स्थल का जायजा लेकर साक्ष्य इकट्ठा किए।
translations.translation: A market manager told Evening News that the pig was kept locked up so that it could not attack anyone, although the police collected evidence after reviewing the scene.
translations.reference: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर युआन के परिवार के लोग और मार्केट के अधिकारी उसकी मृत्यु के लिए मुआवजे पर बातचीत कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Yuan's family and market officials are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
translations.reference: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.

translations.source: हालांकि, पहले भी सूअरों द्वारा लोगों पर हमला करने के दुर्लभ मामले दर्ज किए गए हैं।
translations.translation: However, rare cases of attacks on people by pigs have been reported before.
translations.reference: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.

translations.source: 2016 में, मैसाचुसेट्स में एक सूअर ने एक महिला और उसके पति पर उनके खेत में हमला किया था जिससे व्यक्ति गंभीर रूप से जख्मी हुआ था।
translations.translation: In 2016, a pig in Massachusetts attacked a woman and her husband at their farm, seriously injuring the man.
translations.reference: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.

translations.source: दस साल पहले, एक 650 पाउंड वजन वाले सूअर ने वेल्श के एक किसान पर हमला किया था, उस समय वह अपने ट्रैक्टर पर था, उसने किसान पर तब तक हमला किया जब तक कि उसकी पत्नी ने जानवर को डरा कर नहीं भगाया।
translations.translation: Ten years ago, a 650-pound pig attacked a Welsh farmer on his tractor at the time, attacking the farmer until his wife scared the animal away.
translations.reference: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.

translations.source: 2012 में ओरेगन के एक किसान को उसके सूअरों ने हमला करके उसे जान से मार डाला और अपना भोजन बनाया, मैनीटोबा के एक किसान ने सीबीसी न्यूज से कहा कि आम तौर पर सूअर आक्रामक नहीं होते हैं, लेकिन खून का स्वाद मिल जाने पर वे "खतरनाक" हो सकते हैं।
translations.translation: In 2012, an Oregon farmer was attacked and killed by his pigs and made his own food, a Manitoba farmer told CBC News that usually pigs are not aggressive, but they can be "dangerous" when they taste blood.
translations.reference: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."

translations.source: "वे सिर्फ़ खेल रहे होते हैं।
translations.translation: "They're just playing.
translations.reference: "They're just being playful.

translations.source: वे दांत से काटते हैं और बहुत खोजी होते हैं ...वे आपको जख्मी करने के लिए नहीं होते।
translations.translation: They bite their teeth and they're very inquisitive... they're not meant to hurt you.
translations.reference: They're nippers, very inquisitive ... they aren't out to hurt you.

translations.source: आपको सिर्फ़ उन्हें पर्याप्त सम्मान देना पड़ता है,” उसने बताया।
translations.translation: You just have to give them enough respect, he said.
translations.reference: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.

translations.source: तूफान रोसा के शेष-भाग की वजह से दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका में भारी बारिश हुई
translations.translation: The remainder of Hurricane Rosa caused heavy rainfall in the southwestern United States
translations.reference: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US

translations.source: पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार, तूफान रोसा मेक्सिको के उत्तरी तट के ठंडे पानी पर जाने की वजह से कमजोर होता जा रहा है।
translations.translation: According to forecasts, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves into cold waters off the northern coast of Mexico.
translations.reference: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.

translations.source: हालांकि, रोसा की वजह से आने वाले दिनों में उत्तरी मेक्सिको और दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका में बाढ़ आएगी।
translations.translation: However, Rosa will cause flooding in northern Mexico and the southwestern United States in the coming days.
translations.reference: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.

translations.source: रविवार को ईस्टर्न टाइम के मुताबिक सुबह 5 बजे रोसा में हवा  की रफ़्तार 85 मील प्रति घंटे दर्ज की गई, यह श्रेणी 1 वाला तूफान है, और यह मेक्सिको के पुन्ता यूगेनिया के दक्षिण-पश्चिम में 385 मील की दूरी पर स्थित था।
translations.translation: Wind speeds of 85 mph were recorded in Rosa at 5 a.m. eastern time on Sunday, a Category 1 hurricane, and it was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
translations.reference: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

translations.source: ऐसी उम्मीद है कि रोसा रविवार को उत्तर की ओर बढ़ेगा।
translations.translation: It is expected that Rosa will head north on Sunday.
translations.reference: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.

translations.source: इस बीच, प्रशांत महासागर के ऊपर एक गर्त का आकार बनने लगा है और यह अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट की ओर बढ़ रहा है। चूंकि, रोसा सोमवार को उष्णकटिबंधीय तूफान के तौर पर बाजा कैलिफ़ोर्निया प्रायद्वीप के पास पहुँचने वाला है, इसलिए दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका के उत्तरी इलाकों में बहुत ज़्यादा उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी आनी शुरू हो जाएगी।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, a mound has begun forming over the Pacific Ocean and is moving toward the west coast of the United States. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula as a tropical storm on Monday, much tropical moisture will begin to flow into the northern regions of the southwestern United States.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.

translations.source: सोमवार को मैक्सिको के कुछ हिस्सों में रोसा की वजह 10 इंच बारिश आएगी।
translations.translation: There will be 10 inches of rain due to Rosa in parts of Mexico on Monday.
translations.reference: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.

translations.source: उसके बाद, आने वाले दिनों में गर्त से आने वाली नमी उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी से मिलकर दक्षिण-पश्चिम में भारी वर्षा लाएगी।
translations.translation: Subsequently, moisture from the pot will combine with tropical moisture in the coming days to bring heavy rain to the southwest.
translations.reference: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.

translations.source: स्थानीय तौर पर, 1 से 4 इंच बारिश होने की वजह से खतरनाक बाढ़ के आने, मलबे का बहाव और रेगिस्तान में भूस्खलन की संभावना बनेगी।
translations.translation: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain is likely to lead to dangerous flooding, debris runoff and landslides in the desert.
translations.reference: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.

translations.source: बहुत ज़्यादा उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी की वजह वर्षा की दर कुछ स्थानों पर 2 से 3 इंच हो जाएगी, खास तौर पर दक्षिणी नेवाडा और एरिज़ोना के कुछ इलाकों में इसकी संभावना ज़्यादा है।
translations.translation: Excessive tropical humidity will cause rainfall to drop by 2 to 3 inches in some places, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.
translations.reference: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.

translations.source: दक्षिण-पश्चिमी हिस्से, खास तौर पर एरिज़ोना के ज़्यादातर इलाकों में 2 से 4 इंच बारिश होने की संभावना है।
translations.translation: In the southwestern part, especially in most areas of Arizona, 2 to 4 inches of rain is likely.
translations.reference: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.

translations.source: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा की छिट-पुट प्रकृति की वजह से खराब स्थितियों के साथ बहुत ज़्यादा बाढ़ आ सकती है।
translations.translation: Due to the sparse nature of tropical rainfall, severe flooding can occur in poor conditions.
translations.reference: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.

translations.source: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा के जोखिम को देखते हुए निचले स्तर वाले रेगिस्तान से बाहर रहने के लिए निहायती सलाह दी जाएगी।
translations.translation: Due to the risk of tropical rainfall, extreme advice will be given to stay out of low-lying deserts.
translations.reference: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.

translations.source: भारी बारिश की वजह से घाटियां जोखिम भरी नदियां बन सकती हैं और बादल के गरजने के साथ-साथ स्थानीय इलाकों में तेज़ हवाएं चलेंगी और धूल उड़ेंगी।
translations.translation: Heavy rains can make the valleys dangerous rivers, with thunderstorms and strong winds and dust blowing in the local areas.
translations.reference: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.

translations.source: आ रही गर्त की वजह से दक्षिणी कैलिफोर्निया तट के कुछ भागों में स्थानीय रूप से बहुत ज़्यादा बारिश आाएगी।
translations.translation: Due to the arrival of heavy rains, some parts of the southern California coast will receive heavy rains locally.
translations.reference: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.

translations.source: कुल आधा इंच से ज़्यादा बारिश होने की संभावना है, जिसकी वजह से कुछ हद तक मलबे का बहाव हो सकता है और सड़कों पर फिसलाव की स्थिति बन सकती है।
translations.translation: Over half an inch of total rainfall is likely, which could lead to some debris spilling and slippery conditions on the roads.
translations.reference: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.

translations.source: यह इलाके में नमी वाले मौसम की पहली बारिश होगी।
translations.translation: This will be the first wet season in the region.
translations.reference: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.

translations.source: सोमवार और मंगलवार की शाम को बारिश के ज़्यादा व्यापक होने से पहले रविवार की शाम और सोमवार की सुबह को एरिज़ोना में कुछ छिट-पुट उष्णकटिबंधीय बारिश होने लगेगी।
