translations.source: शुक्रवार को पालू शहर के समुद्र तट पर एक त्यौहार मनाया जा रहा था जिसमें सैकड़ों लोग इकट्ठा हुए, शाम ढ़लने के बाद जब छह मीटर (18 फीट) ऊंची लहरे उठने उठी, तो इसने तबाही मचा दी थी, जिसकी वजह से कई लोगों की मौत हो गई और उनके आस-पास की सभी चीज़ें भी बर्बाद हो गईं।
translations.translation: Hundreds of people gathered at a festival on the beach in the city of Palau on Friday, when six metres (18 ft) high waves rose after dark, causing devastation, killing many people and destroying everything around them.
translations.reference: Hundreds of people had gathered for a festival on the beach in the city of Palu on Friday when waves as high as six meters (18 feet) smashed onshore at dusk, sweeping many to their deaths and destroying anything in their path.

translations.source: सुनामी 7.5 तीव्रता वाले भूकंप के बाद आई।
translations.translation: The tsunami came after a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
translations.reference: The tsunami followed a 7.5 magnitude earthquake.

translations.source: जकार्ता में ब्रीफींग में इंडोनेशिया की आपदा न्यूनीकरण एजेंसी बीएनपीबी के प्रवक्ता सुतोपो पुरवो नुगरोहो ने बताया, "कल जब सुनामी का जोखिम हुआ, उस समय बीच पर मौजूद लोग अपनी गतिविधियों में लगे हुए थे और तुरंत निकलने की स्थिति में नहीं थे और इसमें फंस गए।"
translations.translation: Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, spokesman for the Indonesian disaster mitigation agency BNPB, told a briefing in Jakarta, "When the tsunami risked yesterday, people in the middle were engaged in their activities and were not in a position to leave immediately and got stuck in it".
translations.reference: "When the tsunami threat arose yesterday, people were still doing their activities on the beach and did not immediately run and they became victims," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, the spokesman for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency BNPB said in a briefing in Jakarta.

translations.source: नुग्रोहो ने कहा, "सुनामी सिर्फ़ लोगों की मृत्यु की वजह ही नहीं बनी, बल्कि इसने कारों, लॉग्स और घरों को भी लपेटते हुए जमीन पर खींचती चली गई। समुद्र तट पर हमला करने से पहले सुनामी ने 800 कि.मी. प्रति घंटे (497 मील प्रति घंटे) की रफ़्तार से खुले समुद्र पर यात्रा की।
translations.translation: "Not only did the tsunami kill people, but it also dragged cars, logs and houses to the ground. Before hitting the beach, the tsunami travelled on the open sea at a speed of 800 km/h (497 mph) before hitting the beach", said Nugroho.
translations.reference: "The tsunami didn't come by itself, it dragged cars, logs, houses, it hit everything on land," Nugroho said, adding that the tsunami had traveled across the open sea at speeds of 800 kph (497 mph) before striking the shoreline.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि सुनामी से बचने के लिए कुछ लोगों ने पेड़ों पर चढ़ कर अपना बचाव किया।
translations.translation: He said that some people climbed trees to protect themselves from the tsunami.
translations.reference: Some people climbed trees to escape the tsunami and survived, he said.

translations.translation: 16,700 people were evacuated from 24 centres in Palau.
translations.reference: Around 16,700 people were evacuated to 24 centers in Palu.

translations.source: डिजास्टर एजेंसी द्वारा हवाई जहाज से पोस्ट की गई तस्वीरों में देखा गया कि कई इमारतें और दुकानें बर्बाद हो गईं हैं, पुल मुड़ गए और ढह गए हैं और एक मस्जिद भी पानी से घिरी हुई है।
translations.translation: Photos posted by the Disaster Agency from airplanes showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges bent and collapsed and a mosque also surrounded by water.
translations.reference: Aerial photographs released by the disaster agency showed many buildings and shops destroyed, bridges twisted and collapsed and a mosque surrounded by water.

translations.source: शनिवार को तटवर्ती शहर में पश्चात्वर्ती आघात चट्टानों पर जारी रहा।
translations.translation: Later shock continued on the rocks in the coastal town on Saturday.
translations.reference: Aftershocks continued to rock the coastal city on Saturday.

translations.source: इलाके के 2.4 मिलियन लोगों ने लगातार आने वाले भूकंप का अनुभव किया।
translations.translation: 2.4 million people in the region experienced continuous earthquakes.
translations.reference: The series of earthquakes were felt in an area with 2.4 million people.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया की एजेंसी फॉर द असेसमेंट एंड एप्लीकेशन ऑफ टेक्नोलॉजी (बीपीपीटी) ने बयान में कहा कि शुक्रवार को आए बहुत बड़े भूकंप द्वारा निकलने वाली ऊर्जा की क्षमता द्वितीय विश्वयुद्ध में हिरोशिमा पर गिराए गए परमाणु बम की क्षमता से करीब 200 गुना ज़्यादा थी।
translations.translation: The Indonesian Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in a statement that the energy output from Friday's tremendous earthquake was nearly 200 times the capacity of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War II.
translations.reference: Indonesia's Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology (BPPT) said in statement the energy released by Friday's massive quake was around 200 times the power of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima in World War Two.

translations.source: इसमें बताया गया कि एक लंबी, संकीर्ण खाड़ी के छोर पर बसा शहर का भूगोल सुनामी के आकार को बढ़ा सकता है।
translations.translation: It said that the geography of a city on a long, narrow bay could increase the size of the tsunami.
translations.reference: The geography of the city, which sits at the end of a long, narrow bay, could have magnified the size of the tsunami, it said.

translations.source: नुग्रोहो ने नुकसान के बारे में विस्तार से बताते हुए कहा कि यह "बहुत भयानक" है और इसकी वजह से हजारों घर, अस्पताल, शॉपिंग मॉल और होटल ढह गए।
translations.translation: Negroho explained the damage in detail, saying it was "very terrible" and caused thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels to collapse.
translations.reference: Nugroho described the damage as "extensive" and said thousands of houses, hospitals, shopping malls and hotels had collapsed.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि ढही इमारतों के मलबे में कुछ लोगों के शव फंस गए थे और इसमें 540 लोग घायल हो गए जबकि 29 लोगों का पता नहीं चल पाया है।
translations.translation: He said that some bodies were trapped in the rubble of the collapsed buildings and 540 people were injured while 29 people have not been identified.
translations.reference: Bodies of some victims were found trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings, he said, adding 540 people were injured and 29 were missing.

translations.source: नुग्रोहो ने बताया कि भूकंप के केंद्र के करीब पालू के उत्तर में 300 किलोमीटर (190 मील) के किनारे स्थित डोंगाला नामक इलाके में जनहानि और नुकसान के बहुत ज़्यादा होने की संभावना है।
translations.translation: Dongla, located 300 kilometres (190 mi) north of Palau near the epicentre of the earthquake, is expected to suffer heavy casualties and damage, Ngroho said.
translations.reference: Nugroho said the casualties and the damage could be greater along the coastline 300 km (190 miles) north of Palu, an area called Donggala, which is closer to the epicenter of the quake.

translations.source: नुग्रोहो ने बताया कि डोंगाला में संचार व्यवस्था "पूरी तरह से क्षतिग्रस्त हो गई” थी।
translations.translation: The communication system in Dongala was "completely damaged", Ngroho said.
translations.reference: Communications "were totally crippled with no information" from Donggala, Nugroho said.

translations.source: एक बयान में रेड क्रॉस ने बताया कि 300,000 से ज़्यादा लोग यहां रह रहे हैं और इसके कर्मचारी और स्वयंसेवक प्रभावित इलाकों का दौरा कर रहे थे।
translations.translation: In a statement, the Red Cross said more than 300,000 people were living here and its staff and volunteers were visiting the affected areas.
translations.reference: There are more than 300,000 people living there," the Red Cross said in a statement, adding that its staff and volunteers were heading to the affected areas.

translations.source: इसमें बताया गया, “पहले से यह एक दुखद घटना है, लेकिन यह और भी भयानक हो सकता है।”
translations.translation: It said, "It is a tragic event at first, but it can be even more terrible".
translations.reference: "This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse," it said.

translations.source: शनिवार को एजेंसी ने इस बात की आलोचना की कि अगर पालू में सुनामी आने वाला था, तो इस बात की जानकारी पहले क्यों नहीं दी गई, हालांकि अधिकारियों ने बताया कि चेतावनी जारी किया जाने वाला था लेकिन लहरें पहले ही चली आईं।
translations.translation: On Saturday, the agency criticized why the tsunami was not announced earlier, although officials said the warning was to be issued but the waves had already gone.
translations.reference: The agency on Saturday was widely criticized for not informing that a tsunami had hit Palu, though officials said waves had come within the time the warning was issued.

translations.source: एक व्यक्ति द्वारा शौकिया रूप से कुछ वीडियो बनाए और सोशल मीडिया पर पोस्ट किया जिसमें देखा जा सकता है कि इमारत की ऊपरी मंजिल पर स्थिति एक व्यक्ति को नीचे सड़क पर मौजूद लोग आवाज़ दे रहे थें और इसमें भयावह चेतावनी सुनी जा सकती है।
translations.translation: One person made some amateur videos and posted them on social media in which one person on the upper floor of the building could be seen sounding a voice from people down the street and a terrible warning could be heard.
translations.reference: In amateur footage shared on social media a man on the upper floor of a building can be heard shouting frantic warnings of the approaching tsunami to people on the street below.

translations.source: कुछ ही मिनटों के अंदर बहुत ज़्यादा पानी बीच से बाहर निकलने लगा और इमारतों और कारों को भी अपने साथ खींचता चला गया।
translations.translation: Within a few minutes, huge amounts of water began to flow out of the center, dragging buildings and cars with them.
translations.reference: Within minutes a wall of water crashes onto the shore, carrying away buildings and cars.

translations.source: फुटेज को तुरंत प्रमाणित करने के लिए रॉयटर्स सक्षम नहीं था।
translations.translation: Reuters was unable to immediately authenticate the footage.
translations.reference: Reuters was not able to immediately authenticate the footage.

translations.source: भूकंप और सुनामी की वजह से पालू में बिजली की समस्या हो गई और संचार की लाइनें कट गई जिससे अधिकारियों के लिए बचाव प्रयासों को एक साथ जोड़ना कठिन हो गया।
translations.translation: The earthquake and tsunami caused power failure in Palau and communication lines were cut, making it difficult for the authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.
translations.reference: The quake and tsunami caused a major power outage that cut communications around Palu making it difficult for authorities to coordinate rescue efforts.

translations.source: जकार्ता और दूसरे शहरों की सहायता लेकर अधिकारियों ने कार्गो विमान भेजना शुरू कर दिया है, अधिकारियों ने बताया कि अभी भी लोगों को निकालने और भोजन के साथ-साथ दूसरी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने की ज़रूरत है।
translations.translation: With the help of Jakarta and other cities, officials have started sending cargo planes, officials said that people still need to be evacuated and food as well as other needs are met.
translations.reference: The military has started sending in cargo planes with aid from Jakarta and other cities, authorities said, but evacuees still badly need food and other basic necessities.

translations.source: शहर के एयरपोर्ट को सिर्फ़ राहत प्रयासों के लिए फिर से खोला गया है और अक्टूबर में बंद हो जाएगा।
translations.translation: The city airport has been reopened for relief efforts only and will close in October.
translations.reference: The city's airport has been reopened only for relief efforts and will remain closed until Oct.

translations.source: पालू में निकासी केंद्रों का दौरा राष्ट्रपति जोको विडोडो रविवार को करने वाले थे।
translations.translation: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit the evacuation centres in Palau on Sunday.
translations.reference: President Joko Widodo was scheduled to visit evacuation centers in Palu on Sunday.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया में आई सुनामी की वजह से मरने वाले लोगों की संख्या 800 से ज़्यादा हो गई।
translations.translation: The death toll from the tsunami in Indonesia has risen to more than 800.
translations.reference: Indonesia Tsunami Toll Soars Above 800.

translations.source: यह बहुत भयानक है।
translations.translation: This is terrible.
translations.reference: It Is Very Bad.

translations.source: श्री डोसेबा ने बताया कि डोंगागला में स्थित वर्ल्ड विजन के कर्मचारियों ने पालू शहर को सुरक्षित बनाने का पूरा प्रयास किया, कर्मचारियों ने अपने दफ़्तर के प्रांगण में तिरपाल वाले शेल्टर बनाकर उसमें रह रहे हैं, उन्होंने इस तबाही के नज़ारे अपनी आँखों से देखे हैं।
translations.translation: Shri Doseba said that the staff of World Vision based in Donggala have made every effort to secure the city of Palo, the staff have built shelters in the courtyard of their offices with turf, they have witnessed the disaster with their own eyes.
translations.reference: While World Vision's staff from Donggala have made it safely to Palu city, where employees are sheltering in tarpaulin shelters set up in the courtyard of their office, they passed scenes of devastation on the way, Mr. Doseba said.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “उनसे बात करने पर पता चला कि उन्होंने बहुत से घरों को बर्बाद होते हुए देखा।”
translations.translation: He said that after talking to them, it was revealed that they saw many houses being destroyed.
translations.reference: "They told me they saw lots of houses that were destroyed," he said.

translations.source: यह बहुत भयानक है।
translations.translation: This is terrible.
translations.reference: It is very bad.

translations.source: सहायता समूहों ने आपदा राहत के लिए सामान लाने का काम गंभीरता से शुरू किया, कुछ लोगों ने शिकायत दर्ज़ करवाई कि खास विशेषज्ञता हासिल करने वाले बाहरी सहायता कर्मियों को पालू में आने से मना किया जा रहा है।
translations.translation: Relief groups began seriously bringing supplies for disaster relief, some complained that specialised external aid personnel were being denied access to the pallu.
translations.reference: Even as aid groups began the grim motions of starting the gears of disaster relief, some complained that foreign aid workers with deep expertise were being prevented from traveling to Palu.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया के नियमों के मुताबिक, विदेशों से धन, कोई सामान और कर्मचारी की मदद सिर्फ़ तभी ली जा सकती है जब आपदा क्षेत्र की घोषणा राष्ट्रीय आपदा क्षेत्र के रूप में कर दी जाती है।
translations.translation: According to Indonesian rules, funds, supplies and employee assistance from abroad can only be obtained when the disaster area is declared a national disaster area.
translations.reference: According to Indonesian regulations, funding, supplies and staffing from overseas can only start flowing if the site of a calamity is declared a national disaster zone.

translations.source: लेकिन, ऐसा अभी तक नहीं किया गया है।
translations.translation: But this has not yet been done.
translations.reference: That has not happened yet.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया में स्थित रेड क्रॉस के प्रवक्ता औलिया अरियानी ने बताया, "यह आपदा अभी तक प्रांत स्तर पर ही है।"
translations.translation: "The disaster is still at the provincial level", said Auliya Ariani, a spokeswoman for the Red Cross in Indonesia.
translations.reference: "It's still a province level disaster," said Aulia Arriani, a spokesperson for the Indonesian Red Cross.

translations.source: "सरकार द्वारा यह कहे जाने के बाद कि ठीक है, यह राष्ट्रीय आपदा है, तभी हम अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहायता कर्मियों को बचाव कार्य में शामिल कर सकते हैं लेकिन अभी तक ऐसा नहीं हुआ है।"
translations.translation: "Once the government has said that it is a national disaster, we can only involve international aid personnel in the rescue but this has not happened yet".
translations.reference: "Once the government says, "O.K., this is a national disaster," we can open for international assistance but there's no status yet."

translations.source: शुक्रवार को आए भूकंप और सुनामी के दूसरी रात के बाद भी पालू में जिन लोगों के दोस्त और परिवार के सदस्यों का पता नहीं चल पाया था, उन्हें इस बात की उम्मीद थी कि उनके प्रियजन चमत्कारवश कहीं मिल जाएंगे जैसा कि प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के आने बाद होता है।
translations.translation: Even after the second night of the earthquake and tsunami on Friday, the friends and family members of those who had not been identified in Palau had the hope that their loved ones would be miraculously reunited, as happens after natural disasters.
translations.reference: As the second night fell on Palu after Friday's earthquake and tsunami, friends and family of those still missing were holding out hope that their loved ones would be the miracles that leaven the bleak story lines of natural disasters.

translations.source: शनिवार को पाया गया कि एक छोटा-सा लड़का सीवर में फंसा हुआ था।
translations.translation: On Saturday, a small boy was found trapped in the sewer.
translations.reference: On Saturday, a little boy was plucked from a sewer.

translations.source: बचाव दल ने रविवार को एक महिला को मलबे से निकाला उसके बगल में उसका बच्चा दो दिनों से मलबे में फंसा हुआ था।
translations.translation: The rescue team on Sunday rescued a woman from the rubble next to her child who had been trapped in the rubble for two days.
translations.reference: On Sunday, rescuers freed a woman who had been pinned under rubble for two days with the body of her mother next to her.

translations.source: इंडोनेशियन नेशनल पैराग्लाइडिंग टीम के कोच गैंडन सुबान्डो ने खोए हुए लोगों का पता करने के लिए एशियाई गेम के दो पैराग्लिडर को प्रशिक्षण दिया, जो इंडोनेशिया में इस महीने की शुरुआत से ही इसके लिए समर्पित थे।
translations.translation: Indonesian National Paragliding Team coach Gandan Subando trained two Asian Games paragliders to track down missing people who had been dedicated to it in Indonesia since the beginning of this month.
translations.reference: Gendon Subandono, the coach of the Indonesian national paragliding team, had trained two of the missing paragliders for the Asian Games, which wrapped up earlier this month in Indonesia.

translations.source: मि. मंडगी भी अपने विद्यार्थियों के साथ रोआ रोआ होटल में फंसे हुए लोगों में शामिल थे।
translations.translation: Mr. Mandagi was also among those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel with his students.
translations.reference: Others of those trapped at the Roa Roa Hotel, Mr. Mandagi included, were his students.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “पैराग्लाइडिंग फील्ड में वरिष्ठ के तौर पर मैं भी भावनात्मक रूप से दबा हुआ हूं।”
translations.translation: As a senior in the field of paragliding, I am also emotionally depressed.
translations.reference: "As a senior in the paragliding field, I have my own emotional burden," he said.

translations.source: मि. गेंडन ने कहा कि रोआ रोआ होटल के ढहने की खबर मिलने के बाद ही पैराग्लाइडिंग समुदाय ने अपना काम शुरू कर दिया, उन्होंने बीच फेस्टिवल में भागीदारी कर रहे पालू प्रतियोगियों को WhatsApp के ज़रिए मैसेज भेजे थे।
translations.translation: Mr. Gendon said that as soon as the news of the collapse of the Roa Roa Hotel was received, the paragliding community started its work, they sent messages via WhatsApp to the Palu competitors participating in the Beach Festival.
translations.reference: Mr. Gendon recounted how, in the hours after the news of the Roa Roa Hotel collapse circulated among the paragliding community, he had desperately sent WhatsApp messages to the Palu competitors, who were taking part in the beach festival.

translations.source: फिर भी, उनके मैसेज पर सिर्फ़ ग्रे निशान ही दिखे, इस पर ब्लू निशान नहीं दिखें।
translations.translation: Nevertheless, only grey marks appear on their messages, not blue marks.
translations.reference: His messages, though, only resulted in one gray check mark, rather than a pair of blue checks.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “मुझे लगता है कि इसका मतलब है कि मैसेज लोगों तक नहीं पहुँच पाए।”
translations.translation: He said, 'I think this means that the messages could not reach people.'
translations.reference: "I think that means the messages were not delivered," he said.

translations.source: लेवी के न्यूपोर्ट में एटीएम में पैसे डालने के समय चोरों ने 26,750 डॉलर लुटे
translations.translation: Thieves looted $26,750 while depositing money at an ATM in Newport, Levy.
translations.reference: Thieves take $26,750 during ATM refill at Newport on the Levee

translations.source: न्यूपोर्ट पुलिस डिपार्टमेंट की ओर से जारी किए गए एक खबर के मुताबिक, शुक्रवार की सुबह को ब्रिंक का एक कर्मचारी लेवी के न्यूपोर्ट में स्थित एक एटीएम में पैसे डाल रहा था, इस बीच चोरों ने 26,750 डॉलर चुरा लिए।
translations.translation: According to a report released by the Newport Police Department, on Friday morning, a Brink employee was depositing money at an ATM in Newport, Levy, while thieves stole $26,750.
translations.reference: Thieves on Friday morning stole $26,750 from a Brink's worker refilling an ATM at Newport on the Levee, according to a news release from the Newport Police Department.

translations.source: जारी की गई खबर में डेट. डेनिस मैकार्थी ने लिखा कि कार का ड्राइवर एंटरटेनमेंट कॉम्प्लेक्स में एक एटीएम को खाली कर रहा था और ज़्यादा पैसे डालने की तैयारी कर रहा था।
translations.translation: In the news release, Detective Dennis McCarthy wrote that the driver of the car was clearing an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deposit more money.
translations.reference: The car's driver had been emptying an ATM in the entertainment complex and preparing to deliver more money, Det. Dennis McCarthy wrote in the release.

translations.source: जब वह अपने काम में व्यस्त था, तभी “ब्रिंक के कर्मचारी के पीछे से कोई व्यक्ति दौड़ा हुआ” आया और डालने के लिए रखे गए पैसे के बैग को लेकर भाग गया।
translations.translation: While he was busy with his work, someone came running from behind the Brink employee and ran away with a bag of money to put in.
translations.reference: While he was occupied, another man "ran up from behind the Brink's employee" and stole a bag of money meant for delivery.

translations.source: जारी की गई खबर के मुताबिक घटनास्थल पर मौजूद कई सारे लोगों पर संदेह है, लेकिन पुलिस अभी तक घटनास्थल पर मौजूद लोगों की कुल संख्या का पता नहीं लगा पाई है।
translations.translation: A number of people are suspected of being present at the scene, but the police have not yet been able to determine the total number of people present at the scene.
translations.reference: Witnesses spotted multiple suspects fleeing the scene, according to the release, but police did not specify the number involved in the incident.

translations.source: जिस किसी व्यक्ति को उनके पहचान से जुड़ी जानकारी है, उन्हें न्यूपोर्ट पुलिस को 859-292-3680 पर कॉल करना चाहिए।
translations.translation: Anyone with information relating to their identity should call the Newport Police at 859-292-3680.
translations.reference: Anyone with information about their identities should contact Newport police at 859-292-3680.

translations.source: कान्ये वेस्ट: रैपर ने अपना नाम बदलकर ये रख लिया
translations.translation: Kanye West: The rapper changed his name to this.
translations.reference: Kanye West: Rapper changes his name to Ye

translations.source: रैपर कान्ये वेस्ट अपने नाम को बदलकर ये रखने जा रहे है।
translations.translation: Rapper Kanye West is going to change his name.
translations.reference: Rapper Kanye West is changing his name - to Ye.

translations.source: बदलाव के बारे में उन्होंने शनिवार को ट्विटर पर ट्विट करके बताया: "औपचारिक रूप से उनका नाम कान्ये वेस्ट ही रहेगा।"
translations.translation: He tweeted about the change on Saturday: "Officially, his name will remain Kanye West".
translations.reference: Announcing the change on Twitter on Saturday, he wrote: "The being formally known as Kanye West."

translations.source: 41 वर्षीय वेस्ट ने कुछ समय के लिए अपना नाम ये रख लिया है और इस नाम का उपयोग जून में रिलीज़ हुए उनके आठवें एल्बम के शीर्षक मॉनीकर के लिए करेंगे।
translations.translation: West, 41, has been using the name for some time and will use it for his eighth album, titled Moniker, released in June.
translations.reference: West, 41, has been nicknamed Ye for some time and used the moniker as the title for his eighth album, which was released in June.

translations.source: शनिवार की नाईट लाइव में उनकी मौजूदगी में यह बदलाव किया जा रहा है, जहां उन्हें उनकी नई एल्बम यंदी के शुरू होने की उम्मीद है।
translations.translation: This change is being made to his presence on Saturday Night Live, where he hopes to launch his new album Yindi.
translations.reference: The change comes ahead of his appearance on Saturday Night Live, where he is expected to launch his new album Yandhi.

translations.source: शो के निर्माता ने बताया कि उन्होंने सिंगर एरियाना ग्रांडे को शो से हटा है जिन्होंने "भावनात्मक वजहों” से शो में शामिल होने से मना कर दिया था।
translations.translation: The show's creator said that he has removed singer Ariana Grande from the show who had refused to join the show for "emotional reasons".
translations.reference: He replaces singer Ariana Grande on the show who cancelled for "emotional reasons," the show's creator said.

translations.source: अपने मौजूदा प्रोफेशनल नाम को छोटा करने के साथ ही, वेस्ट ने पहले ही बताया था कि उनके लिए इस शब्द का धार्मिक महत्व है।
translations.translation: In addition to shortening his current professional name, West had already stated that the word had religious significance for him.
translations.reference: As well as being an abbreviation of his current professional name, West has previously said the word has religious significance for him.

translations.source: रेडियो होस्ट बिग बॉय के साथ अपने एल्बम के शीर्षक पर बात करते हुए इस साल की शुरुआत में ही वेस्ट ने कहा था, "मेरी मान्यता है कि 'ये' शब्द का इस्तेमाल बाइबिल में कई बार किया गया है, और बाइबल के अनुसार इसका मतलब है 'आप’।”
translations.translation: Speaking to the radio host Big Boy about the title of his album earlier this year, West said, "I believe that the word 'ye' is used many times in the Bible, and according to the Bible it means 'you.'
translations.reference: "I believe 'ye' is the most commonly used word in the Bible, and in the Bible it means 'you,'" West said earlier this year, discussing his album title with radio host Big Boy.

translations.source: “इसलिए मैं आप हूँ, मैं हम हूँ, यह हम है।
translations.translation: So I am you, I am us, this is us.
translations.reference: "So I'm you, I'm us, it's us.

translations.source: यह शब्द कान्ये से लिया गया है, जिसका मतलब है सिर्फ़ एक, जो सिर्फ़ ये है - यह हमारी अच्छाई, हमारी बुराई, हमारे भ्रम, सबकुछ को दर्शाता है।
translations.translation: This word is derived from kanye, which means only one, which is just that - it represents our goodness, our evil, our confusion, everything.
translations.reference: It went from Kanye, which means the only one, to just Ye - just being a reflection of our good, our bad, our confused, everything.

translations.source: एल्बम में हम कौन हैं इस बारे में दर्शाया गया है।
translations.translation: The album shows who we are.
translations.reference: The album is more of a reflection of who we are."

translations.source: अपना नाम बदलने वाले कई सारे मशहूर रैपर में से वे एक हैं।
translations.translation: He is one of many famous rappers who changed their name.
translations.reference: He is one of a number of famous rappers to change their name.

translations.source: सीन कॉम्ब्स के भी कई नाम हैं, जैसे कि, पफ डैडी, पी. डिड्डी या डिडी, लेकिन इस साल उन्होंने नाम के लिए घोषणा करते समय अपने नाम लव और ब्रदर लव रखे हैं।
translations.translation: Scene Combs also has several names, such as, Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year they have changed their name to Love and Brother Love when announcing the name.
translations.reference: Sean Combs has been variously known as Puff Daddy, P. Diddy or Diddy, but this year announced his preference for the names Love and Brother Love.

translations.source: वेस्ट के एक पुराने मित्र, जय-ज़ेड (JAY-Z) ने भी हाइफ़न और बड़े अक्षरों के साथ या इसके बिना अपने नाम को बदला है।
translations.translation: An old friend of West, Jay-Z, has also changed his name with or without hyphens and capital letters.
translations.reference: A former West collaborator, JAY-Z, has also made do with or without a hyphen and capitals.

translations.source: मैेक्सिको के एएमएलओ ने असैन्य नागरिकों के विरुद्ध सेना का इस्तेमाल न करने की कसम खाई
translations.translation: The AMLO of Mexico vowed not to use military force against civilians.
translations.reference: Mexico's AMLO vows not to use military against civilians

translations.source: विद्यार्थियों के विरुद्ध घातक प्रतिशोध के लिए देश के 50 साल पूरे करने पर मैक्सिकन राष्ट्रपति-उम्मीदवार आंद्रेस मैनुअल लोपेज ओब्रेडोर ने यह कसम खाई सैन्य बल का इस्तेमाल अब कभी असैनिक नागरिकों के लिए नहीं किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: On the 50th anniversary of the country's deadly retaliation against students, Mexican President-Candidate Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador swore that military force would never again be used against civilians.
translations.reference: Mexican President-elect Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador has vowed to never use military force against civilians as the country approaches the 50th anniversary of a bloody reprisal against students.

translations.source: टेल्टेलको प्लाजा में शनिवार को लोपेज़ ओब्रेडोर ने यह वादा किया कि "मैक्सिकन लोगों पर दबाव डालने के लिए कभी भी सैन्य बल का इस्तेमाल नहीं किया जाएगा।"
translations.translation: Lopez Obrador pledged Saturday at Telleco Plaza that "military force will never be used to pressure the Mexican people".
translations.reference: Lopez Obrador promised Saturday at Tlatelolco Plaza to "never ever use the military to repress the Mexican people."

translations.source: 2 अक्टूबर, 1968 को प्लाजा में हो रहे शांतिपूर्ण आंदोलन पर सैनिकों ने गोली चलाई थी जिसमें 300 से ज़्यादा लोगों की मृत्यु हो गई, यह उस समय हुआ जब वामपंथी विद्यार्थियों के आंदोलन पूरे लैटिन अमेरिका में फैल रहे थे।
translations.translation: On October 2, 1968, soldiers opened fire on a peaceful protest in the Plaza, killing more than 300 people, at a time when leftist student protests were spreading throughout Latin America.
translations.reference: Troops fired on a peaceful demonstration at the plaza on Oct. 2, 1968, killing as many as 300 people at a time when leftist student movements were taking root throughout Latin America.

translations.source: लोपेज़ ओब्रेडोर ने मैक्सिको के युवाओं को सहायता देने का वादा किया है, वे पढ़ने वाले विद्यार्थियों को हर महीने अनुदान देंगे और ज़्यादा-से-ज़्यादा मुफ़्त सरकारी यूनिवर्सिटी खोलेंगे।
translations.translation: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support Mexico's youth, grant students a scholarship every month and open more and more free public universities.
translations.reference: Lopez Obrador has pledged to support young Mexicans by giving monthly subsidies to those who study and opening more free public universities.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि बेरोजगारी और शिक्षा पाने के कम अवसरों की वजह से युवा वर्ग अपराध करने वाले लोगों में शामिल हो जाते हैं।
translations.translation: He said that due to unemployment and low educational opportunities, young people are becoming involved in crime.
translations.reference: He has said that unemployment and a lack of educational opportunities draws youth to criminal gangs.

translations.source: यू.एस. को ए.आई. के लिए दिए जाने वाले फंड को दोगुना करना चाहिए
translations.translation: The U.S. should double its funding for AI.
translations.reference: U.S. should double A.I. funding

translations.source: Google, Microsoft और Apple के लिए कम कर चुके निवेशक और एआई के व्यवसायी काई-फू ली ने कहा, चूंकि चीन आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस में ज़्यादा सक्रिय हो रहा है, इसलिए यू.एस. को इस क्षेत्र में शोध पर की जाने वाली खर्च की राशि को दोगुना कर देना चाहिए।
translations.translation: Kai-Fu Li, a downsizing investor and AI entrepreneur for Google, Microsoft and Apple, said that as China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount spent on research in this field.
translations.reference: As China becomes more active in artificial intelligence, the U.S. should double the amount it spends on research in the field, says investor and AI practitioner Kai-Fu Lee, who has worked for Google, Microsoft and Apple.

translations.source: यू.एस. सरकार के अनेक कामों के बाद एआई ने यह टिप्पणी की है, उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि यू.एस. में समग्र औपचारिक एआई रणनीति की कमी है।
translations.translation: AI has made this comment after much work by the U.S. government, adding that the U.S. lacks an overall formal AI strategy.
translations.reference: The comments come after various parts of the U.S. government have made AI announcements, even as the U.S. overall lacks a formal AI strategy.

translations.source: इस बीच, पिछले साल चीन ने एक योजना शुरू की: इसमें उसका लक्ष्य 2030 तक एआई इनोवेशन में नंबर 1 पर पहुँचने का है।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, last year China launched a plan: It aims to become No. 1 in AI innovation by 2030.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, China introduced its plan last year: it's aiming to be No.1 in AI innovation by 2030.

translations.source: ली ने बताया, "एआई शोध बजट को दोगुना करने से बढ़िया शुरुआत मिलेगी, अलग दूसरे सभी देशों पर नज़र डालें, तो यू.एस. इस मामले से बहुत पीछे हैं, और हम एआई की अगली सफलता के लिए कोशिशें कर रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: "Doubling the AI research budget will be a great start", Lee said. "If you look at all the other countries separately, the U.S. is far behind on this, and we're working on the next breakthrough for AI".
translations.reference: "Double the AI research budget would be a good start, given that all other countries are so much farther behind U.S., and we're looking for the next breakthrough in AI," said Lee.

translations.source: इस सप्ताह एक साक्षात्कार में सीएनबीसी से ली ने कहा, “फंड को दोगुना करने से इस बात की संभावना दोगुनी हो सकती है कि एआई की अगली बड़ी उपलब्धि यू.एस. में होगी।”
translations.translation: In an interview with CNBC this week, Lee said that doubling the fund could double the likelihood that the next big achievement of AI will be in the US.
translations.reference: Doubling funding could double the chances that the next big AI achievement will be made in the U.S., Lee told CNBC in an interview this week.

translations.source: ली, जिनकी किताब "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" इसी महीने ह्यूटन मिफ्लिन हरकोर्ट द्वारा प्रकाशित की गई थी, सिनोवेशन वेंचर्स के सीईओ हैं, वे चीन की सबसे बेहतरीन एआई कंपनियों में से एक कंपनी Face++ के निवेशक हैं।
translations.translation: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is the CEO of Sinovation Ventures, is an investor in Face++, one of China's best AI companies.
translations.reference: Lee, whose book "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" was published this month by Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, is CEO of Sinovation Ventures, which has invested in one of the most prominent AI companies in China, Face++.

translations.source: 1980 के दशक में, कार्नेगी मेलन यूनिवर्सिटी में उन्होंने एक एआई सिस्टम पर काम किया था जिसने सबसे ज़्यादा रैंक वाले अमेरिकी ओथेलो प्लेयर को काफ़ी पीछे छोड़ दिया, और बाद में वे  Microsoft Research में एग्जीक्यूटिव के पद पर और Google की चीन ब्रांच में प्रेसिडेंट के पद पर नियुक्त हुए।
translations.translation: In the 1980s, at Carnegie Mellon University, he worked on an AI system that far outranked the highest-ranked American Othello player, and he was later appointed to the positions of executive at Microsoft Research and president at Google's China branch.
translations.reference: In the 1980s at Carnegie Mellon University he worked on an AI system that beat the highest-ranked American Othello player, and later he was an executive at Microsoft Research and president of Google's China branch.

translations.source: ली ने पिछली यू.एस. गवर्नमेंट की तकनीकी योग्यताओं को बेहतर बताया जिसमें डिफेंस एडवांस्ड रिसर्च प्रोजेक्ट्स एजेंसी की रोबोट संबंधित चुनौतियां शामिल हैं और कहा कि वह अगली सरकार कौन होगी जो अगले दूरदर्शी को पहचान पाएगी।
translations.translation: Lee outlined the technical capabilities of the previous U.S. government, including the robotics-related challenges of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, and said who would be the next government to identify the next visionary.
translations.reference: Lee acknowledged previous U.S. government technology competitions like the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge and asked when the next one would be, in order to help identify the next visionaries.

translations.source: ली ने बताया कि यू.एस. के शोधकर्ताओं को अक्सर सरकारी मदद पाने के लिए काफ़ी कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ता है।
translations.translation: Researchers in the U.S. often face considerable difficulties in obtaining government assistance, Lee said.
translations.reference: Researchers in the U.S. often have to work hard in order to win government grants, Lee said.

translations.source: ली ने बताया, "यह अकादमिक नेताओं को हटाने वाला चीन नहीं है, यह कॉर्पोरेट है।"
translations.translation: "It's not China removing academic leaders, it's corporate", Lee said.
translations.reference: "It's not China that is taking away the academic leaders; it's the corporates," Lee said.

translations.source: हाल के सालों में Facebook, Google और दूसरी तकनीकी कंपनियों ने एआई पर काम करने के लिए यूनिवर्सिटी से दिग्गजों को नियुक्त किया है।
translations.translation: In recent years, Facebook, Google and other tech companies have recruited veterans from the university to work on AI.
translations.reference: Facebook, Google and other technology companies have hired luminaries from universities to work on AI in recent years.

translations.source: ली ने बताया कि इमीग्रेशन पॉलिसी में बदलाव करके यू.एस. को अपने एआई प्रयासों में सहायता मिल सकती है।
translations.translation: Lee said a change in immigration policy could help the U.S. in its AI efforts.
translations.reference: Lee said immigration policy changes could also help the U.S. bolster its AI efforts.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया, “मेरे हिसाब से ग्रीन कार्ड के ज़रिए एआई में पीएचडी करने की अनुमति अपने आप मिल जानी चाहिए।”
translations.translation: He said, "In my opinion, getting permission to do a PhD in AI through a green card should be done automatically".
translations.reference: "I think green cards should automatically be offered to PhD's in AI," he said.

translations.source: जुलाई 2017 में चीन की स्टेट काउंसिल ने अपना नेक्स्ट जनरेशन आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस डेवेलपमेंट प्लान जारी किया।
translations.translation: In July 2017, the State Council of China released its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan.
translations.reference: China's State Council issued its Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan in July 2017.

translations.source: ली ने कहा, “चीन के नेशनल नेचुरल साइंस फाउंडेशन ने अकेडमिक इंस्टिट्यूट के लोगों को जिस तरह से फंड दिया जाता है, उसी तरह से नेशनल साइंस फाउंडेशन और दूसरे सरकारी संगठन यू.एस. के शोधकर्ताओं को आर्थिक अनुदान देते हैं, लेकिन चीन में शिक्षा देने के कामों की गुणवत्ता बहुत अच्छी नहीं है।
translations.translation: Li said that the National Natural Science Foundation of China provides financial grants to U.S. researchers in the same way that the National Science Foundation and other governmental organizations provide funding to academic institutions, but the quality of educational work in China is not very good.
translations.reference: China's National Natural Science Foundation provides funding to people at academic institutions similar to the way that the National Science Foundation and other government organizations dole out money to U.S. researchers, but the quality of academic work is lower in China, Lee said.

translations.source: इस साल की शुरुआत में, यू.एस. डिफेंस डिपार्टमेंट ने एक जॉइंट आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस सेंटर खोला, जिसका लक्ष्य उद्योग और शिक्षाविदों के भागीदारों को शामिल करना है, और व्हाइट हाउस ने आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस के लिए सेलेक्ट कमिटी के निर्माण की घोषणा की।
translations.translation: Earlier this year, the U.S. Department of Defense opened a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which aims to engage industry and academic partners, and the White House announced the creation of a Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
translations.reference: Earlier this year the U.S. Defense Department established a Joint Artificial Intelligence Center, which is meant to involve partners from industry and academia, and the White House announced the formation of Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, इसी महीने डीएआरपीए ने एआई नेक्स्ट के नाम से एक पहल शुरू की जिसमें 2 बिलियन डॉलर के निवेश की बात की।
translations.translation: In addition, this month, DARPA launched an initiative called AI Next which talked about investment of 2 billion dollars.
translations.reference: And this month DARPA announced a $2 billion investment in an initiative called AI Next.

translations.source: एनएसएफ के लिए, अभी यह निवेश एआई अनुसंधान में हर साल 100 मिलियन डॉलर से ज़्यादा है।
translations.translation: For NSF, right now that investment in AI research is over $100 million a year.
translations.reference: As for the NSF, it currently invests more than $100 million per year in AI research.

translations.source: इस बीच, यू.एस. में कानून बनाया गया कि आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस के लिए नेशनल सिक्यूरिटी कमीशन बनाने की मांग को महीनों तक नज़रअंदाज़ किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, legislation was enacted in the U.S. that the demand for a National Security Commission for Artificial Intelligence would be ignored for months.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, U.S. legislation that sought to create a National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence has not seen action in months.

translations.source: मैसेडोनिया के लोगों ने इस बात के लिए वोट किया कि देश का नाम बदला जाएगा या नहीं
translations.translation: The people of Macedonia voted to change the name of the country or not.
translations.reference: Macedonians vote in referendum on whether to change country's name

translations.source: रविवार को मैसेडोनिया के लोगों ने इस बात के लिए वोट दिया कि देश के नाम को बदलकर "रिपब्लिक ऑफ नॉर्थ मैसेडोनिया" रखा जाएगा या नहीं, यह एक ऐसा काम है जिससे ग्रीस के साथ चल रहे दशकों पुराने विवाद का समाधान किया जाएगा, इसकी वजह से ग्रीस ने यूरोपीय संघ और नाटो में इसकी सदस्यता बोलियों पर रोक लगा दी थी।
translations.translation: On Sunday, Macedonians voted to change the country's name to the "Republic of North Macedonia", a move to resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece that led to Greece suspending its membership bids in the European Union and NATO.
translations.reference: The people of Macedonia voted in a referendum on Sunday on whether to change its name to "Republic of North Macedonia," a move that would resolve a decades-old dispute with Greece which had blocked its membership bids for the European Union and NATO.

translations.source: ग्रीस में भी एक ऐसा प्रांत है जिसका नाम मैसिडोनिया है, उसका कहना है कि इसके उत्तरी पड़ोसी का नाम उसके इलाके पर है जिससे एक ही दावेदारी के लिए दो नाम हो गए हैं और वह नाटो और यूरोपीय संघ में पहले से ही शामिल है।
translations.translation: There is also a province in Greece called Macedonia, which claims that its northern neighbour is named after its territory, making it two names for the same claim and is already a member of NATO and the European Union.
translations.reference: Greece, which has a province called Macedonia, maintains that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has vetoed its entrance into NATO and the EU.

translations.source: दोनों सरकारों ने सुझाए गए नए नाम के आधार पर जून में एक डील की, लेकिन राष्ट्रवादी विरोधियों ने इसका विरोध किया और कहा कि मैसेडोनिया का नाम बदलने से स्लाविक में रहने वाले बहुसंख्यक लोगों की जातीय पहचान कमजोर हो जाएगी।
translations.translation: The two governments reached a deal in June on the basis of the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents opposed it, saying that changing Macedonia's name would weaken the ethnic identity of the majority of people living in Slavs.
translations.reference: The two governments struck a deal in June based on the proposed new name, but nationalist opponents argue the change would undermine the ethnic identity of Macedonia's Slavic majority population.

translations.source: राष्ट्रपति ग्जॉर्ज इवानोव ने बताया कि वे जनमत संग्रह में वोट देने नहीं जाएंगे और अभियान का बहिष्कार करेंगे, उन्होंने इस बात पर संदेह जताया है कि इस वोटिंग के लिए ज़रूरी न्यूनतम 50 प्रतिशत वोट ही वैध होगा।
translations.translation: President Georgy Ivanov said that he would not go to the referendum and boycott the campaign, doubting that a minimum of 50 per cent of the votes required for this vote would be valid.
translations.reference: President Gjorge Ivanov has said he will not be voting in the referendum and a boycott campaign has cast doubts on whether turnout will meet the minimum 50 percent required for the referendum to be valid.

translations.source: वोटिंग बैलेट पर यह सवाल लिखा होगा: “क्या आप नाटो और ईयू की सदस्यता के लिए ग्रीस के साथ होने वाले समझौते के लिए अपनी स्वीकृति देते हैं।”
translations.translation: The ballot will have the following question: 'Do you approve the agreement with Greece for NATO and EU membership?'
translations.reference: The question on the referendum ballot read: "Are you for NATO and EU membership with acceptance of the agreement with Greece."

translations.source: प्रधानमंत्री ज़ोरान ज़ेव के साथ-साथ नाम के बदलाव से जुड़े समर्थकों का कहना है कि मैसिडोनिया के लिए ईयू और नाटो जैसे निकायों में सदस्य बनाना ज़रूरी है, यह उन देशों में से एक है जो यूगोस्लाविया के पतन से उभरा है।
translations.translation: Prime Minister Zoran Zev and supporters of the name change say that Macedonia needs to become a member of bodies like the EU and NATO, one of the countries that emerged from the collapse of Yugoslavia.
translations.reference: Supporters of the name change, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that it is a price worth paying to pursue admission into bodies such as the EU and NATO for Macedonia, one of the countries to emerge from the collapse of Yugoslavia.

translations.source: स्कोपजे में रहने वाले 79 वर्षीय ओलीवेरा जॉर्जिजेवस्का ने बताया, "आज मैं देश के भविष्य के लिए वोट करने के लिए आया हूं, यह भविष्य मैसेडोनिया में युवा लोगों के लिए है, इससे वे  ईयू की छत्र-छाया में स्वतंत्र रूप से रह सकेंगे क्योंकि इसका मतलब हम सबके लिए सुरक्षित जीवन है।"
translations.translation: "Today I am here to vote for the future of the country, this future is for young people in Macedonia, so that they can live freely in the shadow of the EU because it means a safe life for all of us", said Olivera Georgievska, 79, who lives in Skopje.
translations.reference: "I came today to vote for the future of the country, for young people in Macedonia so they can be live freely under the umbrella of the European Union because it means safer lives for all of us," said Olivera Georgijevska, 79, in Skopje.

translations.source: हालांकि, कानूनी तौर पर इसके लिए जोर नहीं डाला जा रहा है, संसद के ज़्यादातर सदस्यों का कहना है कि वे इसे निर्णायक बनाने के लिए वोट के नतीज़ों के अनुसार काम करेंगे।
translations.translation: While there is no legal push for it, most members of parliament say they will act according to the results of the vote to make it decisive.
translations.reference: Although not legally binding, enough members of parliament have said they will abide by the vote's outcome to make it decisive.

translations.source: संसद में नाम बदलाव के लिए दो-तिहाई बहुमत की ज़रूरत होती है।
translations.translation: A two-thirds majority is required to change the name in Parliament.
translations.reference: The name change would requires a two-thirds majority in parliament.

translations.source: स्टेट इलेक्शन कमीशन का कहना है कि दोपहर 1 बजे तक अनियमितताओं की कोई सूचना नहीं मिली थी।
translations.translation: The State Election Commission says that no irregularities were reported as of 1 pm.
translations.reference: The state election commission said there had been no reports of irregularities by 1 p.m.

translations.source: हालांकि, 2016 में जब पिछ्ला संसदीय चुनाव हुआ था, तो उसमें 34 प्रतिशत की तुलना में वोटिंग सिर्फ़ 16 प्रतिशत रही, इसमें 66 प्रतिशत पंजीकृत मतदाताओं ने अपना वोट दिया था।
translations.translation: However, in 2016 when the last parliamentary elections were held, only 16 per cent of the votes were cast, compared to 34 per cent, with 66 per cent of registered voters casting their votes.
translations.reference: However, turnout stood at only 16 percent, compared to 34 percent in last parliamentary election in 2016 when 66 percent of the registered voters cast their ballot.

translations.source: राजधानी, स्कोप्जे में रहने वाले एक 62 वर्षीय मतदाता गोजो तनेव्स्की ने बताया, "मैं अपने बच्चों के कारण वोट देने आया था, हमारा स्थान यूरोप में है।”
translations.translation: "I came here to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe", said 62 - year - old voter Gozo Tanewski, who lives in Skopje, the capital.
translations.reference: "I came out to vote because of my children, our place is in Europe," said Gjose Tanevski, 62, a voter in the capital, Skopje.

translations.source: मैसेडोनिया के प्रधानमंत्री ज़ोरान ज़ेव अपनी पत्नी ज़ोरिका और अपने बेटे दुशको के साथ देश के नाम में बदलाव के लिए मैसेडोनिया में अपना वोट देने गए, ताकि 30 सितंबर, 2018 को स्ट्रोमिका, मैसेडोनिया में देशा का नाम नाटो और यूरोपीय संघ में शामिल हो जाए।
translations.translation: Macedonian Prime Minister Zoran Zeev, with his wife Zorica and son Dusko, went to Macedonia to vote for the country's name change, so that the country's name in Stromika, Macedonia, would join NATO and the European Union on September 30, 2018.
translations.reference: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.

translations.source: संसद के सामने स्कोप्जे के रहने वाले 54 वर्षीय व्लादिमीर कवर्दार्कोव छोटा-सा स्टेज तैयार कर रहे थे और जो लोग इस वोटिंग के विरोध करने वाले हैं उनके लगाए गए टेंट के सामने कुर्सियां लगा रहे थे।
translations.translation: Vladimir Kvardarkov, 54, who lives in Skopje, was preparing a small stage in front of Parliament and was setting up chairs in front of the tents of those who would oppose the vote.
translations.reference: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.

translations.source: कावड़ार्कोव ने कहा, “हमें नाटो और ईयू की सदस्यता ज़रूर चाहिए, लेकिन हम अपना सिर ऊंचा करके इसमें शामिल होना चाहते, न कि किसी समझौते के माध्यम से।”
translations.translation: "We need NATO and EU membership, but we want to join by lifting our heads, not through an agreement", Kavarkov said.
translations.reference: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.

translations.source: “हमारा देश गरीब ज़रूर है, लेकिन हमारा अपना स्वाभिमान भी है।
translations.translation: Our country is certainly poor, but we also have our own self-respect.
translations.reference: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.

translations.source: अगर वे हमें मैसिडोनिया के नाम से सदस्यता नहीं देना चाहते, तो कोई बात नहीं, हम चीन और रूस जैसे दूसरे देशों से जुड़कर यूरो-एशिया एकीकरण का भाग बन सकते हैं।”
translations.translation: If they don't want us to subscribe in the name of Macedonia, it doesn't matter, we can join other countries like China and Russia to become part of Euro-Asian integration.
translations.reference: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."

translations.source: प्रधानमंत्री ज़ेव ने कहा है कि नाटो में सदस्यता मिल जाने से मैसेडोनिया को बहुत ज़रूरी निवेश मिलेगा, यहां की बेरोजगारी दर 20 प्रतिशत से ज़्यादा है।
translations.translation: Prime Minister Zev has said that accession to NATO will provide a very important investment for Macedonia, with an unemployment rate of more than 20 per cent.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.

translations.source: अपना वोट डालने के बाद ज़ेव ने कहा, "मेरे हिसाब से बहुत ज़्यादा वोट सकारात्मकता को मिलेगा क्योंकि हमारे 80 प्रतिशत से ज़्यादा नागरिक ईयू और नाटो से जुड़ने के लिए सहमत हैं।"
translations.translation: After his vote, Zev said, "I think a lot of votes will be positive because more than 80 percent of our citizens agree to join the EU and NATO".
translations.reference: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि "हां" नतीजे से "हमारे भविष्य की पुष्टि" होगी।
translations.translation: He said that the "yes" result would "confirm our future".
translations.reference: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."

translations.source: पिछले सोमवार को मैसेडोनिया के इंस्टीट्यूट फॉर पॉलिसी रिसर्च द्वारा प्रकाशित सर्वे से पता चला है कि ज़रूरी मतदान में 30 से 43 प्रतिशत वोटर इस वोटिंग में भाग लेंगे।
translations.translation: Last Monday, a survey published by the Macedonian Institute for Policy Research showed that 30 to 43 per cent of voters would participate in the necessary voting.
translations.reference: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.

translations.source: रविवार को मैसेडोनिया के टेल्मा टीवी द्वारा कराए गए दूसरे सर्वे से पता चला है कि 57 प्रतिशत लोग वोट देने की योजना बना रहे हैं।
translations.translation: A second survey conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV on Sunday showed that 57 per cent of people are planning to vote.
translations.reference: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.

translations.source: उनमें से, 70 प्रतिशत लोग हाँ में मतदान करने के लिए सहमत हैं।
translations.translation: Of those, 70 percent agreed to vote yes.
translations.reference: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.

translations.source: वोटिंग के सफल होने के लिए 50 प्रतिशत से ज़्यादा वोटिंग ज़रूरी है।
translations.translation: More than 50 per cent of votes are required for a vote to be successful.
translations.reference: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.

translations.source: अगर वोटिंग असफल होती है, तो पिछले साल मई में बनने वाली वेस्टर्न गवर्नमेंट की नीति को पहला गंभीर झटका लगेगा।
translations.translation: If the vote fails, the policy of the Western government formed in May last year will suffer the first serious blow.
translations.reference: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.

translations.source: देखें: मैनचेस्टर सिटी के सर्जियो एगुएरो ने गोल करने के लिए पूरी ब्राइटन को डिफेंस करने पर मजबूर किया
translations.translation: See: Sergio Aguero of Manchester City forced the whole Brighton to defend to score
translations.reference: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal

translations.source: शनिवार को मैनचेस्टर सिटी, इंग्लैंड के एतिहाद स्टेडियम में सर्जियो एगुएरो और रहिम स्टर्लिंग ने मैनचेस्टर सिटी की 2-0 की जीत में ब्राइटन से काफ़ी डिफेंस करवाया।
translations.translation: At the Etihad Stadium in Manchester City, England on Saturday, Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling made a strong defense against Brighton in a 2-0 win over Manchester City.
translations.reference: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.

translations.source: हास्यास्पद रूप से एगुएरो ने 65वें मिनट में अपना आसान गोल बनाया।
translations.translation: Ironically, Aguero scored his easy goal in the 65th minute.
translations.reference: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.

translations.source: अर्जेंटीना के स्ट्राइकर को शुरुआती दौर में ही मिडफील्ड में पास दिया गया।
translations.translation: The Argentine striker was passed in midfield in the early stages.
translations.reference: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.

translations.source: ओपन फिल्ड में उतरते ही उन्होंने तीन ब्राइटन खिलाड़ियों से डिफेंस करवाया।
translations.translation: As he landed on the open field, he defended against three Brighton players.
translations.reference: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.

translations.source: उसके बाद एगुएरो ने खुद को चार विपक्षी खिलाड़ियों से घिरा हुआ पाया।
translations.translation: Afterwards Aguero found himself surrounded by four opposing players.
translations.reference: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.

translations.source: उन्होंने ब्राइटन बॉक्स के कोने से आगे की ओर बढ़ने से पहले डिफेंस करने वाले एक खिलाड़ी को धक्का दिया।
translations.translation: He pushed a defender before moving forward from the corner of the Brighton box.
translations.reference: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.

translations.source: फिर, स्टर्लिंग को ढूंढते हुए उन्होंने अपनी बाईं ओर एक पास भेजा।
translations.translation: Then, looking for Sterling, he sent a pass to his left.
translations.reference: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.

translations.source: एगुएरो को बॉल वापस देने के लिए बॉक्स में इंग्लिश फॉरवर्ड ने अपने पहले टच का इस्तेमाल किया, एगुएरो ने अपने बाएं बूट का इस्तेमाल करके ब्राइटन कीपर मैथ्यू रयान को बीट किया और बॉल उनके दाईं ओर से निकल कर नेट में चली गई।
translations.translation: The English forward in the box used his first touch to return the ball to Aguero, Aguero used his left boot to beat Brighton keeper Matthew Ryan and the ball passed from his right side into the net.
translations.reference: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.

translations.source: सिटी मैनेजर पेप गार्डियोला ने रिपोर्टर को बताया, "एगुएरो के पैरों में कुछ समस्याएं हो गई हैं जिससे वह परेशान है।"
translations.translation: City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters, "Aguero has had some leg problems that are troubling him".
translations.reference: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.

translations.source: “हमने 55, 60 मिनट उनके खेल पर बात की।
translations.translation: We talked about his game for 55, 60 minutes.
translations.reference: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.

translations.source: यही हुआ भी।
translations.translation: That's what happened.
translations.reference: That's what happened.

translations.source: हम किस्मतवाले रहे कि उन्होंने उसी समय गोल कर दिया।”
translations.translation: We were lucky that they scored at the same time.
translations.reference: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."

translations.source: लेकिन, यह स्टर्लिंग की वजह से हुआ जिसने प्रीमियर लीग की मुठभेड़ में स्काई ब्लूज़ को शुरुआती फ़ायदा पहुंचाया।
translations.translation: But it was Stirling who gave the Sky Blues an early lead in the Premier League clash.
translations.reference: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.

translations.source: 29वें मिनट में वह गोल मिला।
translations.translation: He scored in the 29th minute.
translations.reference: That goal came in the 29th minute.

translations.source: उस गेम में एगुएरो को ब्राइटन के क्षेत्र में बॉल डीप मिला।
translations.translation: In that game Aguero got a ball dip in the area of Brighton.
translations.reference: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.

translations.source: उन्होंने बॉल को खूबसूरत से लेरॉय सेन के बाईं ओर से निकाला।
translations.translation: He pulled the ball beautifully from Leroy Sen's left.
translations.reference: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.

translations.source: बढ़िया खेल रहे स्टर्लिंग को दूर भेजने से पहले सेन कुछ टच किए।
translations.translation: Sen scored a few touchdowns before sending away Sterling, who was playing well.
translations.reference: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.

translations.source: गेम के हाथ से फिसलने से ठीक पहले स्काई ब्लूज़ ने बॉल को आगे की ओर टैप किया।
translations.translation: Just before the game slipped out of hand, Sky Blues tapped the ball forward.
translations.reference: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.

translations.source: चैंपियंस लीग ग्रुप प्ले में अब मुकाबला हॉफेनहेम से मंगलवार को दोपहर 12:55 बजे सिनसिम, जर्मनी के राइन-नेकर-एरिना में होगा।
translations.translation: The Champions League group play will now be played against Hoffenheim on Tuesday afternoon at 12:55 pm in Sinsim, Rhine-Neckar-Arena, Germany.
translations.reference: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.

translations.source: रॉकीज़ के विरुद्ध खेलकर शेज़र उसे हराना चाहते हैं
translations.translation: Shazer wants to beat him by playing against the Rockies.
translations.reference: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies

translations.source: नेशनल्स के साथ प्लेऑफ विवाद खत्म होने के बाद, किसी और स्टार्ट के लिए जोर डालने की कोई बड़ी वजह नहीं थी।
translations.translation: After the playoff dispute with the Nationals was over, there was no big reason to push for another start.
translations.reference: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.

translations.source: लेकिन, हमेशा प्रतिस्पर्धा करने वाले स्केजर को यह उम्मीद है कि रविवार को वे कोलोराडो रॉकीज के विरुद्द बड़े स्कोर बनाएंगे, लेकिन रॉकीज के लिए प्लेऑफ अभी भी सिर्फ़ संभावना बनी हुई है, उसे एनएल वेस्ट में लॉस एंजिल्स डोजर्स के साथ खेले जाने वाले गेम में जीत मिली है।
translations.translation: But Schizer, who has always competed, expects to score big against the Colorado Rockies on Sunday, but the playoffs are still a possibility for the Rockies, winning a game against the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
translations.reference: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.

translations.source: शुक्रवार की रात को नेशनल्स पर 5-2 से जीत दर्ज़ करके रॉकीज ने एक वाइल्ड-कार्ड स्पॉट प्राप्त किया, लेकिन वे अभी भी पहला डिवीज़न टाइटल प्राप्त करने की तलाश में हैं।
translations.translation: The Rockies earned a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but they are still looking to clinch the First Division title.
translations.reference: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.

translations.source: "भले ही हम बहुत बढ़िया नहीं खेल पा रहे हैं, लेकिन हम कम से कम हम यह जानने के लिए खेल सकते हैं कि भीड़ और दूसरी टीम वाले डेनवर का माहौल शायद सबसे ऊंचे लेवल का खेल के लिए होगा जिसका सामना मैं इस साल करूंगा।
translations.translation: "Although we may not be playing very well, we can at least play to know that Denver's atmosphere with crowds and other teams will probably be for the highest level of play I will face this year.
translations.reference: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.

translations.source: मैं उस गेम में क्यों भाग नहीं लेना चाहूंगा? "
translations.translation: Why wouldn't I want to play that game?"
translations.reference: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"

translations.source: नेशनल्स को अभी भी रविवार के लिए स्टार्टर के बारे में बताना बाकी है, लेकिन सुनने में आ रहा है कि ऐसी स्थिति में शेज़र को शामिल किया जा सकता है।
translations.translation: The Nationals have yet to be told about the starter for Sunday, but there are rumors that Shazer could be included in such a situation.
translations.reference: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.

translations.source: अपने 34वें स्टार्ट के लिए खेलने वाले शेज़र ने गुरूवार को बुलपेन सेशन का जोखिम लिया और रविवार को अपने नार्मल पर पिच करेंगे।
translations.translation: Playing for his 34th start, Shazer took the risk of a bullpen session on Thursday and will pitch on his normal on Sunday.
translations.reference: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.

translations.source: वॉशिंगटन के राइट हैंडर ने इस सीजन की 220 2/3 इनिंग में  2.53 ERA और 300 स्ट्राइक के साथ 18-7 पर रहे।
translations.translation: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
translations.reference: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.

translations.source: वेस्ट वर्जीनिया में ट्रम्प की रैलियां
translations.translation: Trump's rallies in West Virginia
translations.reference: Trump rallies in West Virginia

translations.source: मिडटर्म इलेक्शन में रिपब्लिकन मत के महत्व के बारे में बात करते हुए राष्ट्रपति ने ब्रेट कवानौघ को लेकत अपने सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आसपास की स्थिति का सन्दर्भ दिया।
translations.translation: Talking about the importance of the Republican vote in the midterm elections, the President referred to Brett Kavanaugh as referring to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court.
translations.reference: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.

translations.source: "हमारे द्वारा किए गए सभी काम नवंबर में दांव पर होंगे।
translations.translation: "All the work we have done will be at stake in November.
translations.reference: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.

translations.source: हमारे जीवन के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण चुनाव के लिए अब सिर्फ़ पाँच हफ़्ते रह गए हैं।
translations.translation: We are only five weeks away from the most important election of our lives.
translations.reference: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “यह बहुत बड़ा चुनाव है - इसमें मैं शामिल नहीं हूं, लेकिन वाकई मैं ही शामिल हूं, इसकी वजह यह है कि मैं सारे महान उम्मीदवारों के लिए लड़ रहा हूं।”
translations.translation: He said, "This is a big election - I am not involved in it, but I am indeed involved, because I am fighting for all the great candidates. "
translations.reference: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.

translations.source: ट्रम्प ने आगे जोड़ते हुए कहा, "आप डेमोक्रेट के इस बहुत ज़्यादा भयानक कट्टरपंथी समूह पर नज़र डाल सकते हैं, आप अभी हो रही सभी चीज़ों को देख सकते हैं।
translations.translation: Trump added, "You can look at this very terrible radical group of Democrats, you can see everything that's happening right now.
translations.reference: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, वे दूसरे ज़रूरी साधनों का इस्तेमाल करके सत्ता हथियाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं, जिसके बारे में आप जानते हैं कि यह निरर्थक है और बेकार की बात है।
translations.translation: Moreover, they are trying to seize power by other necessary means, which you know is futile and useless.
translations.reference: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.

translations.source: सत्ता और कंट्रोल पाने के लिए वे इस बात की परवाह नहीं करते कि कौन दुखी है, कौन इसके काबिल है, वे बस यहीं चाहते हैं कि सत्ता और कंट्रोल उनको मिल जाए, लेकिन हम ऐसा नहीं होने देंगे।”
translations.translation: In order to gain power and control, they don't care who is unhappy, who is capable, they just want power and control, but we won't let that happen.
translations.reference: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया, डेमोक्रेट का अभियान "विरोध और बाधा डालना" है।
translations.translation: He said the campaign of the Democrats is "contradiction and obstruction".
translations.reference: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “इसके अलावा, आप देख सकते हैं कि पिछले चार दिनों में क्या-क्या हुआ है, डेमोक्रेट का गुस्सा आपने देखा और यह भी देखा वे कितने मतलबी और बुरे हैं।”
translations.translation: Besides, you can see what has happened in the last four days, you have seen the anger of the Democrats and you have also seen how meaningful and evil they are.
translations.reference: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."

translations.source: उन्होंने सीनेट ज्यूडिशियरी कमिटी का सन्दर्भ देकर डेमोक्रेटिक सेन. डायने फेइंस्टीन के नाम का उल्लेख किया, जिनकी सराहना दर्शकों ने जोरदार तरीके से की।
translations.translation: Referring to the Senate Judiciary Committee, he mentioned the name of Democratic Senator Diane Feinstein, who was highly appreciated by the audience.
translations.reference: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.

translations.source: “उसका जवाब याद कीजिए?
translations.translation: Remember his answer?
translations.reference: "Remember her answer?

translations.source: क्या आपने दस्तावेज़ को लीक किया?
translations.translation: Did you leak the document?
translations.reference: Did you leak the document?

translations.source: क्या।
translations.translation: What?
translations.reference: Uh, uh, what.

translations.source: नहीं, नहीं, मैं उस बात का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूं - जिसकी बॉडी लैंग्वेज वाकई बहुत खराब थी - ऐसी खराब बॉडी लैंग्वेज मैंने पहली बार देखी।”
translations.translation: No, no, I'm waiting for the one whose body language was really bad -- such bad body language I've never seen before.
translations.reference: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."

translations.source: काम करना अब ब्रॉड चर्च नहीं है।
translations.translation: Working is no longer broad church.
translations.reference: Labour is no longer a broad church.

translations.source: जो लोग अपने मन की बात कहते हैं, उनके लिए यह बर्दाश्त करने लायक नहीं है
translations.translation: It is not acceptable to those who speak their minds.
translations.reference: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds

translations.source: जब मेरी लोकल पार्टी को आगे बढ़ाने वाले कार्यकर्ताओं ने मुझे चुनने के लिए वोट किया, तो यह मेरे लिए बहुत बड़ा आश्चर्य था।
translations.translation: It was a big surprise to me when the activists who supported my local party voted for me.
translations.reference: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.

translations.source: आखिरकार, उन श्रम सांसदों के बीच मैं सबसे नया हूं जिनका महत्व काफ़ी कम रह गया है - हम अपने मन की सारी बात नहीं कह सकते।
translations.translation: After all, I am the newest of those Labour MPs whose importance has been greatly diminished - we cannot say all that is in our minds.
translations.reference: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.

translations.source: मेरे सांसद सहयोगी जोन रयान के साथ भी यहीं हुआ क्योंकि क्योंकि उसने भी असामाजिकता के लिए आवाज़ उठाई थी।
translations.translation: It was also here with my MP colleague, John Ryan, because he too had raised his voice for anti-socialism.
translations.reference: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.

translations.source: मेरे मामले में, सेंसर मोशन ने जेरेमी कॉर्बिन के साथ असहमति पर मेरी निंदा की।
translations.translation: In my case, censorship motion condemned my disagreement with Jeremy Corbyn.
translations.reference: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.

translations.source: जिम्मेदाराना इकनोमिक पॉलिसी के महत्व पर, राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा पर, यूरोप में व्‍यंग्‍यात्‍मक ढंग से समान समस्याएं थी जिस पर जेरेमी वरिष्ठ नेताओं से असहमत थी।
translations.translation: On the importance of responsible economic policy, on national security, there were explicitly similar problems in Europe that Jeremy disagreed with senior leaders on.
translations.reference: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.

translations.source: नॉटिंघम ईस्ट लेबर मीटिंग के लिए शुक्रवार को कहा गया कि "हमारी इच्छा है कि मीटिंग में सभी बातों को शामिल किया जाए और ये फ़ायदेमंद हों।"
translations.translation: For the Nottingham East Labour Meeting, it was said on Friday: "We want all the things included in the meeting to be beneficial".
translations.reference: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."

translations.source: स्थानीय लेबर एमपी के तौर पर अपने आठ वर्षों के दौरान मैंने ज़्यादातर यहीं देखा कि फ्राइडे नाईट जीसी मीटिंग बिल्कुल वैसी ही रहीं।
translations.translation: During my eight years as a local Labour MP, I have mostly observed that Friday night GC meetings are exactly the same.
translations.reference: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.

translations.source: दुख की बात है कि आज कई मीटिंग में सहमति नहीं है और या वादा किया जाता है कि "दयालु और भद्र लोगों" की राजनीति को वास्तव में भुला दिया जाता है, यहां भी यहीं हुआ।
translations.translation: Sadly, many meetings today are not consensual and the politics of "kind and kind people" are promised to be forgotten, even here.
translations.reference: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.

translations.source: यह साफ़ तौर पर ज़ाहिर है कि लेबर पार्टी में अगर दृष्टिकोण अलग हैं, तो वे बर्दाश्त नहीं किए जाते और हर विचार के लिए इस बात पर निर्णय लिया जाता है कि यह पार्टी नेतृत्व के लिए मंज़ूरी योग्य है या नहीं।
translations.translation: It is clear that if there are different views in the Labour Party, they are not tolerated and for each opinion it is decided whether the party is acceptable to the leadership.
translations.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

translations.source: जेरेमी के नेता बनने के तुरंत बाद यहीं शुरू हुआ, जिन सहयोगियों के लिए मैंने पहले से सोच रखा था कि वे मेरी जैसी राजनीतिक राय रखते हैं, वे मुझसे उम्मीद करने लगे कि मैं अपनी बातों से पलट जाऊं और उन पदों पर काम करूं जिनके साथ मैं कभी भी सहमत नहीं हो सकता - चाहे यह बात राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा की हो या फिर ईयू के सिंगल मार्केट की।
translations.translation: Starting right after Jeremy became the leader, colleagues for whom I had previously thought they had my political views began to expect me to turn my back on what I said and work in positions that I could never agree with - be it national security or the single market of the EU.
translations.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

translations.source: जब भी मैं जनता के लिए आवाज़ उठाता हूं - और इससे वाकई कोई फ़र्क नहीं पड़ता कि मैंने क्या कहा - सोशल मीडिया पर पर बुरे शब्द देखने को मिलते हैं, उसके ऊपर तीखी टिप्पणी की जाती है, सेंटर की राजनीति की निंदा की जाती है और मुझसे कहा जाता है कि मैं लेबर पार्टी के योग्य नहीं हूं।
translations.translation: Whenever I raise my voice for the public - and it really doesn't matter what I say - I see bad words on social media, sharp comments on it, criticism of the Centre's politics, and I'm told I'm not worthy of the Labour Party.
translations.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, वह सिर्फ़ मेरा अनुभव ही नहीं है।
translations.translation: Besides, it's not just my experience.
translations.reference: And that is not just my experience.

translations.source: वाकई, मैं जानता हूं कि मैं अपने कुछ सहयोगियों की तुलना में ज़्यादा किस्मतवाला हूं क्योंकि मेरी टिप्पणियां राजनीति से जुड़ी होती हैं।
translations.translation: In fact, I know that I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues because my comments relate to politics.
translations.reference: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.

translations.source: मैं उन कारोबारियों के काम करने के तरीके के बारे में जानता हूं और उन सहयोगियों के प्रति समर्पित हूं जो हमेशा सेक्स संबंधी या नस्ल संबंधी दुर्व्यवहार का सामना करते हैं, लेकिन आवाज़ उठाने से पीछे नहीं हटते।
translations.translation: I know how businesses work and I am dedicated to colleagues who always face sexual or racial abuse, but do not shy away from raising their voices.
translations.reference: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.

translations.source: आजकल के राजनीतिक युग में कई निराशाजनक पहलू हैं जिनमें से एक यह है कि किस प्रकार दुरुपयोग के स्तरों को सामान्य बनाया जाए।
translations.translation: There are many frustrating aspects of the current political era, one of which is how to normalize levels of abuse.
translations.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

translations.source: पिछले हफ़्ते जेरेमी कॉर्बिन ने दावा किया कि लेबर पार्टी के लिए असहनशील्लता की संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देना ज़रूरी है।
translations.translation: Last week Jeremy Corbyn claimed that the Labour Party needed to promote a culture of intolerance.
translations.reference: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.

translations.source: असलियत यह है कि अब हम ब्रॉड चर्च नहीं रह गए हैं और "अविश्वास" के हर प्रस्ताव या पार्टी के सिलेक्शन रूल में होने वाले बदलाव बहुत कम हो गए हैं।
translations.translation: The reality is that we are no longer broad church and there is little change in any "disbelief" proposal or party selection rule.
translations.reference: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.

translations.source: पिछले दो साल में कई लोगों ने मुझे सलाह दी और मुझसे इस बात का आग्रह किया मैं चुपचाप रहूँ, ज़्यादा न बोलूँ और उसके बाद मैं "सही माना जाऊंगा।"
translations.translation: Over the past two years, many people have advised me and urged me to keep quiet, not to talk too much, and then I would be "accepted as right".
