translations.translation: English has been sent back to the Emergency White Hall for a briefing and Ben Miller's reprise of the role has been combined with his very old gallbladder - sore sideburns.
translations.reference: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.

translations.source: अब बॉफ की शादी हो चुकी है, वह पनडुब्बी कमांडर बनने की कोशिश में लगा हुआ है, उसकी भूमिका जॉली-हॉकी-स्टिक्स की है जिसमें विकी पेपेरडाइन नहीं जम पाए हैं।
translations.translation: Now that Boff is married, he's trying to become a submarine commander, his role is jolie-hockey-sticks in which Vicky Pepperdine can't freeze.
translations.reference: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.

translations.source: इसलिए, उसकी मेजेस्टी के सीक्रेट सर्विस में बैटमैन और रॉबिन को कुछ बहुत बड़ी गलतियाँ तब मिलती हैं जब वे ओल्गा क्रुएलेंको की खूबसूरत फेम्मे फटाले ओफेलिया बुलेटोवा का सामना करते हैं।
translations.translation: So, in His Majesty's Secret Service, Batman and Robin make some very big mistakes when they face Olga Kruelenko's beautiful Femme Fatale Ofelia Bulatova.
translations.reference: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.

translations.source: इस बीच, प्रधानमंत्री उस केरिसमेटिक तकनीकी अरबपति की बात में आकर खतरे में पड़ जाते हैं जो यह दावा करता है कि उसके पास ब्रिटेन के कंप्यूटर संकटों का समाधान है: पापी जेसन वोल्टा ने जेक लेसी की भूमिका निभाई।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, the Prime Minister is threatened by the charismatic tech billionaire who claims to have a solution to Britain's computer crises: the villain Jason Volta plays Jake Lacy.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.

translations.source: इंग्लिश और बॉग फर्सिअल हाई-जिंक्स के अपने ओडिसी की शुरुआत करते हैं: वेटर के तौर पर काम करते हुए एक फ्रेंच रेस्टोरेंट में आग लगा देते हैं; वे वोल्टा की महंगी नाव के माध्यम से तस्करी करते हैं; और इंग्लिश पूरी तरह से अराजकता को तब सक्रिय करता है जब वह वोल्टा के घर के इंटीरियर का इस्तेमाल करने के लिए एक वर्चुअल रियलिटी हेडसेट के इस्तेमाल की कोशिश करता है।
translations.translation: English and Bogg begin their Odyssey of the Furious High-Jings: they set fire to a French restaurant while working as waiters; they smuggle through Volta's expensive boat; and English activates total chaos when he tries to use a virtual reality headset to use the interior of Volta's house.
translations.reference: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.

translations.source: उस आखिरी सीक्वेंस के लिए हर जगह फ़िल्म को निश्चित रूप से खींचा गया है, लेकिन फिर भी यह ठीक-ठाक और मनोरंजक है, पूरी फ़िल्म में बच्चों के लिए काफ़ी मज़ेदार चीज़ें हैं।
translations.translation: For that last sequence, the film has certainly been shot everywhere, but it's still neat and entertaining, with lots of fun for kids throughout the film.
translations.reference: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.

translations.source: ठीक-ठाक मध्यम दर्जे का।
translations.translation: Pretty middle class.
translations.reference: Pretty moderate stuff.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, जैसा कि दूसरी Johnny English फ़िल्मों में मैंने देखा, इस फ़िल्म में मैं यह नहीं समझ पाया कि ब्रिटिश फिल्म इंडस्ट्री में रोवन एटकिंसन को ऐसी भूमिका दी जानी चाहिए या नहीं जो वाकई उनके टैलेंट के हिसाब से हो?
translations.translation: Also, as I saw in other Johnny English films, in this film, I couldn't figure out whether or not Rowan Atkinson should be given a role in the British film industry that was truly his talent.
translations.reference: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?

translations.source: लेबर ने इस बात से इनकार किया है कि वह ब्रिटेन के लोगों के लिए हफ़्ते में सिर्फ़ चार दिन काम करने की योजना बना रहा है, लेकिन पैसे पांच दिनों के हिसाब से मिलेंगे
translations.translation: Labour has denied that it plans to work only four days a week for people in the UK, but the money will come in five days.
translations.reference: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days

translations.source: जेरेमी कॉर्बिन की लेबर पार्टी एक प्रजातंत्रवादी योजना बनने पर विचार कर रही है, जिसमें ब्रिटेन के निवासियों को हफ़्ते में सिर्फ़ चार दिन काम करना होगा - लेकिन पैसे पाँच दिनों के हिसाब से मिलेंगे।
translations.translation: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is considering a democratic plan that would require UK residents to work only four days a week - but pay for five days.
translations.reference: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर पार्टी की इच्छा है कि कंपनी के मालिक आर्टिफीसियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) क्रान्ति के ज़रिए होने वाली बचत का हिस्सा श्रमिकों को दें, ताकि उन्हें एक अतिरिक्त दिन की छुट्टी मिल सके।
translations.translation: The party reportedly wants the company owners to give a share of the savings from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) revolution to workers so that they can get an extra day off.
translations.reference: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.

translations.source: इससे कर्मचारी को हफ़्ते में तीन दिन की छुट्टी मिलेगी - लेकिन फिर भी वे समान वेतन पा सकेंगे।
translations.translation: This will give the employee three days off a week - but they will still be able to get the same salary.
translations.reference: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.

translations.source: सूत्रों का कहना है कि इस तरह का विचार पार्टी के इकनोमिक एजेंडे के साथ 'बढ़िया' रहेगा और यह देश को श्रमिकों को फ़ायदा पहुंचाने की की योजना है।
translations.translation: Sources say that such an idea will be 'big' with the party's economic agenda and it is planned to benefit the workers of the country.
translations.reference: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.

translations.source: ट्रेड्स यूनियन कांग्रेस द्वारा हफ़्ते में चार दिन की शिफ्ट को बढ़ावा दिया जा रहा है ताकि श्रमिक बदलती हुई इकॉनमी का फ़ायदा उठा सकें।
translations.translation: The Trades Union Congress is promoting a shift of four days a week so that workers can take advantage of the changing economy.
translations.reference: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.

translations.source: The Sunday Times से लेबर पार्टी के एक वरिष्ठ कर्मचारी ने कहा: 'नीति समीक्षा, वर्ष की समाप्ति से पहले घोषित होने की संभावना है।
translations.translation: A senior Labour Party official told The Sunday Times: 'The policy review is likely to be announced before the end of the year.
translations.reference: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.

translations.source: 'यह रात-भर में नहीं हो जाएगी, बल्कि इसमें चार दिवसीय कार्य सप्ताह के लगने की उम्‍मीद है, जो कि पार्टी की समग्र औद्योगिक रणनीति के साथ-साथ कामगारों के पक्ष में अर्थव्यवस्था के पुनर्संतुलन के पार्टी के दृष्टिकोण के बिल्‍कुल अनुकूल है।'
translations.translation: 'This will not happen overnight, but is expected to take four days of work week, which is in line with the overall industrial strategy of the Party as well as the Party's vision of rebalancing the economy in favour of the workers.'
translations.reference: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'

translations.source: 2017 के आम चुनाव अभियान के दौरान चार दिवसीय के कार्य सप्ताह का वचन देने वाली ग्रीन पार्टी के होते हुए, लेबर पार्टी इस तरह के विचार का समर्थन करने वाली पहली पार्टी नहीं होगी।
translations.translation: While the Green Party pledged a four-day work week during the 2017 general election campaign, Labour will not be the first party to support such an idea.
translations.reference: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.

translations.source: हालांकि, वर्तमान में लेबर पार्टी द्वारा इस चाह को पूरी तरह समर्थन नहीं दिया जा रहा है।
translations.translation: However, this desire is not being fully supported by the Labour Party at present.
translations.reference: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.

translations.source: लेबर पार्टी के एक प्रवक्ता ने कहा: 'चार दिवसीय कार्य सप्ताह पार्टी की नीति नहीं है और पार्टी द्वारा इस पर विचार नहीं किया जा रहा है।'
translations.translation: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'The four-day work week is not the policy of the Party and is not being considered by the Party.'
translations.reference: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'

translations.source: शैडो चांसलर जॉन मैकडॉनेल ने अर्थव्यवस्था में समाजवादी क्रांति के प्रति अपने दृष्टिकोण को पेश करने के लिए पिछले सप्ताह के श्रम सम्मेलन का उपयोग किया था।
translations.translation: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour Conference to present his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
translations.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.

translations.source: मिस्टर मैकडॉनेल ने कहा कि उन्होंने पक्का इरादा किया हुआ है कि उपयोगिता फर्मों में 'चेहराविहीन निदेशकों' और 'मुनाफ़ाखोरों' से वापस सत्ता हासिल की जाए।
translations.translation: Mr. McDonnell said that he firmly intends to restore power to utility firms from "faceless directors" and "professors".
translations.reference: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.

translations.source: शैडो चांसलर की योजनाओं का यह भी मतलब है कि जल कंपनियों में मौजूदा शेयरधारकों को अपनी पूरी हिस्सेदारी वापस नहीं मिल सकती है क्योंकि लेबर सरकार कथित गलत कामों के आधार पर 'कटौती' कर सकती है।
translations.translation: Shadow Chancellor's plans also mean that existing shareholders in water companies cannot get their full stake back as the Labour government can 'cut' based on alleged misconduct.
translations.reference: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.

translations.source: उन्होंने कर्मचारियों को कंपनी के बोर्डों में शामिल करने और कर्मचारियों के लिए निजी क्षेत्र की फर्मों की 10 प्रतिशत ईक्विटी सौंपने के लिए समावेशी स्वामित्व निधि बनाने की योजना की भी पुष्टि की, जिन्हें £500 तक का वार्षिक लाभांश मिल सकता है।
translations.translation: He also confirmed the plan to create an inclusive ownership fund to incorporate employees into the boards of the company and assign 10 per cent equity of private sector firms to employees, who can receive an annual dividend of up to £500.
translations.reference: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.

translations.source: लिंड्से ग्राहम, जॉन केनेडी "60 मिनट्स" को बताते हैं कि क्या FBI द्वारा कैवना की जाँच उनके मन को बदल सकती है
translations.translation: Lindsay Graham, John Kennedy tells "60 Minutes" whether an FBI investigation into Kavanagh could change their minds.
translations.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds

translations.source: जज ब्रेट कैवना के खिलाफ़ आरोपों की FBI जाँच ने कम से कम एक सप्ताह तक सुप्रीम कोर्ट में उनके नामांकन पर अंतिम मतदान में देरी की, और यह सवाल उठता है कि क्या ब्यूरो के निष्कर्षों ने किसी रिपब्लिकन सेनेटर को अपना समर्थन वापस लेने में मदद की।
translations.translation: The FBI investigation into charges against Judge Brett Kavanagh delayed the final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court for at least a week, and it raises the question of whether the bureau's findings helped a Republican senator withdraw his support.
translations.reference: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.

translations.source: रविवार को प्रसारित एक साक्षात्कार में, "60 मिनट्स" के संवाददाता स्कॉट पेले ने रिपब्लिकन सेनेटर जॉन केनेडी और लिंड्से ग्राहम से पूछा कि क्या FBI द्वारा कुछ ऐसा पता लगाने की संभावना है जो उनके मन को बदलने के लिए प्रेरित करे।
translations.translation: In an interview broadcast on Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pele asked Republican senators John Kennedy and Lindsay Graham if the FBI was likely to find something that would inspire them to change their minds.
translations.reference: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.

translations.source: केनेडी दक्षिण कैरोलिना के अपने सहयोगी की तुलना में अधिक साफ़दिल नज़र आए।
translations.translation: Kennedy looked more white than his South Carolina counterpart.
translations.reference: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.

translations.source: "मेरे ख़याल से, ज़रूर," केनेडी ने कहा।
translations.translation: "I think, of course", Kennedy said.
translations.reference: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.

translations.source: "मैंने कहा कि सुनवाई में जाते हुए मैंने जज कैवना से बात की।
translations.translation: "I said that on my way to the hearing I spoke to Judge Kavanagh.
translations.reference: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.

translations.source: ऐसा होने के बाद, जब यह आरोप सामने आया, मैंने उन्हें कॉल किया, पूछा, 'क्या तुमने ऐसा किया?'
translations.translation: After that, when the allegations came out, I called them and asked, 'Did you do this?'
translations.reference: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'

translations.source: वे सुनिश्चित, दृढ़ निश्चयी, सुस्पष्ट थे।"
translations.translation: They were firm, firm, precise".
translations.reference: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."

translations.source: हालांकि, ग्राहम का वोट, लगता था पत्थर की लकीर थी।
translations.translation: Graham's vote, however, seemed like a stone 's throw.
translations.reference: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.

translations.source: "मैंने ब्रेट कैवना के बारे में मन बना लिया था और इसके लिए विस्फोटक आरोप की ज़रूरत पड़ती," उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: "I had made up my mind about Brett Kavanagh and it would have required an explosive charge", he said.
translations.reference: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.

translations.source: "डॉ. फ़ोर्ड, मैं नहीं जानता क्या हुआ था, लेकिन मुझे यह पता है: ब्रेट ने पुरज़ोर तरीक़े से इनकार किया," ग्राहम ने क्रिस्टीन ब्लेसी फ़ोर्ड का ज़िक्र करते हुए आगे कहा।
translations.translation: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett vehemently refused", Graham continued, referring to Christine Blessy Ford.
translations.reference: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.

translations.source: "और जिसका भी उन्होंने नाम लिया, वह उसे सत्यापित नहीं कर सका।
translations.translation: And he could not verify whatever they named.
translations.reference: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.

translations.source: यह 36 साल पुरानी बात है।
translations.translation: It's 36 years old.
translations.reference: It's 36 years old.

translations.source: मुझे कुछ भी नया बदलाव नज़र नहीं आता।"
translations.translation: I don't see any new changes".
translations.reference: I don't see anything new changing."

translations.source: ग्लोबल सिटिज़न फ़ेस्टिवल क्या है और क्या इससे ग़रीबी में कमी आई है?
translations.translation: What is the Global Citizens' Festival and has it reduced poverty?
translations.reference: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?

translations.source: इस शनिवार को न्यूयॉर्क, ग्लोबल सिटिजन फ़ेेस्टिवल की मेजबानी करेगा, जो एक वार्षिक संगीत कार्यक्रम है जिसमें कई बेहद प्रभावशाली सितारे प्रदर्शन करने वाले हैं, और उतना ही प्रभावशाली इसका मिशन है; दुनिया की ग़रीबी खत्म करना।
translations.translation: This Saturday, New York will host the Global Citizens Festival, an annual concert featuring some of the most influential stars to perform, and just as influential is its mission; to end the world's poverty.
translations.reference: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.

translations.source: अब अपने सातवें वर्ष में, ग्लोबल सिटिजन फ़ेस्टिवल में सेंट्रल पार्क के ग्रेट लॉन में न केवल जेनेट जैक्सन, कार्डी बी और शॉन मेंडेस जैसे कलाकारों का आनंद लेने दसियों हज़ार लोग आएँगे, बल्कि 2030 तक अत्यधिक ग़रीबी मिटाने के कार्यक्रम के सच्चे लक्ष्य के प्रति जागरूकता बढ़ाने का काम भी करेंगे।
translations.translation: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will bring tens of thousands of people to the Great Lawn of Central Park not only to enjoy artists like Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Sean Mendes, but also to raise awareness of the true goal of the program to eradicate extreme poverty by 2030.
translations.reference: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.

translations.source: 2012 में शुरू होने वाला, ग्लोबल सिटिजन फ़ेस्टिवल, अंतरराष्ट्रीय पक्षसमर्थक समूह, ग्लोबल पॉवर्टी प्रॉजेक्ट का विस्तार है, जो सक्रिय रूप से इसके खिलाफ़ लड़ने वाले लोगों की संख्या में वृद्धि करके ग़रीबी को समाप्त करने की उम्मीद करता है।
translations.translation: Launched in 2012, the Global Citizen Festival is an extension of the international advocacy group, the Global Poverty Project, which hopes to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.
translations.reference: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.

translations.source: कार्यक्रम के लिए नि:शुल्क टिकट प्राप्त करने के लिए (सिवाय जब आप VIP टिकट का भुगतान करने के लिए तैयार न हों), कन्सर्ट में जाने वालों को ग़रीबी मिटाने के अपने लक्ष्य के प्रति जागरूकता पैदा करने में मदद के लिए वॉलन्टियर बनने, किसी विश्व नेता को ईमेल करने, फ़ोन कॉल करने जैसे  कई कार्यों, या अन्य सार्थक तरीक़ों से "कार्रवाइयों" को पूरा करना होगा।
translations.translation: To receive free tickets for the event (except when you are unwilling to pay VIP tickets), concertgoers must complete "activities" such as volunteering to help raise awareness of their goal of eradicating poverty, emailing a world leader, making a phone call, or other meaningful ways.
translations.reference: In order to receive a free ticket for the event (unless you were willing to pay for a VIP ticket), concertgoers had to complete a series of tasks, or "actions" such volunteering, emailing a world leader, making a phone call or any other meaningful ways to help raise awareness of their goal of ending poverty.

translations.source: लेकिन अपने लक्ष्य को हासिल करने के लिए बाक़ी 12 वर्षों में ग्लोबल सिटिजन कितना सफल रहा है?
translations.translation: But how successful has Global Citizens been in achieving its goal in the next 12 years?
translations.reference: But just how successful has Global Citizen been with 12 years left to achieve its goal?

translations.source: क्या मुफ़्त संगीत कार्यक्रम के ज़रिए लोगों को पुरस्कृत करने का विचार लोगों को कार्रवाई के लिए आह्वान करने के लिए राजी करने का सही तरीक़ा है, या तथाकथित "क्लिकटिविज़्म" का बस एक और मामला है - लोगों को ऐसा लगे कि वे ऑनलाइन याचिका पर हस्ताक्षर करके या ट्वीट भेजकर सही मायने में फ़र्क पैदा कर रहे हैं?
translations.translation: Is the idea of rewarding people with free concerts the right way to persuade people to take action, or is it just another case of so-called "clique activism" - people feeling like they're really making a difference by signing an online petition or tweeting?
translations.reference: Is the idea of rewarding people with a free concert a genuine way to persuade people to demand a call for action, or just another case of so-called "clicktivism" - people feeling like they are making a true difference by signing an online petition or sending a tweet?

translations.source: 2011 के बाद से, ग्लोबल सिटिज़न का कहना है कि विभिन्न लक्ष्यों के लिए प्रयासों को आगे बढ़ाते हुए उसने अपने समर्थकों से 19 मिलियन से अधिक "कार्रवाइयाँ" दर्ज की हैं।
translations.translation: Since 2011, Global Citizen says it has recorded more than 19 million "actions" from its supporters, pushing forward efforts towards various goals.
translations.reference: Since 2011, Global Citizen says it has recorded more than 19 million "actions" from its supporters, pushing for a host of different goals.

translations.source: इसका कहना है कि इन कार्रवाइयों ने विश्व नेताओं को 2030 तक 2.25 बिलियन से अधिक लोगों के जीवन को प्रभावित करने के लिए निर्धारित $37 बिलियन से अधिक के बराबर प्रतिबद्धताएँ और नीतियों की घोषणा करने में मदद की है।
translations.translation: It says that these actions have helped world leaders to announce commitments and policies equivalent to over $37 billion set to affect the lives of over 2.25 billion people by 2030.
translations.reference: It says that these actions have helped spur world leaders to announce commitments and policies equating to more than $37 billion that is set to affect the lives of more than 2.25 billion people by 2030.

translations.source: 2018 की शुरुआत में, समूह ने अपनी कार्रवाइयों से उपजी 390 प्रतिबद्धताओं और घोषणाओं का हवाला दिया, जिनमें से कम से कम $10 बिलियन पहले ही वितरित या धन-उगाहने वाले हैं।
translations.translation: At the beginning of 2018, the Group cited 390 commitments and announcements generated by its actions, of which at least $10 billion is already distributed or fundraising.
translations.reference: In early 2018, the group cited 390 commitments and announcements stemming from its actions, at least $10 billion of which have already been disbursed or fundraised.

translations.source: समूह का अनुमान है कि सुरक्षित निधि ने अब तक दुनिया भर के लगभग 649 मिलियन लोगों पर सीधा प्रभाव डाला है।
translations.translation: The group estimates that the safe fund has so far had a direct impact on around 649 million people worldwide.
translations.reference: The group estimates the secured funds have so far made a direct impact on nearly 649 million people across the world.

translations.source: कुछ प्रमुख प्रतिबद्धताओं में शामिल हैं, द पावर ऑफ़ न्यूट्रिशन, एक यू.के. स्थित निवेशकों तथा क्रियान्वयकों की भागीदारी, जो वैश्विक नागरिकों से 4,700 से अधिक ट्वीट प्राप्त करने के बाद काउंटी में कुपोषण को समाप्त करने के लिए रवांडा को $35 मिलियन प्रदान करने का वादा करते हुए "बच्चों को उनकी संपूर्ण क्षमता तक विकसित होने में मदद करने" के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।
translations.translation: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a partnership of U.K.-based investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential" by pledging $35 million to Rwanda to end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from global citizens.
translations.reference: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a U.K. based partnership of investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential," promising to provide Rwanda with $35 million to help end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from Global Citizens.

translations.source: लंदन में अप्रैल 2018 को एक लाइव कॉन्सर्ट के दौरान पॉवर ऑफ़ न्यूट्रिशन के राजदूत ट्रेसी उलमान ने भीड़ ने कहा, "ब्रिटेन सरकार, दानकर्ता, राष्ट्रीय सरकार, और आप जैसे वैश्विक नागरिकों की मदद से, हम कुपोषण के सामाजिक अन्याय को इतिहास का फ़ुटनोट बना सकते हैं।"
translations.translation: During a live concert in London in April 2018, Power of Nutrition Ambassador Tracy Ulman told the crowd, "With the help of the UK government, donors, national governments, and global citizens like you, we can make the social injustice of malnutrition a footnote in history".
translations.reference: "With support from the UK government, donors, national governments, and Global Citizens just like you, we can make the social injustice of undernutrition a footnote in history," The Power of Nutrition ambassador Tracey Ullman told the crowd during a live concert in London in April 2018.

translations.source: समूह ने यह भी कहा कि माताओं और बच्चों के लिए पोषण में सुधार के लिए यू.के. को आह्वान देते हुए 5,000 से अधिक कार्रवाइयों के बाद, सरकार ने पावर ऑफ़ न्यूट्रिशन नामक एक परियोजना के लिए वित्त-पोषण की घोषणा की, जो पोषण हस्तक्षेप के साथ 5 मिलियन महिलाओं और बच्चों तक पहुँचेगी।
translations.translation: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions calling on the UK to improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project called Power of Nutrition, which will reach 5 million women and children with nutritional intervention.
translations.reference: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions were taken calling on the U.K. improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project, the Power of Nutrition, that will reach 5 million women and children with nutrition interventions.

translations.source: अपनी वेबसाइट पर अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले एक प्रश्न कि "आपको क्यों लगता है कि हम अत्यधिक ग़रीबी को मिटा सकते हैं?" के जवाब में
translations.translation: In response to a frequently asked question on their website, "Why do you think we can eradicate extreme poverty?"
translations.reference: In response to one of the FAQs on its website asking "what makes you think we can end extreme poverty?"

translations.source: ग्लोबल सिटिज़न ने जवाब दिया: "यह एक लंबा और कठिन रास्ता होगा - कभी-कभार हम गिरेंगे और असफल होंगे।
translations.translation: Global Citizen responded: "It will be a long and difficult road - sometimes we fall and fail.
translations.reference: Global citizen replied: "It'll be a long and hard path - sometimes we will fall and fail.

translations.source: लेकिन, हमारे समक्ष महान नागरिक अधिकारों और रंगभेद विरोधी आंदोलनों के समान ही, हम सफल होंगे, क्योंकि हम एक साथ अधिक शक्तिशाली हैं।
translations.translation: But, just like the great civil rights and anti-apartheid movements before us, we will succeed because we are more powerful together.
translations.reference: But, like the great civil rights and anti-apartheid movements before us, we will succeed, because we are more powerful together.

translations.source: जेनेट जैक्सन, द वीकेंड, शॉन मेंडेस, कार्डी बी, जेनेल मोनाई न्यूयॉर्क में इस साल के कार्यक्रम में प्रदर्शन करने वाले कुछ प्रदर्शन करने वालों में से एक हैं, जिसकी मेजबानी डेबरा-ली फर्नेस और ह्यू जैकमैन करेंगे।
translations.translation: Janet Jackson, The Weekend, Sean Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monay are among the few performers to perform at this year's event in New York, which will be hosted by Debra-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.
translations.reference: Janet Jackson, the Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe are among some of the acts performing at this year's event in New York, which will be hosted by Deborra-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.

translations.source: रूसी ऊर्जा निर्यात में बाधा उत्पन्न करने के लिए अमेरिका "नाकाबंदी" के लिए नौसेना का उपयोग कर सकता है - आंतरिक सचिव
translations.translation: US could use Navy to "unblock" Russian energy exports - Home Secretary
translations.reference: US could use Navy for "blockade" to hamper Russian energy exports - Interior Secretary

translations.source: वॉशिंगटन एक्ज़ामिनर के हवाले से, आंतरिक सचिव रयान ज़िन्के ने खुलासा किया कि मध्य पूर्व सहित, अमेरिकी बाजारों में रूसी ऊर्जा को रोकने के लिए वॉशिंगटन "यदि आवश्यक हो", तो अमेरिकी नौसेना का सहारा ले सकता है।
translations.translation: Citing the Washington Examiner, Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke revealed that Washington could "recourse, if necessary", to the U.S. Navy to block Russian energy in U.S. markets, including the Middle East.
translations.reference: Washington can "if necessary" resort to its Navy to prevent Russian energy hitting the markets, including in the Middle East, US Internal Secretary Ryan Zinke has revealed, as cited by Washington Examiner.

translations.source: ज़िन्के ने आरोप लगाया कि सीरिया में रूस काम - विशेष रूप से, जहाँ वह वैध सरकार के निमंत्रण पर परिचालन कर रहा है - नए ऊर्जा बाज़ारों का पता लगाने के लिए एक बहाना है।
translations.translation: Zinke alleged that Russia's work in Syria - specifically, where it is operating at the invitation of a legitimate government - is an excuse to explore new energy markets.
translations.reference: Zinke alleged that Russia's engagement in Syria - notably, where it is operating at the invitation of the legitimate government - is a pretext to explore new energy markets.

translations.source: उन्होंने कथित तौर पर कहा कि "मेरे ख़याल से मध्य पूर्व में उनकी मौजूदगी का कारण यह है कि वे ऊर्जा की दलाली करना चाहते हैं, जैसा कि उन्होंने यूरोप के दक्षिणी इलाके, पूर्वी यूरोप में किया है।
translations.translation: He reportedly said that "I think the reason for their presence in the Middle East is because they want to broker energy, as they have done in the southern region of Europe, Eastern Europe.
translations.reference: "I believe the reason they are in the Middle East is they want to broker energy just like they do in eastern Europe, the southern belly of Europe," he has reportedly said.

translations.source: और, अधिकारी के अनुसार, इससे निपटने के तरीक़े और साधन हैं।
translations.translation: And, according to the official, there are ways and means of dealing with it.
translations.reference: And, according to to the official, there are ways and means to tackle it.

translations.source: "संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के पास हमारी नौसेना के साथ यह सुनिश्चित करने की क्षमता है कि समुद्री मार्ग खुले रहें, और, यदि आवश्यक हो, तो नाकाबंदी करें, ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि उनकी ऊर्जा बाजार में न जाए," उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: "The United States has the ability with our Navy to ensure that sea lanes remain open, and, if necessary, blockade, to ensure that their energy does not go to market", he said.
translations.reference: "The United States has that ability, with our Navy, to make sure the sea lanes are open, and, if necessary, to blockade, to make sure that their energy does not go to market," he said.

translations.source: ज़िन्के एक गैर-लाभकारी समूह, कन्ज़्यूमर्स एनर्जी एलायंस  द्वारा आयोजित कार्यक्रम के उपस्थित लोगों को संबोधित कर रहे थे, जो खुद को अमेरिका में "ऊर्जा उपभोक्ता की आवाज़" कहते हैं।
translations.translation: Zinka was addressing attendees at an event organized by a nonprofit group, Consumers Energy Alliance, which calls itself the "voice of energy consumers" in the United States.
translations.reference: Zinke was addressing the attendees of the event hosted by the Consumer Energy Alliance, a non-profit group which styles itself as the "voice of the energy consumer" in the US.

translations.source: उन्होंने यह कहते हुए रूस और ईरान से निपटने के लिए वॉशिंगटन के दृष्टिकोण की तुलना की कि वे प्रभावी रूप से एकसमान हैं।
translations.translation: He compared Washington's approach to dealing with Russia and Iran to the fact that they are effectively the same.
translations.reference: He went to compare Washington's approaches to dealing with Russia and Iran, noting that they are effectively the same.

translations.source: रूस को जीवाश्म ईंधन पर निर्भर अर्थव्यवस्था युक्त "एक चाल वाली टट्टू" के रूप में संदर्भित करते हुए उन्होंने कहा, "ईरान और रूस के मामले में आर्थिक विकल्प, कमोबेश, ईंधन का फ़ायदा उठाना और प्रतिस्थापन है।"
translations.translation: Referring to Russia as a "moving duck" with a fossil fuel economy, he said, "In the case of Iran and Russia, the economic option is, more or less, to take advantage of and replace fuel".
translations.reference: "The economic option on Iran and Russia is, more or less, leveraging and replacing fuels," he said, while referring to Russia as a "one trick pony" with an economy dependent on fossil fuels.

translations.source: बयान आ रहे हैं कि ट्रम्प प्रशासन, रूस की जगह लेते हुए, यूरोपीय उपभोक्ताओं के लिए सबसे सस्ते विकल्प के रूप में यूरोप में अपने तरलीकृत प्राकृतिक गैस के निर्यात को बढ़ावा देने के मिशन पर है।
translations.translation: Statements are coming that the Trump administration, replacing Russia, is on a mission to boost its liquefied natural gas exports to Europe as the cheapest option for European consumers.
translations.reference: The statements come as Trump administration has been on a mission to boost the export of its liquefied natural gas to Europe, replacing Russia, the far cheaper option for European consumers.

translations.source: उस हद तक, खुद अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प सहित ट्रम्प प्रशासन के अधिकारियों ने जर्मनी को "अनुचित" नॉर्ड स्ट्रीम 2 पाइपलाइन परियोजना से बाहर निकालने के लिए मनाने की कोशिश की, ट्रम्प के अनुसार जिसने, बर्लिन को मॉस्को का "बंदी" बनाया है।
translations.translation: To that extent, Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, tried to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, according to Trump, which has made Berlin a "prisoner" of Moscow.
translations.reference: For that effect, the Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, try to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which according to Trump, made Berlin Moscow's "captive."

translations.source: मॉस्को ने बार-बार जोर दिया है कि $11 बिलियन नॉर्ड स्ट्रीम 2 पाइपलाइन, जो मौजूदा पाइपलाइन क्षमता को 110 बिलियन क्यूबिक मीटर से दोगुना करने के लिए तैयार है, विशुद्ध रूप से एक आर्थिक परियोजना है।
translations.translation: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity from 110 billion cubic meters, is purely an economic project.
translations.reference: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity to 110 billion cubic meters, is a purely economic project.

translations.reference: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."

translations.translation: "I am deeply concerned about what Donald Trump is doing for our democracy", he said.
translations.reference: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.

translations.translation: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be judged on the basis of the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a suspension violates that principle", Justice-Mitra said.
translations.reference: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be adjudicated on the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a bar violates that principle," the friend-of-the court brief said.

translations.source: अटॉर्नी ने आगे सार-पत्र में तर्क दिया कि अप्रवासियों के प्रवेश से यह कहते हुए इनकार करने वाली नीति अमेरिकी अर्थव्यवस्था को नुकसान पहुँचाती है कि उनके उद्यमी बनने और "आवश्यक श्रम की आपूर्ति" करने की अधिक संभावना है।
translations.translation: The attorney further argued in the brief that a policy of denial of immigrants' entry harms the U.S. economy by saying that they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and supply "essential labor".
translations.reference: Attorneys further argued in the brief that the policy denying immigrants entry hurts the U.S. economy, saying they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and "supply necessary labor."

translations.source: अटॉर्नी जनरल जेफ़ सेशन्स ने आव्रजन न्यायाधीशों को जून में घरेलू शोषण और सामूहिक हिंसा से पीड़ितों को शरण न देने का आदेश दिया।
translations.translation: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges not to shelter victims of domestic abuse and mass violence in June.
translations.reference: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges to no longer grant asylum to victims fleeing domestic abuse and gang violence in June.

translations.source: नीति संबंधी अपनी 11 जून की घोषणा में सेशन्स ने कहा, "जो लोग अपने जाति, धर्म, राष्ट्रीयता या किसी विशेष सामाजिक समूह की सदस्यता के कारण उत्पीड़न या भय के कारण अपना स्वदेश छोड़ते हैं, उनके लिए आश्रय उपलब्ध है।"
translations.translation: In its policy announcement on June 11, Sessions said, "Asylum is available for those who leave their homeland due to persecution or fear because of their race, religion, nationality or membership of a particular social group".
translations.reference: "Asylum is available for those who leave their home country because of persecution or fear on account of race, religion, nationality, or membership in a particular social group or political opinion," Sessions said in his June 11 announcement of the policy.

translations.source: शरण कभी भी सभी समस्याओं - यहाँ तक कि सभी गंभीर समस्याओं - को कम करने के लिए नहीं थी - जिसका लोग दुनिया भर में हर दिन सामना करते हैं।
translations.translation: Refuge was never meant to alleviate all the problems - even all the serious problems - that people around the world face every day.
translations.reference: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.

translations.source: ज़िंदा बचने वालों को खोजने की दौड़ में मरने वालों की संख्या दुगुनी होने के चलते पालू में उग्र बचाव प्रयास
translations.translation: As the number of deaths in the search for survivors doubles, a furious rescue effort is underway in Palau.
translations.reference: Desperate rescue efforts in Palu as death toll doubles in race to find survivors

translations.source: बचने वालों के लिए, स्थिति अत्यधिक गंभीर थी।
translations.translation: For the survivors, the situation was extremely serious.
translations.reference: For survivors, the situation was increasingly dire.

translations.source: "यह बेहद तनावपूर्ण लगता है," तहस-नहस पालू शहर के निकास केंद्र में बुख़ार से पीड़ित बच्चे को सांत्वना देते हुए 35 वर्षीय माँ रीसा कुसुमा ने कहा।
translations.translation: "It sounds extremely stressful", said 35-year-old mother Reza Kusuma while comforting a fever-stricken child in the evacuation center of Tahas-Nas Palou city.
translations.reference: "It feels very tense," said 35-year-old mother Risa Kusuma, comforting her feverish baby boy at an evacuation centre in the gutted city of Palu.

translations.source: "हर मिनट एक एम्बुलेंस शवों को लाता है।
translations.translation: "Every minute an ambulance brings corpses.
translations.reference: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.

translations.source: साफ़ पानी दुर्लभ है।"
translations.translation: Clean water is scarce".
translations.reference: Clean water is scarce."

translations.source: निवासियों को अपने उजड़े घरों में लौटते, जलमग्न सामान उठाते हुए, जो कुछ भी मिल जाए, उसे बचाने की कोशिश करते देखा गया।
translations.translation: Residents were seen returning to their desolate homes, picking up sunken belongings, trying to save whatever they could find.
translations.reference: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.

translations.source: 7.5 परिमाण के भूकंप की चपेट में सैकड़ों लोग घायल हो गए और अस्पताल डूब गए।
translations.translation: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals drowned in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake.
translations.reference: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.

translations.source: ड्वी हारिस सहित कुछ घायल लोग, जो टूटी हुई पीठ और कंधे का सामना कर रहे थे, पालू के सैन्य अस्पताल के बाहर आराम किया, जहाँ लगातार मजबूत भूकंप के झटकों  के कारण मरीजों का बाहर खुले में इलाज किया जा रहा था।
translations.translation: Some wounded, including Dwayne Harris, who were facing broken back and shoulders, rested outside the Palau Military Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to constant strong earthquake shocks.
translations.reference: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.

translations.source: अपनी पत्नी और बेटी के साथ साझा किए गए अपनी पाँचवी मंज़िल के होटल के कमरे में हिंसक भूकंप के झटकों को महसूस करते हुए उसकी आँखों में आँसू भर आए।
translations.translation: His tears filled his eyes as he felt the tremors of a violent earthquake in his fifth floor hotel room shared with his wife and daughter.
translations.reference: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.

translations.source: "हमारे पास खुद को बचाने का समय नहीं था।
translations.translation: "We didn't have time to save ourselves.
translations.reference: "There was no time to save ourselves.

translations.source: मुझे लगता है, मैं दीवार के खंडहर में दब गया था," हारिस ने एसोसिएटेड प्रेस से कहा, साथ ही बताया कि उनका परिवार शादी के लिए शहर में था।
translations.translation: I think I was stuck in the ruins of the wall", Harris told the Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for the wedding.
translations.reference: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.

translations.source: "मैंने अपनी पत्नी को मदद के लिए रोते हुए पुकारते सुना, लेकिन फिर मौन।
translations.translation: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then she was silent.
translations.reference: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.

translations.source: मुझे नहीं पता कि उसके और मेरे बच्चे के साथ क्या हुआ।
translations.translation: I don't know what happened to her and my baby.
translations.reference: I don't know what happened to her and my child.

translations.source: मुझे उम्मीद है कि वे सुरक्षित हैं।"
translations.translation: I hope they are safe".
translations.reference: I hope they are safe."

translations.source: अमेरिकी राजदूत ने चीन पर 'प्रचार विज्ञापनों' के ज़रिए 'धमकाने' का आरोप लगाया
translations.translation: U.S. ambassador accuses China of "threatening" through "advertising"
translations.reference: U.S. ambassador accuses China of 'bullying' with 'propaganda ads'

translations.source: एक अमेरिकी दैनिक अख़बार में सरकारी चीनी अख़बार द्वारा, अमेरिकी-चीनी व्यापार के पारस्परिक लाभों का जिक्र करने वाले, चार-पृष्ठ का विज्ञापन चलाने के एक हफ़्ते बाद चीन के अमेरिकी राजदूत ने बीजिंग पर अमेरिकी प्रेस का उपयोग करके प्रचार-प्रसार करने का आरोप लगाया।
translations.translation: A week after a U.S. daily newspaper, the official Chinese newspaper, ran a four-page ad mentioning the mutual benefits of U.S.-Chinese trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the U.S. press to spread propaganda.
translations.reference: A week after an official Chinese newspaper ran a four-page ad in a U.S. daily touting the mutual benefits of U.S.-China trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the American press to spread propaganda.

translations.source: अमेरिकी  राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने पिछले बुधवार को - चीन द्वारा 6 नवंबर को कांग्रेस के चुनावों में दखल देने की कोशिश करने का आरोप लगाने के बाद - आयोवा के सबसे ज़्यादा बिक्री वाले अख़बार - डेस मोइनेस रजिस्टर में चाइना डेली के पेड सप्लीमेंट कों संदर्भित किया, चीन जिस आरोप को अस्वीकार करता है।
translations.translation: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday - after accusing China of attempting to interfere in the November 6 congressional elections - referred to China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register, Iowa's best-selling newspaper, which China denies.
translations.reference: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday referred to the China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register - the state of Iowa's biggest selling newspaper - after accusing China of seeking to meddle in the Nov. 6 U.S. congressional elections, a charge China denies.

translations.source: ट्रम्प का यह आरोप कि बीजिंग अमेरिकी चुनावों में हस्तक्षेप करने की कोशिश कर रहा था, अमेरिकी अधिकारियों ने रॉयटर को बताया कि वॉशिंगटन द्वारा चीन पर दबाव बनाने के अभियान में एक नया चरण था।
translations.translation: Trump's allegation that Beijing was trying to interfere in the U.S. elections, U.S. officials told Reuters was a new stage in Washington's campaign to pressure China.
translations.reference: Trump's accusation that Beijing was trying to meddle in U.S. elections marked what U.S. officials told Reuters was a new phase in an escalating campaign by Washington to put pressure on China.

translations.source: जबकि विदेशी सरकारों के लिए व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने हेतु विज्ञापन देना सामान्य बात है, बीजिंग और वाशिंगटन वर्तमान में एक ऐसे बढ़ते व्यापार युद्ध में उलझे हैं, जिसने उन्हें एक-दूसरे के आयातों पर सीमा-शुल्क लागू करने के दौर देखे हैं।
translations.translation: While it is common for foreign governments to advertise to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently engaged in a growing trade war that has seen them impose tariffs on each other's imports.
translations.reference: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.

translations.source: चीनी और अमेरिकी विशेषज्ञों का कहना है कि व्यापार युद्ध में पहले चीन के प्रतिशोधी सीमा-शुल्क आयोवा जैसे राज्यों में निर्यातकों पर वार करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए थे, जिन्होंने ट्रम्प की रिपब्लिकन पार्टी  का समर्थन किया था।
translations.translation: Chinese and U.S. experts say China's retaliatory tariffs in the first trade war were designed to hit exporters in states like Iowa who had backed Trump's Republican Party.
translations.reference: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.

translations.source: टेरी ब्रैनस्टेड, चीन में अमेरिका के राजदूत और आयोवा के लंबे समय तक के पूर्व गवर्नर, चीन को कृषि संबंधी माल के प्रमुख निर्यातक ने कहा कि बीजिंग ने अमेरिकी श्रमिकों, किसानों और व्यवसायों को चोट पहुँचाई है।
translations.translation: Terry Branstad, U.S. Ambassador to China and longtime former governor of Iowa, a leading exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing has hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.
translations.reference: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.

translations.source: ब्रैनस्टेड ने रविवार के डेस मोइनेस रजिस्टर में अपनी राय जताते हुए लिखा कि चीन, "अब हमारे अपने स्वतंत्र प्रेस में प्रचार विज्ञापन चलाकर उस बदमाशी को दोगुना कर रहा है।"
translations.translation: Expressing his opinion in the Des Moines Register on Sunday, Branstad wrote that China "is now doubling the amount of bullying by running propaganda ads in our own independent press".
translations.reference: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."

translations.source: "अपने प्रचार-प्रसार में, डेस मोइनेस रजिस्टर में  भुगतान किए गए विज्ञापन देकर, चीन की सरकार वाक् स्वातंत्र्य और  स्वतंत्र पत्रकारिता संबंधी अमेरिका की पोषित परंपरा का लाभ उठा रही है," ब्रैनस्टेड ने लिखा।
translations.translation: "In its propaganda, by placing paid ads in the Des Moines Register, the Chinese government is taking advantage of America's cherished tradition of free speech and free journalism", Branstad wrote.
translations.reference: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.

translations.source: "यह देखते हुए कि मीडिया चीनी कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी की मजबूत मुट्ठी में बंद है, इसके विपरीत, यहाँ बीजिंग में सड़क के किनारे न्यूज़स्टैंड पर, आपको सीमित असंतोषपूर्ण आवाज़ें मिलेंगी और उन असंगत रायों का कोई भी सही प्रतिबिंब नहीं दिखाई देगा जो चीनी लोगों को चीन की चिंताजनक आर्थिक वक्र रेखा पर हो सकती है," उन्होंने लिखा।
translations.translation: "Given that the media is locked in the strong fist of the Chinese Communist Party, on the contrary, here in Beijing at the roadside newsstand, you will find limited discontented voices and no true reflection of the conflicting opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's worrying economic curve", he wrote.
translations.reference: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि "चीन के सबसे प्रमुख समाचार-पत्रों में से एक ने उनके लेख को प्रकाशित करने के प्रस्ताव को बहाने से टाला", हालांकि उन्होंने समाचार-पत्र का नाम नहीं बताया।
translations.translation: He said that "one of China's most prominent newspapers avoided making excuses for publishing his article", although he did not name the newspaper.
translations.reference: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.

translations.source: कैवना की पराजय के साथ रिपब्लिकन मध्यावधि चुनाव से पहले महिला मतदाताओं को अलग-थलग कर रहे हैं, विश्लेषकों ने चेतावनी दी
translations.translation: With Kavanagh's defeat, Republicans are isolating women voters ahead of midterm elections, analysts warn.
translations.reference: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn

translations.source: चूँकि शीर्ष रिपब्लिकन यौन उत्पीड़न के कई आरोपों का सामना कर रहे सुप्रीम कोर्ट के उम्मीदवार ब्रेट कैवना का समर्थन और बचाव कर रहे हैं, विश्लेषक ने चेतावनी दी है कि वे आगामी मध्ययुगीन चुनावों के दौरान, विशेष रूप से महिलाओं से, प्रतिक्रिया देखेंगे।
translations.translation: As top Republican Supreme Court candidate Brett Kavanagh, who faces multiple allegations of sexual assault, supports and defends him, the analyst has warned that he will see a response during the upcoming medieval elections, especially from women.
translations.reference: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.

translations.source: इसके इर्द-गिर्द भावनाएँ काफ़ी प्रचंड हैं, और अधिकांश रिपब्लिकन पहले से ही रिकॉर्ड पर दिखा रहे हैं कि वे मतदान के साथ आगे बढ़ना चाहते हैं।
translations.translation: The emotions surrounding it are overwhelming, and most Republicans are already showing on record that they want to move forward with the vote.
translations.reference: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.

translations.source: उन चीज़ों पर वापस नहीं आया जा सकता है," ग्रांट रीहर, सिरैक्यूज़ विश्वविद्यालय के मैक्सवेल स्कूल में राजनीति विज्ञान के एक प्रोफेसर ने द हिल को शनिवार को प्रकाशित एक लेख के लिए बताया।
translations.translation: You can't go back to those things", Grant Reehr, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School, told The Hill for an article published Saturday.
translations.reference: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.

translations.source: रीहर ने कहा कि उन्हें संदेह है कि सीनेटर जेफ़ फ़्लेक (आर-एरिजोना) द्वारा FBI जाँच के लिए अंतिम मिनट में दबाव नाराज़ मतदाताओं को शांत करने के लिए पर्याप्त होगा।
translations.translation: Reehr said he doubted that last-minute pressure by Senator Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) for an FBI investigation would be enough to calm angry voters.
translations.reference: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.

translations.source: वाशिंगटन D.C. की एक अख़बार के अनुसार, शुक्रवार को प्रगतिशील समूह MoveOn की एक वरिष्ठ सलाहकार और राष्ट्रीय प्रवक्ता कैरीन जीन-पियरे ने कहा, "महिलाएँ जो कल हुआ उसे नहीं भूल सकतीं - न तो आन वाले कल और ना ही नवंबर में इसे भूल सकती हैं।"
translations.translation: According to a Washington, D.C. newspaper, on Friday, Karen Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn, said, "Women can't forget what happened yesterday - neither the next day nor November".
translations.reference: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.

translations.source: शुक्रवार की सुबह, जब न्यायपालिका समिति को नियंत्रित करने वाले रिपब्लिकनों ने डॉ. क्रिस्टीन ब्लेसी फ़ोर्ड की गवाही के बावजूद कैवना के नामांकन के साथ आगे बढ़ना चाहा, तब सीनेट के दालान में प्रदर्शन करने वाले  प्रदर्शनकारियों ने नारे लगाए "नवंबर आ रहा है!", मिक ने रिपोर्ट किया।
translations.translation: On Friday morning, when Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee wanted to move forward with Kavanagh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, protesters protesting in the Senate lobby chanted "November is Coming!", Mick reported.
translations.reference: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.

translations.source: एक गैर-राजनैतिक विश्लेषक स्टु रोथेनबर्ग ने न्यूज़ साइट को बताया, "डेमोक्रेटिक उत्साह और प्रेरणा चार्ट से हटने जा रही है।"
translations.translation: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation are going off the charts", said Stu Rothenberg, a non-political analyst, to the news site.
translations.reference: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.

translations.source: "लोग कह रहे हैं कि यह पहले से ही प्रचंड है; यह सच है।
translations.translation: "People are saying it's already overwhelming; it's true.
translations.reference: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.

translations.source: लेकिन यह और अधिक हो सकता है, विशेष रूप से उपनगरों के महिला मतदाताओं और 18-से-29 वर्षीय युवा मतदाताओं के बीच डोल सकता है, जो राष्ट्रपति को जब पसंद नहीं करते हैं, तो अक्सर वोट नहीं करते हैं।"
translations.translation: But it could be more, especially among suburban female voters and 18- to 29-year-old young voters who don't vote often when they don't like the president".
translations.reference: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."

translations.source: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के नामांकित व्यक्ति के खिलाफ़ फ़ोर्ड द्वारा यौन उत्पीड़न के आरोपों का विस्तृत वर्णन करते हुए सार्वजनिक गवाही से पहले ही विश्लेषकों ने कहा था कि यदि रिपब्लिकन पुष्टि के साथ आगे बढ़ते हैं तो इस पर विरोध की संभावना है।
translations.translation: Explaining in detail Ford's allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts had said before the public testimony that it is likely to be contested if Republicans move forward with confirmation.
translations.reference: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.

translations.source: NBC न्यूज़ के अनुसार, रिपब्लिकन नेशनल कमेटी के पूर्व अध्यक्ष माइकल स्टील ने कहा, "यह GOP के लिए एक उलझन भरी गड़बड़ी बन गई है।"
translations.translation: According to NBC News, former chairman of the Republican National Committee Michael Steele said, "It's become a confusing mess for the GOP".
translations.reference: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.

translations.source: "यह सिर्फ़ कमेटी वोट या अंतिम वोट या कैवना को बेंच पर बिठाने के बारे में नहीं है, यह इस मामले से भी संबंधित है कि रिपब्लिकन ने इसे कैसे संभाला है और उन्होंने उनके साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया है," डेमोक्रेट को चुनाव में मदद करने वाली संस्था प्रायॉरिटीज़ यूएसए के निदेशक, गाइ सेसिल ने न्यूज़ चैनल को ध्यान दिलाया।
translations.translation: "It's not just about the committee vote or the final vote or putting Kavanah on the bench, it's also about how the Republicans have handled it and how they've treated them", Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, an organization helping Democrats in the election, told the News Channel.
translations.reference: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.

translations.source: हालांकि, अमेरिकी इस मामले में कुछ हद तक विभाजित दिखते हैं कि फ़ोर्ड और कैवना की गवाही के मद्देनजर किस पर विश्वास करें, जिनमें ज़्यादातर कैवना का पक्ष लेते नज़र आए।
translations.translation: However, Americans seem somewhat divided on who to believe in light of the testimony of Ford and Cavanagh, most of whom seem to favor Cavanagh.
translations.reference: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.

translations.source: YouGov के एक नए सर्वेक्षण से पता चलता है कि 41 प्रतिशत उत्तरदाताओं ने निश्चित या संभावित रूप से फ़ोर्ड की गवाही पर विश्वास किया, जबकि 35 प्रतिशत ने कहा कि वे निश्चित या संभावित रूप से कैवना पर विश्वास करते हैं।
translations.translation: A new YouGov survey shows that 41 percent of respondents believed Ford's testimony to be certain or likely, while 35 percent said they believed Kavanagh to be certain or likely.
translations.reference: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.

translations.source: इसके अतिरिक्त, 38 प्रतिशत ने कहा कि उन्हें लगा कि कैवना ने अपनी गवाही के दौरान शायद या निश्चित रूप से झूठ बोला है, जबकि सिर्फ़ 30 प्रतिशत ने फ़ोर्ड के बारे में ऐसा ही कहा।
translations.translation: In addition, 38 percent said they felt that Kavanagh may or may not have lied during his testimony, while only 30 percent said the same about Ford.
translations.reference: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.

translations.source: फ्लेक से दबाव के बाद, FBI वर्तमान में फ़ोर्ड और साथ ही, कम से कम एक अन्य फ़रियादी, डेबोरा रामिरेज़ द्वारा लगाए गए आरोपों की जाँच कर रही है, द गार्जियन ने रिपोर्ट की।
translations.translation: Following pressure from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating charges brought by Ford as well as at least one other defendant, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.
translations.reference: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.

translations.source: फ़ोर्ड ने पिछले सप्ताह शपथ लेकर सीनेट न्यायपालिका समिति के सामने गवाही दी कि कैवना ने 17 साल की उम्र में नशे में उसके साथ मारपीट की।
translations.translation: Ford took the oath last week and testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee that Kavanagh beat her drunk at the age of 17.
translations.reference: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.

translations.source: रामिरेज़ का आरोप है कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के नामिती ने अपने जननांगों को प्रदर्शित किया, जब वे 1980 में येल में पढ़ते समय एक पार्टी में शामिल हुए थे।
translations.translation: Ramirez alleged that the Supreme Court nominee displayed her genitals when she joined a party while attending Yale in 1980.
translations.reference: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.

translations.source: वर्ल्ड वाइड वेब के आविष्कारक द्वारा Google और Facebook के मुक़ाबले में एक नया इंटरनेट शुरू करने की योजना बनाई जा रही है
translations.translation: The inventor of the World Wide Web is planning to launch a new Internet as opposed to Google and Facebook.
translations.reference: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook

translations.source: वर्ल्ड वाइड वेब के आविष्कारक टिम बर्नर्स-ली ने एक स्टार्टअप शुरू किया है जो Facebook, Amazon और Google को टक्कर देना चाहता है।
translations.translation: Tim Berners-Lee, inventor of the World Wide Web, has launched a startup that wants to compete with Facebook, Amazon and Google.
translations.reference: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.

translations.source: प्रौद्योगिकी लीजेंड की नवीनतम परियोजना, Inrupt, एक ऐसी कंपनी है जो बर्नर्स-ली के ओपन सोर्स प्लेटफ़ॉर्म Solid का निर्माण करती है।
translations.translation: Technology Legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.
translations.reference: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.

translations.source: Solid उपयोगकर्ताओं को यह चुनने की अनुमति देता है कि उनका डेटा कहाँ संग्रहीत हो और किन लोगों को किस जानकारी तक पहुँचने की अनुमति होगी।
translations.translation: Solid allows users to choose where their data will be stored and which people will be allowed to access what information.
translations.reference: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.

translations.source: फ़ास्ट कंपनी के साथ एक विशेष साक्षात्कार में, बर्नर्स-ली ने मज़ाक में कहा कि Inrupt के पीछे इरादा "विश्व वर्चस्व" हासिल करना है।
translations.translation: In a special interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee jokingly said that the intent behind Inrupt is to gain "world dominance".
translations.reference: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."

translations.source: "हमें इसे अभी करना है," उन्होंने स्टार्टअप के बारे में कहा।
translations.translation: "We have to do it now", he said of the start-up.
translations.reference: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.

translations.source: "यह एक ऐतिहासिक क्षण है।"
translations.translation: "This is a historic moment".
translations.reference: "It's a historical moment."

translations.source: ऐप लोगों को अपने स्वयं के "व्यक्तिगत ऑनलाइन डेटा स्टोर" या POD बनाने की अनुमति देने के लिए Solid की प्रौद्योगिकी का उपयोग करता है।
translations.translation: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data stores" or PODs.
translations.reference: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.

translations.source: इसमें संपर्क सूचियाँ, टू-डू सूचियाँ, कैलेंडर, म्यूज़िक लाइब्रेरी और अन्य व्यक्तिगत और व्यावसायिक उपकरण शामिल हो सकते हैं।
translations.translation: This may include contact lists, to-do lists, calendars, music library and other personal and business tools.
translations.reference: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.

translations.source: यह ऐसा है मानो Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack और Spotify सभी एक ब्राउज़र पर और एक ही समय में उपलब्ध हैं।
translations.translation: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and at the same time.
translations.reference: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.

translations.source: व्यक्तिगत ऑनलाइन डेटा स्टोर के बारे में अनोखी बात यह है कि यह पूरी तरह से उपयोगकर्ता पर निर्भर करता है कि कौन किस तरह की जानकारी तक पहुँच सकता है।
translations.translation: The unique thing about personal online data stores is that it is entirely up to the user who can access what kind of information.
translations.reference: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.

translations.source: कंपनी इसे "डेटा के माध्यम से व्यक्तिगत सशक्तिकरण" कहती है।
translations.translation: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data".
translations.reference: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."

translations.source: कंपनी के CEO जॉन ब्रूस के अनुसार Inrupt का विचार, कंपनी द्वारा संसाधन, प्रक्रिया और उचित कौशल लाना है ताकि Solid सभी को उपलब्ध करा सकें।
translations.translation: According to company CEO John Bruce, the idea of Inrupt is to bring resources, processes and appropriate skills by the company so that Solid can be made available to everyone.
translations.reference: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.

translations.source: वर्तमान में कंपनी में बर्नर्स-ली, ब्रूस, IBM द्वारा खरीदा गया एक सेक्युरिटी प्लैटफ़ॉर्म, परियोजना पर काम करने के लिए अनुबंधित कुछ ऑन-स्टाफ़ डेवलपर्स, और वालंटियर कोडरों का समुदाय शामिल है।
translations.translation: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform purchased by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.
translations.reference: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform bought by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.

translations.source: इस सप्ताह से, दुनिया भर के प्रौद्योगिकी डेवलपर्स Inrupt  वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध उपकरणों का उपयोग करके अपने स्वयं के विकेंद्रीकृत ऐप बना सकते हैं।
translations.translation: Starting this week, technology developers around the world can create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.
translations.reference: Starting this week, technology developers around the world could create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.

translations.source: बर्नर्स-ली ने कहा कि वह और उनकी टीम "Facebook और Google से इस बारे में बात नहीं कर रही है कि संपूर्ण परिवर्तन की शुरुआत की जाए या नहीं, जहाँ उनके सभी बिजनेस मॉडल रातों-रात पूरी तरह खत्म हो जाएँगे।
translations.translation: Berners-Lee said that she and her team "are not talking to Facebook and Google about whether or not to initiate a complete change, where all their business models will be completely wiped out overnight.
translations.reference: Berners-Lee said that he and his team are not talking to "Facebook and Google about whether or not to introduce a complete change where all their business models are completely upended overnight.

translations.source: "हम उनसे अनुमति नहीं माँग रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: "We do not ask permission from them".
translations.reference: "We are not asking their permission."

translations.source: शनिवार को प्रकाशित Medium पर एक पोस्ट में, बर्नर्स-ली ने लिखा कि Inrupt का "मिशन Solid पर निर्मित नए वेब की अखंडता और गुणवत्ता की रक्षा में मदद करने के लिए वाणिज्यिक ऊर्जा और पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र प्रदान करना है।
translations.translation: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and ecosystems to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid".
translations.reference: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and an ecosystem to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid."

translations.source: 1994 में, बर्नर्स-ली ने इंटरनेट को तब बदल दिया जब उन्होंने मैसाचुसेट्स इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ़ टेक्नोलॉजी में वर्ल्ड वाइड वेब कंसॉर्शियम की स्थापना की।
translations.translation: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he founded the World Wide Web Consortium at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
translations.reference: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

translations.source: हाल के महीनों में, बर्नर्स-ली नेट तटस्थता बहस में एक प्रभावशाली आवाज़ रहे हैं।
translations.translation: In recent months, Berners-Lee Net has been an influential voice in the neutrality debate.
translations.reference: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.

translations.source: यहाँ तक कि Inrupt लॉन्च करते समय, बर्नर्स-ली वर्ल्ड वाइड वेब कंसॉर्शियम, वेब फाउंडेशन और ओपन डेटा इंस्टीट्यूट के संस्थापक और निदेशक बने रहेंगे।
translations.translation: Even when launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the founder and director of the World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.
translations.reference: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.

translations.source: "मैं वेब के इस अगले युग के लिए अविश्वसनीय रूप से आशावादी हूँ," बर्नर्स-ली ने कहा।
translations.translation: "I'm incredibly optimistic about this next era of the web", said Berners-Lee.
translations.reference: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.

translations.source: बर्नार्ड वॉन: WW1 विक्टोरिया क्रॉस क्लेरिक का जश्न मनाया गया
translations.translation: Bernard Vaughn: WW1 Victoria Cross Cleric was celebrated
translations.reference: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated

translations.source: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान योद्धा के रूप में विक्टोरिया क्रॉस जीतने वाले चर्च ऑफ़ इंग्लैंड के एकमात्र पादरी का उनके गृह नगर में 100 वर्ष का जश्न मनाया गया।
translations.translation: The only Church of England clergyman to win the Victoria Cross as a warrior during the First World War celebrated 100 years in his home town.
translations.reference: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.

translations.source: लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल रेवरेंड बर्नार्ड वॉन ने 29 सितंबर 1918 को बेलेंगलाइज़ और लेहॉकोर्ट में हुए हमले में यह पुरस्कार जीता।
translations.translation: Lt. Col. Reverend Bernard Vaughn won the award in the attack on 29 September 1918 at Belenglis and Lehighcourt.
translations.reference: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.

translations.source: हालांकि, वे चार दिन बाद एक स्नाइपर द्वारा मारे गए और उन्होंने कभी नहीं जाना कि उन्होंने सर्वोच्च ब्रिटिश सैन्य सम्मान जीता था।
translations.translation: However, he was killed four days later by a sniper and he never knew he had won the highest British military honour.
translations.reference: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.

translations.source: शनिवार को नॉर्थम्पटनशायर के रशडेन में आयोजित परेड में उनके दो पोतों द्वारा स्मारक पत्थर का अनावरण किया गया।
translations.translation: The memorial stone was unveiled by his two ships at a parade held in Rushden, Northamptonshire on Saturday.
translations.reference: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.

translations.source: उनके पौत्रों में से एक, माइकल वॉन ने कहा कि यह "शानदार ढंग से प्रतीकात्मक" था कि उनके दादा के पुरस्कार जीतने के ठीक 100 साल बाद इस प्रस्तर का अनावरण किया जा रहा है।
translations.translation: One of his grandsons, Michael Vaughn, said it was "beautifully symbolic" that the scroll was being unveiled exactly 100 years after his grandfather won the prize.
translations.reference: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.

translations.source: लंदन गजट के अनुसार, 29 सितंबर 1918 को लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल वॉन ने कैनाल डी सेंट-क्वेंटिन में "एक बहुत घने कोहरे के बीच, युद्ध के मैदान में भारी गोलाबारी और मशीनगनों के तहत" अपनी बटालियन का नेतृत्व किया।
translations.translation: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918, Lieutenant-Colonel Vaughn led his battalion at the Canal de Saint-Quentin "in the midst of a very dense fog, under heavy shelling and machine guns on the battlefield".
translations.reference: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."

translations.source: बाद में वे फ़ायरिंग लाइन की ओर बढ़ गए और "बड़ी वीरता" के साथ, अकेले फ़ील्ड-गन हाथ में लेने से पहले सैन्य-पंक्ति की अगुआई की और तीन टुकड़ियों को धराशायी किया।
translations.translation: He later moved to the firing line and, with "great bravery", led the military line and drove three troops before taking up field guns alone.
translations.reference: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.

translations.source: लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल वॉन 4 अक्तूबर 1918 को - युद्ध समाप्त होने से बस एक महीने पहले, एक जर्मन स्नाइपर द्वारा मारे गए ।
translations.translation: Lieutenant Colonel Vaughn was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just a month before the war ended.
translations.reference: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.

translations.source: 72 वर्षीय माइकल वॉन ने कहा कि उनके दादा के कारनामे "कुछ ऐसे थे, जिनकी मैं जानता हूँ कि कभी बराबरी नहीं कर सकता, लेकिन जिन पर हमें नाज़ है।"
translations.translation: Michael Vaughn, 72, said that his grandfather's accomplishments were "some that I know I can never match, but that we are proud of".
translations.reference: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."

translations.source: उन्होंने और उनके भाई डॉ. जेम्स वॉन ने भी परेड के बाद माल्यार्पण किया, जिसका नेतृत्व ब्रेंटवुड इंपीरियल यूथ बैंड ने किया।
translations.translation: He and his brother Dr. James Vaughn also inaugurated after the parade, led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
translations.reference: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.

translations.source: माइकल वॉन ने कहा कि वे "परेड में भूमिका निभाने के लिए बहुत सम्मानित महसूस कर रहे हैं" और उन्होंने कहा "अनेक लोगों द्वारा दिए जा रहे समर्थन से एक वास्तविक नायक की वीरता का प्रदर्शन किया जा रहा है।"
translations.translation: Michael Vaughn said he was "very honoured to play a role in the parade" and he said "the support provided by so many people is demonstrating the heroism of a real hero".
translations.reference: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."

translations.source: MMA के प्रशंसक बेलाटर 206 को देखने के लिए पूरी रात जागते रहे, लेकिन इसके बजाय उन्हें पेप्पा पिग मिला
translations.translation: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Belater 206, but instead they got Peppa Pig.
translations.reference: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead

translations.source: कल्पना कीजिए, आप पूरी रात खचाखच भरे बेलाटर 206 को देखने के लिए जगे रहे, लेकिन मुख्य कार्यक्रम देखने से वंचित हो गए।
translations.translation: Imagine that you stayed up all night to watch the cluttered Belater 206, but missed the main event.
translations.reference: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.

translations.source: सैन जोस के बिल में 13 मुक़ाबले थे, जिनमें मुख्य कार्ड पर छह शामिल थे और यू.के. चैनल 5 पर पूरी रात लाइव दिखाया जा रहा था।
translations.translation: The San Jose Bill had 13 contests, including six on the main card and was being shown live all night on UK Channel 5.
translations.reference: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.

translations.source: सुबह 6 बजे, जैसे ही गेगार्ड मौसासी और रोरी मैकडोनाल्ड एक-दूसरे का सामना करने की तैयारी कर रहे थे, यू.के. में दर्शक कवरेज के पेप्पा पिग में बदल जाने से स्तब्ध रह गए।
translations.translation: At 6am, as Gagard Moussaci and Rory McDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were stunned by the change in coverage to Peppa Pig.
translations.reference: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.

translations.source: विशेष रूप से मुक़ाबले के लिए सुबह सवेरे तक जागते रहने के बाद कुछ बेहद निराश थे।
translations.translation: Some were extremely disappointed, especially after staying up until the early hours of the morning to compete.
translations.reference: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.

translations.source: ट्विटर पर एक प्रशंसक ने बच्चों के कार्टून में स्विच करने को "एक प्रकार का बीमारू मज़ाक" के रूप में वर्णित किया।
