translations.source: शुक्रवार को सुलावेसी के द्वीप पर सुनामी को सक्रिय करते हुए प्रमुख भूकंप के हमले के बाद 800 से अधिक लोग मारे गए और कई और लापता हैं।
translations.translation: More than 800 people were killed and many more are missing after a major earthquake triggered a tsunami on the island of Sulawesi on Friday.
translations.reference: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.

translations.source: क्षेत्र में पश्चात्वर्ती आघात निरंतर विनाश करते रहे और पालू के शहर में मलबे के नीचे में कई लोग फंस गए।
translations.translation: Subsequent shocks in the region continued to devastate and many people were trapped beneath the rubble in the city of Palo.
translations.reference: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.

translations.source: लेकिन जब उसके सहयोगी अपनी जान बचाने के लिए भाग रहे थे, तब 21 वर्षीय एंथोनियस गुनावां एगंग ने मुटियारा सिस अल जुफ़री एयरपोर्ट पालू एयरपोर्ट पर अस्त व्यस्त रूप से नियंत्रित अपनी पोस्ट को छोड़ने से मना कर दिया।
translations.translation: But while his associates were fleeing to save their lives, 21-year-old Anthony Guanavan Egang refused to leave his post at the bustlingly controlled Mutiara Sisi al-Jufri Airport at Palu Airport.
translations.reference: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.

translations.source: वह यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए वहाँ डटा रहा कि बेटिक एयर फ़्लाइट 6321, जो उस समय रनवे पर था, सुरक्षित तरीके से उतर सके।
translations.translation: He stood there to ensure that flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, could land safely.
translations.reference: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.

translations.source: फिर वह ट्रैफ़िक कंट्रोल टावर से कूद गया, जब उसे लगा कि यह गिरने वाला था।
translations.translation: Then he jumped from the traffic control tower, when he thought it was going to fall.
translations.reference: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.

translations.source: बाद में अस्पताल में उनकी मौत हो गई।
translations.translation: He later died in hospital.
translations.reference: He died later in hospital.

translations.source: एयर नेविगेशन इंडोनेशिया के एक प्रवक्त, योहानेस सिरट्रेट ने कहा कि इस निर्णय से सैकड़ों लोगों की जान बच सकती थीं, ऑस्ट्रेलिया के ABC News ने रिपोर्ट की।
translations.translation: Air Navigation Indonesia spokesman Johannes Sirtrate said the decision could have saved hundreds of lives, ABC News of Australia reported.
translations.reference: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.

translations.source: हमने उन्हें दूसरे शहर से बड़े अस्पताल में ले जाने के लिए कलिमंटन में बलिकपपन से एक हेलीकॉप्टर तैयार किया।
translations.translation: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Climton to transport them from another city to a larger hospital.
translations.reference: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.

translations.source: दुर्भाग्य से, हमने हेलीकॉप्टर के पालू पहुँचने से पहले ही उन्हें खो दिया।
translations.translation: Unfortunately, we lost them before the helicopter reached the flank.
translations.reference: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.

translations.source: "उनके जाने से हमारा दिल टूट गया," उसने कहा।
translations.translation: "His departure broke our hearts", she said.
translations.reference: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.

translations.source: इसी बीच, अधिकारियों को डर है कि देश के विनाश के साथ मरने वालों की संख्या हज़ारों तक पहुँच सकती है, अल्पीकरण एजेंसी का कहना है कि डोंगाला, सिगी और बोटोंश तक पहुँच सीमित है।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, officials fear that the death toll from the devastation of the country could reach thousands, with limited access to Dongla, Sigi and Botonsh, the shortening agency says.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.

translations.source: "मृत्यु दर अभी भी बढ़ोतरी हो सकती है क्योंकि कई शव अभी भी अवशेष या मलबे में दबे हुए हो सकते हैं, या कई ऐसे स्थानों पर जहाँ पहुँचा नहीं जा सकता है," एजेंसी के प्रवक्त सुटोपो नुघरोहो ने कहा।
translations.translation: "The mortality rate may still increase because many bodies may still be crushed in debris or debris, or in many places that cannot be reached", said agency spokesman Sutopo Nugroho.
translations.reference: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.

translations.source: छह मीटर तक ऊँची उठी लहरों ने पालू को तबाह कर दिया, जिसके कारण रविवार को सामूहिक दफ़न किया गया।
translations.translation: Waves up to six meters high destroyed the palace, causing a mass burial on Sunday.
translations.reference: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.

translations.source: सेना और वाणिज्यिक विमान सहायता और आपूर्ति ला रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing aid and supplies.
translations.reference: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.

translations.source: रीसा कुसुमा, एक 35 वर्षीय माँ ने, स्काई न्यूज़ को बतायाः "हर मिनट एंबुलेस शवों को लेकर आती थी।
translations.translation: Reza Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute ambulances came with bodies.
translations.reference: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.

translations.source: स्वच्छ जल मिलना दुर्लभ है।
translations.translation: Access to clean water is rare.
translations.reference: Clean water is scarce.

translations.source: हर जगह छोटे-छोटे बाज़ारों को लूटा जाता था।"
translations.translation: Small markets were looted everywhere".
translations.reference: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."

translations.source: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय रेड क्रॉस के प्रमुख, जैन गैलफैंड ने CNN को बतायाः "इंडोनेशिया रेड क्रॉस जीविकों की मदद करने के लिए दौड़ भाग कर रही है, लेकिन हमें नहीं पता कि उन्हें वहाँ क्या मिलेगा।
translations.translation: The head of the International Red Cross, Jane Galfand, told CNN: "Indonesia is racing to help Red Cross organisms, but we don't know what they will find there.
translations.reference: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.

translations.source: यह पहले से ही एक त्रासदी है, लेकिन यह और भी अधिक बुरा हो सकता है।"
translations.translation: It's already a tragedy, but it could be worse".
translations.reference: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया के राष्ट्रपति जोको विडोडो रविवार को पालू पहुँचें और उन्होंने देश की सेना को बतायाः "मैं आप सभी से निकासी या खाली करने से संबंधिक हर कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए दिन-रात काम करने के लिए कह रहा हूँ।
translations.translation: Indonesian President Joko Widodo arrived in Palau on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every task related to evacuation or evacuation.
translations.reference: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.

translations.source: क्या आप तैयार हैं?" CNN ने रिपोर्ट की।
translations.translation: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
translations.reference: Are you ready?" CNN reported.

translations.source: इंडोनेशिया में पहले इस वर्ष की शुरूआत में लोबोंक में भूंकप आया था, जिसमें लगभग 550 लोग मारे गए थे।
translations.translation: Earlier this year, in Indonesia, there was an earthquake in Lombok that killed about 550 people.
translations.reference: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.

translations.source: माइक्रोनेशिया विमान दुर्घटना: एयर नियुगिनी अब बताता है कि लैगून विमान दुर्घटना के बाद से एक आदमी लापता है
translations.translation: Micronesia plane crash: Air Nugini now reports that a man has been missing since the lagoon plane crash
translations.reference: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash

translations.source: मैक्रोनेशिया में प्रशांत लैगून में दुर्घटनाग्रस्त विमान का परिचालन करने वाली एयरलाइन अब कहती है कि एक आदमी लापता है, जब पिछली बार बताया गया था कि 47 यात्रियों और क्रू या चालक दल को डूबते हुए विमान से सुरक्षित निकाला गया था।
translations.translation: The airline operating the plane that crashed in Makronesia's Pacific Lagoon now says a man is missing after 47 passengers and crew were last reported to have been safely evacuated from the sinking aircraft.
translations.reference: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.

translations.source: एयर नियुगिनी ने शनिवार दोपहर को एक रिलीज़ में कहा कि यह एक पुरुष यात्री का पता नहीं लगा पाए।
translations.translation: Air Nugini said in a release on Saturday afternoon that it could not locate a male passenger.
translations.reference: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.

translations.source: एयरलाइन ने कहा कि वह उस आदमी का पता लगाने के लिए स्थानी अधिकारियों, अस्पताल और जांचकर्ताओं के साथ मिलकर काम कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: The airline said it is working closely with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to track down the man.
translations.reference: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.

translations.source: एयरलाइन यात्री के बारे में अधिर जानकारी के अनुरोध पर तत्काल प्रतिक्रिया नहीं करती, जैसे उसकी आयु या राष्ट्रीयता।
translations.translation: The airline does not immediately respond to requests for incomplete information about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
translations.reference: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.

translations.source: चूक द्वीप एयरपोर्ट पर उतरने का प्रयास करते समय जब विमान पानी में जा गिरा, तो स्थानीय नावों ने अन्य यात्रियों और चालक दल को बचाने में मदद की।
translations.translation: Local boats helped to rescue other passengers and crew when the plane plunged into the water while attempting to land at the Falklands Airport.
translations.reference: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.

translations.source: अधिकारियों ने शुक्रवार को कहा कि सात लोगों को अस्पताल ले जाया गया।
translations.translation: Officials said on Friday that seven people were taken to hospital.
translations.reference: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.

translations.source: एयरलाइन ने कहा कि छह यात्री शनिवार को अस्पताल में रहे और उन सभी की स्थिति अब स्थिर है।
translations.translation: The airline said that six passengers were hospitalized on Saturday and all are now in stable condition.
translations.reference: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.

translations.source: क्रैश का कारण और घटना किस-किस तरह हुई यह अस्पष्ट है।
translations.translation: It is unclear what caused the crash and how it happened.
translations.reference: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.

translations.source: एयरलाइन और अमेरिका नेवी का कहना है कि दोनों विमान रनवे पर ठीक से नहीं उतरे।
translations.translation: The airline and the US Navy say the two planes did not land properly on the runway.
translations.reference: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.

translations.source: कुछ साक्षियों या प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों ने सोचा कि विमान रनवे पर उतरे ही नहीं।
translations.translation: Some witnesses or eyewitnesses thought the plane did not land on the runway.
translations.reference: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.

translations.source: अमेरिकी यात्री बिल जेन ने कहा कि विमान बहुत नीचे आ गया था।
translations.translation: U.S. passenger Bill Jane said the plane had come down a lot.
translations.reference: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.

translations.source: जेन ने कहा "यह एक बेहद अच्छी चीज़ है"।
translations.translation: Jane said, "This is a very good thing".
translations.reference: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.

translations.source: जेन ने कहा कि उसे और दूसरों को डूबते हुए विमान पर मौजूद आपातकालीन निकास से गहरे पानी में से बाहर निकाला गया।
translations.translation: Jane said she and others were pulled out of the deep water by an emergency exit on the sinking plane.
translations.reference: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि विमान के कर्मचारी घबराए हुए थे और चिल्ला रहे थे और उसे सिर पर एक मामूली चोट लग गई।
translations.translation: He said that the flight crew were panicking and screaming and he suffered a minor head injury.
translations.reference: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.

translations.source: अमेरिका नौसेना ने कहा कि घाट को बेहतर बनाने के लिए आस-पास काम कर रहे नाविकों ने विमान के डूबने से पहले लगभग पानी के 30 मीटर (100 फ़ीट) में लोगों को किनारे पर लाने के लिए एक हवा वाली नाव का उपयोग करके बचाव करने में भी मदद की।
translations.translation: The U.S. Navy said that sailors working nearby to improve the strait also helped rescue by using a windy boat to bring people ashore in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water before the plane sank.
translations.reference: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.

translations.source: एविएशन सुरक्षा नेटवर्क से डेटा संकेत करता है कि पिछले दो दशकों में PNG-पंजीकृत एयरलाइन के क्रेश में 111 लोग मारे गए लेकिन कोई भी एयर नियुगिनी में शामिल नहीं था।
translations.translation: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates that 111 people were killed in the crash of a PNG-registered airline in the last two decades but no one was involved in Air New Guinea.
translations.reference: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.

translations.source: विश्लेषक ने रात का वह समय बताया, जब महिला को जिंदा जलाया गया
translations.translation: The analyst described the time of night when the woman was burned alive.
translations.reference: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive

translations.source: अभियोजन पक्ष ने 2014 में एक मिसिसिपी महिला को ज़िंदा जलाने के आरोप में एक आदमी को फिर से मुकदमा करने के लिए शनिवार को अपने केस को बहाल कर दिया।
translations.translation: Prosecutors resumed their case on Saturday to retrial a man accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
translations.reference: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.

translations.source: अमेरिका न्याय विश्लेषक पॉल रोलेट के विभाग ने जांच विश्लेषण की फ़ील्ड में एक विशेषज्ञ गवाह के रूप में घंटों तक प्रमाण प्रस्तुत किए।
translations.translation: U.S. Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett's department presented evidence for hours as an expert witness in the field of investigative analysis.
translations.reference: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.

translations.source: उसने जूरी को बताया कि कैसे उसने उसके मरने की रात पर 29 वर्षीय मुलज़िम क्विंटन टेलीस और 19 वर्षीय पीड़ित जैसिका चैंबर की गतिविधियों को एक साथ लाने के लिए सेलफ़ोन रिकॉर्ड का उपयोग किया हो।
translations.translation: He told the jury how on the night of his death he used cellphone records to bring together the activities of 29-year-old Mulzim Quinton Teles and 19-year-old victim Jessica Chamber.
translations.reference: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.

translations.source: रोलेट ने कहा कि उसने कई सेलफ़ोन से स्थान डेटा प्राप्त किया, जो दिखाता है कि उसके पिछले दावों का खंडन करते हुए मृत्यु वाली शाम को टैलिस चैंबर्स के साथ थी, द क्लेरियन-लेजर ने रिपोर्ट किया।
translations.translation: Rowlett said she obtained location data from several cell phones, which shows that the deceased was with Tallis Chambers on the evening of her death, denying her previous claims, The Clarion-Laser reported.
translations.reference: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .

translations.source: जब डेटा दिखाता है कि जब उसने कहा कि वह अपने मित्र मिशैल सैनफ़ोर्ड के साथ था, उस समय उसका सेलफ़ोन चैंबर्स के पास था, पुलिस ने सैनफ़ोर्ड को बताया।
translations.translation: When the data shows that he had his cell phone near the chambers when he said he was with his friend Michelle Sanford, the police told Sanford.
translations.reference: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.

translations.source: सैनफ़ोर्ड ने शनिवार को आगे आकर अपनी बात कही और प्रमाण प्रस्तुत किए कि वह उस दिन शहर में नहीं था।
translations.translation: Sanford came forward on Saturday and presented evidence that he was not in town that day.
translations.reference: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.

translations.source: अभियोक्ताओं के पूछने पर कि यदि टैलीस सच बोल रहा है, जब उसने कहा कि वह उस रात सैनफ़ोर्ड की ट्रक में था, तब सैनफ़ोर्ड ने कहा कि वह "झूठ बोल रहा है क्योंकि उसका ट्रक नैशविले में था।"
translations.translation: When asked by prosecutors if Tallis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying because his truck was in Nashville".
translations.reference: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."

translations.source: दूसरी असंगति यह थी कि टैलिस ने कहा कि वह चैंबर्स को उसकी मृत्यु से लगभग दो सप्ताह पहले से ही जानता था।
translations.translation: The second discrepancy was that Tallis said he knew Chambers about two weeks before his death.
translations.reference: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.

translations.source: सेलफ़ोन रिकॉर्ड दिखाते हैं कि वे एक दूसरे को एक सप्ताह से ही जानते थे।
translations.translation: Cell phone records show that they had known each other for a week.
translations.reference: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.

translations.source: रोलेट ने कहा कि चैंबर की मृत्यु के कुछ समय बाद, टैलीस ने अपने फ़ोन से चैंबर के सारे टेक्स्ट या संदेश, कॉल या संपर्क जानकारी हटा दी है।
translations.translation: Rowlett said that shortly after Chamber's death, Tallis deleted all texts or messages, calls or contact information from the Chamber from her phone.
translations.reference: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.

translations.source: हेल ने कहा, "उसने उसे अपनी ज़िंदगी से मिटा दिया।"
translations.translation: "He erased her from his life", said Hale.
translations.reference: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.

translations.source: बचाव पक्ष रविवार को अपने समापन तर्क शुरू करने के लिए तैयार हैं।
translations.translation: The defense is ready to begin its concluding arguments on Sunday.
translations.reference: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.

translations.source: न्यायाधीश ने कहा कि उन्हें उस दिन मुकदमे को सुनवाई के लिए जूरी के पास जाने की उम्मीद थी।
translations.translation: The judge said that he expected to go to the jury for the hearing of the case that day.
translations.reference: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.

translations.source: उच्च ब्रीड: सचेत या जागरूक हिप हॉप क्या है?
translations.translation: High breed: What is conscious or conscious hip hop?
translations.reference: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?

translations.source: हिप हॉप की तिकड़ी अपने संगीत में सकारात्मक संदेशों को भरकर शैली के नकारात्मक दृश्य को बदलना चाहती है।
translations.translation: The hip hop trio wants to change the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
translations.reference: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.

translations.source: ब्रिस्टोल से उच्च ब्रीड ने दावा किया कि हिप-हॉप राजनीतिक संदेशों और सामाजिक मुद्दों से निपटने के लिए अपने मूल से दोर हो गया है।
translations.translation: The Bristol-based High Breed claimed that hip-hop has drifted away from its roots to deal with political messages and social issues.
translations.reference: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.

translations.source: वे अपने जड़ों से दूर होकर और लोकप्रिय हिप-हॉप को फिर से जागरूक बनाना चाहते थे।
translations.translation: They wanted to move away from their roots and reawaken popular hip-hop.
translations.reference: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.

translations.source: फ़्यूजेस और कॉमन जैसे कलाकारों ने अलाका और लोकी जैसे कलाकारों के माध्यम से ब्रिटेन में एक नवीनतम पुनरुत्थान देखा।
translations.translation: Artists such as Fugees and Common saw a recent revival in Britain through artists such as Alaka and Loki.
translations.reference: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.

translations.source: दूसरा काला व्यक्ति?!
translations.translation: The other black person?!
translations.reference: Another black person?!

translations.source: NY नैनी ने "जातिवादी" टेक्स्ट के बाद फ़ायरिंग करने के बाद युगल दंपत्ति पर मुकदमा चलाता है
translations.translation: NY Nanny sues the couple after firing after a "racial" text.
translations.reference: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text

translations.source: एक न्यूयॉर्क नैनी एक माँ के द्वारा शिकायत करने पर कि वह "दूसरा काला व्यक्ति" है, भ्रामक पाठ करने के बाद पक्षपाती निशानेबाज़ी के लिए एक युगल दंपत्ति पर मुकदमा करती हैं।
translations.translation: A New York nanny sues a couple for biased targeting after a mother complained that she was "the second black person".
translations.reference: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."

translations.source: युगल दंपत्ति अस्वीकार करते हैं कि वे रेसिस्ट हैं, "अपकर्षण" के लिए मुकदमा चलाना।
translations.translation: Couples deny that they are racist, suing for "abduction".
translations.reference: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."

translations.source: लिनसी प्लास्को-फ़्लैक्समैन, दो बच्चों की माँ यह पता चलने पर कि नए बच्चों के देखभाल करने वाला गिसैल मॉरीस को अपनी बैचेनी व्यक्त करती है, जो 2016 में अपने पहले कार्य दिवस पर ब्लैक थी।
translations.translation: Lindsay Plasco-Flaxman, mother of two, reveals her frustration with new baby-sitter Gisele Morris, who was black on her first day at work in 2016.
translations.reference: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.

translations.source: "कोई अन्य काला व्यक्ति नहीं" श्रीमती प्लैस्को फ़्लैक्समेन ने एक टेक्स्ट में अपने पति से कहा।
translations.translation: "No other black person", Mrs. Plasco Flaxman told her husband in a text.
translations.reference: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.

translations.source: हालांकि, इसे अपने पति को भेजने के बजाय इसने इसे दो बार सुश्री मॉरिस को भेजा।
translations.translation: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Morris twice.
translations.reference: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.

translations.source: एक न्यूयॉर्क पोस्ट के अनुसार, अपनी भूल का एहसास होने के बाद, एक "असहज" प्लास्को-फ़्लैक्समैन ने सुश्री मॉरिस को निकाल दिया, यह बताते हुए कि उनकी बाहर जाने वाली नैनी जो अफ़्रीकी-अमेरिकी थी, ने खराब काम किया है और वह इसके बजाय एक फ़िलिपिनो की उम्मीद कर रहे है।
translations.translation: According to the New York Post, after realizing his mistake, an "uncomfortable" Placebo-Flaxman fired Ms. Morris, stating that her estranged nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and was expecting a Filipino instead.
translations.reference: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.

translations.source: सुश्री मॉरिस को अपने एक दिन के काम का भुगतान करके ऊबर में घर भेज दिया गया।
translations.translation: Ms. Morris was sent home to Uber to pay for her one day's work.
translations.reference: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.

translations.source: अब, मॉरिस दंपत्ति पर नौकरी से निकालने और छह महीने के लिए प्रति दिन 350 डॉलर के मुआवज़े की मांग करती है, लिव-इन गिग में उसे हालांकि बिना किसी अनुबंध के काम शुरू करने के लिए नियुक्त किया गया।
translations.translation: Now, Morris is demanding a dismissal from the couple and compensation of $350 a day for six months, while at Live-in Gig she was hired to start work without a contract.
translations.reference: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.

translations.source: "देखो मैं उन्हें दिखाना चाहता हूँ कि आप ऐसा कोई काम नहीं करते हैं" उन्होंने यह बताते हुए कि "मैं जानता हूँ कि यह भेदभाव है", उसने शुक्रवार को एक पोस्ट में कहा।
translations.translation: "Look, I want to show them that you don't do anything like that", he said in a post on Friday, explaining, "I know it's discrimination".
translations.reference: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."

translations.source: युगल दंपत्ति ने दावों पर कहा कि वे जातिवादी हैं, यह बताते हुए कि उसका अपमान करने के बाद वे उस पर भरोसा नहीं कर सकते, मॉरिस के रोज़गार को समाप्त करना उचित था।
translations.translation: The couple claimed to be racist, stating that after insulting him they could not trust him, it was justified to terminate Morris' employment.
translations.reference: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.

translations.source: "मेरी पत्नी ने कुछ भेजा था जिससे उसका मतलब वह नहीं था।
translations.translation: "My wife sent me something she didn't mean.
translations.reference: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.

translations.source: वह जातिवादी नहीं है।
translations.translation: He is not a racist.
translations.reference: She's not a racist.

translations.source: हम जातिवादी लोग नहीं है, "पति जो प्लास्को ने पोस्ट को बताया।
translations.translation: We are not racist people", the husband, Joe Plasco, told the Post.
translations.reference: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.

translations.source: लेकिन क्या आप अपने बच्चों को किसी ऐसे के हाथ में दे सकते हैं, जिसका कभी आपने अपमान किया हो, चाहे वो गलती से ही हुआ हो?
translations.translation: But can you put your children in the hands of someone you've ever insulted, even if it was by mistake?
translations.reference: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?

translations.source: आपका नवजात शिशु?
translations.translation: Your newborn?
translations.reference: Your newborn baby?

translations.translation: Leave it alone".
translations.reference: Come on."

translations.source: "अपकर्षण" के मुकदमे की तरह, प्लास्को ने कहा कि उसकी पत्नी को बच्चा हुए केवल दो महीने ही हुए हैं और वह "बहुत मुश्किल स्थिति" में है।
translations.translation: Like the "abduction" case, Plasco said that his wife has only had a baby for two months and is in a "very difficult situation".
translations.reference: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."

translations.source: "आप किसी ऐसे के पीछे जा रहे हैं?
translations.translation: "Are you going after someone like that?
translations.reference: "You're going to go after someone like that?

translations.source: ऐसा करना सही नहीं है," निवेश बैंकर ने कहा।
translations.translation: It is not right to do this", the investment banker said.
translations.reference: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.

translations.source: जबकि कानूनी मुकदमा अभी भी चल रहा है, उनके व्यवहार और तर्क के लिए उन्हें चुप कराते हुए सोशल मीडिया पर युगल दंपत्ति पर दोषारोपण करने पर त्वरित प्रतिक्रिया दी है।
translations.translation: While the legal proceedings are still ongoing, they have responded quickly to the accusation of the couple on social media, silencing them for their behaviour and reasoning.
translations.reference: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.

translations.source: पैडिस्टन प्रकाशकों को आशंका है कि रीडर इसे अपने खुद के विचारों और राय से नहीं जोड़ेगा, नए पत्र से पता चलता है
translations.translation: Paddington publishers fear that the reader will not associate it with their own thoughts and opinions, the new paper reveals.
translations.reference: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals

translations.source: बॉन्ड की बेटी कैरन जेंकल, जो बुक स्वीकृत होने के बाद पैदा हुई, पत्र में कहा गया: "इसके प्रकाशित होने से पहले इसे पहली बार पढ़ने पर किसी को खुद की जगह रखने कर सोचना मुश्किल है।
translations.translation: Bond's daughter, Karen Jenkins, who was born after the book was approved, said in the letter: "It's hard to think of anyone holding their own when reading it for the first time before it's published.
translations.reference: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.

translations.source: पैंडिंगटन की सफ़लता के बारे में जानना आश्चर्यजनक है।"
translations.translation: It's amazing to know about Pendington's success".
translations.reference: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."

translations.source: अपने पिता के बारे में बताते हुए, जिन्होंने एक छोटे भालू के खिलौने से प्रेरित होकर एक बच्चों की किताब लिखने से पहले BBC कैमरामेन के रूप में काम किया था, वह अपने काम के अस्वीकार होने को लेकर आशावादी थे, उसने कहा कि उनकी मृत्यु के बाद उनकी पुस्तक के प्रकाशन की 60वीं वर्षगांठ में "खुशी और गम" दोनों थे।
translations.translation: Describing his father, who was inspired by a small bear toy and worked as a BBC cameraman before writing a children's book, who was optimistic about the rejection of his work, he said that after his death there were both "joy and grief" on the 60th anniversary of the publication of his book.
translations.reference: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.

translations.source: पैडिंगटन के बारे में, जिसके बारे मे वह "अपने परिवार के महत्वपूर्ण सदस्य" के रूप में वर्णन करती है, वह बताती है कि उसके पिता को उसकी संभावित सफ़लता पर गर्व था।
translations.translation: Of Paddington, whom she describes as "an important member of her family", she explains that her father was proud of her potential success.
translations.reference: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.

translations.source: "वह एक शांत आदमी थे और बिल्कुल भी घमंडी नहीं थे," उसने कहा।
translations.translation: "He was a calm man and was not arrogant at all", she said.
translations.reference: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.

translations.source: "लेकिन क्योंकि पैंडिंगटन उनके लिए बहुत वास्तविक था, यह लगभग ऐसा था कि आपके पास कोई बच्चा है जो कुछ पा लेता हैः आप उन पर गर्व करते हैं, भले ही वास्तव में आप उसे नहीं कर रहे हों।
translations.translation: "But because Pendington was so real to them, it was almost like you have a kid who gets something: you're proud of them, even if you're not actually doing it.
translations.reference: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.

translations.source: मुझे लगता है कि उन्होंने पैडिंगटन की सफ़लता को उस तरह से देखा है।
translations.translation: I think that's how they saw Paddington's success.
translations.reference: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.

translations.source: यद्यपि यह उनकी कल्पना और रचना थीं, फिर भी वह हमेशा पैडिंगटन को ही इसका श्रेय देते थे।"
translations.translation: Although it was his imagination and composition, he always attributed it to Paddington".
translations.reference: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."

translations.source: मेरी बेटी मर रही थी और मुझे उसे फ़ोन पर अलविदा कहना था
translations.translation: My daughter was dying, and I had to say goodbye on the phone.
translations.reference: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone

translations.source: लैंड करने पर, उसकी बेटी को नाइस के लूइस पैस्टोर 2 अस्पताल में ले जाया गया, जहाँ डॉक्टरों द्वारा किया गया काम बेकार गया।
translations.translation: Upon landing, her daughter was taken to Louis Pasteur 2 Hospital in Nice, where the work done by the doctors was in vain.
translations.reference: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.

translations.source: "नैड नियमित रूप से कह रहा था कि यह सच में बुरा था, उससे ऐसी उम्मीद नहीं था," श्रीमती एडनेन-लैपरूस ने कहा।
translations.translation: "Nade was regularly saying that it was really bad, I didn't expect that from him", Mrs. Adnan-Laproux said.
translations.reference: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.

translations.source: "फिर नैड ने मुझे फ़ोन करके बताया कि वह अगले दो मिनट में मरने वाली है और मुझे उसे अलविदा कहना है।
translations.translation: "Then Nad called me and told me that she was going to die in the next two minutes and that I had to say goodbye to her.
translations.reference: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.

translations.source: और मैनें किया।
translations.translation: And I did.
translations.reference: And I did.

translations.source: मैंने कहा, "ताशी, मैं तुमसे बहुत प्यार करता हूँ, बेटा।
translations.translation: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, son.
translations.reference: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.

translations.source: मैं जल्दी ही तुम्हारे साथ रहूँगा।
translations.translation: I'll be with you soon.
translations.reference: I'll be with you soon.

translations.source: मैं तुम्हारे साथ होउंगा।
translations.translation: I'll be with you.
translations.reference: I'll be with you.

translations.source: उसके दिल को धड़कने के लिए डॉक्टरों ने जो दवाई दी थी वह धीरे धीरे उसके सिस्टम को छोड़ती हुई समाप्त हो रही थी।
translations.translation: The medicine doctors had given him to beat his heart was gradually running out of his system.
translations.reference: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.

translations.source: वह कुछ समय पहले ही मर गई होती और यह सब बंद हो गया होता।
translations.translation: She would have died a short time ago and it would have been over.
translations.reference: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.

translations.source: मुझे बस वहाँ जाकर बैठना था और प्रतीक्षा करनी थी, यह जानते हुए भी कि यह सब समाप्त होने वाला है।
translations.translation: All I had to do was sit there and wait, knowing that it was all about to end.
translations.reference: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.

translations.source: मैं चीखना, चिल्लाना या रोना कुछ भी नहीं कर सकता था, क्योंकि मैं अपने परिवार के लोगों से घिरा हुआ था।
translations.translation: I could not do anything to scream, scream or cry, because I was surrounded by my family.
translations.reference: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.

translations.source: मुझे सबको संभालना था।"
translations.translation: I had to take care of them all".
translations.reference: I had to really hold it together."

translations.source: आखिरकार श्रीमती एडनेन-लैपरूस जो अपनी बेटी को खोने से दुखी थीं, उन अन्य यात्रियों के साथ विमान में सवार हो गईं - जो इस बात से अनजान थे कि वे किस स्थिति से गुज़र रहीं थी।
translations.translation: Eventually Mrs. Adnan-Laproux, saddened by the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane with the other passengers - who were unaware of the situation they were going through.
translations.reference: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.

translations.source: "कोई-नहीं जानता," उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: "Nobody knows", he said.
translations.reference: "No-one knew," she said.

translations.source: "मैंने अपना सिर नीचे किया और हर समय आँसू बह रहे थे।
translations.translation: "I bowed my head and wept all the time.
translations.reference: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.

translations.source: इसे व्यक्त करना मुश्किल था, लेकिन मुझे विमान में नैड के लिए अत्यंत सहानुभूति की भावना देखने को मिली।
translations.translation: It was difficult to express, but I could see a feeling of extreme sympathy for Ned on the plane.
translations.reference: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.

translations.source: उसे मेरे प्यार और समझ की आवश्यकता थी।
translations.translation: She needed my love and understanding.
translations.reference: That he needed my love and understanding.

translations.source: मैं जानता हूँ कि वह उससे कितना प्यार करता था।"
translations.translation: I know how much he loved her".
translations.reference: I knew how much he loved her."

translations.source: पुल पर आत्महत्या को रोकने के लिए पीड़ित महिलाओं के पोस्टकार्ड
translations.translation: Postcards of victims to prevent suicide on the bridge
translations.reference: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge

translations.source: दो महिलाएं जिन्होंने अपने प्रियजनों को आत्महत्या करने के कारण खो दिया, वह दूसरों को उनका जीवन खोने से रोकना चाहते हैं।
translations.translation: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide want to prevent others from losing their lives.
translations.reference: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.

translations.source: शैरन डेविस और कैली हंफरी प्रेरणादायक संदेशों के साथ वेल्श के पुल पर कार्ड और फ़ोन नंबर पोस्ट करते हैं, जिस पर लोग सहायता के लिए कॉल कर सकते हैं।
translations.translation: Sharon Davis and Callie Humphrey post cards and phone numbers on Welsh Bridge with inspiring messages that people can call for help.
translations.reference: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.

translations.source: श्री डेविस का बेटा 13 साल का था जब वह डीप्रेशन से पीड़ित था और उसने 18 वर्ष की आयु में आत्महत्या कर ली।
translations.translation: Mr. Davis' son was 13 years old when he suffered from depression and committed suicide at the age of 18.
translations.reference: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.

translations.source: "मैं नहीं चाहती कि किसी भी माता पिता को वैसा महसूस हो, जिसे मैं प्रतिदिन महसूस करती हूँ," उसने कहा।
translations.translation: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I feel every day", she said.
translations.reference: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.

translations.source: 45 वर्षीय श्री डेविस जो लिडनी में रहते हैं, उन्होंने कहा कि उनका बेटा एक होनहार शेफ़ था जो हर जगह अपनी मुस्कान फ़ैलाता था।
translations.translation: Mr Davis, 45, who lives in Lidney, said his son was a promising chef who spread his smile everywhere.
translations.reference: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.

translations.source: "हर कोई उसे उसकी मुस्कान के लिए जानता था।
translations.translation: "Everyone knew her for her smile.
translations.reference: "Everyone knew him for his smile.

translations.source: वे हमेशा कहते थे कि उसकी मुस्कान हर कहीं रोशनी कर सकती है।"
translations.translation: They always said that her smile could shine everywhere".
translations.reference: They always said his smile lit up any room."

translations.source: हालांकि उसने मरने से पहले काम छोड़ दिया था और वह एक "बहुत ही अंधेरे कमरे में रहता था।"
translations.translation: However, before he died, he had quit his job and was living in a "very dark room".
translations.reference: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."

translations.source: 2014 में, टाइलर का भाई जो उस समय 11 वर्ष की आयु में अपने खोए हुए भाई या बहन को खोजता था, जिसके बाद उसने आत्महत्या कर ली।
translations.translation: In 2014, Tyler's brother who was searching for his missing brother or sister at the age of 11 at the time, committed suicide.
translations.reference: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.

translations.source: सुश्री डेविस ने कहा: "मुझे निरंतर चिंता लगी रहती थी कि कोई संचयी प्रभाव होने वाला है।"
translations.translation: "I was constantly worried that there was going to be a cumulative effect", Ms. Davis said.
translations.reference: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."

translations.source: सुश्री डेविस ने कार्ड बनाए, "लोगों को यह बताने के लिए कि बाहर भी ऐसे लोग हैं जिनसे आप जाकर बात कर सकते हैं, भले ही वह कोई मित्र क्यों न हो।
translations.translation: "To let people know that there are people out there you can go and talk to, even if they're friends", Ms. Davis made the cards.
translations.reference: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.

translations.source: शांत मत बैठो - आपको बात करने की ज़रूरत है।"
translations.translation: Don't sit still - you need to talk".
translations.reference: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."

translations.source: सुश्री हंफरीज़, जो वर्षों से सुश्री डेविस की मित्र है, उन्होंने 15 साल के अपने दोस्त मार्क को खो दिया, अपनी माँ की मृत्यु के कुछ समय बाद ही।
translations.translation: Ms. Humphries, who has been a friend of Ms. Davis for years, lost her 15-year-old friend Mark shortly after her mother's death.
translations.reference: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.

translations.source: "उसने ऐसा कुछ नहीं कहा कि वह उदास या खिन्न या कुछ और महसूस कर रहा है," उसने कहा।
translations.translation: "She didn't say anything that made her feel sad or sad or anything else", she said.
translations.reference: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.

translations.source: "क्रिसमस से कुछ दिन पहले हमने उसके व्यवहार में कुछ बदलाव देगा।
translations.translation: "A few days before Christmas we will make some changes in her behaviour.
translations.reference: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.

translations.source: वह क्रिसमस के दिन बहुत उदास था - जब बच्चों ने अपने तोहफ़े खोले, तो वह उनसे आँख नहीं मिला सका।"
translations.translation: He was so sad on Christmas Day - when the children opened their presents, he couldn't see them".
translations.reference: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."

translations.source: उसने कहा कि उनकी मृत्यु उसके लिए एक बड़ा सदमा थी, लेकिन उन्हें उससे बाहर निकलना थाः "इसने परिवार को अंदर से चीर कर रख दिया।
translations.translation: She said that her death was a great shock to her, but she had to get out of it: "It tore the family apart from the inside.
translations.reference: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.

translations.source: इसने हमें दुखी कर दिया।
translations.translation: It made us sad.
translations.reference: It tears us apart.

translations.source: लेकिन हम सभी को आगे बढ़कर लड़ना था।"
translations.translation: But we all had to move forward and fight".
translations.reference: But we've all got to carry on and fight."

translations.source: यदि आप संघर्ष का सामना कर रहे हैं, तो आप 116 123 (ब्रिटेन और आयरलैंड) पर निःशुल्क कॉल कर सकते हैं, jo@samaritans.org पर ईमेल कर सकते हैं या यहाँ Samaritans की वेबसाइट पर जा सकते हैं।
translations.translation: If you are experiencing conflict, you can call 116 123 (UK and Ireland) free of charge, email jo@samaritans.org or visit the website of Samaritans here.
translations.reference: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.

translations.source: FBI की जांच शुरू होने पर कवनगुआ का भविष्य अधर में लटका हुआ था
translations.translation: When the FBI's investigation began, Kavanaugh's future was at stake.
translations.reference: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation

translations.source: "मैनें सोचा, यदि मुझे वास्तव में कुछ ऐसा मिल सकता है, जिसकी वह खोज कर रहा है - एक सीमित समय और सीमित दायरे की जांच - शायद हम थोड़ी एकता ला पाएं," शनिवार को श्री फ़्लेक ने कहा और साथ ही यह भी कि उन्हें डर है कि आरोपित पक्षपातपूर्ण ग्रिडलॉक के बीच समिति "टूट रही है।"
translations.translation: "I thought, if I could really find something he was looking for - a limited time and a limited scope of investigation - maybe we could bring a little unity", Mr. Flake said on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee among the alleged biased gridlock was "breaking up".
translations.reference: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.

translations.source: श्री कवनगुआ और उनके रिपब्लिकन समर्थक FBI जांच क्यों चाहते थे?
translations.translation: Why did Mr. Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want an FBI investigation?
translations.reference: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?

translations.source: उनकी अनिच्छा समय के कारण थी।
translations.translation: His reluctance was due to time.
translations.reference: Their reluctance is all due to timing.

translations.source: मध्यपद चुनाव केवल पाँच सप्ताह दूर थे, 6 नवंबर को - जैसा कि उम्मीद है, रिपब्लिकन बहुत खराब प्रदर्शन करते हैं, तो वे भूमि पर उच्च न्यायालय में जिसे जिताना चाहते थे, उसमें वे अपने प्रयासों में गंभीर रूप से कमज़ोर पड़ जाएंगे।
translations.translation: The midterm elections were only five weeks away, on November 6 - as expected, the Republicans perform very poorly, so they will be severely weakened in their efforts in what they wanted to win in the High Court on the ground.
translations.reference: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.

translations.source: जॉर्ज डब्लयू बुश सिनेटर को कॉल करने के लिए फ़ोन उठाते हैं, श्री कुवानगुआ का समर्थन करने के लिए उनका प्रचार करते हैं, जो व्हाइट हाउस में श्री बुश के लिए काम करता था और उनके ज़रिए उनकी पत्नी एशली से मिलते हैं, जो श्री बुश की निजी सचिव या सैक्रेटरी थे।
translations.translation: George W. Bush picks up the phone to call the Senator, promotes him to support Mr. Quangua, who worked for Mr. Bush at the White House and through him meets his wife Ashley, who was Mr. Bush's private secretary or secretary.
translations.reference: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.

translations.source: FBI द्वारा अपनी रिपोर्ट पेश करने के बाद क्या हुआ?
translations.translation: What happened after the FBI submitted its report?
translations.reference: What happens after the FBI produces its report?

translations.source: सिनेट में मतदान होगा, जिसमें वर्तमान में 51 रिपब्लिकन और 49 लोकतंत्रवादी बैठते हैं।
translations.translation: There will be a vote in the Senate, which currently seats 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats.
translations.reference: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.

translations.source: यह स्पष्ट नहीं है कि श्री कुवानगुआ को सिनेट फ़्लोर पर कम से कम 50 वोट प्राप्त हो सकते हैं, जो माइक पेंस, उपाध्यक्ष को इसे समाप्त करके और सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में इसकी पुष्टि करनी थी।
translations.translation: It is unclear whether Mr. Kuangua could get at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which Mike Pence, Vice President, had to abolish and confirm in the Supreme Court.
translations.reference: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.

translations.source: उत्तर कोरिया के भगोड़ों का किम द्वारा 'पतन' हो गया
translations.translation: North Korean fugitives 'fallen' by Kim
translations.reference: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim

translations.source: दक्षिण कोरियो में गए उत्तर कोरिया को भगोड़ों की संख्या में सात वर्ष पहले जॉन-उन के सत्ता में आने पर कमी आ गई, एक दक्षिण कोरियाई व्यवस्थापक ने कहा।
translations.translation: The number of North Korean refugees to South Korea declined when John-won came to power seven years ago, a South Korean administrator said.
translations.reference: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.

translations.source: दक्षिण के एकीकरण मंत्रालय का हवाला देते हुए, पार्क बेयोंग-सियोग ने कहा कि 2011 में 2,706 की तुलना में पिछले साल 1,127 लोग अपना कर्तव्य छोड़कर भागे हैं।
translations.translation: Citing the Ministry of Integration of the South, Park Baiyong-Siyog said that 1,127 people fled their duties last year compared to 2,706 in 2011.
translations.reference: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.

translations.source: श्री पार्क ने कहा कि उत्तर कोरिया और चीन के बीच मज़बूत सीमा और तस्करों और चुंगीचोरों द्वारा लगाई गई उच्च दरें मुख्य कारक थे।
translations.translation: Mr Park said the strong border between North Korea and China and the high rates imposed by smugglers and tax collectors were the main factors.
translations.reference: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.

translations.source: प्योंगयांग ने कोई सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी नहीं की।
translations.translation: Pyongyang made no public comment.
translations.reference: Pyongyang has made no public comments.

translations.source: उत्तर से भगोड़ों की एक बड़ी संख्या को अंततः दक्षिण कोरिया की नागरिकता प्रस्तावित की जाती है।
translations.translation: A large number of North Korean refugees are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
translations.reference: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.

translations.source: सियोल का कहना है कि 30,000 से अधिक उत्तर कोरियाई लोगों ने 1953 से कोरिया युद्ध के अंत के बाद से अवैध रूप से सीमा पार की है।
translations.translation: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have crossed the border illegally since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
translations.reference: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.

translations.source: अधिकतम चीन भाग गए, जिसकी सीमा उत्तर कोरिया के साथ सबसे लंबी है और दो कोरिया के बीच मज़बूती से संरक्षित असैनिकीकरण किए गए क्षेत्र (DMZ) को पार करना आसान है।
translations.translation: Most of China fled, whose border with North Korea is the longest and the strongly defended demilitarized zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas is easy to cross.
translations.reference: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.

translations.source: चीन भगोड़ों को शरणार्थियों के बजाय अवैध प्रवासियों के रूप में मानता है और अक्सर उन्हें मजबूर करके अपने देश वापस भेजता है।
translations.translation: China treats refugees as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly sends them back to their countries.
translations.reference: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.

translations.translation: "Do they think I have a discount?" she wondered.
translations.reference: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.

translations.source: जब उसने यह घोषणा करते हुए अपना भाषण बनाया कि वह कोई औपचारिक अभियान लॉन्च नहीं करेगी, तो वह भावनाओं पर काबू नहीं पा सकी - उन लोगों के लिए आभार जिन्होंने उसका साथ दिया, उस सिस्टम से निराशा जिसके कारण उसे धन एकत्रित करने में मुश्किल हुआ और प्रतिनिधियों के बजाय लक्षित मतदाताओं से भी निराशा और लिंगवाद पर गुस्सा - उसका दम घुटने लगा।
translations.translation: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she couldn't control her emotions - gratitude for the people who supported her, frustration with the system that made it difficult for her to raise funds and frustration with even targeted voters rather than representatives and anger at sexism - she fell to her knees.
translations.reference: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.

translations.source: "आपने सोचा होगा कि मुझे नर्वस ब्रेक डाउन होगा" सुश्री श्रोडर ने याद किया कि कैसे प्रेस ने उनके बारे में प्रतिक्रिया दी होगी।
translations.translation: "You must have thought I would have a nervous breakdown", Ms. Schroeder recalled how the press would have reacted to her.
translations.reference: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.

translations.source: "आपने सोचा होगा कि क्लेनेक्स मेरा कॉर्पोरेट प्रायोजक है।
translations.translation: "You may have thought that Clenex is my corporate sponsor.
translations.reference: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.

translations.source: मुझे याद है कि वे मेरी समाधि पर क्या डालेंगे?
translations.translation: I remember what they would put on my grave?
translations.reference: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?

translations.translation: "She cried"?""
translations.reference: "She cried"?""

translations.source: कैसे अमेरिका-चीन का व्यापार युद्ध बीजिंग के लिए अच्छा हो सकता है
translations.translation: How the US-China trade war could be good for Beijing
translations.reference: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing

translations.source: अमेरिका और चीन के बीच व्यापार युद्ध का आरंभिक साल्वो धीमा करने वाला था और जबकि युद्ध अभी समाप्ति से दूर है, देशों के बीच दरार लंबी अवधि में बीजिंग के लिए लाभकारी हो सकती हैं, विशेषज्ञों ने कहा।
translations.translation: The initial escalation of the trade war between the U.S. and China was a slowdown and while the war is still far from over, the rifts between the countries could be beneficial to Beijing in the long run, experts said.
translations.reference: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.

translations.source: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनल्ड ट्रंप ने कहा कि सोलर पैनलों, स्टील और एल्युमिनियम सहित प्रमुख चीनी निर्यात कर लगाकर इस वर्ष के शुरू में पहली चेतावनी दी गई थी।
translations.translation: U.S. President Donald Trump said the first warning was issued earlier this year by imposing a major export tax on sugar, including solar panels, steel and aluminum.
translations.reference: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.

translations.source: 200 डॉलर बिलियन (150 बिलियन पाउंड) तक के आइटम को प्रभावित करके नए टैरिफ़ के साथ इस सप्ताह में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि को चीन से अमेरिका में आए सभी आधे से ज़्यादा सामानों पर प्रभावी रूप से कर लगाया जाता है।
translations.translation: The most significant increase this week, with new tariffs affecting items up to $200 billion (£150 billion), is effectively taxing more than half of all goods imported from China into the US.
translations.reference: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.

translations.source: बीजिंग ने हर बार अपने तरीके से प्रतिकार लिया है, सबसे हाल ही में अमेरिकी सामानों के 60 बिलियन डॉलर के पांच से 10 प्रतिशत स्लैपिंग टैरिफ़।
translations.translation: Beijing has responded in its own way every time, most recently with slapping tariffs of five to 10 percent of the $60 billion in U.S. goods.
translations.reference: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.

translations.source: चीन ने अमेरिका शॉट-से-शॉट से मिलान करने का वादा किया है और विश्व की दूसरी सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था संभवतः जल्दी ही टिमटिमाने वाली है।
translations.translation: China has pledged to match the U.S. shot-to-shot and the world's second largest economy is likely to collapse soon.
translations.reference: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.

translations.source: वाशिंगटन को वापस पाने का मतलब है कि मांगों को खोखला करना, लेकिन सार्वजनिक रूप से अमेरिका के सामने सिर झुकाना ज़ी जिंगपिंग, चीन के राष्ट्रपति के लिए बहुत शर्मनाक होगा।
translations.translation: Getting Washington back means hollowing out demands, but publicly nodding to the US would be very embarrassing for Xi Jinping, the president of China.
translations.reference: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.

translations.source: अभी भी, विशेषज्ञ कहते हैं कि बीजिंग अपनी चाल चल सकता है, अमेरिका का व्यापार युद्ध सकारात्मक रूप से दो अर्थव्यवस्थाओं की अंतर-निर्भरता को कम करते हुए दीर्घ अवधि पर चीन का सकारात्मक रूप से समर्थन कर सकता है।
translations.translation: Still, experts say Beijing can make its own move, the US trade war can positively support China in the long run while reducing the interdependence of the two economies.
translations.reference: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.

translations.source: "यह तथ्य कि वाशिंगटन या बीजिंग में एक त्वरित राजनीतिक निर्णय ऐसी स्थितियां बना सकता है जो या तो देश में आर्थिक टेलस्पिन को शुरू करता है, जो वास्तव में दर्शकों द्वारा पहले देखे गए की तुलना में और भी अधिक खतरनाक है", अबिगेल ग्रेस ने कहा, एक शोध एसोसिएट जो नई अमेरिका सुरक्षा, एक थिंक टैंक के लिए केंद्र पर एशिया पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।
translations.translation: "The fact that a swift political decision in Washington or Beijing could create conditions that either initiate an economic tailspin in the country is actually even more dangerous than previously seen by audiences", said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the center of New America Security, a think tank.
translations.reference: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.

translations.source: सीरिया शरणार्थियों के वापस लौटने के लिए 'तैयार' है, विदेश मंत्री ने कहा
translations.translation: Syria is 'ready' for the return of refugees, Foreign Minister says
translations.reference: Syria 'ready' for refugees to return, says Foreign Minister

translations.source: सीरिया ने कहा कि वह शरणार्थियों की स्वैच्छिक वापसी के लिए तैयार है और सात साल से अधिक लंबे युद्ध द्वारा तबाह किए गए देश को पुनः निर्माण करने के लिए मदद की अपील कर रहा है।
translations.translation: Syria has said it is ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by more than seven years of war.
translations.reference: Syria says it's ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by a more than seven-year long war.

translations.source: संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा असेंबली से बात करते हुए, विदेश मंत्री वालिद अल-मौलम ने कहा कि देश में स्थितियां सुधर रहीं है।
translations.translation: Speaking to the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Maulum said that the situation in the country is improving.
translations.reference: Speaking to the United Nations General Assembly, Foreign minister Walid al-Moualem said conditions in the country are improving.

translations.source: "आज आंतकवाद के विरोध में की गई प्रगति के कारण भूमि पर स्थिति अधिक स्थिर और सुरक्षित है" उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure due to the progress made against terrorism", he said.
translations.reference: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure thanks to progress made in combating terrorism," he said.

translations.source: सरकार सामान्य स्थिति को पुनः स्थापित करने के लिए आतंकवादियों द्वारा नष्ट किए गए क्षेत्रों में पुनर्वास करना जारी रखती है।
translations.translation: The government continues to resettle in areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.
translations.reference: The government continues to rehabilitate the areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.

translations.source: आतंकवाद के कारण देश में शरणार्थियों की स्वैच्छिक वापसी के लिए अब सभी परिस्थितियाँ उपस्थित हैं और एकतरफ़ा आर्थिक उपाय जो उनके दैनिक जीवन और आजीविका को लक्षित करते हैं।
translations.translation: There are now all the conditions for the voluntary return of refugees to the country due to terrorism and unilateral economic measures that target their daily lives and livelihoods.
translations.reference: All conditions are now present for the voluntary return of refugees to the country they had to leave because of terrorism and the unilateral economic measures that targeted their daily lives and their livelihoods.

translations.source: संयुक्त राष्ट्र अनुमान लगाता है कि 2011 में युद्ध के शुरू होने से लेकर अब तक देश से 5.5 मिलियन से अधिक सीरियाई भाग चुके हैं।
translations.translation: The United Nations estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the start of the war in 2011.
translations.reference: The UN estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the war began in 2011.

translations.source: देश में रह रहे दूसरे छह मिलियन लोगों को अब भी मानवीय सहायता की आवश्यकता है।
translations.translation: The other six million people living in the country are still in need of humanitarian assistance.
translations.reference: Another six million people still living in the country are in need of humanitarian assistance.

translations.source: अल-मौलम ने कहा कि सीरिया शासन तबाह हुए देश का पुनः निर्माण करने में मदद का स्वागत करेगा।
translations.translation: Al-Mawlum said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.
translations.reference: Al-Moualem said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.

translations.source: लेकिन उन्होंने ज़ोर देकर कहा कि यह विद्रोह को प्रायोजित करने वाले देशों से सशर्त सहायता या मदद स्वीकार नहीं करेगा।
translations.translation: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or assistance from the countries sponsoring the uprising.
translations.reference: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or help from countries that sponsored the insurgency.

translations.source: यूरोप पेरिस में राइडर कप में जीत प्राप्त करता है
translations.translation: Europe wins the Ryder Cup in Paris
translations.reference: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris

translations.source: यूरोप की टीम ने पेरिस, फ्रांस के बाहर ले गोल्फ़ नेशनल पर 16.5 से 10.5 तक के अंतिम स्कोर द्वार अमेरिका की टीम को हराकार 2018 का राइडर कप जीता।
translations.translation: The European team won the 2018 Ryder Cup by defeating the US team by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
translations.reference: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.

translations.source: अमेरिका ने अब यूरोपीय की मिट्टी पर लगातार छह बार हार का सामना किया और 1993 से अब तक यूरोप में राइडर कप नहीं जीता।
translations.translation: The U.S. has now suffered six consecutive defeats on European soil and has not won the Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
translations.reference: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.

translations.source: जब डैनिश के कप्तान थोमस जॉर्न की टीन अमेरिकी को हराने के लिए आवश्यक 14.5 अंकों तक पहुँचती है, तो यूरोप फिर से अपना खिताब हासिल करता है।
translations.translation: When Danish captain Thomas Jorn's teen reaches 14.5 points needed to beat the American, Europe regains its title.
translations.reference: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.

translations.source: अमेरिकी स्टार फ़िल मिकेलसन, जिन्होंने अधिकतम टूर्नामेंट में संघर्ष किया, उन्होंने फ़्रांसेस्को मोलिनरी से मैच स्वीकार करके पार 3 16वें होल पर पानी में अपना टी-शॉट दिखाया।
translations.translation: American star Phil Mickelson, who struggled in the Maximum Tournament, showed his T-shot in the water at the 3rd 16th hole by accepting a match from Francisco Molinari.
translations.reference: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.

translations.source: इतालवी गोल्फ़र मोलिनरी ने 1979 में टूर्नामेंट के वर्तमान फ़ॉर्मेट शुरू करने के बाद से अब तक 5-0-0 का स्कोर बनाने के लिए 4 खिलाड़ियों में से 1 बनकर अपने सभी राउंड में जीत हासिल की।
translations.translation: Italian golfer Molinari won all his rounds by becoming 1 of 4 players to score 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format began in 1979.
translations.reference: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.

translations.source: अमेरिकी जोर्डन स्पीथ को यूरोपीय टीम के सबसे कम रैंक वाले खिलाड़ी डेनमार्क के थोर्बजोन ओलेसन द्वारा 5 और 4 से हराया गया।
translations.translation: American Jordan Speeth was defeated 5 and 4 by the lowest ranked player in the European team, Thorbjon Oleson of Denmark.
translations.reference: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.

translations.source: विश्व का शीर्ष रैंक वाला खिलाड़ी, डस्टिन डॉनसन इंग्लैड के लैन पोल्टर से 2 और 1 से हार गया, जिसने शायद अपना अंतिम राइडर कप खेला था।
translations.translation: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Dawson, lost 2-1 to England's Lane Polter, who had probably played his last Ryder Cup.
translations.reference: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.

translations.source: आठ राइडर कप का एक अनुभवी, स्पेनियर्ड सर्जियो गार्शिया 25.5 कैरियर पॉइंट के साथ टूर्नामेंट में हर बार जीतने वाला यूरोपीय बन गया है।
translations.translation: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia has become the European to win the tournament every time with 25.5 career points.
translations.reference: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.

translations.source: "मैं आम तौर पर रोता नहीं हूँ, लेकिन आज मैं खुद को रोक नहीं सकता।
translations.translation: "I don't usually cry, but today I can't help myself.
translations.reference: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.

translations.source: यह एक कठिन वर्ष रहा।
translations.translation: It was a difficult year.
translations.reference: It's been a rough year.

translations.source: इसलिए मुझे चुनने और मुझमें विश्वास करने के लिए थोमस का धन्यवाद।
translations.translation: So thank you to Thomas for choosing me and believing in me.
translations.reference: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.

translations.source: मैं कप को वापस पाकर बहुत, बहुत खुश हूँ।
translations.translation: I am very, very happy to have the cup back.
translations.reference: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.

translations.source: यह टीम के बारे में है., और मैं बहुत खुश हूँ कि मैं मदद कर पाया", यूरोप की जीत के बाद ग्रेशिया ने भावनात्मक होकर कहा।
translations.translation: It's about the team, and I'm very happy that I was able to help", Gracia said emotionally after winning Europe.
translations.reference: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.

translations.source: उसने अपने साथी जॉन राम को मशाल थमाई, जिन्होंने रविवार को सिंगल प्ले में अमेरिकी गोल्फ़ लेजेंड टाइगर वुड को 2 और 1 से हराया।
translations.translation: He lit a torch on his partner John Ram, who defeated US golfer legend Tiger Wood 2 - 1 in single play on Sunday.
translations.reference: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.

translations.source: 23 वर्षीय रहम ने कहा कि "मुझे टाइगर वुड को हराकर असाधारण गर्व महसूस हो रहा है, मैं उन्हें देखता हुआ बड़ा हुआ हूँ।"
translations.translation: "I am incredibly proud to beat Tiger Wood, I grew up watching him", said 23-year-old Rahm.
translations.reference: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.

translations.source: वुड फ़्रांस में अपने सभी चार मैच हार गए और अब उनके पास 13-21-3 कैरियर राइडर कप रिकॉर्ड हैं।
translations.translation: Wood lost all four of his matches in France and now has a 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
translations.reference: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.

translations.reference: PALM परीक्षण में, ZMapp ने एक नियंत्रण के रूप में कार्य किया, जिसका अर्थ है कि वैज्ञानिकों ने इसे बेसलाइन के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया और इसके साथ तीन अन्य उपचारों की तुलना की.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.translation: यूएसए जिमनास्टिक्स संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका ओलंपिक समिति के पत्र का समर्थन करता है और हमारे सभी एथलीटों के लिए एक सुरक्षित वातावरण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए ओलंपिक परिवार की पूर्ण आवश्यकता को स्वीकार करता है।
translations.reference: अमेरिकी जिमनास्टिक्स, संयुक्त राज्य ओलंपिक समिति के पत्र का समर्थन करता है. साथ ही, सभी एथलीटों को एक सुरक्षित माहौल देने के लिए, ओलंपिक परिवार के होने की अहमियत स्वीकार करता है.

translations.source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.translation: हम यूएसओसी के बयान से सहमत हैं कि हमारे एथलीटों और क्लबों और उनके खेल के हितों की सेवा हमारे संगठन के भीतर सार्थक परिवर्तन के साथ आगे बढ़कर की जा सकती है।
translations.reference: हम USOC के इस कथन से सहमत हैं कि हमारे एथलीटों और क्लबों और उनके खेल, हमारे संगठन के भीतर सार्थक बदलाव के साथ आगे बढ़ कर बेहतर सेवा की जा सकती है ना की विप्रमाणन से |

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.translation: यूएसए जिम्नास्टिक्स एक स्वतंत्र जांच का समर्थन करता है जो प्रकाश डाल सकता है कि लैरी नसर के जीवित बचे लोगों द्वारा इतनी बहादुरी से वर्णित अनुपात का दुरुपयोग कैसे इतने लंबे समय तक अनदेखा हो सकता है और किसी भी आवश्यक और उपयुक्त परिवर्तन को गले लगाता है।
translations.reference: यूएसए जिमनास्टिक्स एक स्वतंत्र जाँच का समर्थन करता है जो इस बात पर प्रकाश डाल सकता है कि लैरी नासर के बचे लोगों द्वारा इतनी हिम्मत से बताए गए प्रपोर्शन का दुरुपयोग इतने लंबे समय तक चल सकता था और किसी भी आवश्यक और उचित परिवर्तन को अपना सकता है.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.translation: यूएसए जिम्नास्टिक्स और यूएसओसी का एक ही लक्ष्य है  जिम्नास्टिक्स और अन्य खेलों को सुरक्षित, सकारात्मक और सशक्त वातावरण में अपने सपनों का पालन करने के लिए एथलीटों के लिए जितना संभव हो उतना सुरक्षित बनाना।
translations.reference: यूएसए जिमनास्टिक्स और यूएसओसी का एक ही लक्ष्य है — एथलीटों को सुरक्षित, सकारात्मक और सशक्त वातावरण में अपने सपनों का अनुसरण करने के लिए जिमनास्टिक्स और अन्य लोगों के खेल को जितना संभव हो सके उतना सुरक्षित बनाना.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.translation: 1960 के दशक में, ब्रजेन्स्की ने जॉन एफ केनेडी के लिए अपने सलाहकार के रूप में और फिर लिंडन बी जॉनसन प्रशासन के रूप में काम किया।
translations.reference: 1960 के दशक के दौरान, ब्रेझिन्स्की ने जॉन एफ कैनेडी के सलाहकार के तौर पर और उसके बाद लिंडन बी जॉनसन के प्रशासन के लिए काम किया.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.translation: 1976 के चुनावों के दौरान उन्होंने विदेश नीति पर कार्टर को सलाह दी, फिर 1977 से 1981 तक राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार (एनएसए) के रूप में कार्य किया, जो कि हेनरी किसिंजर का उत्तराधिकारी था।
translations.reference: 1976 चयन के दौरान उन्होंने विदेश नीति पर कार्टर को सलाह दी, फिर 1977 से लेकर 1981 तक राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार (एनएसए) के रूप में हेनरी किसिंजर को सेवा दी.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.translation: एनएसए के रूप में, उन्होंने कैम्प डेविड समझौते, 1978; 1970 के दशक के अंत में अमेरिकी-चीन संबंधों को सामान्य करने; ईरान क्रांति, जो ईरान बंधक संकट, 1979; और अफगानिस्तान में सोवियत आक्रमण, 1979 के रूप में विश्व के मामलों को राजनयिक रूप से संभालने में कार्टर की सहायता की।
translations.reference: एनएसए के रूप में, उन्होंने कूटनीतिक रूप से विश्व मामलों को संभालने में कार्टर की सहायता की, जैसे कि कैंप डेविड एकॉर्ड्स, 1978; 1970 के दशक के अंत में अमेरिका-चीन संबंधों को सामान्य बनाना; ईरानी क्रांति, जो ईरान बंधक संकट का कारण बनी, 1979; और अफ़गानिस्तान में सोवियत आक्रमण, 1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.translation: फिल्म, जिसमें रयान गोस्लिंग और एम्मा स्टोन शामिल हैं, ने सभी प्रमुख श्रेणियों में नामांकन प्राप्त किए।
translations.reference: जिस फिल्म में रायन गोज़लिंग और एम्मा स्टोन ने मुख्य भूमिकाएँ निभाई हैं, उसे सभी प्रमुख श्रेणियों में नॉमिनेशन किया गया है.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.translation: गोस्लिंग और स्टोन को क्रमशः सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता और अभिनेत्री के लिए नामांकन प्राप्त हुए।
translations.reference: गोसलिंग और स्टोन को क्रमशः सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता और अभिनेत्री के लिए नामांकन मिला है.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.translation: अन्य नामांकनों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म, निर्देशक, सिनेमैटोग्राफी, पोशाक डिजाइन, फिल्म-संपादन, मूल स्कोर, उत्पादन डिजाइन, ध्वनि संपादन, ध्वनि मिश्रण और मूल पटकथा शामिल हैं।
translations.reference: अन्य नामांकनों में बेस्ट पिक्चर, डायरेक्टर, सिनेमेटोग्राफ़ी, कॉस्ट्यूम डिज़ाइन, फ़िल्म-संपादन, मूल स्कोर, प्रोडक्शन डिज़ाइन, ध्वनि संपादन, ध्वनि मिश्रण और ओरिजनल स्क्रीनप्ले शामिल हैं.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
