translations.translation: So far, several hostages have been rescued and at least six have been confirmed to have been killed.
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.

translations.source: बच्चों और बुजुर्गों सहित छह बंधकों को जल्दी छोड़ दिया गया, और फिलिपिनो फोटोग्राफरों को भी।
translations.translation: Six hostages, including children and elderly, were released early, and so were Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.

translations.source: फ़ोटोग्राफ़रों ने बाद में एक वृद्ध महिला की जगह ले ली, क्योंकि उसे शौचालय जाना ज़रूरी था. मेंडोज़ा को गोली मार दी गई थी.
translations.translation: The photographers later took the place of an elderly woman, who had to go to the bathroom.
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.

translations.source: लिगिंन्स ने अपने पिता की तरह चिकित्सा के क्षेत्र में अपने कैरियर की शुरूआत की.
translations.translation: Liggins, like his father, began his career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.

translations.source: उन्हें एक प्रसूति विशेषज्ञ के रूप में प्रशिक्षित किया गया और 1959 में उन्होंने ऑकलैंड के राष्ट्रीय महिला अस्पताल में काम करना शुरू किया।
translations.translation: She was trained as an obstetrician and in 1959 she began working at the National Women's Hospital in Auckland.
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.

translations.source: अस्पताल में काम करते हुए, लिगिन्स ने अपने खाली समय के दौरान समय से पहले प्रसव की जाँच शुरू कर दी.
translations.translation: While working at the hospital, Ligins began preterm birth checks during her free time.
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.

translations.source: उनके शोध से पता चला कि अगर हार्मोन को प्रभाव में लाया जाए तो यह बच्चे के भ्रूण के फेफड़ों की परिपक्वता को गति देगा.
translations.translation: Their research showed that if the hormone were put into action, it would accelerate the maturation of the fetal lungs of the child.
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.

translations.source: शिन्हुआ ने बताया कि सरकारी जाँचकर्ताओं ने बुधवार को दो 'ब्लैक बॉक्स' फ़्लाइट रिकॉर्डर बरामद किए हैं.
translations.translation: According to Xinhua, government investigators recovered two 'Black Box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.

translations.source: लूना को साथी पहलवानों ने भी श्रद्धांजलि दी.
translations.translation: Luna was also honoured by fellow wrestlers.
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.

translations.source: टॉमी ड्रीमर ने कहा “लूना पहली क्वीन ऑफ़ एक्सट्रीम थी. मेरी पहली मैनेजर. लूना की मृत्यु दो चाँद वाली मशहूर रात में हुई थी. वह रात उसकी तरह ही ख़ास थी. वह बेहद शक्तिशाली महिला थी.”
translations.translation: Tommy Dreamer said, "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. She was my first manager.
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."

translations.source: डस्टिन “गोल्डस्ट” रनअल्स ने टिप्पणी की कि “लूना मेरे जैसी ही अजीब थी...शायद मुझसे भी अधिक...उसे प्यार करता हूँ और उसकी याद आएगी...आशा है कि वह एक बेहतर जगह में है।”
translations.translation: Dustin Runnals commented that Luna was just as strange as I was... maybe more than I am... I love her and she will be remembered... hopefully she's in a better place.
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."

translations.source: 2010 के संघीय चुनाव से पहले 1,400 लोगों ने मतदान किया, 2008 से जो लोग ऑस्ट्रेलिया के गणतंत्र बनने का विरोध करते हैं उनमें 8 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई.
translations.translation: In the run-up to the 2010 federal election, 1,400 people voted, an 8 percent increase in the number of people opposed to Australia becoming a republic since 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.

translations.source: कार्यवाहक प्रधानमंत्री जूलिया गिलार्ड ने 2010 के संघीय चुनाव के कैंपेन के दौरान दावा किया कि वह मानती हैं कि रानी एलिजाबेथ द्वितीय के शासनकाल के अंत में ऑस्ट्रेलिया को एक गणतंत्र बनना चाहिए.
translations.translation: Acting Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the 2010 federal election campaign that she believed that Australia should become a republic at the end of the reign of Queen Elizabeth II.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.

translations.source: उनमें से 34 फ़ीसदी लोगों ने मतदान में यह मत साझा करते हुए इच्छा जताई, कि वे क्वीन एलिज़ाबेथ द्वितीय को ऑस्ट्रेलिया की आखिरी रानी बनाना चाहते हैं.
translations.translation: Thirty-four per cent of those who voted shared the view that they wanted Queen Elizabeth II to be the last Queen of Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.

translations.source: सर्वे के नतीजे के मुताबिक, सर्वे में शामिल 29 प्रतिशत लोगों का मानना है कि ऑस्ट्रेलिया को जल्द से जल्द एक गणतंत्र बन जाना चाहिए, जबकि 31 प्रतिशत लोगों का मानना है कि ऑस्ट्रेलिया को कभी भी गणतंत्र नहीं बनना चाहिए.
translations.translation: According to the results of the survey, 29 per cent of the people surveyed believe that Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe that Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.

translations.source: ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदक विजेता राष्ट्रमंडल खेलों में 100 मीटर और 200 मीटर फ़्रीस्टाइल और तीन रिले में तैरने वाला था, लेकिन उसकी शिकायतों के कारण उसकी स्वस्थता संदेह में रही है।
translations.translation: The Olympic gold medalist was a swimmer in the 100m and 200m freestyle and three relay at the Commonwealth Games, but his health has been in doubt due to his complaints.
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.

translations.source: अपने दर्द को दूर करने के लिए वे ज़रूरी दवाओं को लेने में असमर्थ हो गए क्योंकि वे दवाइयाँ खेलों में प्रतिबंधित थीं.
translations.translation: They were unable to take the necessary medicines to relieve their pain because they were banned from sports.
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.

translations.source: कर्टिस कूपर, सेंट्रल मिसौरी विश्वविद्यालय में एक गणितज्ञ और कंप्यूटर विज्ञान के प्रोफेसर ने 25 जनवरी को अब तक की सबसे बड़ी ज्ञात प्राइम संख्या की खोज की है।
translations.translation: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and professor of computer science at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number ever on January 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.

translations.source: कई लोगों ने फरवरी की शुरुआत में कई हार्डवेयर और सॉफ़्टवेयर इस्तेमाल करके खोज की पुष्टि की है और मंगलवार को इसकी घोषणा की गई थी.
translations.translation: Several people have confirmed the discovery using multiple hardware and software in early February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.

translations.source: धूमकेतु अंग के साथ संभवतः पृथ्वी पर जल वितरण का स्रोत हो सकता है|”
translations.translation: Together with the Comet organ, it could possibly be the source of water distribution on Earth.
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.

translations.translation: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets had collided long before the Earth.
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.

translations.source: इस साल की शुरुआत में 53 साल के कुओमो ने अपना शासनकाल शुरू किया और पिछले महीने समलैंगिक विवाह को वैध बनाने वाले बिल पर हस्ताक्षर किए.
translations.translation: Earlier this year, 53-year-old Kuomo began his reign and signed a bill to legalize same-sex marriage last month.

translations.translation: He called the rumors political nonsense and nonsense.
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".

translations.translation: He expects to win the presidency in 2016.
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.

translations.translation: The FAA claims about the NextGen system that it will make it possible to fly the aircraft on short routes and save millions of gallons of fuel every year and also reduce carbon emissions.
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.

translations.source: यह उपग्रह-आधारित प्रौद्योगिकी का उपयोग करता है, जो पुराने ज़मीनी-रडार-आधारित तकनीक के विपरीत है, जिससे हवाई यातायात नियंत्रकों को अधिक सटीकता के साथ विमान को चलाने और पायलटों को अधिक सटीक जानकारी देने में मदद मिलती है.
translations.translation: It uses satellite-based technology, as opposed to the older ground-based radar technology, which enables air traffic controllers to operate the aircraft with greater accuracy and give pilots more accurate information.

translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.

translations.translation: Fears of lack of transportation have increased the likelihood that the game will have to be played behind closed doors without supporters of the team.
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.

translations.source: जर्नल साइंस में गुरूवार को प्रकाशित एक अध्ययन ने इक्वाडोरियन गैलापागोस आइलैंड पर एक नई पक्षी प्रजाति के निर्माण की सूचना दी.
translations.translation: A study published Thursday in the journal Science reported the creation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorian Galapagos Island.
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.

translations.source: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में प्रिंसटन विश्वविद्यालय और स्वीडन में उप्साला विश्वविद्यालय के शोधकर्ताओं ने बताया कि नई प्रजातियाँ सिर्फ दो पीढ़ियों में विकसित हुईं, हालाँकि एक स्थानिक डार्विन फिंच, जियोस्पाइज़ा फोर्टेस और अप्रवासी कैक्टस फिंच, जिओस्पिज़ा कोनिरोस्ट्रिस के बीच प्रजनन के कारण इस प्रक्रिया में काफी समय लगने की बात कही गई थी.
translations.translation: Researchers at Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported that the new species evolved in just two generations, although the process was said to take a long time because of the breeding between a local Darwin finch, the Geospiza Fortress, and an immigrant cactus finch, the Geospiza Conyrostris.
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: सोना हर तरह के आकार में काम कर सकता है. इसे छोटे आकार में मोड़ा जा सकता है.
translations.translation: Gold can work in all sorts of sizes. It can be folded into smaller sizes.
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.

translations.source: इसे पतले तार में खींचा जा सकता है, जिसे मोड़ा और गूंथा जा सकता है। इसे पीटा जा सकता है या शीट बनाई जा सकती हैं।
translations.translation: It can be pulled in a thin wire, which can be folded and knotted. It can be beaten or made into sheets.
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.

translations.source: इसे काफ़ी पतला बनाया जा सकता है और दूसरी धातु पर लगाया जा सकता है. इसे इतना पतला बनाया जा सकता है कि इसे कभी-कभी “प्रकाशित पांडुलिपियाँ” नामक किताबों में हाथ से बनाए गए चित्रों को सजाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाता था.
translations.translation: It can be made very thin and applied to other metals. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate handmade drawings in books called "Published Manuscripts".
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".

translations.source: इसे केमिकल का pH कहा जाता है. आप लाल गोभी के जूस का इस्तेमाल करके एक संकेतक बना सकते हैं.
translations.translation: It's called the pH of a chemical. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

translations.source: गोभी का जूस अम्लीय या आधारभूत (क्षारीय) रसायन के आधार पर रंग बदलता है.
translations.translation: Coconut juice changes colour depending on acidic or basic (alkaline) chemistry.
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.

translations.source: पीएच (pH) स्तर हाइड्रोजन (पीएच में मौजूद एच) कण के आधार पर बनता है.
translations.translation: The pH level is formed on the basis of the hydrogen (H) particles present in the pH.
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.

translations.source: हाइड्रोजन आयन वे प्रोटोन्स हैं जिनके इलेक्ट्रॉन्स ने उन्हें हटा दिया (क्योंकि हाइड्रोजन एटम एक प्रोटान और एक इलेक्ट्रॉन से मिल कर बना होता है).
translations.translation: The hydrogen ions are the protons whose electrons have removed them (because the hydrogen atom is made of a combination of a proton and an electron).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).

translations.source: दोनों सूखे चूर्णों को एक साथ मिला लें और फिर साफ़ गीले हाथों से, एक गोले में निचोड़ लें.
translations.translation: Mix the two dried slices together and then squeeze them into a ball with clean, wet hands.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

translations.source: आपके हाथों की नमी बाहरी परतों के साथ क्रिया करेगी, जो अजीब महसूस करेगी और एक तरह का आवरण बनाएगी.
translations.translation: The humidity of your hands will interact with the outer layers, which will make you feel strange and create a kind of covering.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.

translations.source: हड़प्पा और मोहन-जोदड़ो के शहरों में लगभग हर घर में एक फ़्लश शौचालय था, जो एक परिष्कृत सीवेज सिस्टम से जुड़ा था.
translations.translation: In the towns of Harappa and Mohon - Jodharo, almost every household had a flush toilet, which was connected to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.

translations.source: ग्रीस में मिनोअन सिटीज़ ऑफ़ क्रेटे एंड सांटोरिनी के घरों में सिवेज सिस्टम्स के अवशेष पाए गए हैं.
translations.translation: Remnants of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan Cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

translations.source: प्राचीन मिस्र, पर्शिया और चीन में शौचालय भी थे. रोमन सभ्यता में शौचालय स्नान घरों का हिस्सा होते थे, जिन्हें पुरुष और महिलाएँ दोनों ही समूह में एक साथ इस्तेमाल करते थे.
translations.translation: In ancient Egypt, Persia, and China, toilets were also used. In Roman civilization, toilets were part of bathhouses, which were used by both men and women in the same group.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.

translations.source: हज़ारों मील दूर किसी को कॉल करने के लिए, आप सैटेलाइट इस्तेमाल करते हैं.
translations.translation: To call someone thousands of miles away, you use a satellite.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

translations.source: अंतरिक्ष में उपग्रह को कॉल मिलता है और फिर इसे वापस नीचे, उसी समय परावर्तित करता है.
translations.translation: The satellite in space receives a call and then reflects it back down, at the same time.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.

translations.source: उपग्रह को एक रॉकेट से अंतरिक्ष में भेजा गया था. वैज्ञानिक अंतरिक्ष में दूरबीनों का उपयोग करते हैं क्योंकि पृथ्वी का वायुमंडल हमारे कुछ प्रकाश और दृश्य को अशुद्ध करता है.
translations.translation: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth's atmosphere tarnishes some of our light and vision.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.

translations.source: स्पेस में सैटेलाइट या दूरबीन रखने के लिए 100 फ़ीट से ज़्यादा ऊँचे बड़े रॉकेट की ज़रूरत होती है.
translations.translation: A rocket greater than 100 feet in height is needed to hold a satellite or a telescope in space.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.

translations.source: पहिये ने विश्व को असाधारण रूप से बदला है. सबसे बड़ी बात यह है कि पहिये ने हमें ज़्यादा आसान और तेज़ ट्रांस्पोर्टेशन देने का काम किया है.
translations.translation: The wheels have changed the world tremendously. The most important thing is that they have made transportation easier and faster.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.

translations.source: इसने हमें ट्रेन, कार और इसी प्रकार के कई अन्य परिवहन के साधन दिए हैंं।
translations.translation: It has given us trains, cars and many other similar means of transportation.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.

translations.source: उनके अंतर्गत अधिक मध्यम आकार की बिल्लियाँ होती हैं जो खरगोशों से लेकर मृगों और हिरणों तक के मध्यम आकार के शिकार खाती हैं.
translations.translation: They have more medium-sized cats that feed on medium-sized prey from rabbits to reindeer and deer.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.

translations.source: अंत में, कई ऐसी छोटी बिल्लियाँ (लूज़ पेट कैट्स सहित) हैं जो कीट, रोडंट्स, छिपकलियों और पक्षियों जैसे कई छोटे जीवों को खाती हैं.
translations.translation: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose-bellied cats) that feed on many small organisms, such as insects, rodents, snails, and birds.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.

translations.source: प्रत्येक बिल्ली के पास एक ख़ास काम रहता है जो उसे दूसरों के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करने से रोकता है.
translations.translation: Each cat has a specific task that prevents it from competing with others.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.

translations.source: शेर प्राइड नामक बड़े समूहों में रहने वाली सबसे बड़ी सामाजिक बिल्लियाँ हैं.
translations.translation: Lions Pride are the largest social cats that live in large groups.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.

translations.source: शेरों का समूह वयस्क नर के साथ-साथ तीस से ज़्यादा मादा और शावकों के साथ एक से तीन तक का बना होता है.
translations.translation: The group of lions consists of one to three adult males as well as more than thirty females and lions.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.

translations.source: बहनों और बेटियों का एक बड़ा परिवार होने के नाते, मादाएँ आमतौर पर एक-दूसरे के करीब जुड़ी होती हैं.
translations.translation: Being a large family of sisters and daughters, females are usually closely related.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.

translations.source: शेरों का समूह काफी हद तक भेड़ियों या कुत्तों के झुंड की तरह काम करता है, जो जानवर व्यवहार में आश्चर्यजनक रूप से शेरों (लेकिन अन्य बड़ी बिल्लियों) के समान होते हैं, और अपने शिकार के लिए बहुत घातक भी होते हैं।
translations.translation: The group of lions acts largely like a herd of wolves or dogs, which are animals that are surprisingly similar in behavior to lions (but other larger cats), and are also very lethal to their prey.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.

translations.source: एक पूरी तरह से विकसित एथलीट की तरह, बाघ चढ़ाई कर सकता है (हालाँकि अच्छी तरह से नहीं), तैर सकता है, बड़ी दूरी तक छलांग लगा सकता है और एक शक्तिशाली मनुष्य के पाँच गुना बल के साथ खींच सकता है.
translations.translation: Like a fully developed athlete, a tiger can climb (though not well), swim, jump long distances and pull with five times the force of a powerful human.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.

translations.source: बाघों, तेंदुओं, और जगुआर की ही तरह, शेर भी उसी समूह (जीनस पैंथेरा) का है। केवल ये चार ही बिल्लियाँ हैं जो गर्जन कर सकती हैं।
translations.translation: Like tigers, leopards, and jaguars, lions belong to the same group (genus panthera). These are the only four cats that can roar.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.

translations.source: बाघ की दहाड़ किसी शेर की तेज़ आवाज़ वाली दहाड़ की तरह नहीं होती है, लेकिन उसकी बँधी हुई, चिल्लाने जैसी होती है.
translations.translation: A tiger's roar is not like a lion's roar, but it's like a tied, screaming roar.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.

translations.source: औसीलट छोटे जानवरों को खाना पसंद करते हैं। यदि वे पकड़ सकें, तो वे बंदरों, साँपों, कृन्तकों और पक्षियों को पकड़ लेंगे। लगभग सभी जानवर जो औसीलट का शिकार होते हैं, इनसे बहुत छोटे होते हैं।
translations.translation: If they can catch, they will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents, and birds.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.

translations.source: वैज्ञानिकों का मानना है कि ओसेलोट्स गंध के द्वारा जानवरों का पीछा करते और खाते (शिकार) हैं, यह सूँघते हुए कि वे ज़मीन पर कहाँ रहे होंगे।
translations.translation: Scientists believe that oscilloscopes chase and eat animals by smell, sensing where they may have been on Earth.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.

translations.source: वे रात के अंधेरे में बहुत अच्छी तरह से देख सकते हैं, और बहुत ही चुपके से आगे बढ़ सकते हैं. औसीलट अपने आस-पास के क्षेत्र में घूमकर फिर अपने शिकार पर झपट्टा मारकर अपना शिकार करते हैं.
translations.translation: They can see very well in the dark at night, and can move very stealthily.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.

translations.source: जब जीवित चीजों का एक छोटा समूह (छोटी आबादी) मुख्य आबादी के उस हिस्से से अलग हो जाता है जहाँ से वे आए हैं (जैसे कि अगर वे किसी पर्वत श्रृंखला या नदी से आए हैं या अगर वे किसी नए द्वीप पर जाते हैं ताकि वे आसानी से पीछे न हट सकें), तो वे अक्सर खुद को एक अलग माहौल में पाते हैं.
translations.translation: When a small group of living things (a small population) is separated from the part of the main population from where they came from (such as if they come from a mountain range or a river or if they move to a new island so that they cannot easily retreat), they often find themselves in a different environment.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.

translations.source: इस नई जगह में अलग-अलग संसाधन और प्रतियोगी हैं, इसलिए नई आबादी को पहले के मुकाबले एक मजबूत प्रतियोगी बनने के लिए अलग-अलग खासियत या बदलाव अपनाने की ज़रूरत होगी.
translations.translation: This new space has different resources and competitors, so the new population will need to adopt different characteristics or changes to become a stronger competitor than before.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.

translations.source: मूल आबादी में किसी तरह का बदलाव नहीं हुआ है, अभी भी वह पहले की तरह ही अनुकूलता चाहते हैं.
translations.translation: The indigenous population has not changed in any way, they still want the same adaptability as before.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.

translations.source: समय के साथ, जैसे-जैसे नई आबादी नए माहौल में ढलती जाती है, वह भी दूसरी आबादी की तरह अनदेखी करना शुरू कर देती है.
translations.translation: Over time, as a new population moves into a new environment, it also begins to be overlooked like other populations.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.

translations.source: अंततः, हजारों या लाखों साल बाद, दोनों आबादियाँ इतनी अलग दिखाई देंगी कि उन्हें एक ही प्रजाति नहीं कहा जा सकेगा.
translations.translation: Eventually, after thousands or millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they cannot be called the same species.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.

translations.source: हम इस प्रक्रिया को प्रजातिकरण कहते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है नई प्रजातियों का गठन। प्रजातिकरण एक अच्छा कदम है और विकास का एक बहुत महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है।
translations.translation: We call this process speciesization, which means the formation of new species. Speciesization is a good step and is a very important part of development.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.

translations.source: पौधे ऑक्सीजन बनाते हैं जिसका उपयोग मनुष्य साँस लेने में करते हैं और वे कार्बन-डाइऑक्साइड लेते हैं जो मनुष्य साँस से छोड़ते हैं (यानी साँस छोड़ते हैं).
translations.translation: Plants make the oxygen that humans use to breathe and they take in the carbon dioxide that humans exhale.
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).

translations.source: पौधे फ़ोटोसिंथेसिस द्वारा सूर्य से अपना भोजन बनाते हैं. वह छाया भी देते हैं.
translations.translation: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also give shade.
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.

translations.source: हम अपने घरों को पौधों से बनाते हैं और कपड़े पौधों से बनाते हैं। अधिकतर खाद्य पदार्थ जो हम खाते हैं वो पौधे होते हैं। पौधों के बिना, जानवर जीवित नहीं रह सकते हैं।
translations.translation: We build our homes from plants and we make clothes from plants. Most of the food we eat is from plants. Without plants, animals cannot survive.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.

translations.source: मोसासौरस अपने समय का सबसे बड़ा शिकारी था, इसलिए उसे अन्य मोसासौरस के अलावा किसी का भय नहीं था।
translations.translation: Mossaurus was the greatest hunter of his time, so he was afraid of none other than the other Mossaurus.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

translations.source: इसके मुंह के तालु में एक अतिरिक्त सेट के साथ ही 70 से ज़्यादा रेजर की तरह नुकीले दाँतों से भरे इसके लंबे जबड़े थे, जिसका अर्थ है कि उसके रास्ते से गुज़रने वाली किसी भी चीज़ के लिए कोई बचाव नहीं था.
translations.translation: It had an extra set in its mouth as well as long jaws filled with more than 70 razor-like pointed teeth, which meant there was no defense for anything passing through its path.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.

translations.source: हम पक्के तौर पर नहीं जानते हैं, लेकिन इसकी कांटेदार जीभ हो सकती है. इसके आहार में कछुए, बड़ी मछली, दूसरे मोसासॉर शामिल थे और ये एक नरभक्षी भी हो सकता है.
translations.translation: We don't know for sure, but it may have a horned tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosses, and it may have been a carnivore.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.

translations.source: ये पानी में जाने वाली किसी भी चीज़ पर भी हमला किया करते थे, यहाँ तक कि टी. रेक्स जैसे विशालकाय डायनासोर का भी कोई मुकाबला नहीं होगा.
translations.translation: They would attack anything in the water, not even a giant dinosaur like T. Rex.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.

translations.source: जबकि उनके अधिकतर व्यंजन हमारे लिए जाने-पहचाने होंगे, रोमनों ने अपने हिस्से को अजीब या असामान्य दावत वस्तुओं में शामिल किया, जिनमें जंगली सूअर, मोर, घोंघे और एक प्रकार का रोडेंट (कृंतक) शामिल है, जिसे डॉर्महाउस कहा जाता है.
translations.translation: While most of their dishes may be familiar to us, the Romans incorporated their share in strange or unusual feasting items, including wild pigs, moors, snails, and a kind of rodent, called the dormouse.
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse

translations.source: एक और अंतर यह था कि जहाँ गरीब लोग और महिला कुर्सियों पर बैठकर खाना खाते थे, वहीं अमीर लोग मिलजुल कर दावतें करना पसंद करते थे और भोजन करते वक्त वे मौज मस्ती करते थे.
translations.translation: Another difference was that where the poor and the women sat down to eat in chairs, the rich liked to get together and have fun while eating.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.

translations.source: प्राचीन रोमन भोजन में बाद की शताब्दियों में अमेरिका या एशिया से यूरोप आए खाद्य पदार्थ शामिल नहीं हो सकते थे.
translations.translation: Ancient Roman food could not have included foods from the Americas or Asia to Europe in later centuries.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.

translations.source: उदाहरण के लिए, उनके पास ना तो मकई थी, न ही टमाटर, आलू, और कोकोआ था और किसी भी प्राचीन रोम वासी ने कभी भी टर्की नहीं चखा था।
translations.translation: For example, they had neither corn, nor tomatoes, potatoes, or cocoa, and no ancient Roman had ever tasted turkey.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.

translations.source: बेबीलोन के निवासियों ने अपने प्रत्येक देवता का एक प्राथमिक मंदिर बनाया जिसे देवता का घर माना जाता था.
translations.translation: The inhabitants of Babylon built a primary temple to each of their gods that was considered the home of the gods.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.

translations.source: लोग देवताओं के लिए बलि लाते हैं और पुजारी आयोजनों और त्यौहारों में अपना समय देकर देवताओं की सेवा करते हैं.
translations.translation: People offer sacrifices to the gods and priests serve the gods by devoting their time to events and festivals.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.

translations.source: प्रत्येक मंदिर में मंदिर का एक खुला प्रांगण था और फिर एक आंतरिक गर्भगृह था जिसमें केवल पुजारी ही प्रवेश कर सकते थे।
translations.translation: In each temple there was an open courtyard of the temple and then an inner courtyard into which only priests could enter.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.

translations.source: खास पिरामिड के आकार के टॉवर (पगोडा) जिन्हें कभी-कभी ज़िगुरैट के नाम से भी जाना जाता था, को मंदिर के हिस्से के तौर पर बनाया गया था.
translations.translation: A special pyramid-shaped tower (Pagoda), sometimes known as a ziggurat, was built as part of the temple.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.

translations.source: टॉवर का शीर्ष देवता के लिए खास गर्भगृह था.
translations.translation: The top of the tower was a special tomb for the god.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.

translations.source: मध्यपूर्व की गर्म जलवायु में घर उतना ज़रूरी नहीं था.
translations.translation: In the warm climate of the Middle East, a home was not so important.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.

translations.source: हिब्रू परिवार का अधिकांश जीवन खुली हवा में बिता |
translations.translation: Most of the life of the Hebrew family was spent outdoors.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.

translations.source: महिलाएँ आँगन में खाना पकाती थीं; स्टोर सड़क पर खुले काउंटर दिख रहे थे. मकान बनाने में पत्थर का इस्तेमाल किया गया था.
translations.translation: Women were cooking in the courtyard; shops were looking at open counters on the street.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.

translations.source: कनान देश में बड़े जंगलो के न होने के चलते वहाँ लकड़ियाँ बहुत महंगी थी।
translations.translation: Because of the lack of large forests in the land of Canaan, timber was very expensive.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.

translations.source: ग्रीनलैंड को बहुत कम जगह बसाया गया था. नॉर्स सगास में वे कहते हैं कि एरिक रेड हत्या के लिए आइसलैंड से निर्वासित किया गया था, और आगे पश्चिम की यात्रा करते समय, ग्रीनलैंड मिला जिसे ग्रीनलैंड नाम दिया गया.
translations.translation: In the Norse saga, they say that Erik Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and while traveling further west, he found Greenland which was renamed Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: लेकिन उनकी खोज पर ध्यान दिए बिना, एस्किमो जनजाति उस समय पहले से ही वहाँ रह रही थी.
translations.translation: But regardless of their discovery, the Eskimos were already living there at the time.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.

translations.source: हालाँकि हर देश 'स्कैंडिनेवियाई' था, लेकिन डेनमार्क, स्वीडन, नॉर्वे और आइसलैंड के लोगों, राजाओं, रीति-रिवाजों और इतिहास के बीच कई अंतर थे.
translations.translation: Although each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.

translations.source: अगर आपने फ़िल्म नेशनल ट्रेज़र देखी है, तो आपको लगेगा कि स्वतंत्रता के घोषणा-पत्र के पीछे एक ख़ज़ाने का नक्शा लिखा गया था.
translations.translation: If you've seen the movie National Treasure, you'll think that a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.

translations.source: हालाँकि, यह सच नहीं है. हालाँकि दस्तावेज़ के पीछे कुछ लिखा हुआ है, लेकिन यह कोई ख़ज़ाने का नक्शा नहीं है.
translations.translation: However, this is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.

translations.source: स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा की पीठ पर लिखे गए शब्द थे 4 जुलाई 1776 को स्वतंत्रता की मूल घोषणा। “पाठ दस्तावेज़ के तल पर दिखाई देता है, उल्टा।”
translations.translation: The words written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the original Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776. The text appears at the bottom of the document, reversed.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.

translations.source: जबकि किसी को नहीं पता कि इसे किसने लिखा है संग्रह करने के लिए बड़े चमड़े के कागज़ के दस्तावेज़ (इसका माप 24½ इंच बटा 29¾ है) को इकठ्ठा किया था.
translations.translation: While no one knows who wrote it, it collected large leather paper documents (measuring 241⁄2 inches, 293⁄4 of an inch) for collection.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.

translations.source: इसलिए, यह माना जा रहा है कि नोटेशन को सिर्फ़ एक लेबल के रूप में जोड़ा गया था.
translations.translation: So, it's assumed that the notation was just added as a label.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.

translations.source: डी-डे की लैंडिंग और उसके आगे की लड़ाइयों ने उत्तरी फ्रांस को मुक्त कर दिया था, लेकिन दक्षिण फ्रांस अभी भी मुक्त नहीं था।
translations.translation: The D-Day landings and subsequent battles had liberated northern France, but southern France was still not free.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.

translations.source: यह “विची” फ़्रांसीसी लोगों द्वारा शासित था. ये फ़्रांसीसी लोग ही थे जिन्होंने 1940 में जर्मनों के साथ शांति स्थापित की थी और आक्रमणकारियों से लड़ने के बजाय उनके साथ काम किया था.
translations.translation: It was ruled by the French people of Vichy. It was the French people who made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with them instead of fighting the invaders.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.

translations.source: 15 अगस्त 1940 को, मित्र राष्ट्र ने दक्षिणी फ़्रांस पर आक्रमण किया, आक्रमण को “ऑपरेशन ड्रैगून” कहा गया था.
translations.translation: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, an invasion known as Operation Dragon.
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: केवल दो हफ़्तों में अमेरिकियों और फ़्री फ़्रेंच बलों ने दक्षिणी फ़्रांस को मुक्त कर दिया था और जर्मनी की ओर बढ़ रहे थे.
translations.translation: In just two weeks, American and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were moving toward Germany.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.

translations.source: ऐसी संस्कृति को सभ्यता कहते हैं जो लोगों के एक बड़े समूह में साझा की जाती है. यहाँ लोग आपसी सहयोग करते हुए समाज में रहते हैं और मिलकर काम करते हैं.
translations.translation: A culture is a civilization that is shared by a large group of people, where people live and work together in a community, cooperating with each other.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.

translations.source: सभ्यता शब्द लैटिन सिविलिस से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है नागरिक, लैटिन सिविस से संबंधित है, जिसका अर्थ है नागरिक, और सिवितास, जिसका अर्थ है शहर या शहर-राज्य, और वह एक तरह से समाज के आकार को भी परिभाषित करता है।
translations.translation: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning citizen, from the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and it also defines the shape of society in a way.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.

translations.source: शहर-राज्य राष्ट्रों के अगुआ हैं। एक सभ्यतागत संस्कृति का अर्थ है कई पीढ़ियों में ज्ञान का पारित होना, एक टिका हुआ सांस्कृतिक पदचिह्न और निष्पक्ष प्रसार।
translations.translation: A civilized culture means the passing of knowledge over many generations, a sustained cultural footprint and an impartial dissemination.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.

translations.source: छोटी संस्कृतियां बिना बड़े ऐतिहासिक सबूतों के खत्म हो जाती हैं और उन्हें सभ्यता का दर्जा नहीं मिल पाता.
translations.translation: Small cultures go extinct without great historical evidence and cannot be classified as civilized.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.

translations.source: कंफेडेरशन के अनुच्छेद के तहत क्रांतिकारी युद्ध के दौरान, तेरह राज्यों ने पहली बार एक कमजोर केंद्रीय सरकार का गठन किया जिसमें कांग्रेस इसका एकमात्र घटक थी.
translations.translation: During the Revolutionary War under the Articles of Confederation, thirteen states for the first time formed a weak central government in which the Congress was its sole component.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: कांग्रेस के पास टैक्स लगाने का कोई अधिकार नहीं था, क्योंकि वहाँ कोई राष्ट्रीय कार्यकारी या न्यायपालिका नहीं थी. यह राज्य के अधिकारियों पर निर्भर थे, जो अक्सर अपने सभी कार्यों को लागू करने में सहयोगी नहीं थे.
translations.translation: The Congress had no power to impose taxes, since there was no national executive or judiciary. It depended on state officials, who were often not cooperative in carrying out all of its functions.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.

translations.source: इसके राज्यों के बीच कर कानूनों और शुल्कों को ओवरराइड करने का भी कोई अधिकार नहीं था.
translations.translation: It also had no right to override tax laws and fees between its states.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.

translations.source: लेख को संशोधित करने से पहले सभी राज्यों से सर्वसम्मति से सहमति की आवश्यकता थी और राज्यों ने केंद्र सरकार को गंभीरता से नहीं लिया और उनके प्रतिनिधि अक्सर सभा में आते ही नहीं थे।
translations.translation: The amendment of the article required the unanimous consent of all the States and the States did not take the Central Government seriously and their representatives did not frequently come to the assembly.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.

translations.source: सफलता के मामले में, जर्मनी की राष्ट्रीय फुटबॉल टीम के बाद इटली की राष्ट्रीय फुटबॉल टीम आती है, ये फीफा वर्ल्ड कप 2006 के विजेता थे.
translations.translation: In terms of success, the German national football team is followed by the Italian national football team, the 2006 FIFA World Cup winners.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.

translations.source: लोकप्रिय खेलों में फ़ुटबॉल, बास्केटबॉल, वॉलीबॉल, वाटर पोलो, तलवारबाज़ी, रग्बी, साइकिलिंग, आइस हॉकी, रोलर हॉकी और एफ़ 1 मोटर रेसिंग शामिल हैं.
translations.translation: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water polo, swordplay, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.

translations.source: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय खेलों और ओलंपिक स्पर्धाओं में प्रतिस्पर्धा करने वाले इटालियंस के साथ, शीतकालीन खेल उत्तरी क्षेत्रों में सबसे लोकप्रिय हैं.
translations.translation: With Italians competing in international games and the Olympic Games, the Winter Games are most popular in the northern regions.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.

translations.source: जापान में करीब 7,000 द्वीप हैं (सबसे बड़ा द्वीप होन्शु है). यह जापान को दुनिया के 7वें सबसे बड़े द्वीप का दर्जा देता है!
translations.translation: Japan has about 7,000 islands (the largest being Honshu), making it the seventh largest island in the world!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!

translations.source: जापान के पास, द्वीपों के समूह होने के कारण, जापान को भौगोलिक रूप से अक्सर “द्वीपसमूह” के रूप में संदर्भित किया जाता है।
translations.translation: Because of its proximity to Japan, being a group of islands, Japan is often referred to geographically as an archipelago.
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"

translations.source: ताइवान की खोज 15वीं शताब्दी में यूरोपीय नाविकों ने की थी. उन्होंने इस आइलैंड को इल्हा फ़ॉर्मोसा या सुंदर आइलैंड कहा था.
translations.translation: Taiwan was discovered in the 15th century by European sailors who called it Ilha Formosa, or the Beautiful Island.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.

translations.source: 1624 में, डच ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने दक्षिण-पश्चिमी ताइवान में एक बेस की स्थापना की थी, जो आदिवासी अनाज उत्पादन के तरीको में परिवर्तन की शुरुआत कर रही थी और चीनी मजदूरों को अपने चावल और चीनी बागानों पर काम करने के लिए नियुक्त कर रही थी।
translations.translation: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company had established a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a change in the way tribal grain was produced and hiring Chinese laborers to work on their rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.

translations.source: 1683 में चिंग राजवंश (1644-1912) ने ताइवान के पश्चिमी और उत्तरी तटीय क्षेत्रों में जबरन कब्ज़ा कर लिया और 1885 में ताइवान को साम्राज्य का प्रांत घोषित किया.
translations.translation: In 1683 the Qing Dynasty (1644-1912) forcibly seized the western and northern coastal areas of Taiwan and declared Taiwan a province of the Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.

translations.source: 1895 में, प्रथम चीन-जापान युद्ध (1894-1895) में हार के बाद, चिंग सरकार शिमोनोसेकी की संधि पर हस्ताक्षर करती है, जिसके द्वारा वह ताइवान की संप्रभुता जापान को सौंप देती है, जो 1945 तक द्वीप पर राज करता है।
translations.translation: In 1895, following the defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it ceded the sovereignty of Taiwan to Japan, which ruled the island until 1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.

translations.source: माचू पिच्चू में तीन मुख्य संरचनाएं हैं, जो कि इतिहुआताना, सूर्य का मंदिर और तीन खिड़कियों का कमरा हैं।
translations.translation: In Machu Picchu there are three main structures, namely, the Ethuyatana, the Temple of the Sun and the Three Window Room.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: परिसर के किनारे ज़्यादातर इमारतें फिर से बनाई गई हैं ताकि पर्यटकों को बेहतर ढंग से पता चल सके कि वे मूल रूप में कैसी दिखाई देती थी.
translations.translation: Most of the buildings on the edge of the complex have been rebuilt to give tourists a better understanding of what they originally looked like.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.

translations.source: सन 1976 तक माचू पिचू के तीस प्रतिशत हिस्से का जीर्णोद्धार कर दिया गया था और जीर्णोद्धार का कार्य आज तक जारी है।
translations.translation: By 1976 thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and the restoration work continues to this day.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.

translations.source: उदाहरण के लिए, दुनिया में सबसे ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल होने वाला फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी फ़ॉर्मेट 35mm है. यह एनालॉग फिल्म दौर के आखिर में काफी प्रचलित था.
translations.translation: For example, the most widely used photographic format in the world is 35mm. This was quite common in the late analog film era.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.

translations.source: यह आज भी बनाया जाता है, लेकिन इससे भी महत्वपूर्ण बात यह है कि इसका अभिमुखता अनुपात डिजिटल कैमरा इमेज सेंसर प्रारूपों द्वारा विरासत में मिला है.
translations.translation: It is still made today, but more importantly, its orientation ratio is inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.

translations.source: 35 मिमी प्रारूप वास्तव में, थोड़ा भ्रामक है, जो ऊँचाई में 24 मिमी गुना 36 मिमी चौड़ाई में है.
translations.translation: The 35mm format is, in fact, a bit misleading, which is 24mm in height by 36mm in width.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.

translations.source: इस प्रारूप (सबसे सरल पूर्ण-संख्या अनुपात प्राप्त करने के लिए बारह से भाग देना) के अभिमुखता अनुपात को इसलिए 3:2 कहा जाता है।
translations.translation: The orientation ratio of this format (splitting by twelve to obtain the simplest integer ratio) is therefore called 3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.

translations.source: कई सामान्य प्रारूप (उदाहरण के लिए, प्रारूप का APS परिवार) इस अभिमुखता अनुपात के लगभग बराबर या उसके आस-पास हैं.
translations.translation: Many common formats (for example, the APS family of formats) are roughly equal to or in the vicinity of this orientation ratio.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.

translations.source: बहुत-दुर्व्यवहार और अक्सर उपहास करने वाला तीसरा नियम एक सरल दिशानिर्देश है जो एक छवि में क्रम का माप रखते हुए गतिशील बनाता है.
translations.translation: The much-abused and often derisive third law is a simple guideline that moves by measuring order in an image.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.

translations.source: यह बताता है कि मुख्य विषय के लिए सबसे असरदार जगह इमेज को तिरछे और क्षैतिज रूप में विभाजित करने वाली लाइनों को काटने वाली जगह पर है (उदाहरण देखें).
translations.translation: It indicates that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines that divide the image vertically and horizontally (see examples).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).

translations.source: यूरोपीय इतिहास की इस अवधि के दौरान कैथोलिक चर्च जो समृद्ध और शक्तिशाली हो गया था, जाँच के दायरे में आ गया.
translations.translation: During this period of European history the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.

translations.source: भाषा और रीति-रिवाज़ में अंतर के बावजूद हज़ारों सालों से ईसाई धर्म ने यूरोपीय देशों को एक साथ बांधे रखा है.
translations.translation: In spite of the differences in language and customs, for thousands of years, Christianity has kept European countries united.
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I

translations.source: इसकी सर्वव्यापी शक्ति ने राजा से लेकर आम तक सभी को प्रभावित किया.
translations.translation: Its omnipotent power affected everyone from the king to the commoner.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.

translations.source: मुख्य ईसाई सिद्धातों में से एक यह है कि धन का उपयोग दुख और गरीबी को कम करने के लिए किया जाना चाहिए और चर्च के मौद्रिक कोष विशेष रूप से इसीलिए हैं.
translations.translation: One of the main Christian principles is that money should be used to alleviate grief and poverty and that is why the church's monetary funds are especially important.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.

translations.source: रोम में चर्च का केंद्रीय प्राधिकरण एक हज़ार से भी ज़्यादा सालों से है और ताकत और पैसे के इस तरह एक ही जगह पर केंद्रित होने से कई लोगों के मन में सवाल है कि यह सिद्धांत पूरा हो रहा था या नहीं.
translations.translation: The central authority of the church in Rome has existed for more than a thousand years, and the concentration of power and money in such a single place has led many to question whether this doctrine was being fulfilled.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.

translations.source: शत्रुता फैलाने के तुरंत बाद, ब्रिटेन ने जर्मनी की समुद्री घेराबंदी शुरू कर दी थी.
translations.translation: Shortly after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain had begun a naval siege of Germany.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.

translations.source: रणनीति महत्वपूर्ण सैन्य और असैन्य आपूर्ति को काटते हुए प्रभावी साबित हुई, हालाँकि इस नाकाबंदी ने पिछले दो शताब्दियों के कई अंतरराष्ट्रीय समझौतों द्वारा आमतौर पर स्वीकृत अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कानून का उल्लंघन किया।
translations.translation: The strategy proved effective in cutting off significant military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated international law generally accepted by many international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.

translations.source: ब्रिटेन ने किसी भी जहाज को समुद्र के पूरे हिस्सों में प्रवेश करने से रोकने के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय जल का खनन किया, जिससे तट पर खड़े जहाजों के लिए भी खतरा पैदा हो गया।
translations.translation: The UK mined international waters to prevent any vessel from entering the whole of the sea, which also posed a threat to ships standing on the shore.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.

translations.source: चूँकि इस रणनीति को सीमित प्रतिसाद ही मिला था, इसलिए जर्मनी ने अपने अप्रतिबंधित पनडुब्बी युद्ध को लेकर भी इसी तरह के प्रतिसाद की उम्मीद की थी.
translations.translation: Given the limited response to this strategy, Germany had expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.

translations.source: 1920 के दशक के दौरान ज़्यादातर नागरिकों और देशों में शांतिवाद और अलगाव का नज़रिया प्रचलित था.
translations.translation: During the 1920s, the view of pacifism and isolation prevailed in most citizens and countries.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.

translations.source: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान युद्ध की भयानकता और अत्याचारों को देखने के बाद, राष्ट्र भविष्य में ऐसी स्थिति से बचने के लिए कामना करता है ।
translations.translation: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during the First World War, the nation wishes to avoid such a situation in the future.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.

translations.source: 1884 में, टेस्ला न्यूयॉर्क शहर में एडिसन कंपनी के साथ नौकरी स्वीकार करने के लिए यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स ऑफ़ अमेरिका चले गए।
translations.translation: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.

translations.source: अपनी जेब में 4 सेंट्स, कविता की एक पुस्तक और उनके थॉमस एडिसन को संबोधित सिफारिशी चिट्ठी (पिछली नौकरी के मैनेजर द्वारा लिखी) लेकर वे अमरीका पहुंचे.
translations.translation: He arrived in the United States with 4 cents in his pocket, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation (written by his former job manager) addressed to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: प्राचीन चीन में अलग-अलग समय अवधि दिखाने का एक अनूठा तरीका था; चीन का प्रत्येक चरण या प्रत्येक परिवार जो सत्ता में था, एक ख़ास राजवंश था.
translations.translation: In ancient China, there was a unique way of showing different time periods; every stage of China, or every family that was in power, had a distinct dynasty.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, यह हर राजवंशों में राज्यों के बंटवारे को लेकर अस्थिरता का दौर था. इसी काल में तीन राज्यों के बंटवारे को लेकर हान और जिन राजवंशों के बीच 60 वर्षों तक चला संघर्ष काफ़ी मशहूर है.
translations.translation: In addition, it was a period of instability in the division of the three kingdoms between the Han dynasty and the Jin dynasty for 60 years.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.

translations.source: इस अवधि के दौरान सिंहासन के लिए लड़ रहे कई अमीरजादों के बीच भयंकर युद्ध हुआ।
translations.translation: During this period there was a fierce battle between the several emirzads fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.

translations.source: द थ्री किंग़डम्स प्राचीन चीन के इतिहास में सबसे खूनी धब्बों में एक युग था, हजारों लोगों की मृत्यु हो गई थी, जो शीआन में भव्य महल में सबसे ऊंची सीट पर बैठने के लिए लड़ रहे थे।
translations.translation: The Three Kingdoms was an era of the bloodiest stains in the history of ancient China, with thousands of people dying fighting to take the highest seat in a majestic palace in Xi'an.
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.

translations.source: मीट्रिक प्रणाली के इस्तेमाल, निरपेक्षवाद से गणतंत्रवाद, राष्ट्रवाद में बदलाव और देश का भरोसा लोगों से है किसी एक शासक से नहीं, ऐसी बातों का बहुत ज़्यादा सामाजिक और राजनैतिक असर होता है.
translations.translation: The use of the metric system, the transition from absolutism to republicanism, the transition to nationalism and the trust of the country in the people, not in a single ruler, have a great social and political impact.
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.

translations.source: तथा, क्रांति के बाद व्यवसाय सभी पुरुष आवेदकों के लिए खुले थे जिसमें सबसे महत्त्वाकांक्षी और सफल होने वाले सफल हो सकते थे।
translations.translation: And, after the revolution, businesses were open to all male applicants where the most ambitious and successful could be successful.
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.

translations.source: यही सेना पर भी लागू होता है क्योंकि सेना की रैंकिंग वर्ण पर आधारित होने के बजाय अब योग्यता पर आधारित हैं।
translations.translation: The same applies to the army as the ranking of the army is now based on qualifications rather than on character.
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.

translations.source: फ़्रांसीसी क्रांति ने दूसरे देशों में मौजूद कामगार वर्ग के कई दमित लोगों को भी अपनी-अपनी क्रांतियां शुरू करने की प्रेरणा दी.
translations.translation: The French Revolution also inspired many of the oppressed working class in other countries to start their own revolutions.
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.

translations.source: मोहम्मद इस सांसारिक जीवन से परे मामलों में गहरी रुचि रखते थे। वे अक्सर चिंतन के लिए एक गुफा का उपयोग करते थे जिसे “नूर” (प्रकाश) के पर्वत पर “हीरा” के रूप में जाना जाता है।
translations.translation: Muhammad had a deep interest in matters beyond this worldly life. He often used a cave for meditation which is known as the "Diamond" on the mountain of Nur (Light).
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.

translations.source: उन्होंने खुद को एकांत करा , जो कई समय तक रहा, यह मुहम्मद के आध्यात्मिक झुकाव की एक बहुत ही उज्ज्वल छवि देता है।
translations.translation: He isolated himself, which lasted for a long time, giving a very vivid picture of the spiritual inclination of Muhammad.
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.

translations.source: मक्का के उत्तर में स्थित पहाड़ों में से एक के शीर्ष पर स्थित गुफा दुनिया के बाकी हिस्सों से पूरी तरह कटी हुई है।
translations.translation: Located at the top of one of the mountains to the north of Mecca, the cave is completely cut off from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.

translations.source: असल में, किसी को इसकी मौजूदगी का पता होने पर भी इसे ढूँढना बिल्कुल भी आसान नहीं है. एक बार गुफ़ा में पहुँच जाने पर, वहाँ आप एकदम अकेले हो जाते हैं.
translations.translation: In fact, it's not so easy to find it even if someone knows it exists.
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.

translations.source: ऊपर साफ़ वातावरण, सुंदर आसमान और आस-पास के कई पहाड़ों के अलावा और कुछ भी नहीं नज़र आता है. इसलिए इस गुफ़ा के अंदर से दुनिया का छोटा सा हिस्सा ही देखा या सुना जा सकता है.
translations.translation: Nothing can be seen above except the clear atmosphere, the beautiful skies and the many surrounding mountains, so only a small part of the world can be seen or heard from the inside of this cave.
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.

translations.source: गीज़ा में मौजूद ग्रेट पिरामिड सात अजूबा में से केवल एक है जो आज भी खड़ा है।
translations.translation: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing today.
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.

translations.source: तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व में मिस्रियों द्वारा निर्मित, ग्रेट पिरामिड मृत फिरौन का सम्मान करने के लिए निर्मित कई बड़ी पिरामिड संरचनाओं में से एक है।
translations.translation: Built by the Egyptians in the 3rd century BC, the Great Pyramid is one of several large pyramid structures built to honor the dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.

translations.source: गीज़ा पठार, “गीज़ा नेक्रोपोलिस” या मृतकों की मिस्र की घाटी में कई पिरामिड (जिनमें से द ग्रेट पिरामिड सबसे बड़ा है), कई छोटी कब्रें, कई मंदिर और महान स्फिंक्स हैं.
translations.translation: The Giza Plateau, the Necropolis of Giza, or the Valley of the Dead, has many pyramids (of which The Great Pyramid is the largest), many small tombs, many temples, and great sphinxes.
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.

translations.source: महान पिरामिड फेरो खुफू के सम्मान में बनाया गया था, और कई छोटे पिरामिड, कब्र और मंदिरों का निर्माण खुफू की पत्नियों और परिवार के सदस्यों के सम्मान में किया गया था।
translations.translation: The Great Pyramid was built in honour of Pharaoh Khufu, and many small pyramids, tombs and temples were built in honour of Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.

translations.source: “अप बो” चिह्न वी की तरह दिखता है और “डाउन बो” चिन्ह स्टेपल की तरह दिखता है या ऐसे चौकोर जैसा जिसका निचला हिस्सा गायब हो।
translations.translation: The up side looks like a V sign and the down side looks like a staple or a square with the bottom missing.
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.

translations.source: आगे का मतलब यह है कि आपको शीर्ष से शुरू कर कमान को धकेलना चाहिए और पीछे का मतलब यह है कि आपको फ़्रॉग (जहां से आप हाथ से कमान को पकड़ते हैं) से शुरू कर कमान को खींचना चाहिए.
translations.translation: Forward means you have to push the command from the top and back means you have to pull the command from the frog (where you hold the command by hand).
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.

translations.source: एक ऊपरी-चाप आमतौर पर एक मृदु ध्वनि उत्पन्न करता है, जबकि एक निचला-चाप मजबूत और अधिक मुखर होता है।
translations.translation: An upper-pressure usually produces a soft sound, while a lower-pressure is stronger and louder.
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.

translations.source: अपने खुद के मार्क्स पर लिखने के लिए स्वतंत्र महसूस करें, लेकिन याद रखें कि म्यूज़िकल कारणों से प्रिंटेड बोइंग मार्क्स भी होते हैं, इसलिए आमतौर पर उनका सम्मान करना चाहिए.
translations.translation: Feel free to write on your own marks, but remember that there are also printed Boeing marks for musical reasons, so they should generally be respected.
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.

translations.source: घबराए हुए राजा लुईस XVI, रानी मैरी एंटोनेट और उनके दो बच्चे (11 साल की मैरी थैरेस और चार साल का लुईस चार्ल्स) और राजा की बहन मैडम एलिजावेथ को 6 अक्टूबर 1789 को बाज़ार में मौजूद महिलाओं की भीड़ ने वर्साय से वापस पेरिस जाने के लिए मजबूर किया था.
translations.translation: The frightened King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette and their two children (Mary Thérèse, 11 years old, and Louis Charles, 4 years old) and the King's sister, Madame Elizabeth, were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a crowd of women in the marketplace on October 6, 1789.
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.

translations.source: महाराजा और महारानी के ख़िलाफ़ चीखते-चिल्लाते लोगों की भीड़ से घिरी एक गाड़ी में सफर करते हुए वे लोग पेरिस वापस आए.
translations.translation: Traveling in a wagon, they returned to Paris, surrounded by a crowd of people shouting against the king and queen.
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.

translations.source: लोगों की भीड़ ने राजा और रानी को अपनी गाड़ी की खिड़की खोलने के लिए मजबूर किया.
translations.translation: A crowd of people forced the king and queen to open the window of their carriage.
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.

translations.source: एक मौके पर तो भीड़ में मौजूद किसी व्यक्ति ने घबराई हुई महारानी के सामने ही वर्सेल्स में मारे गए शाही अंगरक्षक का सिर पकड़कर हिला दिया.
translations.translation: On one occasion, a man in the crowd shook the head of the royal bodyguard who had been killed in Versailles in front of the frightened queen.
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.

translations.source: फिलीपींस की विजय में अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवाद के युद्ध व्यय का भुगतान फिलिपिनो के लोगों ने खुद किया था.
translations.translation: The cost of American imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines was paid by the Filipinos themselves.
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.

translations.source: वे अमेरिकी स्ट्रीट औपनिवेशिक शासन को करों का भुगतान करने के लिए मजबूर कर रहे थे, जो कि व्यय का एक बड़ा हिस्सा और फिल स्ट्रीट सरकार द्वारा वॉल स्ट्रीट बैंकिंग घरों के माध्यम से फिलीपीन सरकार के नाम पर लगाए गए बॉन्ड पर ब्याज को धोखा देने के लिए था।
translations.translation: They were forcing the U.S. Street Colonial regime to pay taxes, a large portion of the expense and to defraud the interest on bonds imposed in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street Banking Houses by the Fill Street government.
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.

translations.source: निश्चित रूप से, फिलिपिनो लोगों के शोषण से प्राप्त सुपरफास्टिट्स अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवाद के बुनियादी लाभ का गठन करेंगे।
translations.translation: Certainly, the superfastites derived from the exploitation of the Filipino people will constitute the basic advantage of American imperialism.
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.

translations.source: टेम्पलर्स को समझने के लिए वह संदर्भ समझना ज़रूरी है जिसने आदेश दिए जाने की प्रेरणा दी थी.
translations.translation: To understand the Templars, it is necessary to understand the context that inspired the order.
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.

translations.source: जिस समय घटनाएँ हुई उसके युग को सामान्य रूप से यूरोप के इतिहास में 11वीं, 12वीं और 13वीं सदी (AD 1000-1300) में यूरोपियन इतिहास के उच्च मध्य युग की अवधि के रूप में बताया जाता है.
translations.translation: The period of time at which the events took place is commonly referred to in the history of Europe as the period of the High Middle Ages of European history in the 11th, 12th and 13th centuries (AD 1000-1300).
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).

translations.source: उच्च मध्य युग आरंभिक मध्य युग से पहले हुआ था और उसके बाद आधुनिक मध्य युग आया जिसका समापन 1500 के आसपास माना जाता है।
translations.translation: The High Middle Ages preceded the Early Middle Ages and were followed by the Modern Middle Ages, which is thought to have ended around 1500.
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.

translations.source: टेक्नोलॉजिकल निर्धारणवाद एक ऐसा शब्द है, जो व्यवहार में विचारों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को शामिल करता है, प्रौद्योगिकी-धक्का या तकनीकी अनिवार्यता से लेकर सख्त अर्थ तक कि मानव नियति वैज्ञानिक कानूनों और प्रौद्योगिकी में उनके प्रदर्शन से जुड़े एक अंतर्निहित तर्क से प्रेरित है।
translations.translation: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of concepts in practice, from technological-push or technical necessity to the strict sense that human destiny is inspired by an underlying reasoning associated with scientific laws and their performance in technology.
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.

translations.source: तकनीकी निर्धारण की ज़्यादातर व्याख्याएँ दो सामान्य विचारों के बारे में बताती हैं: तकनीकी विकास पर सांस्कृतिक या राजनीतिक असर का कोई भी प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता है और परिणामस्वरूप सामाजिक रूप से अनुकूलित होने के बजाय वह तकनीक निहित समाजों को “प्रभावित” करती है.
translations.translation: Most interpretations of technological determination refer to two general concepts: the cultural or political impact on technological development has no effect whatsoever and, as a result, it affects the societies in which technology is found, rather than being socially adapted.
