translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.

translations.source: उदाहरण के लिए, कोई कह सकता है कि मोटर कार आवश्यक रूप से सड़कों के विकास को प्रभावित करती हैं।
translations.translation: For example, one might say that motor cars necessarily influence the development of roads.
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.

translations.source: हालाँकि, देशभर में बिछा सड़कों का जाल सिर्फ़ मुट्ठीभर कारों के लिए किफ़ायती नहीं था, इसलिए कार खरीदने का खर्च कम करने क लिए उत्पादन के नए-नए तरीके विकसित किए गए.
translations.translation: However, the network of roads spread across the country was not affordable for just a handful of cars, so new ways of production were developed to reduce the cost of buying a car.
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.

translations.source: सड़कों पर ज़्यादा दुर्घटना की वजह बहुत ज़्यादा कार ओनरशिप है, जिससे शरीर में हुई टूट-फूट को सुधारने के लिए हेल्थकेयर में नई तकनीकों के आविष्कार को बढ़ावा मिला है.
translations.translation: The high number of accidents on the roads is due to the large number of car owners, which has led to the invention of new technologies in healthcare to repair fractures in the body.
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.

translations.source: रूमानियत में सांस्कृतिक नियतिवाद का बड़ा तत्व था, जो गोएथे, फिच्ते और श्लेगल जैसे लेखकों से लिया गया.
translations.translation: There was a major element of cultural determinism in Romanianism, derived from authors such as Goethe, Fichte and Schlagel.
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.

translations.source: स्वच्छंदतावाद के संदर्भ में, भूगोल ने व्यक्तियों को ढाला और समय के साथ-साथ उस भूगोल से जुड़े रीति-रिवाज और संस्कृति उत्पन्न हुई. समाज के स्थान के मुताबिक होने की वजह से ये लोग मनमाने ढंग से लगाए गए कानूनों से कहीं बेहतर थे.
translations.translation: In the context of hygiene, geography has shaped individuals and, over time, has given rise to customs and cultures associated with that geography.
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.

translations.source: जिस तरह पेरिस को आज की दुनिया की फ़ैशन राजधानी के रूप में जाना जाता है उसी तरह कॉन्स्टेंटिनोपल को सामंती यूरोप की फैशन राजधानी के रूप में माना जाता था.
translations.translation: Just as Paris is known today as the fashion capital of the world, so was Constantinople as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.

translations.source: विलासिता के एक उपरिकेंद्र होने के लिए इसको लगभग 400 A.D से  1100 A.D तक जाना गया।
translations.translation: It was known from about 400 A.D. to 1100 A.D. for being a hub of luxury.
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.

translations.source: इसकी स्थिति बारहवीं शताब्दी के दौरान मुख्य रूप से इस बात के कारण घट गई थी कि धर्म योद्धा रेशम और मसालों जैसे उपहार ले कर आए, जो कि बाइज़ेन्टिन बाजारों की पेशकश की तुलना में अधिक मूल्यवान थे।
translations.translation: Its status declined during the twelfth century, mainly because the religious warriors brought gifts such as silk and spices, which were more valuable than what the Byzantine markets offered.
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.

translations.source: यह वो समय था जब कॉन्स्टेंटिनोपल को हटाकर पेरिस को फैशन राजधानी का खिताब दिया गया था।
translations.translation: This was the time when the title of fashion capital was given to Paris from Constantinople.
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.

translations.source: 10वीं से लेकर 11वीं सदी के बीच और 14वीं सदी में गोथिक स्टाइल चरम पर थी.
translations.translation: Between the 10th and 11th centuries and the 14th century, the Gothic style was at its peak.
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.

translations.source: शुरुआत में पोशाक, पूर्व में बीजान्टिन संस्कृति से काफी प्रभावित थी।
translations.translation: Initially, the dress was heavily influenced by Byzantine culture.
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.

translations.source: हालाँकि धीमे कम्युनिकेशन चैनल की वजह से पश्चिम का रहन-सहन 25-30 साल पीछे जा सकता है.
translations.translation: However, due to the slow communication channels, the West's livelihoods can go back 25-30 years.
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.

translations.source: मध्य युग के अंत में पश्चिमी यूरोप ने अपनी शैली विकसित करना शुरू कर दिया. धर्मयुद्ध के परिणामस्वरूप उस समय के सबसे बड़े विकास में से एक लोगों ने कपड़ों को बाँधने के लिए बटन का उपयोग करना शुरू किया
translations.translation: In the late Middle Ages, Western Europe began to develop its own style. As a result of the Wars of Religion, one of the biggest developments of the time, people began to use buttons to bind clothes.
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.

translations.source: निर्वाह कृषि केवल कृषक तथा उसके परिवार की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने और पर्याप्त भोजन उत्पादन के लिए की जाती है।
translations.translation: Subsistence farming is done only to meet the needs of the farmer and his family and to produce adequate food.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.

translations.source: जीविका आधारित खेती एक आसान, अक्सर जैविक, प्रणाली है जिसमें ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा फ़सल लेने के लिए स्थानीय भौगोलिक इलाके के सहेजे गए बीज को फ़सल चक्र या दूसरी अपेक्षाकृत आसान तकनीकों का इस्तेमाल किया जाता है.
translations.translation: Subsistence-based farming is a simple, often organic, system in which seeds from a local geographical area are saved using crop cycles or other relatively simple techniques to harvest maximum crops.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.

translations.source: ऐतिहासिक रूप से ज़्यादातर किसान जीविका आधारित खेती ही करते रहे हैं और अब भी कई विकासशील देशों में यही होता है.
translations.translation: Historically, most farmers have been subsistence farmers and this is still the case in many developing countries.
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.

translations.source: उपसंस्कृति समान विचारधारा वाले व्यक्तियों को साथ लाती है जो सामाजिक मानकों में अपने आप को पिछड़ा हुआ महसूस करते हैं और उन्हें अपनी पहचान की भावना विकसित करने की अनुमति देते हैं।
translations.translation: The subculture brings together like-minded individuals who feel left behind in social norms and allows them to develop their sense of identity.
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.

translations.source: सदस्यों की आयु, नस्ल, वर्ग, स्थान, और/या लिंग की वजह से उपसंस्कृतियों में अंतर हो सकता है.
translations.translation: Subcultures may differ because of the age, race, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.

translations.source: वे गुण जो किसी उप-संस्कृति को अलग बनाते हैं, जैसे कि भाषा, सौंदर्य, धर्म, राजनीति, यौन, भूगोल या कई सारे कारकों का मिश्रण हो सकते हैं.
translations.translation: The qualities that distinguish a subculture can be a mixture of languages, aesthetics, religion, politics, sexuality, geography, or many other factors.
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.

translations.source: एक उपसंस्कृति के सदस्य अक्सर शैली के एक विशिष्ट और प्रतीकात्मक उपयोग के माध्यम से अपनी सदस्यता का संकेत देते हैं, जिसमें फैशन, तौर-तरीके और ख़ास बोली शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: Members of a subculture often indicate their membership through a specific and symbolic use of style, which includes fashion, manners, and specific speech.
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.

translations.source: समाजीकरण के महत्व को स्पष्ट करने के लिए इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले सबसे आम तरीकों में से कुछ बच्चों के दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण मामलों को आकर्षित करना है, जो बड़े होने के दौरान वयस्कों द्वारा उपेक्षित नहीं, बल्कि उपेक्षा, दुर्भाग्य या दुर्व्यवहार के माध्यम से होते थे।
translations.translation: Some of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization are to draw on the unfortunate cases of children, which were not neglected by adults as they grew up, but through neglect, misfortune or abuse.
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.

translations.source: ऐसे बच्चे “पाशविक प्रवृत्ति वाले” या जंगली कहलाते हैं. कुछ जंगली बच्चों को लोग (ज़्यादातार उनके माता-पिता) दुनिया से अलग रखते हैं. कुछ मामलों में बच्चों की किसी मानसिक या शारीरिक कमी की वजह से माता-पिता ऐसा करते हैं.
translations.translation: Such children are called "wild" or "wild". Some wild children are isolated from the rest of the world. In some cases, the parents do so because of a mental or physical deficiency of the children.
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.

translations.source: यह संभव है की बंदी बच्चों ने छोड़े जाने या  भागने से पहले गंभीर बाल दुर्व्यवहार या आघात का सामना करा हो |
translations.translation: It's possible that children in captivity may have been subjected to severe child abuse or trauma before being released or escaped.
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.

translations.source: दूसरों को कथित तौर पर जानवरों से ढोकर लाया गया था; कुछ के बारे में कहा जाता है कि वे खुद ही जंगल में रह रहे थे.
translations.translation: Others were reportedly brought in by animals; some are said to have lived in the woods themselves.
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.

translations.source: पूरी तरह से गैर-मानवीय जानवरों पर ढोकर लाए जाने के बाद, जंगली बच्चा करीब-करीब वैसा ही बर्ताव (शारीरिक सीमाओं के भीतर) करते हैं जैसा खास-देखभाल वाले जानवर करते हैं, जैसे कि इंसानों से डर या बेपरवाही.
translations.translation: After being brought up on completely non-human animals, wild children behave much the same (within physical limits) as animals with special care, such as fear of humans or carelessness.
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.

translations.source: जबकि प्रोजेक्ट आधारित लर्निंग को, लर्निंग को और आसान और अधिक दिलचस्प बनाना चाहिए, स्कैफोल्डिंग इससे भी एक कदम आगे जाती है.
translations.translation: While project-based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step further.
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.

translations.source: स्कैफ़ोल्डिंग सीखने की एक विधि नहीं है, बल्कि ऐसे लोगों को मददगार होती है जो किसी नई चीज़ को सीख रहे हों जैसे नया कंप्यूटर प्रोग्राम चलना या एक नया प्रोजेक्ट शुरू करना.
translations.translation: Scaffolding is not a method of learning, but it is helpful for people who are learning something new, like running a new computer program or starting a new project.
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.

translations.source: स्कैफ़ोल्ड वर्चुअल भी हो सकते हैं और असली भी, दूसरे शब्दों में, टीचर एक तरह के स्कैफ़ोल्ड होते हैं लेकिन Microsoft Office का पेपरक्लिप मैन भी वही है.
translations.translation: Scaffolding can be virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a sort of scaffolding, but it's the same as a Microsoft Office paper clip man.
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.

translations.source: वर्चुअल स्कैफ़ोल्ड सॉफ़्टवेयर का ही अंदरूनी हिस्सा होते हैं और वे ऐसी प्रक्रियाओं पर सवाल उठाते हैं, उनका संकेत देते हैं और उनके बारे में जानकारी देते हैं जो छात्र के लिए अकेले संभालने में चुनौती भरी होती हैं.
translations.translation: Virtual scaffolding is an integral part of the software, and it raises questions, suggests and provides information about processes that are challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.

translations.source: बच्चों को कई वजहों से फ़ॉस्टर केयर में रखा जाता है, जिनमें अनदेखी करना, बुरा बर्ताव करना, और यहां तक कि ज़बरदस्ती वसूली करना भी शामिल है.
translations.translation: Children are placed in foster care for a variety of reasons, including neglect, mistreatment, and even forcible recovery.
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.

translations.source: किसी भी बच्चे को कभी भी ऐसे वातावरण में नहीं बढ़ना चाहिए जो कि पालन पोषण करने, देखभाल करने वाला और शैक्षणिक न हो, लेकिन वे बढ़ रहे हैं.
translations.translation: No child should ever grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring and educational, but they are growing.
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.

translations.source: हम फोस्टर केयर सिस्टम को इन बच्चों के लिए एक सुरक्षित क्षेत्र मानते हैं।
translations.translation: We consider the foster care system to be a safe area for these children.
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.

translations.source: हमारा पालक देखभाल प्रणाली प्रदान करता है सुरक्षित घर, प्यार से भरा देखभाल, स्थिर शिक्षा और विश्वसनीय स्वास्थ्य देखभाल।
translations.translation: Our foster care system provides a safe home, loving care, stable education and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.

translations.source: फ़ॉस्टर केयर उन सभी तरह की ज़रूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए होते हैं जो उस घर में नहीं मिल रही थीं जहां से उन्हें लाया गया था.
translations.translation: Foster care is for all kinds of needs that were not available in the home where they were brought from.
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.

translations.source: इंटरनेट, लोगों और अंतर-परस्पर संचार, दोनों के तत्वों को मिलाता है.
translations.translation: The Internet, people and interpersonal communication, combines the elements of both.
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.

translations.source: इंटरनेट की अलग-अलग विशेषताएँ उपयोग और संतुष्टि के दृष्टिकोण के संदर्भ में अतिरिक्त आयामों की ओर ले जाती हैं.
translations.translation: The different characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of usage and satisfaction.
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.

translations.source: उदाहरण के लिए, “लर्निंग” और “सोशलाइजेशन” को इंटरनेट इस्तेमाल करने की अहम वजह के तौर पर बताया गया है (जेम्स एट अल., 1995).
translations.translation: For example, learning and socialization have been cited as a major reason for using the Internet (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: “जब ऐमी और मॅकॉर्ड (1998) ने वेबसाइटों पर दर्शकों की प्रतिक्रियाओं की जांच-पड़ताल की थी, तब “निजी भागीदारी” और “सतत संबंध” को भी प्रेरणा देने वाले नए पहलूओं के तौर पर पहचान हुई.
translations.translation: When Amy and McCord (1998) examined viewers' responses to websites, private partnership and direct relationships were also identified as inspiring new aspects.
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.

translations.source: माइक्रो-एक्सप्रेशन्स, फ़ेशियल मूवमेंट्स जिसमें कुछ मिलीसेकंड्स लगते हैं, उसकी व्याख्या करने में वीडियो रिकॉर्डिंग के इस्तेमाल ने महत्वपूर्ण खोजों को बढ़ावा दिया है.
translations.translation: The use of video recording to interpret micro-expressions, facial movements that take a few milliseconds, has led to important discoveries.
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.

translations.source: विशेष रूप से, यह दावा किया जाता है कि किसी व्यक्ति की सूक्ष्म अभिव्यक्तियों की सही व्याख्या करके यह समझा सकता है कि वह झूठ बोल रहा है या नहीं।
translations.translation: In particular, it is claimed that by correctly interpreting a person's subtle expressions it can explain whether he is lying or not.
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.

translations.source: ओलिवर सैक्स ने अपने पेपर द प्रेसिडेंट स्पीच में संकेत दिया कि कैसे जो लोग दिमागी नुकसान के कारण भाषण को समझ नहीं पाते हैं फिर भी वे ईमानदारी का सही आकलन कर पाते हैं.
translations.translation: In his paper The President's Speech, Oliver Sacks pointed out how people who don't understand speech because of a brain injury can still make an accurate assessment of honesty.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.

translations.source: वे यह भी सुझाव देते हैं कि मानव व्यवहार में व्याख्या करने की जो क्षमताएँ हैं उसे पालतू कुत्ते जैसे जानवर के ज़रिए भी शेयर किया जा सकता है.
translations.translation: They also suggest that the ability to interpret human behavior can also be shared by animals such as pet dogs.
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.

translations.source: बीसवीं सदी के शोध से पता चला है कि आनुवंशिक भिन्नता के दो पूल हैं: छुपा हुआ और अभिव्यक्त.
translations.translation: 20th-century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.

translations.source: उत्परिवर्तन नई आनुवंशिक भिन्नता जोड़ता है, और चयन इसे व्यक्त भिन्नता के पूल से निकाल देता है.
translations.translation: The mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection takes it out of the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.

translations.source: अलगाव और पुनर्संयोजन भिन्नता प्रत्येक पीढ़ी के साथ दो पूलों के बीच आगे-पीछे होती रहती है।
translations.translation: The separation and recombination variation continues back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.

translations.source: सवाना में, मानव जैसे पाचन तंत्र वाले प्राइमेट के लिए उसकी अमीनो-एसिड आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए उपलब्ध पौधे शायद कम पड़ें।
translations.translation: In Savannah, there may be a shortage of plants available to meet its amino acid requirements for a primate with a digestive system like a human.
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.

translations.source: इसके अतिरिक्ता, ऐसा करने में असफल होने के गंभीर परिणाम होते हैं: अवसाद बढ़ना, कुपोषण और अंततः मृत्यु।
translations.translation: In extreme cases, failure to do so has serious consequences: increased depression, malnutrition and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.

translations.source: पौधों से सबसे आसानी से मिलने वाले संसाधनों में पत्तियों और फलियों में मिलने वाले प्रोटीन होते, लेकिन हम जैसे प्राइमेट्स के लिए उसे पकाए बिना पचाना मुश्किल होता है.
translations.translation: The most readily available resources from plants are the proteins found in the leaves and berries, but primates like us have a hard time digesting them without cooking them.
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.

translations.source: इसके विपरीत, पशु खाद्य पदार्थ (चींटियाँ, दीमक, अंडे) न केवल आसानी से पचने योग्य होते हैं, बल्कि वे उच्च मात्रा में प्रोटीन प्रदान करते हैं जिसमें सभी ज़रूरी अमीनो एसिड होते हैं.
translations.translation: In contrast, animal foods (archs, larvae, eggs) are not only easily digestible, but they also provide a high amount of protein containing all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.

translations.source: अगर हमारे अपने पूर्वजों ने अपनी “प्रोटीन की समस्या” को कुछ हद तक उसी तरह सुलझाया, तो हमें आश्चर्यचकित नहीं होना चाहिए, जैसे कि आज के समय में चिंपाजी करते हैं।
translations.translation: If our ancestors solved their protein problem somewhat the same way, we should not be surprised, as chimpanzees do today.
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.

translations.source: नींद की रुकावट आपके सामान्य नींद की अवधि के दौरान आपको जगाने की प्रक्रिया है और थोड़े समय बाद (10-60 मिनट) यह चली जाती है ।
translations.translation: Sleep disruption is the process of waking you up during your normal sleep period and after a short time (10-60 minutes) it goes away.
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).

translations.source: पूरी तरह से जागे बिना आपको चेतना में लाने के लिए अपेक्षाकृत शांत अलार्म घड़ी का उपयोग करके इसे आसानी से किया जा सकता है।
translations.translation: This can be done easily by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without waking up completely.
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.

translations.source: यदि आप खुद को अपनी नींद में घड़ी को रीसेट करते हुए पाते हैं, तो इसे कमरे के दूसरी तरफ रखिये , जिससे आपको इसे बंद करने के लिए बिस्तर से मजबूरन उठना ही पड़ेगा ।
translations.translation: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, put it on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.

translations.source: अन्य बायोरैड-आधारित विकल्पों में सोने से पहले बहुत सारे तरल पदार्थ पीना (विशेष रूप से पानी या चाय, एक प्रचलित मूत्रवर्धक) शामिल है, जिससे व्यक्ति को मूत्र करने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ता है”.
translations.translation: Other biorad-based alternatives include drinking a lot of fluids before bed (especially water or tea, a popular urethral enhancer), forcing the person to urinate.
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.

translations.source: किसी व्यक्ति में जितनी आंतरिक शांति होती है वह उसके शरीर और आत्मा में मौजूद तनाव की मात्रा के विपरीत सहसंबंधित होती है.
translations.translation: The amount of inner peace a person has is inversely related to the amount of stress in his body and soul.
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.

translations.source: जितनी कम चिंता, उतनी ज़्यादा सकारात्मक जीवन ऊर्जा का संचार. हर इंसान परम शांति और संतोष पा सकता है.
translations.translation: The less anxiety, the more positive the communication of life energy. Every human being can find ultimate peace and contentment.
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.

translations.source: हर कोई ज्ञान प्राप्त कर सकता है। इस लक्ष्य के रास्ते में केवल एक चीज़ है वह है हमारा अपने तनाव और नकारात्मकता।
translations.translation: There is only one thing in the way of this goal is our own stress and negativity.
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.

translations.source: तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म बुद्ध की शिक्षाओं पर आधारित है, लेकिन प्रेम के महायान मार्ग और भारतीय योग से बहुत सारी तकनीकों द्वारा इसे बढ़ाया गया.
translations.translation: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of the Buddha, but it was enhanced by the great path of love and by many techniques of Indian yoga.
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.

translations.source: सैद्धांतिक रूप से तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म बहुत सरल है। इसमें कुंडलिनी योग, ध्यान और सभी को प्रेम से गले लगाने वाला मार्ग शामिल है।
translations.translation: In theory, Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It includes kundalini yoga, meditation and a path that embraces all with love.
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.

translations.source: कुंडलिनी योग के द्वारा कुंडलिनी ऊर्जा (ज्ञान ऊर्जा) को योग मुद्राओं, श्वास अभ्यास, मंत्रों और मानसदर्शन के माध्यम से जागृत किया जाता है।
translations.translation: Through Kundalini Yoga, the Kundalini energy (knowledge energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and mansa-darshan.
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.

translations.source: दैव योग तिब्बती ध्यान का केंद्र है. अलग-अलग देवताओं के चित्रण से ऊर्जा चैनलों को साफ़ किया जाता है, चक्रों को सक्रिय किया जाता है और आत्मज्ञान चेतना का निर्माण किया जाता है.
translations.translation: Divya Yoga is the center of Tibetan meditation. The depiction of different deities purifies the energy channels, activates the cycles and builds awareness.
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.

translations.source: यूएसएसआर और यूएसए के बीच सहयोग की अगुआई में, द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध में जर्मनी एक आम दुश्मन था. लड़ाई ख़त्म होने के साथ ही सिस्टम, प्रक्रिया और संस्कृति के टकरावों की वजह से देश टूटने लगे थे.
translations.translation: Under the leadership of the cooperation between the USSR and the USA, Germany was a common enemy in World War II. As the war ended, the country began to fall apart due to conflicts of systems, processes, and culture.
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.

translations.source: लड़ाई के आख़िरी दो सालों में, पहले के साथी अब दुश्मन बन गए थे और शीत युद्ध की शुरुआत हो चुकी थी.
translations.translation: In the last two years of the war, former allies had become enemies and the Cold War had begun.
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.

translations.source: इसे अगले 40 सालों तक चलना था और यह असली में, छद्म सेनाओं द्वारा, अफ़्रीका से लेकर एशिया तक की युद्धभूमियों पर, अफ़गानिस्तान, क्यूबा और दूसरी कई जगहों पर होना था.
translations.translation: It was to last for the next 40 years, and it was to take place in reality, by pseudo-armed forces, on the battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.

translations.source: 17 सितंबर, 1939 तक, पोलिश रक्षापंक्ति लगभग टूट चुकी थी, और एक अकेली उम्मीद थी पीछे हटना और फिर रोमानियाई ब्रिजहेड के साथ एकजुट होना.
translations.translation: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense line was almost broken, and the only hope was to retreat and then unite with the Romanian Bridgehead.
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.

translations.source: हालाँकि, लगभग रातों-रात इन योजनाओं को तब बनाया गया था जब सोवियत की यूनियन रेड आर्मी के 800,000 से ज़्यादा सैनिकों ने पोलैंड के पूर्वी क्षेत्रों पर हमला करने के बाद प्रवेश करते हुए बेलारूसी और यूक्रेनी मोर्चे खड़े कर दिए थे. उन्होंने यह रिगा शांति संधि, द सोवियत-पॉलिश नॉन-एग्रेशन पैक्ट और अन्य अंतरराष्ट्रीय द्विपक्षीय और बहुपक्षीय दोनों तरह की संधियों का उल्लंघन करते हुए किया था.
translations.translation: However, these plans were created overnight when more than 800,000 soldiers of the Soviet Union's Red Army had set up the Belarusian and Ukrainian front after invading the eastern regions of Poland, violating the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact and other international bilateral and multilateral treaties.
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.

translations.source: सामान के ट्रांसपोर्ट के लिए जहाज़ों का इस्तेमाल करना समुद्रों के एक सिरे से दूसरे सिरे तक बड़ी मात्रा में लोगों और सामान को लाने और ले जाने का बहुत ज़्यादा प्रभावी तरीका है.
translations.translation: The use of ships for the transport of goods is a much more efficient way of transporting and transporting large quantities of people and goods from one end of the sea to the other.
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.

translations.source: नौसेनाओं का काम पारंपरिक रूप से यह है कि अपने देश के लोगों और सामान को एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थानांतरण करने की क्षमता बनाए रखे ,और साथ ही अपने दुश्मन देश की लोगों और सामान को स्थानांतरण करने की क्षमता में हस्तक्षेप कर सकें |
translations.translation: The Navy's job is traditionally to maintain the ability to move people and goods from one place to another, and to interfere with the ability of your enemy to move people and goods from one place to another.
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.

translations.source: इसका सबसे उल्लेखनीय हालिया उदाहरण दूसरे विश्वयुद्ध का उत्तरी अटलांटिक अभियान था। अमेरिकी ब्रिटेन की सहायता करने के लिए अटलांटिक महासागर में सैनिकों और सामग्रियों को स्थानांतरित करने का प्रयास कर रहे थे।
translations.translation: The most notable recent example of this was the North Atlantic Campaign of World War II. The Americans were attempting to move troops and supplies into the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.

translations.source: इसके साथ ही जर्मन नौसेना मुख्य रूप से यू-बोट का इस्तेमाल करते हुए इस ट्रैफिक को रोकने की कोशिश कर रही थी।
translations.translation: At the same time, the German Navy was trying to stop this traffic, mainly using U - boats.
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.

translations.source: अगर मित्र राष्ट्र विफल हो जाते, तो जर्मनी शायद ब्रिटेन को पराजित कर देता क्योंकि उसके पास शेष यूरोप था.
translations.translation: If the Allies had failed, Germany would have probably defeated Britain because it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.

translations.source: माना जाता है कि ईरान की ज़ाग्रोस पहाड़ियों में 10,000 साल पहले बकरी पालन की शुरुआत हुई थी.
translations.translation: It is believed that goat breeding began 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: प्राचीन संस्कृतियों और जनजातियों ने दूध, बाल, मांस और चमड़े को अपनी आसान पहुँच में बनाए रखना शुरू कर दिया.
translations.translation: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep milk, hair, meat and leather within easy reach.
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.

translations.source: घरेलू बकरियों को आम तौर पर झुंडों में रखा जाता था जो पहाड़ियों या अन्य चरने वाले क्षेत्रों में घूमती थीं, अक्सर वे बकरियों के झुंड की तरफ जाती थीं जहां अक्सर बच्चे या किशोर होते थे, अधिक व्यापक रूप से ज्ञात चरवाहे के समान। झुंडों के ये तरीके आज भी इस्तेमाल किए जाते हैं।
translations.translation: Domestic goats were usually kept in herds that roamed the hills or other grazing areas, often going to a herd of goats where there were often children or adolescents, much like the more widely known shepherds. These herd methods are still used today.
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.

translations.source: वैगनवे 16 वीं शताब्दी की शुरुआत में इंग्लैंड में बनाए गए थे.
translations.translation: Wagonways were built in England in the early 16th century.
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.

translations.source: हालांकि, साधारण रूप से वैगनवे में लकड़ी से बने एकसमान तख्त लगे होते थे, लेकिन घोड़े उन्हें तेज़ गति से खींच सकते थे और उन दिनों के थोड़ी ज़्यादा ख़राब रास्तों पर ज़्यादा बड़े भार ले जाए जा सकते थे.
translations.translation: The wagonways, however, usually had the same wooden planks, but the horses could pull them at a faster rate and carry larger loads on the slightly more impoverished roads of the day.
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.

translations.source: पटरियों को उनके स्थान पर बनाए रखने के लिए क्रॉ्सटाई को काफी पहले व्यवहार में लाया गया था। लेकिन धीरे-धीरे यह महसूस हुआ कि अगर पटरियों ऊपर लोहे की पत्ती हो तो वे ज्यादा दक्ष होंगी।
translations.translation: Crosstying was introduced a long time ago to keep the tracks in their place, but it was gradually realized that if the tracks were to have a sheet of iron above them, they would be more efficient.
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.

translations.source: यह आम बात हो गई, लेकिन लोहे वाहनों के लकड़ी के पहियों पर अधिक घिसन करते थे।
translations.translation: This became commonplace, but the wooden wheels of iron vehicles tended to slide more.
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

translations.source: आख़िरकार, लोहे के पहियों ने लकड़ी के पहियों की जगह ले ली. 1767 में, पूरी तरह लोहे से बनी रेल की शुरुआत हो गई.
translations.translation: Eventually, iron wheels replaced wooden wheels. In 1767, a railway made entirely of iron was introduced.
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.

translations.source: पहला ज्ञात परिवहन पैदल चलना था, इंसानों ने होमो इरेक्टस (यानी अपराइट मैन) के उद्भव के साथ बीस लाख साल पहले पैदल चलने की शुरुआत की थी.
translations.translation: The first known transportation was walking, with the advent of Homo erectus (i.e. untamed man) two and a half million years ago.
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).

translations.source: उनके पूर्वज, ऑस्ट्रलोपिथेकस आदतन सीधा नहीं चलते थे।
translations.translation: His ancestors, the Australopithecus, did not usually walk straight.
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.

translations.source: 4.2 से 3.9 मिलियन वर्ष पूर्व से आस्ट्रेलोपोपिथेकस जीवाश्मो में बाइपैडल विशेषज्ञत पाई जाती है हालांकि हो सकता है 7 मिलियन वर्ष पहले से सहेंथ्रोपस दो पैरों पर चल सकता था |
translations.translation: Bipedals are known to have been found in the Australopithecus fossil from 4.2 to 3.9 million years ago, but it's possible that by 7 million years ago, the synthropus could have walked on two legs.
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.

translations.source: हम पर्यावरण के साथ ज़्यादा दोस्ताना तरीके से रहना शुरू कर सकते हैं, इसके लिए पर्यावरण आंदोलन में शामिल हो सकते हैं, और हम भविष्य को कुछ हद तक कष्ट से बचाने के लिए पर्यावरण कार्यकर्ता भी बन सकते हैं.
translations.translation: We can start to be more environmentally friendly, we can join the environmental movement, and we can also become environmental activists to save the future a little bit of trouble.
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.

translations.source: यह कई मामलों में रोगसूचक उपचार की तरह ही है। हालाँकि, अगर हम केवल अस्थायी समाधान नहीं चाहते हैं, तो हमें समस्याओं की जड़ को ढूँढ कर उन्हें निष्क्रिय करना चाहिए।
translations.translation: It is similar in many respects to pathological treatment. However, if we do not want only temporary solutions, we should find the root of the problems and turn them off.
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.

translations.source: यह अत्यंत स्पष्ट है कि मानव जाति की वैज्ञानिक और तकनीकी प्रगति के कारण दुनिया बहुत बदल गई है, तथा अधिक जनसंख्या और मानव जाति की अतिव्ययी जीवन शैली के कारण समस्याएँ बढ़ गई हैं।
translations.translation: It is very clear that the world has changed greatly because of the scientific and technological advances of mankind, and the problems caused by the increased population and the excessive lifestyle of mankind have increased.
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.

translations.source: 4 जुलाई को कांग्रेस द्वारा अपनाए जाने के बाद, एक हाथ से लिखे गए मसौदे पर कांग्रेस के अध्यक्ष जॉन हैनकॉक और सचिव चार्ल्स थ्रॉन द्वारा हस्ताक्षर किये गए थे, फिर इसे कुछ ब्लॉक दूर जॉन डनलप की प्रिंटिंग की दुकान पर भेजा गया था.
translations.translation: After being adopted by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft was signed by Congress President John Hancock and Secretary Charles Thron, then sent to John Dunlap's printing shop a few blocks away.
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.

translations.source: रात के समय 150 और 200 के बीच प्रतियों बनती है , जिन्हे अब “डनलप ब्रॉडसाइड्स” के रूप में जाना जाता है।
translations.translation: Between 150 and 200 copies were made at night, which are now known as Dunnelup broadsides.
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".

translations.source: जॉन निक्सन द्वारा डॉक्यूमेंट की पहली पब्लिक रीडिंग 8 जुलाई को इंडिपेंडेंस हॉल के यार्ड में की गई थी.
translations.translation: The first public reading of the document by John Nixon took place on July 8 in the yard of Independence Hall.
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.

translations.source: उनमें से एक जॉर्ज वाशिंगटन को 6 जुलाई को भेजा गया, जिसने कि इसको अपनी सेना के लिए न्यूयॉर्क में 9 जुलाई को पढ़ा। उसकी एक कॉपी 10 अगस्त को लंदन पहुंची।
translations.translation: One of them was sent to George Washington on 6 July, who read it to his army in New York on 9 July. A copy arrived in London on 10 August.
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.

translations.source: मौजूदा 25 डनलप ब्रॉडसाइड अब तक बची हुई सबसे पुरानी कॉपी के डॉक्यूमेंट हैं. हाथ से लिखी गई मूल कॉपी सहेजी नहीं जा सकी है.
translations.translation: The current 25 Dunlop broadsides are the oldest surviving copy documents. The original handwritten copy could not be saved.
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.

translations.source: कई जीवाश्म विज्ञानी आज भी यह मानते हैं कि डायनासोर का एक समूह लुप्त होने से बच गया और वह आज भी जीवित है, उन्हें हम पक्षी कहते हैं।
translations.translation: Many fossilologists still believe that a group of dinosaurs survived extinction and are still alive today, which we call birds.
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.

translations.source: उनके पंख और उड़ने की वजह से कई लोग उनको डायनासोर नहीं मानते.
translations.translation: Because of their wings and their ability to fly, many people don't think of them as dinosaurs.
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.

translations.source: लेकिन उन पक्षियों के बारे में बहुत सी चीजें हैं जो अभी भी डायनासोर जैसे दिखते हैं।
translations.translation: But there are a lot of things about these birds that still look like dinosaurs.
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.

translations.source: उनके पैरों में पपड़ियाँ और पंजे हैं, वे अंडे देते हैं, और वे किसी टी-रेक्स की तरह अपने दो पीछे वाले पैरों पर चलते हैं.
translations.translation: They have claws and claws in their legs, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two hind legs like a T-rex.
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.

translations.source: आजकल उपयोग किए जाने वाले सभी कंप्यूटर, जानकारी के हेरफेर पर आधारित हैं इन्हें बाइनरी नंबर के रूप में कोड किया गया है.
translations.translation: All computers used nowadays are based on the manipulation of information, they are encoded as binary numbers.
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.

translations.source: किसी बाइनरी संख्या में दो में से एक ही मान हो सकता है, यानी 0 या 1, और इन संख्याओं को ही बाइनरी अंक - या कंप्यूटर की शब्दावली में बिट कहा जाता है.
translations.translation: A binary number can have the same value as two, i.e. 0 or 1, and these same numbers are called binary numbers - or bits in computer terminology.
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.

translations.source: अंदरूनी विषाक्तता का तुरंत पता नहीं चलता है. इसके लक्षण सामान्य होते हैं जैसे कि उल्टी आना, इसलिए इसका तुरंत निदान नहीं किया जा सकता है.
translations.translation: Internal toxicity is not immediately detected. Its symptoms are normal such as nausea, so it cannot be diagnosed immediately.
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.

translations.source: इंटरनल पॉइज़निंग का सबसे अच्छा लक्षण दवाई या विषैले घरेलू रसायनों के खुले डिब्बे की मौजूदगी हो सकती है.
translations.translation: The best symptom of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medicines or toxic household chemicals.
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.

translations.source: उस विशेष जहर के लिए विशेष प्राथमिक चिकित्सा निर्देशों के लिए लेबल को देखेंं।
translations.translation: For specific first aid instructions for that particular poison, see the label.
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.

translations.source: कीटविज्ञानियों द्वारा बग शब्द का उपयोग कीटों के इस समूह के लिए एक औपचारिक तौर पर किया जाता है।
translations.translation: The word bug is used by entomologists as a formal term for this group of insects.
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.

translations.source: मानवों पर आश्रित सबसे ज़्यादा अनुकूलतम कीट खटमल के साथ पुरानी समानता से यह परिभाषा बनी है.
translations.translation: This definition is based on an ancient resemblance to the most adaptable insect to which humans rely.
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.

translations.source: गुप्तघाती कीड़े और खटमल दोनों नीडवासी होते हैं, जो घोसले या होस्ट के घर में बिना किसी परेशानी के रह सकते हैं.
translations.translation: Insect bites and bats are both nest - dwellers, who can live in the house of the host or in the house of the host without any problem.
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.

translations.source: पूरे संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में, मल्टीपल स्केलेरोसिस (MS) के लगभग 400,000 ज्ञात मामले हैं, जो युवा और मध्यम आयु वर्ग के वयस्कों में प्रमुख न्यूरोलॉजिकल बीमारी है.
translations.translation: Across the United States, there are about 400,000 known cases of multiple sclerosis (MS), a major neurological disease in young and middle-aged adults.
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.

translations.source: MS, बीमारी केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र पर असर करती है, जिसमें दिमाग, स्पाइनल कॉर्ड और ऑप्टिक नर्व शामिल हैं.
translations.translation: MS affects the central nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, and optic nerve.
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.

translations.source: शोध में पाया गया है कि महिलाओं में पुरुषों की तुलना में एमएस होने की संभावना दो गुना अधिक होती है।
translations.translation: Research has found that women are twice as likely to have MS as men.
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.

translations.source: एक दंपत्ति फैसला ले सकता है कि यह उनके या उनके बच्चे के हित में बिलकुल नहीं है कि एक दूसरा बच्चा किया जाए |
translations.translation: A couple may decide that it is not in their or their child's best interest to have another child.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.

translations.source: ये जोड़े अपने बच्चे के लिए गोद लेने की योजना बनाने का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं.
translations.translation: These couples can choose to plan for their child's adoption.
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.

translations.source: गोद लेने की प्रक्रिया में, जन्म देने वाले माता-पिता अपने अभिभावकीय अधिकार ख़त्म कर देते हैं ताकि कोई दूसरा जोड़ा बच्चे का अभिभावक बन सके.
translations.translation: In the process of adoption, the parents giving birth terminate their parental rights so that another couple can become the guardian of the child.
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.

translations.source: विज्ञान का मुख्य लक्ष्य वैज्ञानिक पद्धति के माध्यम से दुनिया के काम करने के तरीके का पता लगाना है। वास्तव में अधिकांश वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधानों इस विधि पर निर्धारित हैं |
translations.translation: The main goal of science is to figure out how the world works through the scientific method. In fact, most scientific research is based on this method.
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.

translations.source: हालाँकि यह अकेला नहीं है, प्रयोग करना, और प्रयोग एक ऐसा परीक्षण होता है जिसका इस्तेमाल करके एक या इससे ज़्यादा संभावित परिकल्पनाओं को ख़त्म करने, सवाल करने, और अवलोकन करने से भी वैज्ञानिक शोध को मार्गदर्शन मिलता है.
translations.translation: While it's not alone, experimentation and experimentation is a test that uses one or more possible hypotheses to eliminate, question, and observe to provide guidance for scientific research.
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.

translations.source: प्रकृतिवादियों और दार्शनिकों ने शास्त्रीय ग्रंथों पर और विशेष रूप से लैटिन में लिखे बाइबिल पर ध्यान दिया।
translations.translation: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts, especially the Bible, written in Latin.
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.

translations.source: मनोविज्ञान सहित विज्ञान के सभी मामलों पर अरस्तू के विचारों को स्वीकार किया जाता है।
translations.translation: Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology, are accepted.
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.

translations.source: जैसे-जैसे ग्रीक का ज्ञान घटता गया, पश्चिम ने खुद को अपनी ग्रीक दार्शनिक और वैज्ञानिक जड़ों से कटा हुआ पाया.
translations.translation: As Greek knowledge declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.

translations.source: काफी लोगो में यह देखा गया है शारीरिक विज्ञान और व्यवहार में, अक्सर अंतर्जात चक्रों की उपस्थिति जैविक घड़ियों के माध्यम और उनके उत्पादन पर निर्भर करते हैं।
translations.translation: It has been observed in many people in physiology and practice, often the presence of inborn cycles depends on the means of biological clocks and their production.
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.

translations.source: ऐसी सामयिक लय जो सिर्फ़ बाहरी सामयिक संकेतों की प्रतिक्रियाएँ नहीं हैं, को बैक्टीरिया, कवक, पौधों और जानवरों सहित ज़्यादातर जीवित प्राणियों के लिए दर्ज किया गया है.
translations.translation: Simultaneous rhythms that are not just responses to external temporal signals have been recorded for most living organisms, including bacteria, fungi, plants and animals.
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

translations.source: जैविक घड़ियां आत्मनिर्भर ऑसिलेटर हैं जो बाहरी संकेतों के अभाव में भी मुक्त चलने वाले साइकिल को एक अवधि तक जारी रखेंगे।
translations.translation: Biological clocks are self-sustaining oscillators that will continue to cycle freely for a period of time, even in the absence of external signals.
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.

translations.source: हर्शे और चेस के परीक्षण का एक प्रमुख सुझाव था कि DNA एक जेनेटिक मटेरियल था.
translations.translation: One of the key suggestions of the Hershey and Chase tests was that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.

translations.source: हर्शे और चेज़ ने अपने डीएनए को एक जीवाणु में डालने के लिए फेज या वायरस का इस्तेमाल किया.
translations.translation: Hershey and Chase used a phase, or virus, to insert their DNA into a bacterium.
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.

translations.source: उन्होंने डीएनए को रेडियोएक्टिव फॉस्फोरस के साथ विभोजी में करने या विभोजी के प्रोटीन को रेडियोधर्मी सल्फर के साथ चिह्नित करते हुए दो प्रयोग किए।
translations.translation: He conducted two experiments in which DNA was dissolved with radioactive phosphorus or the dissolved protein was marked with radioactive sulfur.
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.

translations.source: म्यूटेशन की किस्मों, प्रभावित जेनेटिक मटेरियल के टुकड़े का महत्व और इस बात पर कि क्या प्रभावित सेल्स जर्म-लाइन सेल्स हैं, इसके आधार पर म्यूटेशन का कई तरह से अलग-अलग प्रभाव होता है.
translations.translation: Depending on the types of mutations, the importance of the affected piece of genetic material and whether the affected cells are germline cells, mutations have a variety of different effects.
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.

translations.source: केवल जर्म-लाइन कोशिकाओं में वृद्धि बच्चों तक पहुँच सकती है जबकि अन्य कहीं होने वाली वृद्धि से कोशिकाएँ नष्ट हो सकती हैं या कैंसर हो सकता है.
translations.translation: Only germline cell growth can reach children whereas other growths can destroy cells or lead to cancer.
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.

translations.source: प्रकृति आधारित पर्यटन, प्राकृतिक दृश्यों को देखने में रूचि रखने वाले लोगों को आकर्षित करने के उद्देश्य से आकर्षित करता है, जिसमें पौधे और पशु वन्यजीव शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: Nature-based tourism, with the aim of attracting people interested in seeing natural landscapes, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.

translations.source: ऑन साइट गतिविधियों के उदाहरणों में शामिल है शिकार, मछली पकड़ना, फोटोग्राफी, बर्ड वॉचिंग और पार्कों का दौरा करना और पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के बारे में जानकारी का अध्ययन करना।
translations.translation: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, birdwatching and visiting parks and studying information about ecosystems.
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.

translations.source: बॉर्नियो में जाना, फोटोग्राफी करना, और औरैंगउटान के बारे में जानना एक उदाहरण है.
translations.translation: Going to Borneo, taking photographs, and knowing about Aurangutan is an example.
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.

translations.source: काम पर जाने के लिए अपनी गाड़ियों से छोटे शहरो को छोड़ देते हैं और दूसरों द्वारा पारित किया गया काम की स्थान है जो उन्होंने अभी छोड़ी है।
translations.translation: They leave the small towns by their cars to go to work and have passed the workplace that they have just left.
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.

translations.source: इस गतिशील परिवहन शटल में हर कोई किसी न किसी तरह से जुड़ा हुआ है, और निजी कारों पर आधारित परिवहन प्रणाली का समर्थन करता है.
translations.translation: In this dynamic transport shuttle, everyone is connected in some way, and supports a transportation system based on private cars.
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.

translations.source: विज्ञान अब यह संकेत देता है कि इस विशाल कार्बन अर्थव्यवस्था ने जीवमंडल को उसकी स्थिर स्थितियों में से एक से हटा दिया है जिसने पिछले बीस लाख सालों में मानव विकास में सहायता की है.
translations.translation: Science now indicates that this vast carbon economy has removed the biosphere from one of its stable conditions that has assisted human development over the past two and a half million years.
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.

translations.source: हर कोई समाज से जुड़ा होता है और ट्रांसपोर्ट सिस्टम का उपयोग करता है. लगभग सभी लोग ट्रांसपोर्ट सिस्टम के बारे में शिकायत करते हैं.
translations.translation: Everyone is connected to society and uses the transportation system. Almost everyone complains about the transportation system.
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.

translations.source: विकसित देशों में आप शायद ही कभी पानी की गुणवत्ता या पुलों के गिरने की मिलते-जुलते स्तरों वाली शिकायतें सुनते हैं.
translations.translation: In developed countries, you rarely hear the same level of complaints about the quality of water or the collapse of bridges.
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.

translations.source: परिवहन प्रणाली ऐसी शिकायतों को क्यों बढ़ावा देती है? वे हर दिन क्यों पिछड़ जाते हैं? क्या परिवहन इंजीनियर काबिल नहीं हैं? या इस प्रणाली में कोई और बड़ी गड़बड़ी है?
translations.translation: Why is the transportation system promoting such complaints? Why are they falling behind every day? Are transportation engineers not qualified?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?

translations.source: यातायात बहाव दो बिंदुओं के बीच व्यक्तिगत चालकों और वाहनों की गतिविधि और एक दूसरे के साथ की जाने वाली पारस्परिक क्रिया का अध्ययन है।
translations.translation: Traffic flow is the study of the activity and interaction of individual drivers and vehicles between two points.
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.

translations.source: दुर्भाग्य से, ट्रैफ़िक फ़्लो का अध्ययन करना मुश्किल होता है क्योंकि ड्राइवर के व्यवहार का सौ प्रतिशत निश्चितता के साथ पहले से अनुमान नहीं लगाया जा सकता है.
translations.translation: Unfortunately, it is difficult to study traffic flow because the driver's behavior cannot be predicted with one hundred percent certainty.
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.

translations.source: सौभाग्य से, ड्राइवर एक उचित सुसंगत सीमा के भीतर चलते हैं; इस प्रकार, ट्रैफ़िक स्ट्रीम में कुछ उचित स्थिरता होती है और मोटे तौर पर गणितीय रूप से इसे दिखाया जा सकता है.
translations.translation: Fortunately, drivers move within a reasonable consistent range; thus, the traffic stream has some reasonable consistency and can be shown roughly mathematically.
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.

translations.source: यातायात प्रवाह को बेहतर तरीके से दिखाने के लिए, तीन मुख्य विशेषताओं में संबंद्ध बनाया गया है: (1) प्रवाह, (2) घनत्व, और (3) वेग।
translations.translation: In order to better show traffic flow, three main characteristics are correlated: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.

translations.source: यह संबंध प्लानिंग, डिज़ाइनिंग और रोडवे फ़ैसिलिटीज़ के ऑपरेशन्स में मदद करते हैं.
translations.translation: These links help in the planning, design and operation of roadway facilities.
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.

translations.source: कीड़े हवा में उड़ने वाले पहले जानवर थे। उड़ान भरने की उनकी क्षमता ने उन्हें दुश्मनों को अधिक आसानी से बचने में मदद की और भोजन और साथी को अधिक कुशलता से पाने में भी।
translations.translation: Insects were the first animals to fly in the air. Their ability to fly helped them to avoid enemies more easily and to get food and companions more efficiently.
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.

translations.source: ज़्यादातर कीटों को अपने पंख को वापस अपने शरीर पर ओढ़ लेने का फायदा होता है।
translations.translation: Most insects have the advantage of putting their wings back on their bodies.
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.

translations.source: यह उन्हें शिकारियों से छिपने के लिए छोटे स्थानों की एक बहुत बड़ी श्रृंखला देता है।
translations.translation: This gives them a very large range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.

translations.source: वर्तमान में, जो कीड़े अपने पंखों को वापस नहीं मोड़ सकते हैं उनमें केवल ड्रैगनफ़्लाई और मेफलीज़ हैं.
translations.translation: Currently, the insects that can't turn their wings back have only dragonflies and mephalizes.
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.

translations.source: हज़ारों साल पहले, एरिस्टार्चस नामक एक व्यक्ति ने कहा था कि सौर मंडल सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमता है।
translations.translation: Thousands of years ago, a man named Aristarchus said that the solar system revolves around the sun.
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.

translations.source: कुछ लोगों ये सोचते थे की कि वह सही था लेकिन बहुत से लोग इसके विपरीत मानते थे; की सौर मंडल सूर्य (और यहां तक कि अन्य सितारों) सहित पृथ्वी के चारों और चक्कर लगता था ।
translations.translation: Some people thought that he was right, but many believed the opposite; that the solar system revolved around the earth, including the sun (and even other stars).
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).

translations.source: यह तर्कसंगत लग रहा है, क्योंकि ऐसा महसूस नहीं होता है कि पृथ्वी चल रही है, है कि नहीं?
translations.translation: It seems logical, because it doesn't feel like the Earth is moving, does it?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?

translations.source: अमेज़न नदी धरती की दूसरी सबसे लंबी और सबसे बड़ी नदी है. इसमें दूसरी सबसे बड़ी नदी से 8 गुना से भी ज़्यादा पानी है.
translations.translation: The Amazon River is the second longest and largest river on Earth. It has more than eight times the water volume of the second largest river.
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.

translations.source: अमेज़न धरती की सबसे चौड़ी नदी भी है, जो कभी-कभी छह मील जितनी चौड़ी हो जाती है.
translations.translation: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, sometimes as wide as six miles.
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.

translations.source: हमारे ग्रह की नदियों से महासागरों में जाने वाले पानी का 20% हिस्सा अमेज़न से आता है।
translations.translation: 20% of the water from our planet's rivers to our oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.

translations.source: मुख्य आमेजन नदी 6,387 किमी (3,980 मील) लंबी है। इसमें हजारों छोटी नदियां मिलती हैं।
translations.translation: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 mi) long, draining thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.

translations.source: हालाँकि, पुराने साम्राज्य के अंत तक पत्थर से पिरामिड निर्माण जारी रहा, कभी भी गीज़ा के पिरामिड के आकार और उनके निर्माण की तकनीकी उत्कृष्टता को पार नहीं किया जा सका।
translations.translation: However, the construction of stone pyramids continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, never exceeding the size of the Giza pyramids and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.

translations.source: न्यू किंगडम प्राचीन मिस्रवासी अपने पूर्ववर्तियों के स्मारकों से आश्चर्यचकित थे, जो तब एक हज़ार वर्ष से अधिक पुराने थे।
translations.translation: The New Kingdom the ancient Egyptians were amazed at the monuments of their predecessors, who were then more than a thousand years old.
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.

translations.source: वेटिकन सिटी की जनसंख्या लगभग 800 है. यह विश्व का सबसे कम जनसंख्या वाला सबसे छोटा स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र है.
translations.translation: Vatican City has a population of about 800. It is the least populous independent nation in the world.
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.

translations.source: वैटिकन सिटी अपने कानूनी और आधिकारिक संचार में इतालवी का उपयोग करता है।
translations.translation: Vatican City uses Italian in its legal and official communications.
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.

translations.source: इटैलियन भी रोज़ाना इस्तेमाल होने वाली भाषा है जिसे राज्य में काम करने वाले अधिकांश लोग उपयोग में लाते हैं, जबकि लेटिन का धार्मिक रस्मों में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है.
translations.translation: Italian is also a daily language used by most of the people working in the state, while Latin is used in religious ceremonies.
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.

translations.source: वेटिकन सिटी के सभी नागरिक रोमन कैथोलिक हैं.
translations.translation: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholics.
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.

translations.source: प्राचीनकाल से ही लोग सोने, चाँदी, और तांबे जैसे रासायनिक तत्वों के बारे में ही जानकारी रखते हैं, क्योंकि इन्हें प्रकृति में मूल स्वरूप में ढूँढा जा सकता है और इन्हें प्राथमिक उपकरणों के ज़रिए ढूँढना अपेक्षाकृत आसान है.
translations.translation: Since ancient times, people have been familiar with chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper, because they can be found in nature in their original form and are relatively easy to find through primary means.
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.

translations.source: अरस्तू, एक दार्शनिक, ने सिद्ध किया कि सब कुछ एक या चार तत्वों के मिश्रण से बना है. वे पृथ्वी, जल, वायु और अग्नि थे.
translations.translation: Aristotle, a philosopher, proved that everything is made of a mixture of one or four elements: earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.

translations.source: यह ज़्यादातर पदार्थ की चार स्थितियों जैसा ही था (उसी क्रम में): ठोस, तरल, गैस, और प्लाज़्मा, हालाँकि उन्होंने यह सिद्धांत भी स्थापित किया कि हमें जो दिखाई देता है वे उससे भी नए पदार्थों में बदल जाते हैं.
translations.translation: It was the same as the four states of most matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, although he also established the theory that they change into new matter even more than what we see.
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.

translations.source: मिश्रधातु मूल रूप से दो या अधिक धातुओं का मिश्रण होते हैं। यह न भूलें कि आवर्त सारणी पर कई तत्व हैं।
translations.translation: An alloy is basically a mixture of two or more metals. Do not forget that there are many elements in the periodic table.
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.

translations.source: कैल्शियम और पोटैशियम जैसे तत्वों को धातु माना जाता है। बेशक, चांदी और सोने जैसी धातुएं भी हैं।
translations.translation: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.

translations.source: आप मिश्रित धातुएँ भी ले सकते हैं जिनमें कार्बन जैसे नॉन-मैटेलिक एलिमेंट्स की छोटी मात्रा शामिल हो.
translations.translation: You can also take alloys that contain a small amount of non-metallic elements such as carbon.
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.

translations.source: ब्रह्मांड की सभी वस्तुएँ पदार्थ से बनी हैं. सारे पदार्थ सूक्ष्तम कणों से बनें हैं, जिन्हें अणु कहा जाता है.
translations.translation: All things in the universe are made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called molecules.
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.

translations.source: परमाणु अविश्वसनीय रूप से इतने छोटे हैं कि वे खरबों की संख्या में वाक्य के अंत में लगने वाले बिंदु में फिट हो सकते हैं।
translations.translation: Atoms are so incredibly small that they can fit into trillions of numbers at the end of a sentence.
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.

translations.source: इस प्रकार, जब पेंसिल आई तो यह कई लोगों के लिए एक अच्छी दोस्त थी.
translations.translation: So, when the pencil came in, it was a good friend for a lot of people.
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.

translations.source: अफ़सोस की बात यह है कि जैसे-जैसे लिखने के नए-नए तरीके विकसित हुए हैं, वैसे-वैसे पेंसिल की स्थिति और इस्तेमाल कमतर होते गए हैं.
translations.translation: Unfortunately, as new ways of writing have evolved, the pencil's condition and use have diminished.
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.

translations.source: लोग अब कंप्यूटर स्क्रीन पर संदेश लिखते हैं, शार्पनर का उपयोग करने की आवश्यकता नहीं पड़ती।
translations.translation: People now write messages on a computer screen, no need to use a sharpener.
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.

translations.source: अभी कोई यह नहीं सोच सकता की कुछ नया आने से कीबोर्ड क्या बन जायेगा |
translations.translation: There's no way of thinking about what a new thing is going to be like on a keyboard.
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.

translations.source: विखंडन बम इस सिद्धांत पर काम करता है कि कई प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन वाले एक नाभिक को एक साथ रखने के लिए ऊर्जा लगती है।
translations.translation: The fission bomb operates on the principle that it takes energy to hold a nucleus of many protons and neutrons together.
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.

translations.source: जैसे किसी भारी गाड़ी को पहाड़ पर रोल करके चढ़ाया जा रहा हो. न्यूक्लियस को फिर से विभाजित करना और उसमें से कुछ ऊर्जा निकालना.
translations.translation: It's like rolling a heavy car over a mountain, re-splitting the nucleus and extracting some of the energy from it.
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.

translations.source: कुछ अणुओं में अस्थिर केंद्रक होता है, जिसका मतलब यह है कि उनमें थोड़े या बिना किसी झटके से टूटने की प्रवृत्ति होती है,
translations.translation: Some molecules have unstable centers, which means they have a tendency to break up with little or no shock.
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.

translations.source: चांद की सतह चट्टानों और धूल से बनी है. चांद की बाहरी परत को क्रस्ट कहते हैं.
translations.translation: The surface of the moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the moon is called the crust.
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.

translations.source: सबसे नज़दीकी सिरे पर क्रस्ट की मोटाई करीब 70 किलोमीटर है और सबसे दूर के सिरे पर यह 100 किलोमीटर है.
translations.translation: The thickness of the crust at the nearest end is about 70 kilometers and at the farthest end it is 100 kilometers.
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.

translations.source: यह समुद्र के नीचे पतला और ऊँचे क्षेत्रों के नीचे मोटा होता है।
translations.translation: It is thin under the sea and thick under the high ground.
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.

translations.source: पपड़ी पतली होने के कारण आस-पास पर कई मारिया होंगी. लावा के लिए सतह पर बढ़ना आसान था.
translations.translation: Due to the fact that the crest is thin, there will be many marria around. It was easy for the lava to grow on the surface.
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.

translations.source: सामग्री के सिद्धांत यह खोजने पर केंद्रित है कि लोगों को क्या टिक करता है या उन्हें क्या आाकर्षित करता है।
