translations.translation: If an individual has any information, he or she can inform the DM at @MerPolCC, or call 101, or contact him or her anonymously at 0800 555 111 by referring to log 247 dated 30 September.
translations.reference: Anyone with information is asked to DM @MerPolCC, call 101 or contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111 quoting log 247 of 30th September.

translations.source: संसद के सामने बनी क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति हाल ही में सबसे मशहूर स्मारक बन गई, इसे ‘इतिहास’ में फिर से दर्ज़ किया गया
translations.translation: The statue of Cromwell, erected in front of Parliament, has recently become the most famous monument, it was re-recorded in history.
translations.reference: Parliament's statue of Cromwell becomes latest memorial hit by 'rewriting history' row

translations.source: इसका निर्वासन उनके कट्टरपंथी प्यूरिंटन अनुयायियों द्वारा बनाई गई इंग्लैंड की कई सारी सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक कलाकृतियों के उसके तालिबान जैसे विनाश के लिए आदर्श न्याय होगा।
translations.translation: Its expulsion would be the ideal justice for its Taliban-like destruction of many of England's cultural and religious artifacts created by its radical Puritan followers.
translations.reference: Its banishment would be poetic justice for his Taliban-like destruction of so many of England's cultural and religious artefacts carried out by his fanatical Puritan followers.

translations.source: लेकिन, क्रॉमवेल सोसायटी ने "मूर्खतापूर्ण" और "इतिहास को दुबारा लिखने की कोशिश" के तौर पर मि. क्रिक के सुझाव के बारे में बताया।
translations.translation: But the Cromwell Society described Mr. Crick's suggestion as "ridiculous" and "an attempt to rewrite history".
translations.reference: But the Cromwell Society described Mr Crick's suggestion as "folly" and "attempting to rewrite history."

translations.source: क्रॉमवेल सोसायटी के चेयरमैन जॉन गोल्डस्मिथ ने कहा: "मूर्तियों को हटाने पर चल रही मौजूदा बहस में इस बात की पूरी आशंका थी कि पैलेस ऑफ़ वेस्टमिंस्टर के बाहर ओलिवर क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति को निशाना बनाया जाएगा।
translations.translation: John Goldsmith, Chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "In the current debate on the removal of the statues, there was widespread fear that the statue of Oliver Cromwell would be targeted outside the Palace of Westminster.
translations.reference: John Goldsmith, chairman of the Cromwell Society, said: "It was inevitable in the present debate about the removal of statues that the figure of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster would become a target.

translations.source: इंग्लिश सिविल वार के प्रतीक चिह्न के लिए न तो कोई आदेश दिया गया था और न ही क्रॉमवेल ने इसे बनवाया।
translations.translation: The emblem of the English Civil War was neither ordered nor built by Cromwell.
translations.reference: The iconoclasm of the English civil wars was neither ordered nor carried out by Cromwell.

translations.source: यह गलत हो सकता है कि पिछली सदी में अपने पूर्वज थॉमस के कामों के लिए क्रॉमवेल ने त्याग किया होगा।
translations.translation: It may be wrong to think that Cromwell sacrificed himself to the works of his ancestor Thomas in the last century.
translations.reference: Perhaps the wrong Cromwell would be sacrificed for the actions of his ancestor Thomas in the previous century.

translations.source: सर विलियम हेमो थोरोक्रॉफ्ट के अनुसार क्रॉमवेल का बेहतरीन प्रतिनिधित्व 19वीं सदी के विचार और एक ऐसी मूर्ति के इतिहास के भाग का साक्ष्य है, जिसे कई लोग अभी भी प्रशंसा करने योग्य मानते हैं।
translations.translation: The best representation of Cromwell is evidence of a 19th - century idea and part of the history of a statue that many still consider to be commendable, according to Sir William Hemo Thorecroft.
translations.reference: Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft's magnificent representation of Cromwell is evidence of 19th century opinion and part of the historiography of a figure who many believe is still worth celebrating.

translations.source: द संडे टेलीग्राफ को मि. गोल्डस्मिथ ने बताया: "क्रॉमवेल का सम्मान कई लोग करते हैं, शायद इसी वजह से ज़्यादातर लोग आज भी 19वीं सदी के अंत में राजशाही के मामले में उन्हें बाहरी दबावों के विरुद्ध खड़े संसद के रक्षक के तौर पर जानते हैं।
translations.translation: "Cromwell is revered by many", Mr. Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph, "and perhaps that is why most people still know him as the protector of the parliament in the late 19th century when it came to monarchy.
translations.reference: Mr Goldsmith told The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell is regarded by many, perhaps more in the late 19th century than today, as a defender of parliament against external pressure, in his case of course the monarchy.

translations.source: फिर भी, उन्हें बिल्कुल सटीक प्रतिनिधि माना जाता है, जो ऐतिहासिक रूप से बहस का विषय बना हुआ है।
translations.translation: Nevertheless, they are considered an exact representative, which has historically remained a subject of debate.
translations.reference: Whether that is a wholly accurate representation is the subject of continuing historical debate.

translations.source: यह तो जाहिर है कि 17वीं सदी के मध्य में हुए संघर्ष के बाद से हमारे राष्ट्र का विकास होता आ रहा है, और क्रॉमवेल की मूर्ति निजी पहचान बनी हुई है जिसमें उस विभाजन के एक पक्ष की झलक दिखती है।
translations.translation: It is obvious that our nation has been evolving since the conflict of the mid-17th century, and Cromwell's statue remains a personal identity that reflects one side of the divide.
translations.reference: What is certain is that the conflict of the mid 17th century has shaped the subsequent development of our nation, and Cromwell is an individual recognisable figure who represents one side of that divide.

translations.source: लॉर्ड प्रोटेक्टर के तौर पर उनकी उपलब्धियां प्रशंसनीय और याद रखने योग्य हैं।”
translations.translation: His achievements as Lord Protector are commendable and memorable.
translations.reference: His achievements as Lord Protector are also worth celebrating and commemorating."

translations.source: घातक सूअर ने चाइनीज़ किसान पर हमला किया जिससे किसान की मौत हो गई
translations.translation: A deadly pig attacked a Chinese farmer, killing the farmer.
translations.reference: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death

translations.source: स्थानीय मीडिया रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, दक्षिण-पश्चिमी चीन के एक मार्केट में सूअर ने एक किसान पर हमला कर दिया जिससे किसान की मौत हो गई।
translations.translation: According to local media reports, a pig attacked a farmer in a market in southwestern China, killing the farmer.
translations.reference: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.

translations.source: रविवार को साउथ चाइना मॉर्निंग पोस्ट में बताया गया कि उस व्यक्ति की पहचान के तौर पर सिर्फ़ उसके उपनाम "युआन" का पता लगाया गया है, उसके शव पर गंभीर जख्म पाए गए, गुइझोऊ प्रांत के लिउपांसुई के मार्केट में सूअर-बाड़े के पास उसका शव खून से लथपथ पाया गया।
translations.translation: On Sunday, the South China Morning Post reported that only his nickname "Yuan" has been identified, his body was found to be severely wounded, and his body was found covered in blood near a pigsty in the market in Liupansui, Guizhou Province.
translations.reference: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.

translations.source: 30 मई, 2005 को चीन के किन्हाई प्रांत के ज़िनिंग में एक सूअर पालने वाले वाला किसान सूअर-बाड़े में सूअरों को टीका लगाने की तैयारी कर रहा था।
translations.translation: On May 30, 2005, a pig farmer in Xining, Kinhai Province, China, was preparing to vaccinate pigs in a pig barn.
translations.reference: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर वह बुधवार को पास के युन्नान प्रांत में रहने वाले अपने कज़न के साथ मार्केट में 15 सूअरों को बेचने के लिए आया था।
translations.translation: He reportedly came to the market on Wednesday with his cousin from nearby Yunnan Province to sell 15 pigs.
translations.reference: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.

translations.source: अगली सुबह, उसके कज़न की मृत्यु हो गई और पाया गया कि पास में ही एक सूअर-बाड़े का दरवाज़ा खुला हुआ था।
translations.translation: The next morning, his cousin died and it was found that the door of a pig barn was opened nearby.
translations.reference: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.

translations.source: उसने बताया कि सूअर-बाड़े में एक काफ़ी बड़ा नर सूअर दिखा जिसके मुंह पर खून लगा हुआ था।
translations.translation: He told me that in the pig 's den he saw a large male pig with blood on his mouth.
translations.reference: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.

translations.source: रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, एक फोरेंसिक जांच में इस बात की पुष्टि हुई कि 550 पाउंड वजन वाले एक सूअर ने किसान पर हमला करके उसे मार डाला।
translations.translation: According to the report, a forensic investigation confirmed that a pig weighing 550 lbs attacked the farmer and killed him.
translations.reference: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.

translations.source: गुइयांग इवनिंग न्यूज के अनुसार, “वु” उपनाम वाले उसके कज़न ने कहा, "मेरे कज़न के पैर खून से लथपथ और पूरी तरह से जख्मी थे।”
translations.translation: According to Guyang Evening News, her cousin, nicknamed वु, said, "My cousin's legs were covered in blood and completely injured.
translations.reference: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.

translations.source: सिक्योरिटी कैमरा फुटेज में देखा गया कि युआन गुरुवार को सुबह 4.40 बजे अपने सूअरों को चारा देने के लिए मार्केट में आया था।
translations.translation: Security camera footage showed that Yuan had come to the market at 4.40 am on Thursday to feed his pigs.
translations.reference: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.

translations.source: उसका शव लगभग एक घंटे बाद बरामद किया गया।
translations.translation: Her body was recovered about an hour later.
translations.reference: His body was found about an hour later.

translations.source: व्यक्ति पर हमला करके उसे मारने वाला सूअर युआन या उसके कज़न का नहीं था।
translations.translation: The person who attacked and killed him was not a pig of the Yuan or his cousin.
translations.reference: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.

translations.source: ईवनिंग न्यूज को एक मार्केट मैनेजर ने बताया कि सूअर को बंद करके रखा गया था, ताकि यह किसी व्यक्ति पर हमला न कर पाए, हालांकि पुलिस ने घटना-स्थल का जायजा लेकर साक्ष्य इकट्ठा किए।
translations.translation: A market manager told Evening News that the pig was kept locked up so that it could not attack anyone, although the police collected evidence from the scene.
translations.reference: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.

translations.source: कथित तौर पर युआन के परिवार के लोग और मार्केट के अधिकारी उसकी मृत्यु के लिए मुआवजे पर बातचीत कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Yuan's family and market officials are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
translations.reference: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.

translations.source: हालांकि, पहले भी सूअरों द्वारा लोगों पर हमला करने के दुर्लभ मामले दर्ज किए गए हैं।
translations.translation: However, there have been rare cases of people being attacked by pigs in the past.
translations.reference: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.

translations.source: 2016 में, मैसाचुसेट्स में एक सूअर ने एक महिला और उसके पति पर उनके खेत में हमला किया था जिससे व्यक्ति गंभीर रूप से जख्मी हुआ था।
translations.translation: In 2016, a pig in Massachusetts attacked a woman and her husband on their farm causing the person to be severely injured.
translations.reference: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.

translations.source: दस साल पहले, एक 650 पाउंड वजन वाले सूअर ने वेल्श के एक किसान पर हमला किया था, उस समय वह अपने ट्रैक्टर पर था, उसने किसान पर तब तक हमला किया जब तक कि उसकी पत्नी ने जानवर को डरा कर नहीं भगाया।
translations.translation: Ten years ago, a 650-pound pig attacked a Welsh farmer, who was on his tractor at the time, attacking the farmer until his wife scared the animal away.
translations.reference: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.

translations.source: 2012 में ओरेगन के एक किसान को उसके सूअरों ने हमला करके उसे जान से मार डाला और अपना भोजन बनाया, मैनीटोबा के एक किसान ने सीबीसी न्यूज से कहा कि आम तौर पर सूअर आक्रामक नहीं होते हैं, लेकिन खून का स्वाद मिल जाने पर वे "खतरनाक" हो सकते हैं।
translations.translation: In 2012, an Oregon farmer was attacked and killed by his pigs and made his own food, a Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not usually aggressive, but they can be "dangerous" when they taste blood.
translations.reference: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."

translations.translation: "They're just playing.

translations.source: वे दांत से काटते हैं और बहुत खोजी होते हैं ...वे आपको जख्मी करने के लिए नहीं होते।
translations.translation: They cut with their teeth and are very inquisitive... they are not meant to hurt you.

translations.source: आपको सिर्फ़ उन्हें पर्याप्त सम्मान देना पड़ता है,” उसने बताया।
translations.translation: You just have to give them enough respect, he said.
translations.reference: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.

translations.source: तूफान रोसा के शेष-भाग की वजह से दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका में भारी बारिश हुई
translations.translation: The remainder of Hurricane Rosa caused heavy rainfall in the southwestern United States
translations.reference: Hurricane Rosa's remnants to bring widespread heavy rain to southwest US

translations.source: पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार, तूफान रोसा मेक्सिको के उत्तरी तट के ठंडे पानी पर जाने की वजह से कमजोर होता जा रहा है।
translations.translation: According to forecasts, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves to the cold waters of the northern coast of Mexico.
translations.reference: As forecast, Hurricane Rosa is weakening as it moves over the cooler waters of the northern coast of Mexico.

translations.source: हालांकि, रोसा की वजह से आने वाले दिनों में उत्तरी मेक्सिको और दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका में बाढ़ आएगी।
translations.translation: However, in the coming days, Rosa will cause flooding in northern Mexico and the southwestern United States.
translations.reference: However, Rosa will bring flooding rains across northern Mexico and the southwest U.S. over the coming days.

translations.source: रविवार को ईस्टर्न टाइम के मुताबिक सुबह 5 बजे रोसा में हवा  की रफ़्तार 85 मील प्रति घंटे दर्ज की गई, यह श्रेणी 1 वाला तूफान है, और यह मेक्सिको के पुन्ता यूगेनिया के दक्षिण-पश्चिम में 385 मील की दूरी पर स्थित था।
translations.translation: At 5 a.m. eastern time on Sunday, wind speeds of 85 miles per hour were recorded in Rosa, a Category 1 hurricane, and it was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
translations.reference: Rosa had winds of 85 mph, a Category 1 Hurricane, as of 5 a.m. Eastern time Sunday, and was located 385 miles southwest of Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

translations.source: ऐसी उम्मीद है कि रोसा रविवार को उत्तर की ओर बढ़ेगा।
translations.translation: It is expected that Rosa will move north on Sunday.
translations.reference: Rosa is expected to move north on Sunday.

translations.source: इस बीच, प्रशांत महासागर के ऊपर एक गर्त का आकार बनने लगा है और यह अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट की ओर बढ़ रहा है। चूंकि, रोसा सोमवार को उष्णकटिबंधीय तूफान के तौर पर बाजा कैलिफ़ोर्निया प्रायद्वीप के पास पहुँचने वाला है, इसलिए दक्षिण-पश्चिमी अमेरिका के उत्तरी इलाकों में बहुत ज़्यादा उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी आनी शुरू हो जाएगी।
translations.translation: In the meantime, a mass has begun to form over the Pacific Ocean and is moving toward the western coast of the United States. As the tropical storm Rosa is set to hit the Baja California Peninsula on Monday, much of the northern parts of the southwestern United States will begin to experience tropical moisture.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, a trough is beginning to take shape over the Pacific Ocean and move east toward the West Coast of the U.S. As Rosa approaches the Baja California peninsula on Monday as a tropical storm it will begin to push deep tropical moisture northward into the southwest U.S.

translations.source: सोमवार को मैक्सिको के कुछ हिस्सों में रोसा की वजह 10 इंच बारिश आएगी।
translations.translation: On Monday, some parts of Mexico will receive 10 inches of rain due to Rosa.
translations.reference: Rosa will bring up to 10 inches of rain in parts of Mexico on Monday.

translations.source: उसके बाद, आने वाले दिनों में गर्त से आने वाली नमी उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी से मिलकर दक्षिण-पश्चिम में भारी वर्षा लाएगी।
translations.translation: After that, in the coming days, moisture from the crust will combine with tropical moisture to bring heavy rain to the southwest.
translations.reference: Then, tropical moisture interacting with the approaching trough will create widespread heavy rainfall in the Southwest over the coming days.

translations.source: स्थानीय तौर पर, 1 से 4 इंच बारिश होने की वजह से खतरनाक बाढ़ के आने, मलबे का बहाव और रेगिस्तान में भूस्खलन की संभावना बनेगी।
translations.translation: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain is likely to lead to dangerous flooding, debris flooding and landslides in the desert.
translations.reference: Locally, 1 to 4 inches of rain will cause dangerous flash flooding, debris flows and possibility landslides in the desert.

translations.source: बहुत ज़्यादा उष्णकटिबंधीय नमी की वजह वर्षा की दर कुछ स्थानों पर 2 से 3 इंच हो जाएगी, खास तौर पर दक्षिणी नेवाडा और एरिज़ोना के कुछ इलाकों में इसकी संभावना ज़्यादा है।
translations.translation: Excessive tropical humidity will result in 2 to 3 inches of rainfall in some places, especially in southern Nevada and some areas of Arizona.
translations.reference: Deep tropical moisture will cause rainfall rates to approach 2 to 3 inches per hour in spots, especially in parts of southern Nevada and Arizona.

translations.source: दक्षिण-पश्चिमी हिस्से, खास तौर पर एरिज़ोना के ज़्यादातर इलाकों में 2 से 4 इंच बारिश होने की संभावना है।
translations.translation: In the southwestern part of the country, especially in most areas of Arizona, there is a possibility of 2 to 4 inches of rain.
translations.reference: As much as 2 to 4 inches of rain is expected in parts of the Southwest, especially over much of Arizona.

translations.source: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा की छिट-पुट प्रकृति की वजह से खराब स्थितियों के साथ बहुत ज़्यादा बाढ़ आ सकती है।
translations.translation: Due to the sluggish nature of tropical rainfall, there can be very high flooding with poor conditions.
translations.reference: Flash flooding is possible with rapidly deteriorating conditions due to the scattered nature of tropical rain.

translations.source: उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा के जोखिम को देखते हुए निचले स्तर वाले रेगिस्तान से बाहर रहने के लिए निहायती सलाह दी जाएगी।
translations.translation: In view of the risk of tropical rainfall, it will be advisable to stay out of low-lying deserts.
translations.reference: It would be extremely ill advised to venture out into the desert on foot with the threat of tropical rainfall.

translations.source: भारी बारिश की वजह से घाटियां जोखिम भरी नदियां बन सकती हैं और बादल के गरजने के साथ-साथ स्थानीय इलाकों में तेज़ हवाएं चलेंगी और धूल उड़ेंगी।
translations.translation: Due to heavy rainfall, the valleys can become dangerous rivers and the thunder of clouds, as well as strong winds and dust will blow in the local areas.
translations.reference: Heavy rain could cause canyons to become raging rivers and thunderstorms will bring locally gusty winds and blowing dust.

translations.source: आ रही गर्त की वजह से दक्षिणी कैलिफोर्निया तट के कुछ भागों में स्थानीय रूप से बहुत ज़्यादा बारिश आाएगी।
translations.translation: As a result of the storm, some parts of the southern California coast will experience significant local rainfall.
translations.reference: The approaching trough will bring some locally heavy rain to parts of the Southern California coastline.

translations.source: कुल आधा इंच से ज़्यादा बारिश होने की संभावना है, जिसकी वजह से कुछ हद तक मलबे का बहाव हो सकता है और सड़कों पर फिसलाव की स्थिति बन सकती है।
translations.translation: A total of more than half an inch of rain is likely, which can lead to a slight displacement of the debris and lead to slippery conditions on the roads.
translations.reference: Rainfall totals of over half an inch are possible, which could cause minor debris flows and slick roadways.

translations.source: यह इलाके में नमी वाले मौसम की पहली बारिश होगी।
translations.translation: This will be the first wet-season rainfall in the area.
translations.reference: This would be the region's first rainfall of their wet season.

translations.source: सोमवार और मंगलवार की शाम को बारिश के ज़्यादा व्यापक होने से पहले रविवार की शाम और सोमवार की सुबह को एरिज़ोना में कुछ छिट-पुट उष्णकटिबंधीय बारिश होने लगेगी।
translations.translation: On Monday and Tuesday evenings, there will be some slight tropical rainfall in Arizona on Sunday evening and Monday morning before more extensive rainfall.
translations.reference: Some scattered tropical rain showers will begin to approach Arizona late Sunday and early Monday, before the rain becomes more widespread late Monday and Tuesday.

translations.source: मंगलवार को फोर कॉर्नर में भारी बारिश होगी और यह बुधवार तक होती रहेगी।
translations.translation: There will be heavy rainfall in the Four Corners on Tuesday and it will continue till Wednesday.
translations.reference: Heavy rain will spread into the Four Corners on Tuesday and last through Wednesday.

translations.source: अक्टूबर महीने में पूरे यू.एस. में तापमान में तेज़ी से बदलाव हो सकता है क्योंकि इस समय आर्कटिक का मौसम ठंडा हो जाता है, लेकिन उष्णकटिबंधीय इलाकों में काफ़ी गर्मी रहती है।
translations.translation: During the month of October, temperatures across the U.S. can change rapidly as the Arctic gets colder, but the tropical areas remain quite hot.
translations.reference: October can see some intense temperature swings across the U.S. as the Arctic gets cooler, but the tropics remain quite warm.

translations.translation: Sometimes this short distance leads to strange changes in temperature.
translations.reference: Sometimes this leads to dramatic changes in temperature over short distances.

translations.translation: The unusual change in temperature in the central U.S. on Sunday is a good example.
translations.reference: There is a great example of dramatic temperature differences through the central U.S. on Sunday.

translations.source: कैनसस सिटी, मिसौरी तथा ओमाहा, नेब्रास्का के बीच और सेंट लुइस तथा डेस मोइनेस, आयोवा के बीच तापमान में करीब 20 डिग्री का फ़र्क होता है।
translations.translation: The temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa, is about 20 degrees.
translations.reference: There is nearly a 20-degree temperature difference between Kansas City, Missouri, and Omaha, Nebraska, and between St. Louis and Des Moines, Iowa.

translations.source: अगले कुछ दिनों में, होने वाली गर्मी की वजह से मौसम गर्म होने लगेगा और गर्मी बढ़ती जाएगी।
translations.translation: In the next few days, the weather will get warmer and the heat will increase due to the hot weather.
translations.reference: Over the next few days, lingering summer warmth will try to build and expand again.

translations.source: सेंट्रल और ईस्टर्न यू.एस. के ज़्यादातर इलाकों में अक्टूबर से मौसम के गर्म होने की उम्मीद है जो दक्षिणी मैदानों से लेकर पूर्वोत्तर के कुछ इलाकों में व्यापक 80s हो सकता है।
translations.translation: Most areas of the central and eastern U.S. are expected to experience warmer weather from October, which can range from the southern plains to a wide 80s in some areas of the northeast.
translations.reference: Much of the central and eastern U.S. is expected to see a warm start to October with widespread 80s from the Southern Plains to parts of the Northeast.

translations.source: मंगलवार को न्यूयॉर्क सिटी का तापमान 80 डिग्री तक पहुंच सकता है, जो औसत तापमान से करीब 10 डिग्री ज़्यादा होगा।
translations.translation: On Tuesday, New York City's temperature could reach 80 degrees, which would be about 10 degrees above average.
translations.reference: New York City could reach 80 degrees on Tuesday, which would be approximately 10 degrees above average.

translations.source: हमारे दीर्घकालिक जलवायु पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार हमें यह संकेत मिल रहा है कि अक्टूबर के शुरूआती छह महीने में ईस्टर्न यू.एस. के तापमान के औसत तापमान से ज़्यादा रहने के काफ़ी मौके हैं।
translations.translation: Based on our long-term climate forecasts, we are getting an indication that there are plenty of opportunities for the eastern U.S. to be above average temperatures for the first six months of October.
translations.reference: Our long term climate forecast is indicating high chances for above-average temperatures for the eastern U.S. through the first half of October.

translations.source: 20 मिलियन से ज़्यादा लोगों ने ब्रेट कैवनौघ की सुनवाई देखी
translations.translation: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh's hearing.
translations.reference: More than 20 million people watched Brett Kavanaugh hearing

translations.source: गुरूवार को 20 मिलियन से ज़्यादा लोगों ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट में हाज़िर हुए ब्रेट कैवनौघ और उस महिला के मुकदमे की सुनवाई देखी जिसने ब्रेट कैवनौघ पर यौन शोषण का आरोप लगाया है, जो कथित तौर पर 1980 के दशक में किया गया था, महिला का नाम क्रिस्टीन ब्लेसी फोर्ड है, यह सुनवाई छह टेलीविजन चैनलों पर दिखाई गई।
translations.translation: On Thursday, more than 20 million people attended the Supreme Court hearing of Brett Kavanaugh and the case of the woman who has accused Brett Kavanaugh of sexual abuse, allegedly committed in the 1980s, the woman's name is Christine Blessy Ford, the hearing was shown on six television channels.
translations.reference: More than 20 million people watched Thursday's gripping testimony by Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh and the woman who accused him of a sexual assault that allegedly occurred in the 1980s, Christine Blasey Ford, on six television networks.

translations.source: इस बीच, राजनीतिक गतिरोध भी देखे गए, प्रसारणकर्ताओं ने शुक्रवार के लास्ट-मिनट ट्विस्ट: ऐन एग्रीमेंट इंजिनियर्ड बाई एरिजोना सेन के नियमित प्रोग्राम को रोक दिया। इस मुकदमे को एफबीआई के जेफ फ्लेक ने एक हफ़्ते तक आरोपों की जांच करने के बाद दायर किया।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, political turmoil was also observed, with broadcasters blocking the regular program of Friday's Last-Minute Twist: An Agreement Engineered by Arizona Sen. The lawsuit was filed by Jeff Flake of the FBI after a week-long investigation of the allegations.
translations.reference: Meanwhile, the political standoff continued, with broadcasters interrupting regular programming for Friday's last-minute twist: an agreement engineered by Arizona Sen. Jeff Flake for the FBI to conduct a one-week investigation of the charges.

translations.source: फोर्ड ने सीनेट ज्यूडिशियरी कमिटी से कहा कि वह पूरी तरह से सुनिश्चित है कि एक हाई स्कूल पार्टी में कैवनौघ ने उसे नशीली चीज़ें पिलाई और उसके कपड़े उतारने का प्रयास किया।
translations.translation: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that he was absolutely certain that at a high school party, Kavanaugh drank him intoxicants and tried to undress him.
translations.reference: Ford told the Senate Judiciary Committee that she's 100 percent certain that Kavanaugh groped her drunkenly and tried to take off her clothes at a high school party.

translations.source: कैवनौघ ने अपना बचाव करते हुए कहा कि वह पूरी तरह से सुनिश्चित है कि ऐसा बिल्कुल भी नहीं हुआ।
translations.translation: In his defense, Kavanaugh said that he was absolutely certain that this did not happen at all.
translations.reference: Kavanaugh, in impassioned testimony, said he's 100 percent certain that it didn't happen.

translations.source: इस बात की संभावना जताई जा रही है कि 20.4 मिलियन से ज़्यादा लोगों ने शुक्रवार को नीलसन की यह रिपोर्ट देखी।
translations.translation: It is estimated that more than 20.4 million people viewed Nielsen's report on Friday.
translations.reference: It's likely that more than the 20.4 million people reported by Nielsen on Friday watched it.

translations.source: कंपनी CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox न्यूज़ चैनल और MSNBC पर औसत दर्शकों की गणना कर रही थी।
translations.translation: The company was counting average viewers on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.
translations.reference: The company was counting average viewership on CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel and MSNBC.

translations.source: PBS, C-SPAN और Fox Business Network के साथ-साथ इसे दिखाने वाले दूसरे चैनलों के लिए आंकड़े त्वरित रूप से मौजूद नहीं थे।
translations.translation: The figures for PBS, C-SPAN and Fox Business Network as well as other channels showing it were not immediately available.
translations.reference: Figures weren't immediately available for other networks that showed it, including PBS, C-SPAN and the Fox Business Network.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, आमतौर पर नीलसन को उन लोगों की गणना करने में कुछ दिक्कत होती है जो दफ़्तरों में देखते हैं।
translations.translation: In addition, Nielsen usually has some difficulty in counting the people who look in the offices.
translations.reference: And Nielsen usually has some trouble measuring people who watch in offices.

translations.source: इस दृष्टिकोण से, यह प्लेऑफ फुटबॉल गेम या अकेडमी अवार्ड के दर्शकों की संख्या के बराबर है।
translations.translation: From this point of view, it is equal to the number of spectators for a playoff football game or an Academy Award.
translations.reference: To put that in perspective, that's an audience size similar to that for a playoff football game or the Academy Awards.

translations.source: नीलसन ने बताया कि Fox न्यूज़ चैनल, जिस पर विचार देने वाले होस्ट ने कैवनौघ की नियुक्ति का बहुत ज़्यादा समर्थन किया है, सभी चैनलों से आगे रही, इस पर पूरे दिन की सुनवाई के दौरान औसतन 5.69 मिलियन दर्शक मौजूद थे।
translations.translation: According to Nielsen, the Fox News channel, on which the commenting host has strongly supported Kavanaugh's appointment, was ahead of all channels, with an average of 5.69 million viewers attending the whole day's hearing.
translations.reference: Fox News Channel, whose opinion hosts have strongly backed Kavanaugh's appointment, led all networks with an average of 5.69 million viewers during the all-day hearing, Nielsen said.

translations.source: ABC पर दर्शकों की संख्या 3.26 मिलियन थी और यह दूसरे स्थान पर रही।
translations.translation: The number of viewers on ABC was 3.26 million and it came in second place.
translations.reference: ABC was second with 3.26 million viewers.

translations.source: CBS पर 3.1 मिलियन, NBC पर 2.94 मिलियन, MSNBC पर 2.89 मिलियन और CNN पर 2.52 मिलियन दर्शक मौजूद थें, नीलसन ने बताया।
translations.translation: There were 3.1 million viewers on CBS, 2.94 million on NBC, 2.89 million on MSNBC and 2.52 million on CNN, Nielsen reported.
translations.reference: CBS had 3.1 million, NBC had 2.94 million, MSNBC had 2.89 million and CNN had 2.52 million, Nielsen said.

translations.source: सुनवाई पर लोगों की दिलचस्पी बहुत ज़्यादा रही।
translations.translation: People were very interested in the hearing.
translations.reference: Interest remained high after the hearing.

translations.source: शुक्रवार को हुए इस ड्रामे में फ्लेक केंद्रीय व्यक्ति थे।
translations.translation: In this drama on Friday, Flake was the central figure.
translations.reference: Flake was the central figure in Friday's drama.

translations.source: उदारवादी रिपब्लिकन के दफ़्तर की ओर से कार्यकाल के बाद एक बयान जारी किया गया जिसमें कहा गया कि वे कैवनौघ की ओर से आवाज़ उठाएंगे, वे शुक्रवार की सुबह को CNN और CBS के कैमरे के सामने आए, उस समय प्रदर्शनकारी न्यायिक समिति की सुनवाई का विरोध करने के लिए चिल्ला रहे थें।
translations.translation: A post-term statement from the Liberal Republican office said they would raise their voices on behalf of Kavanaugh, who appeared in front of CNN and CBS cameras on Friday morning, screaming at the time to protest the hearing of the protesting Judicial Committee.
translations.reference: After the moderate Republican's office issued a statement that he would be voting in favor of Kavanaugh, he was caught be CNN and CBS cameras Friday morning being shouted at by protesters as he tried to ride an elevator to a Judiciary Committee hearing.

translations.source: जब उन्हें अपशब्द कहे जा रहे थें, तो उस समय वे कुछ मिनट तक अपनी आँखें झुकाए खड़े थे, यह CNN पर लाइव देखा गया।
translations.translation: When they were being taunted, they stood up for a few minutes with their eyes down, this was seen live on CNN.
translations.reference: He stood with eyes downcast for several minutes as he was berated, televised live on CNN.

translations.source: एक महिला ने कहा, "लीजिए, मैं भी आपके सामने यहीं खड़ी हूँ।”
translations.translation: One woman said, "Let me stand right here in front of you.
translations.reference: "I'm standing right here in front of you," one woman said.

translations.source: "क्या आप ऐसा सोचते हैं कि वे देश को सही बात बता रहे हैं?
translations.translation: "Do you think they are telling the country the right thing?
translations.reference: "Do you think he's telling the truth to the country?

translations.source: उनसे कहा गया, "क्या आपको सत्ता में इसलिए लाया गया कि आप बहुत सारी महिलाओं को शक्तिहीन बनाएं।"
translations.translation: She was asked, "Did you come to power to make a lot of women powerless?"
translations.reference: He was told, "you have power when so many women are powerless.""

translations.source: फ्लेक ने बताया कि एलीवेटर के बंद होने से पहले उनके दफ़्तर की ओर से एक बयान जारी किया गया और कहा गया कि कमिटी की सुनवाई में वे अपनी पूरी बात रख पाएंगे।
translations.translation: Flake said that a statement was issued by his office before the closure of the elevator and said that he would be able to give his full statement at the committee hearing.
translations.reference: Flake said that his office had issued a statement and said, before the elevator closed, that he would have more to say at the committee hearing.

translations.source: जब ज्यूडिशियरी कमिटी वोट के लिए कैवनौघ के नामांकन को पूरे सीनेट के लिए आगे कर रही था, उस समय केबल और ब्रॉडकास्ट चैनल कई घंटे बाद भी सभी चीज़ों को लाइव दिखा रहे थे।
translations.translation: While the Judiciary Committee was forwarding Kavanaugh's nomination for the vote to the entire Senate, at the time the cable and broadcast channels were still showing everything live after several hours.
translations.reference: The cable and broadcast networks were all covering live hours later, when the Judiciary Committee was to vote to advance Kavanaugh's nomination to the full Senate for a vote.

translations.source: लेकिन, फ्लेक ने बताया कि वे इस बात की पूरी समझ के साथ ऐसा करेंगे कि एफ़बीआई अगले हफ़्ते नामित व्यक्तियों के विरुद्ध लगे आरोपों पर नज़र डालेगी, जिसका आग्रह अल्पसंख्यक डेमोक्रेट द्वारा किया जा रहा है।
translations.translation: But, Flack said, they will do so with full understanding that the FBI will look into the allegations against the designated individuals next week, which are being urged by the minority Democrats.
translations.reference: But Flake said he would only do so with the understanding that the FBI would look into the allegations against the nominee for the next week, which minority Democrats have been urging.

translations.source: फ्लेक ने इस बारे में अपने दोस्त, डेमोक्रेटिक सेन. क्रिस कून्स के साथ बातचीत की।
translations.translation: Flake discussed this with his friend, Democrat Senator Chris Coons.
translations.reference: Flake was convinced in part by conversations with his friend, Democratic Sen. Chris Coons.

translations.source: कून्स और कई सीनेटर के साथ बातचीत करने के बाद, फ्लेक ने अपना फ़ैसला लिया।
translations.translation: After talking to Coons and several senators, Flake made his decision.
translations.reference: After a conversation with Coons and several senators afterwards, Flake made his decision.

translations.source: फ्लेक को सत्ता बहुत पसंद थी, क्योंकि यह साफ़ तौर पर दिख रहा था कि बिना जांच के कैवनौघ को मंज़ूरी देने से रिपब्लिकन को वोट नहीं मिल पाएगा।
translations.translation: Flake was a big fan of power, because it was obvious that the Republican would not get the vote if he passed the Cavanough without an inquiry.
translations.reference: Flake's choice had power, because it was evident Republicans would not have the votes to approve Kavanaugh without the investigation.

translations.source: कैवनौघ पर लगे आरोपों के लिए राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप ने FBI जांच की मंज़ूरी दे दी है।
translations.translation: For the allegations against Kavanaugh, President Trump has approved an FBI investigation.
translations.reference: President Trump has opened an FBI investigation into the allegations against Kavanaugh.

translations.source: ब्रिटिश प्रधानमन्त्री मे ने आलोचकों पर आरोप लगाया कि वे ब्रेक्सिट को लेकर ‘राजनीति कर रहे हैं’
translations.translation: British Prime Minister May accused the critics of politicising Brexit.
translations.reference: British PM May accuses critics of 'playing politics' over Brexit

translations.source: Sunday Times न्यूज़पेपर के साथ हुए इंटरव्यू में प्रधानमंत्री थेरेसा मे ने आलोचकों से कहा कि वे यूरोपीय संघ में "राजनीति को खेल" बना कर ब्रिटेन के भविष्य के साथ खिलवाड़ करना छोड़ दें और अपना पूरा ध्यान राष्ट्रीय हित पर लगाएं।
translations.translation: In an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper, Prime Minister Theresa May told critics to stop messing with Britain's future by making "politics a game" in the European Union and focusing their full attention on the national interest.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Theresa May accused critics of her plans to leave the European Union of "playing politics" with Britain's future and undermining the national interest in an interview with the Sunday Times newspaper.

translations.source: 29 सितंबर, 2018 को बर्मिंघम, ब्रिटेन में होने वाली कंजर्वेटिव पार्टी कांफ्रेंस में ब्रिटेन की प्रधानमंत्री थेरेसा शामिल हो सकती हैं।
translations.translation: UK Prime Minister Theresa May may attend the Conservative Party Conference to be held in Birmingham, UK on 29th September, 2018.
translations.reference: Britain's Prime Minister Theresa May arrives for the Conservative Party Conference in Birmingham, Britain, September 29, 2018.

translations.source: न्यूज़पेपर के पहले पन्ने पर उनके इंटरव्यू के ठीक बगल में, उनके पूर्व विदेश मंत्री बोरिस जॉनसन के साथ हुए इंटरव्यू को छापा गया जिसमें बोरिस जॉनसन ने ब्रेक्सिट के तथाकथित चेकर्स प्लान की वजह से अपने ऊपर हुए हमले को दबाने की कोशिश की, उनका वक्तव्य यह था कि ब्रिटेन और ईयू को एक-दूसरे के साथ ताल-मेल रखना चाहिए जो “पूरी तरह से निरर्थक है”।
translations.translation: On the front page of the newspaper, right next to his interview, was an interview with his former foreign secretary, Boris Johnson, in which Boris Johnson tried to suppress an attack on himself because of the so-called Brexit checkers' plan, his statement was that Britain and the EU should be in sync with each other, which is utterly pointless.
translations.reference: In another interview next to the one with her on the newspaper's front page, her former foreign minister Boris Johnson pressed his attack of her so-called Chequers plan for Brexit, saying a proposal that Britain and the EU should collect each other's tariffs was "entirely preposterous."

translations.source: वेडे सिम्स पर गोली चलाई गई: एलएसयू खिलाड़ी की मौत के लिए पुलिस ने एक संदिग्ध व्यक्ति डायटन सिम्पसन को हिरासत में लिया
translations.translation: Madden Sims shot: Police detain a suspect in the death of an LSU player, Dayton Simpson.
translations.reference: Wayde Sims shooting: Police arrest suspect Dyteon Simpson in LSU player's death

translations.source: पुलिस ने वेडे सिम्स पर गोली चला कर हत्या करने के लिए एक संदिग्ध व्यक्ति को हिरासत में लिया, 20 वर्षीय वेडे एलएसयू के बास्केटबॉल खिलाड़ी थें।
translations.translation: Police have detained a suspect in the shooting death of Wade Sims, a 20-year-old Wade LSU basketball player.
translations.reference: Police have arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting death of Wayde Sims, a 20-year-old basketball player at LSU.

translations.source: बैटन रूज पुलिस डिपार्टमेंट ने बताया कि सेकंड-डिग्री मर्डर के आरोप में 20 वर्षीय डायटॉन सिम्पसन को हिरासत में लेकर जेल में भेज दिया गया है।
translations.translation: The Baton Rouge Police Department reported that 20-year-old Dayton Simpson has been taken into custody and sent to prison for second-degree murder.
translations.reference: Dyteon Simpson, 20, has been arrested and booked into prison on a second-degree murder charge, the Baton Rouge Police Department said.

translations.source: सिम्स और सिम्पसन के बीच हुई मुठभेड़ का वीडियो अधिकारियों द्वारा जारी किया गया, और पुलिस ने बताया कि मुठभेड़ के समय सिम्स का चश्मा खो गया था।
translations.translation: The video of the encounter between Sims and Simpson was released by the authorities, and police reported that Sims' glasses were lost at the time of the encounter.
translations.reference: Officials released video of the confrontation between Sims and Simpson, and police said Sims lost his glasses during the fight.

translations.source: घटनास्थल से पुलिस ने चश्मा बरामद कर लिया है और बताया है कि सीबीएस से जुड़ी WAFB रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक पाया गया कि डीएनए सिम्पसन का है।
translations.translation: The police have recovered the glasses from the scene and have reported that according to a WAFB report from CBS, the DNA was found to be that of Simpson.
translations.reference: Police recovered the glasses from the scene and said they found Simpson's DNA on them, CBS affiliate WAFB reports.

translations.source: सिम्पसन से पूछताछ करके पुलिस ने बताया कि उसने वेडे को जान से मार डालने के लिए घातक रूप से गोली चलाई।
translations.translation: After questioning Simpson, the police reported that he had fatally shot Wade to death.
translations.reference: After questioning Simpson, police said he admitted to fatally shooting Wayde.

translations.source: एडवोकेट की रिपोर्ट में बताया गया कि इसके लिए उसे 350,000 डॉलर देकर सेट किया गया है।
translations.translation: Advocate's report said that he has been set at $350,000 for this.
translations.reference: His bond has been set at $350,000, the Advocate reports.

translations.source: ईस्ट बैटन रूज पैरिश कोरोनर के दफ़्तर की ओर से शुक्रवार को शुरूआती रिपोर्ट जारी की गई, जिसमें बताया गया है कि गर्दन में गोली लगने की वजह मौत हुई है।
translations.translation: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released an initial report on Friday, stating that the cause of death was a gunshot wound to the neck.
translations.reference: The East Baton Rouge Parish Coroner's Office released a preliminary report Friday, saying the cause of death is a gunshot wound to the head into the neck.

translations.source: डिपार्टमेंट इसका श्रेय लुइसियाना स्टेट पुलिस के फूगूटिव टास्क फोर्स, स्टेट पुलिस क्राइम लैब, साउथर्न यूनिवर्सिटी पुलिस और हिरासत के लिए जांच में सहयोग देने वाले इलाके के लोगों को दे रहा है।
translations.translation: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police's Fugitive Task Force, the State Police Crime Lab, the Southern University Police and the people of the area who assisted in the investigation for detention.
translations.reference: The department is crediting the Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, the state police crime lab, Southern University police and area citizens in assisting in the investigation leading to the arrest.

translations.source: एलएसयू एथलेटिक डायरेक्टर जो अललेवा ने इसके "मेहनत और न्याय की खोज" के लिए इलाके में लागू कानून को धन्यवाद दिया।
translations.translation: LSU Athletic Director Joe Allewa thanked the local law for its "labor and justice-seeking".
translations.reference: LSU athletic director Joe Alleva thanked area law enforcement for its "diligence and pursuit of justice."

translations.source: सिम्स की आयु 20 साल थी।
translations.translation: Sims was 20 years old.
translations.reference: Sims was 20 years old.

translations.source: उसकी लंबाई 6 फुट 6 इंच थी, वह बैटन रूज में पला-बढ़ा था, जहां उसके पिता वेन रहते हैं, उन्होंने भी एलएसयू के लिए बास्केटबॉल खेला था।
translations.translation: He was 6 feet 6 inches tall, grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.
translations.reference: The 6-foot-6 forward grew up in Baton Rouge, where his father, Wayne, also played basketball for LSU.

translations.source: उन्होंने पिछले सीज़न के गेम में 5.6 पॉइंट और 2.6 रिबाउंड प्राप्त किया था।
translations.translation: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds in a game last season.
translations.reference: He averaged 5.6 points and 2.6 rebounds a game last season.

translations.source: शुक्रवार की सुबह को एलएसयू बास्केटबॉल के कोच विल वेड ने बताया कि वेड की मृत्यु से टीम "तितर-बितर" हो गई है और "बहुत दुखी" है।
translations.translation: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade reported that the team has been "dispersed" and "very sad" by Wade's death.
translations.reference: On Friday morning, LSU basketball coach Will Wade said the team is "devastated" and "in shock" by Wayde's death.

translations.source: वेड ने बताया, "अब उसकी जगह कौन लेगा, इसकी चिंता हमेशा बनी रहेगी।”
translations.translation: "It will always be a matter of who will take his place from now on", said Wade.
translations.reference: "This is what you worry about at all times," Wade said.

translations.source: मैक्सिको सिटी में ज्वालामुखी की राख मिली
translations.translation: In Mexico City, volcanic ash was found.
translations.reference: Volcano spews ash on Mexico City

translations.source: मैक्सिको की राजधानी के दक्षिणी इलाकों में पॉपोकेपेटल ज्वालामुखी से निकलने वाला राख मिला है।
translations.translation: Ashes from the Popocépital volcano have been found in the southern areas of Mexico's capital.
translations.reference: Ash spewing from the Popocatepetl volcano has reached the southern neighborhoods of Mexico's capital.

translations.source: ज्वालामुखी पहाड के मुख की गतिविधि को देखकर शनिवार को नेशनल सेंटर फ़ॉर डिज़ास्टर प्रिवेंशन ने मैक्सिको के नागरिकों को यह चेतावनी दी थी कि वे ज्वालामुखी से दूर रहे और बताया कि 24 घंटे में 183 बार गैस और राख निकलने का क्रम दर्ज़ किया गया है।
translations.translation: On Saturday, the National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexican citizens to stay away from the volcano, seeing the activity of the volcano's mouth and reporting that 183 gas and ash discharges have been recorded in 24 hours.
translations.reference: The National Center for Disaster Prevention warned Mexicans on Saturday to stay away from the volcano after activity picked up in the crater and it registered 183 emissions of gas and ash over 24 hours.

translations.source: कई झटकों और स्पंदन पर केंद्र नज़र रखे हुआ था।
translations.translation: Several shocks and vibrations were monitored by the centre.
translations.reference: The center was monitoring multiple rumblings and tremors.

translations.source: सोशल मीडिया पर पोस्ट की गई तस्वीरों में दिखाया गया है कि एक्सोचिमिल्को जैसे मैक्सिको के शहर के पड़ोस के इलाके में ऐश कोटिंग कार विंडशील्ड की पतली परतें दिख रही थी।
translations.translation: Photos posted on social media showed that thin layers of ash-coated car windshields were visible in the vicinity of Mexico City such as Exochimilco.
translations.reference: Images on social media showed thin layers of ash coating car windshields in neighborhoods of Mexico City such as Xochimilco.

translations.source: सितंबर 2017 में, 7.1 तीव्रता वाला भूकंप सेंट्रल मैक्सिको में आया था, तब से भूभौतिकीविदों ने ज्वालामुखी की बढ़ती गतिविधि पर ध्यान देया जो कैपिटल के दक्षिण-पूर्व में 45 मील (72 किलोमीटर) की दूरी पर है।
translations.translation: In September 2017, a 7.1 magnitude earthquake struck central Mexico, since then geophysicists have noticed the increasing activity of the volcano, which is 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital.
translations.reference: Geophysicists have noticed an increase in activity at the volcano that sits 45 miles (72 kilometers) southeast of the capital since a 7.1-magnitude earthquake rocked central Mexico in September 2017.

translations.source: "डॉन गोयो" नामक ज्वालामुखी 1994 से ही सक्रिय है।
translations.translation: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.
translations.reference: The volcano known as "Don Goyo" has been active since 1994.

translations.source: इंडिपेंडेंस वोट एनिवर्सरी के अवसर पर पुलिस की झड़प केटालोनिया के अलगाववादियों के साथ हुई
translations.translation: On the occasion of the Independence Vote Anniversary, police clashed with separatists from Catalonia
translations.reference: Police clash with Catalan separatists ahead of independence vote anniversary

translations.source: शनिवार को दंगाई पुलिस के साथ स्वतंत्रता समर्थक प्रदर्शनकारियों की झड़प के बाद बार्सिलोना के छह लोगों को हिरासत में लिया गया, और केटालोनिया में अलगाव पर मत करने के लिए मनाई जाने वाली पहली वर्षगांठ पर हजारों प्रतिद्वंद्वी प्रदर्शनों में शामिल हुए।
translations.translation: Six people from Barcelona were detained after a clash of pro-independence protesters with riot police on Saturday, and thousands of rivals joined the protests on the first anniversary of Catalonia's celebration of voting for segregation.
translations.reference: Six people were arrested in Barcelona on Saturday after pro-independence protesters clashed with riot police, and as thousands joined rival demonstrations to mark the first anniversary of Catalonia's polarizing vote on secession.

translations.source: नकाबपोश समर्थक अलगाववादियों के एक समूह ने दंगाई पुलिस पर अंडे और पाउडर पेंट फेंके, जिससे सड़क की धुल काली हो गई, इससे आमतौर पर आने-जाने वालों को परेशानी हुई।
translations.translation: A group of Nakabposh pro-secessionists threw eggs and powder paint on riot police, which turned the street dust black, usually causing inconvenience to commuters.
translations.reference: A group of masked pro-separatists held back by riot police pelted them with eggs and hurled powder paint, creating dark clouds of dust in streets that would usually be thronged with tourists.

translations.source: पुलिस ने झड़प पर काबू पाने के लिए अपने डंडों का इस्तेमाल किया और बाद में हाथापाई भी की।
translations.translation: The police used their rods to control the clashes and later fought back.
translations.reference: Scuffles also broke out later in the day with police using their batons to contain the fighting.

translations.source: स्वतन्त्रता समर्थक समूहों ने कई घंटों तक "कोई भूल नहीं, कोई माफ़ी नहीं" का नारा लगाया जबकि संघी प्रदर्शनकारियों ने "स्पेन अमर रहे” का नारा लगाया।
translations.translation: For several hours, pro-independence groups chanted "No forgetting, no apology", while union protesters chanted "Spanish immortality".
translations.reference: Over several hours pro-independence groups chanting "No forgetting, no forgiveness" faced off with unionist protesters shouting, "Long live Spain."

translations.source: स्थानीय प्रेस की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, प्रदर्शन की वजह से चोटिल होने वाले चौदह लोगों का उपचार किया गया।
translations.translation: According to a local press report, fourteen people who were injured as a result of the demonstration were treated.
translations.reference: Fourteen people received treatment for minor injuries received in the protests, local press reported.

translations.source: मैड्रिड के अनुसार गैरकानूनी माना जाने वाला 1 अक्टूबर का जनमत संग्रह एक साल से स्वतंत्र विचार वाले इलाकों में तनाव को बढ़ा रहा है, लेकिन केटालोनिया के अलगाववादी विचार वाले लोग इसका जश्न मना रहे थें।
translations.translation: According to Madrid, the illegal October 1 referendum has been raising tensions in independent-minded areas for a year, but Catalonia's separatist-minded people were celebrating it.
translations.reference: Tensions remain high in the independence-minded region a year after the October 1 referendum deemed illegal by Madrid but celebrated by separatist Catalans.

translations.source: स्वतन्त्रता के लिए वोटरों ने बहुत बढ़िया तरीका चुना, हालांकि ऐसे लोग कम थें जिन्होंने अलगाव के खिलाफ मतदान का भारी विरोध किया।
translations.translation: Voters chose a very good method for independence, although there were few who strongly opposed the vote against isolation.
translations.reference: Voters chose overwhelmingly to become independent, though turnout was low with those against secession largely boycotting the vote.

translations.source: केटालोनिया के अधिकारियों ने बताया कि जब पुलिस झड़प की बीच इलाके के मतदान केंद्रों पर आगे बढ़ने से लोगों को रोकने की कोशिश रही थी, उसमें पिछले साल करीब 1000 लोग घायल हुए थे।
translations.translation: Officials in Catalonia said about 1,000 people were injured last year when police tried to stop people from moving on to local polling stations amid clashes.
translations.reference: According to Catalan authorities almost 1000 people were injured last year after police tried to stop the vote going ahead at polling stations across the region in violent clashes.

translations.source: स्वतंत्रता का समर्थन करने वाले समूहों ने प्रदर्शन को रोकने के लिए नेशनल पुलिस को सहायता देने हेतु शुक्रवार को रात भर वहीं रुके हुए थे।
translations.translation: The pro-independence groups stayed there overnight on Friday to assist the National Police in stopping the protests.
translations.reference: Pro-independence groups had camped out overnight on Friday to prevent a demonstration in support of the national police.

translations.source: प्रदर्शन को आगे बढ़ाया गया, लेकिन उसे अलग फ़ैसला लेने पर मजबूर होना पड़ा।
translations.translation: The demonstration was postponed, but she was forced to make a different decision.
translations.reference: The demonstration went ahead but was forced to take a different route.

translations.source: 68 साल के इलेक्ट्रीशियन नार्सिस टर्मिनस अपनी पत्नी के साथ अलगाववादी विरोध प्रदर्शन में भाग लेने पहुंचे थे, उन्होंने बताया कि उन्हें कैटेलोनिया के स्वतंत्रत होने की कोई संभावनाना नहीं दिख रही थी।
translations.translation: The 68-year-old electrician Narcisse Terminus, who arrived with his wife to take part in the separatist protests, said he saw no prospect of Catalonia becoming independent.
translations.reference: Narcis Termes, 68, an electrician attending the separatist protest with his wife said he was no longer hopeful about the prospects of Catalonia gaining independence.

translations.source: “हमारा सबसे बढ़िया साला पिछला साल रहा।
translations.translation: Our best year was last year.
translations.reference: "Last year we lived through one of our best moments.

translations.source: मैंने अपने माता-पिता को मतदान करके खुशी जताते हुए देखा था, लेकिन ऐसा लगता है कि अब हम फंस गए हैं,” उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: I had seen my parents cheerfully voting, but it seems that we are now trapped, he said.
translations.reference: I watched my parents cry with joy at being able to vote but now we are stuck," he said.

translations.source: पिछले साल दिसंबर में हुए क्षेत्रीय चुनावों में छोटी सी जीत मिलने पर भी, कैटेलोनिया के स्वतंत्रता समर्थक दलों ने इस साल अपने कई मशहूर नेताओं के साथ प्रभाव बनाए रखने के लिए संघर्ष किया, चाहे वह खुद को उजागर करने में हो या मतसंग्रह को संगठित और स्वतन्त्रता की निरंतर घोषणा के लिए अपनी भूमिका हेतु अवरोध की प्रतीक्षा करने में हो।
translations.translation: Despite a small victory in the regional elections held in December last year, the pro-independence parties of Catalonia have struggled to maintain influence this year with many of their prominent leaders, whether it is to expose themselves or to wait for an obstacle to their role in organising the polls and continuing to declare independence.
translations.reference: Despite managing a vital if narrow victory in regional elections last December, Catalan pro-independence parties have struggled to retain momentum this year with many of their best known leaders either in self imposed exile or in detention awaiting trial for their role in organizing the referendum and subsequent declaration of independence.

translations.source: पुलिस की सहायता के लिए अपने फ़ोन पर विरोध को रिकॉर्ड करने वाले 42 वर्षीय मैकेनिक जोआन पुइग बताया कि दोनों पक्षों के राजनेताओं के बीच होने वाले वाले संघर्ष को रोक दिया गया था।
translations.translation: Joan Puig, a 42 - year - old mechanic who recorded the protests on his phone to help the police, said the clashes between the politicians of both sides had been stopped.
translations.reference: Joan Puig, a 42-year-old mechanic recording the protest in support of the police on his phone, said the conflict had been stoked by politicians on both sides.

translations.source: उसने बताया, “यह बहुत ज़्यादा तनावपूर्ण हो गया है।”
translations.translation: He said, "It has become very stressful".
translations.reference: "It's getting more and more tense," he said.

translations.source: शनिवार को ओरोल जुनक्वेर्स, जो पिछले साल के आखिरी समय से प्री-ट्रेल जेल में शामिल कैटेलोनिया के नौ नेताओं में से एक हैं, ने इस बात की घोषणा की कि वे अगले साल यूरोपीय संसद के चुनावों में लड़ेंगे।
translations.translation: On Saturday, Orol Junqueiros, one of the nine Catalan leaders who have been in pre-trial prison since the end of last year, announced that he would contest the European Parliament elections next year.
translations.reference: On Saturday, Oriol Junqueras, one of nine Catalan leaders in pre-trial jail since late last year, announced he would run in European Parliament elections next year.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, "एक उम्मीदवार के तौर पर यूरोपीय चुनावों लड़ना लोकतांत्रिक महत्वों में वापसी और उस वापसी की निंदा करने का सबसे बढ़िया तरीका है जिसे हमने स्पेन सरकार में देखा है।
translations.translation: "Fighting European elections as a candidate is the best way to condemn a return to democratic values and a return that we have seen in the Spanish government", he said.
translations.reference: "Standing as a candidate for the European elections is the best way to denounce the regression in democratic values and repression we have seen from the Spanish government," he said.

translations.source: लंदनडेरी: कार से घर पर हमला करने वाले लोगों को हिरासत में लिया गया
translations.translation: London Derry: People who attacked the house with a car were taken into custody
translations.reference: Londonderry: Men arrested after house rammed by car

translations.source: लंदनडेरी के एक घर पर कार से बार-बार हमला करने के आरोप में 33, 34 और 39 साल के तीन लोगों को हिरासत में लिया गया है।
translations.translation: Three people aged 33, 34 and 39 have been detained for repeatedly assaulting a house in Londonderry.
translations.reference: Three men, aged 33, 34 and 39, have been arrested after a car was repeatedly rammed into a house in Londonderry.

translations.source: गुरुवार को करीब 19:30 बजे BST पर यह घटना बैल्लीनागर्ड क्रेसेंट में हुई।
translations.translation: The incident took place in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at around 19:30 BST.
translations.reference: The incident unfolded in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at about 19:30 BST.

translations.source: डिप्टी इंस्पेक्टर बॉब ब्लेमिंग्स ने बताया कि घर के दरवाज़े और इमारत क्षतिग्रस्त हो गए हैं।
translations.translation: Deputy Inspector Bob Blemings reported that the doors and buildings of the house were damaged.
translations.reference: Det Insp Bob Blemmings said damage was caused to the gates and the building itself.

translations.source: कुछ जगहों पर क्रॉसबो पर कार द्वारा हमला किया गया हो सकता है।
translations.translation: In some places the crossbow may have been attacked by a car.
translations.reference: A crossbow may also have been fired at the car at some point.

translations.source: मेंगा ने रेंजर्स के विरुद्ध लिविंगस्टन को 1-0 से जीत दिलाई
translations.translation: Menga defeated Livingston 1-0 against Rangers
translations.reference: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers

translations.source: डॉली मेंगा के पहले गोल ने लिविंगस्टन की जीत को सुनिश्चित किया
translations.translation: The first goal of Dolly Menga ensured Livingston's victory.
translations.reference: Dolly Menga's first goal for Livingston secured victory

translations.source: इब्रोक्स क्लब के मैनेजर के अनुसार तेज़ी से आगे बढ़ रहे लिविंगस्टन ने रेंजर्स चौंका दिया जिससे स्टीवन गेरार्ड को 18 मैच में सिर्फ़ अपनी दूसरी हार की जिम्मेदारी लेनी पड़ी।
translations.translation: According to the manager of the Ibrox club, the fast-moving Livingston shocked the Rangers, forcing Steven Gerard to take responsibility for only his second loss in 18 matches.
translations.reference: Promoted Livingston stunned Rangers to consign Steven Gerrard to just his second defeat in 18 games as manager of the Ibrox club.

translations.source: डॉली मेंगा के स्ट्राइक ने वह अंतर बनाया जिसे मैच के दूसरे भाग में हाइबरियन के साथ गैरी होल्ट के साइड मूव ने बराबर कर दिया था।
translations.translation: Dolly Menga's strike made the difference which was equaled by Gary Holt's side move with the Hibernians in the second half of the match.
translations.reference: Dolly Menga's strike proved to be the difference as Gary Holt's side moved level with Hibernian in second.

translations.source: गेरार्ड का साइड इस सीजन के प्रीमियरशिप में जीत से एक कदम दूर रह गया और अगले रविवार को उन लीडर्स हर्ट्स का सामना करेगा, जो आठ पॉइंट से पीछे हैं।
translations.translation: Gerard's side is one step away from winning this season's premiership and will face Leaders Hearts, who are eight points behind, next Sunday.
translations.reference: Gerrard's side remain without an away win in the Premiership this season and face leaders Hearts, who they trail by eight points, next Sunday.

translations.source: इससे पहले, गुरुवार को यूरोपा लीग में रेंजर्स ने रैपिड वियना की मेजबानी की।
translations.translation: Earlier on Thursday, Rangers hosted Rapid Vienna in the Europa League.
translations.reference: Before then, Rangers host Rapid Vienna in the Europa League on Thursday.

translations.source: इस बीच, पिछले महीने केनी मिलर की जगह मुख्य कोच होल्ट को लाने से लिविंगस्टन छह गेम के डिवीजन में लगातार जीत रही है।
translations.translation: Meanwhile, by replacing Kenny Miller with head coach Holt last month, Livingston has been winning a six-game division consecutively.
translations.reference: Livingston, meanwhile, extend their unbeaten run in the division to six games, with head coach Holt still to taste defeat since replacing Kenny Miler last month.

translations.source: विज़िटर को अपना खेल दिखाने से लिविंगस्टन चूक गया
translations.translation: Livingston missed showing his game to the visitor.
translations.reference: Livingston miss chances against blunt visitors

translations.source: स्कोर करने से काफ़ी समय पहले ही होल्ट की टीम को आगे निकल जाना चाहिए था, साथ ही, उनके बढ़िया गेम की वजह से रेंजर्स को कई तरह की समस्याएं हुईं।
translations.translation: Holt's team should have been ahead a long time before they scored, and their excellent play caused a number of problems for the Rangers.
translations.reference: Holt's team should have been ahead long before they scored, with their directness causing Rangers all manner of problems.

translations.source: स्कॉट रॉबिन्सन ने रिकॉर्ड तोड़ा, लेकिन गोल करने के प्रयास से पीछे रह गई, फिर एलन लिथगो फिसलने के बाद अपना बेहतरीन प्रयास करते हुए सिर्फ़ डायरेक्ट रह सकीं ताकि क्रेग हल्केट के हैडर में गोल को पूरा किया जा सके।
translations.translation: Scott Robinson broke the record but lagged behind the goal-scoring effort, and then Alan Lithgow slipped and did his best to stay straight to complete the goal in Craig Hulkett's header.
translations.reference: Scott Robinson broke through but dragged his effort across the face of goal, then Alan Lithgow could only direct his effort wide after sliding in to meet Craig Halkett's header across goal.

translations.source: मेजबानों को रेंजर्स के विरुद्ध खेलने का मौका मिला, वे जानते थें कि वे सेट पीस पर विज़िटर को मुश्किल में डाल सकते हैं।
translations.translation: The hosts had a chance to play against the Rangers, they knew they could get the visitor in trouble on the set piece.
translations.reference: The hosts were content to let Rangers play in front of them, knowing they could trouble the visitors at set pieces.

translations.source: और इसी तरीके की वजह से वह महत्वपूर्ण गोल मिला।
translations.translation: And this is how he scored an important goal.
translations.reference: And that was the manner in which the crucial goal came.

translations.source: रेंजर्स को एक फ़्री-किक मिला और लिविंगस्टन ने ओपनिंग की, डेक्लान गैलेघर और रॉबिन्सन ने मेंगा को सेट करने का काम किया, जिसने एक टच किया और बॉक्स के सेंटर से स्कोर किया।
translations.translation: The Rangers got a free-kick and Livingston opened, Declan Gallagher and Robinson worked to set up the manga, which made a touchdown and scored from the center of the box.
translations.reference: Rangers conceded a free-kick and Livingston worked an opening, Declan Gallagher and Robinson combining to set up Menga, who took a touch and scored from the centre of the box.

translations.source: उस स्टेज पर, रेंजर्स ने अपनी स्थिति मजबूत कर ली थी, लेकिन होम डिफेंस में चूक गई और गोलकीपर लियाम केली काफ़ी हद तक पीछे रह गई,
translations.translation: On that stage, the Rangers had strengthened their position, but missed out on home defense and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely left behind,
translations.reference: By that stage, Rangers had dominated possession but had found the home defence impenetrable and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely untroubled,

translations.source: यह पैटर्न सेकंड हाफ में भी चलता रहा, हालांकि अल्फ्रेडो मोरेलोस ने केली पर सेव होने के लिए जोर डाला।
translations.translation: This pattern continued into the second half, although Alfredo Morelos insisted on Kelly being saved.
translations.reference: That pattern continued into the second half, though Alfredo Morelos did force a save from Kelly.

translations.source: स्कॉट पिटमैन के शॉट को रेंजर्स के गोलकीपर एलन मैकग्रेगर ने पैरों से रोका और लिथगो ने दूसरे लिविंगस्टन से फ्लिक करके गेम पर पूरी तरह से कब्ज़ा किया।
translations.translation: Scott Pittman's shot was stopped by Rangers goalkeeper Alan McGregor on his feet and Lithgow took full control of the game by flicking from another Livingston.
translations.reference: Scott Pittman was denied by the feet of Rangers goalkeeper Allan McGregor and Lithgow flicked wide from another Livingston set play.

translations.source: लिविंग्स्टन बॉक्स में क्रॉस लगातार आते रहे और गोल होने तक जारी रहे, जबकि हल्केट की चैलेंज के बाद दो पेनल्टी के दावे किए गए जिसमें से एक ग्लेन मिडलटन को लाने पर और दूसरा हैंडबॉल पर शामिल था।
translations.translation: Crosses in the Livingston box continued to come and go until the round, while two penalty claims were made after the Hulket challenge, one involving bringing in Glenn Middleton and the other on a handball.
translations.reference: Crosses continually came into the Livingston box and were continually cleared, while two penalty claims - after Halkett's challenge on substitute Glenn Middleton, and one for handball - were waved away.

translations.source: लिविंगस्टन के 'असाधारण गोल' का विश्लेषण
translations.translation: An analysis of Livingston's 'extraordinary goal'
translations.reference: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - analysis

translations.source: बीबीसी स्कॉटलैंड के अलासडेयर लामोंट को टोनी मैकारोनी एरिना में शामिल किया गया
translations.translation: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont was included in the Tony MacArony Arena.
translations.reference: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont at the Tony Macaroni Arena

translations.source: लिविंगस्टन का असाधारण परफॉरमेंस और नतीजा।
translations.translation: Livingston's exceptional performance and results.
translations.reference: A phenomenal performance and result for Livingston.

translations.source: किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए, वे बेहतरीन थे, उन्होंने इस बढ़ती ट्राजेक्टरी पर उम्मीदों को बढ़ाना जारी रखा है।
translations.translation: For anyone, they were great, they have continued to raise expectations on this growing trajectory.
translations.reference: To a man, they were excellent, continuing to exceed expectations on this upward trajectory.

translations.source: उनके खेल के तरीके और व्यक्तित्व ने टॉप फ्लाइट से उनकी वापसी के बाद से आश्चर्यजनक रूप से बदला है, लेकिन सबसे ज़्यादा श्रेय होल्ट के उस तरीके को जाता है जिसमें उन्होंने अपने आने के बाद से ही टीम को नई रूप-रेखा दी है।
translations.translation: His style of play and personality have changed dramatically since his return from the top flight, but most of the credit goes to Holt's way of redefining the team since his arrival.
translations.reference: Their style of play and personnel has scarcely changed since their return to the top flight, but great credit has to go to Holt for the way he has galvanised the team since his arrival.

translations.source: उसमें कई सारे बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी थे।
translations.translation: There were a lot of great players in it.
translations.reference: He had so many heroes.

translations.source: कैप्टन हल्केट बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी रहे, उन्होंने शानदार तरीके से सेव किया, जबकि मेंगा ने कॉनर गोल्ड्सन और जो वॉर्ल को अपने पीछे उलझाए रखा।
translations.translation: Captain Hulkett was a great player, he served well, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Warrell behind him.
translations.reference: Captain Halkett was immense, marshalling a superbly-organised defence, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Worrall on their toes throughout.

translations.source: हालांकि, रेंजर्स में सीखने की कमी थी।
translations.translation: However, there was a lack of learning in the Rangers.
translations.reference: Rangers were short of inspiration, though.

translations.source: जिस तरह का बढ़िया प्रदर्शन उन्होंने जेरार्ड के तहत कई बार किया है, वे उनके स्टैण्डर्ड से कम थे।
translations.translation: The great performances he has made many times under Gerard were below his standard.
translations.reference: As good as they have been at times under Gerrard, they fell well short of those standards.

translations.source: उनके फाइनल बॉल में कमी थी - वे केवल एक बार ही अपने होम साइड ओपन की ओर कट कर पाए थें - और यह रेंजर्स के लिए कुछ वेक-अप कॉल जैसा रहा, जिन्होंने खुद को मिड-टेबल में बनाए रखा।
translations.translation: Their final ball was short - they were only able to cut to their home side open once - and it was like some wake-up call for the Rangers, who kept themselves in the middle of the table.
translations.reference: Their final ball was lacking - only once did they cut the home side open - and it is something of a wake-up call for Rangers, who find themselves in mid-table.

translations.source: कोलोन में एरडोगन का मिला-जुला स्वागत किया गया
translations.translation: Erdoğan was welcomed to Cologne
translations.reference: Erdogan get mixed reception in Cologne

translations.source: शनिवार (29 सितंबर) को तुर्की और जर्मनी के नेता बर्लिन में जब नाश्ते पर मिलें, तो मुस्कुराहटें बिखरी लेकिन कोई फ़ायदा नहीं मिला।
translations.translation: On Saturday (September 29), when the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakfast in Berlin, smiles were scattered but to no avail.
translations.reference: There were smiles and blue skies on Saturday (September 29) as the leaders of Turkey and Germany met for breakast in Berlin.

translations.source: यह जर्मनी के विवादास्पद दौरे पर राष्ट्रपति एरडोगन का आखिरी दिन है - जिसका लक्ष्य नाटो के सहयोगी देशों के साथ संबंधों को बेहतर बनाना है।
translations.translation: This is the last day of President Erdoğan's controversial visit to Germany - which aims to improve relations with NATO allies.
translations.reference: It's the last day of President Erdogan's controversial visit to Germany - which is aimed at repairing relations beteen the NATO allies.

translations.source: वे मानवाधिकार, प्रेस की आज़ादी और ईयू में तुर्की के पदारोहण सहित कई मुद्दों पर विवादों में फंसे रह गए।
translations.translation: They remained embroiled in controversy over a number of issues, including human rights, freedom of the press and Turkey's rise to power in the EU.
translations.reference: They've fallen out over issues including human rights, press freedom and Turkey's accession to the EU.

translations.source: उसके बाद, एरडोगन ने कोलोन में एक बहुत बड़ी नई मस्जिद के निर्माण पर बात की।
translations.translation: After that, Erdoğan spoke of the construction of a very large new mosque in Cologne.
translations.reference: Erdogan then headed for Cologne to open a giant new mosque.

translations.source: तुर्की के बाहर यह शहर एक ऐसा इलाका है जहां सबसे ज़्यादा तुर्की निवासी रहते हैं।
translations.translation: Outside of Turkey, the city is one of the most densely populated areas of Turkey.
translations.reference: The city is home to the largest Turkish population outside Turkey.

translations.source: पुलिस ने सुरक्षा वजहों की बात करते हुए 25,000 लोगों वाली भीड़ को मस्जिद के सामने इकट्ठा होने से रोका, लेकिन कई समर्थक अपने राष्ट्रपति को देखने के लिए आस-पास की जगहों पर उमड़ पड़े।
translations.translation: Speaking of security reasons, the police prevented a crowd of 25,000 people from gathering in front of the mosque, but many supporters flocked to nearby places to see their president.
translations.reference: Police cited security reasons to block a 25,000-strong crowd from gathering in front of the mosque, but plenty of supporters turned out nearby to see their president.

translations.source: एरडोगन का विरोध करने वाले सैकड़ों प्रदर्शनकारियों - जिनमें से कुछ लोग कुर्द के भी थें - ने नारे भी लगाएं, उन्होंने एरडोगन की नीतियों और देश में उनके स्वागत के लिए जर्मनी सरकार के निर्णय की घोर निंदा की।
translations.translation: Hundreds of protesters - some of whom were also Kurds - also chanted slogans, denouncing Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him into the country.
translations.reference: Hundreds of anti-Erdogan protesters - many of them Kurdish - also made their voices heard, condemning both Erdogan's policies and the German government's decision to welcome him to the country.

translations.source: दो-तरफ़ा विरोध प्रदर्शनों में आगंतुक का स्वागत करने वाले उन लोगों के बीच विभाजन देखा गया जिसमें से कुछ लोगों ने उन्हें जर्मन तुर्क नायक माना और बाकी लोगों ने स्वेच्छाचारी शासक बताकर उनका अपमान किया।
translations.translation: The two-way protests saw a split between those who welcomed the visitor, with some calling him a German Turk hero and others denouncing him as a volunteer ruler.
translations.reference: The dueling protests reflect the divisiveness of a visitor hailed as a hero by some German Turks and reviled as an autocrat by others.

translations.source: डेप्टफ़ोर्ड में सड़क दुर्घटना: साइकिल सवार की मौत कार से टक्कर लगने की वजह से हुई
translations.translation: Road accident in Deptford: A bicycle rider was killed after being hit by a car
translations.reference: Deptford road crash: Cyclist dies in collision with car

translations.source: लंदन में एक साइकिल सवार की मौत कार से टकराकर हुई।
translations.translation: In London, a cyclist died after being hit by a car.
translations.reference: A cyclist has died in a collision involving a car in London.

translations.source: यह दुर्घटना करीब 10:15 BST पर शहर के दक्षिण-पूर्वी इलाके में, डेप्टफ़ोर्ड की एक चहल-पहल वाली सड़क बेस्टवुड स्ट्रीट और एवलिन स्ट्रीट के जंक्शन के नज़दीक हुई।
translations.translation: The accident occurred at about 10:15 BST in the southeastern part of the city, near the intersection of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy street in Deptford.
translations.reference: The crash happened near the junction of Bestwood Street and Evelyn Street, a busy road in Deptford, in the south-east of the city, at about 10:15 BST.

translations.source: कार के ड्राइवर ने कार रोक कर उसे प्राथमिक चिकित्सा दिलवाई, लेकिन घटनास्थल पर व्यक्ति की ही मौत हो गई।
translations.translation: The driver of the car stopped the car and brought him to first aid, but the person died on the spot.
translations.reference: The driver of the car stopped and paramedics attended, but the man died at the scene.

translations.source: शनिवार को हुई इस दुर्घटना-स्थल से करीब एक मील दूर चाइल्डर्स स्ट्रीट में हिट-ऐंड-रन की वजह से एक और साइकिल सवार की मौत कुछ महीने पहले हुई थी।
translations.translation: Another cyclist was killed a few months ago in a hit and run on Children's Street, about a mile from the scene of the accident on Saturday.
translations.reference: The crash comes months after another cyclist died in a hit-and-run on Childers Street, about a mile away from Saturday's crash.

translations.source: मेट्रोपॉलिटन पुलिस ने बताया कि उस व्यक्ति की पहचान करने और उसके परिजनों को जानकारी देने के लिए अधिकारी काम कर रहे थे।
translations.translation: The Metropolitan Police said that the authorities were working to identify the person and provide information to his family.
translations.reference: The Metropolitan Police said officers were working to identify the man and inform his next-of-kin.

translations.source: सड़क के मोड़ और बस के डायवर्सन की वजह से ऐसी घटनाएं हो रही हैं और वाहन चालकों को ऐसे इलाके में जाने से बचने की सलाह दी गई है।
translations.translation: Such incidents are occurring due to the bending of the road and bus diversion and motorists are advised to avoid going to such areas.
translations.reference: Road closures and bus diversions are in place and motorists have been advised to avoid the area.

translations.source: लॉन्ग लार्टिन जेल: गड़बड़ी की वजह से छह अधिकारी चोटिल हुए
translations.translation: Long Lartin Prison: Six officers were injured as a result of a disturbance
translations.reference: Long Lartin prison: Six officers hurt in disorder

translations.source: जेल के दफ़्तर की ओर से कहा गया कि हाई सिक्यूरिटी वाले पुरुषों के जेल में गड़बड़ी की वजह से छह जेल अधिकारी चोटिल हुए हैं।
translations.translation: Six prison officials were injured as a result of a disturbance in the high-security men's prison, the prison office said.
translations.reference: Six prison officers have been injured in a disturbance at a high security men's jail, the Prison Office has said.

translations.source: रविवार को करीब 09:30 BST बजे वोर्सस्टरशायर के एचएमपी लॉन्ग लार्टिन में कुछ गड़बड़ी हुई और अभी तक जारी है।
translations.translation: At around 09:30 BST on Sunday, a disturbance occurred at HMP Long Lartin, Worcestershire and is still ongoing.
translations.reference: Disorder broke out at HMP Long Lartin in Worcestershire at about 09:30 BST on Sunday and is ongoing.

translations.source: गड़बड़ी को ठीक करने विशेषज्ञ "टोरनाडो" अधिकारियों को बुलाया गया है, यह गड़बड़ी एक विंग में हैं जिसमें आठ कैदियों को रखा गया है।
translations.translation: The expert "Tornado" officials have been called to fix the mess, the mess is in a wing that holds eight prisoners.
translations.reference: Specialist "Tornado" officers have been brought in to deal with the disturbance, which involves eight inmates and is contained to one wing.

translations.source: घटनास्थल पर अधिकारों के चेहरे पर मामूली चोटें आईं थी जिसका उपचार किया गया था।
translations.translation: There were minor injuries to the face of the rights at the scene who were treated.
translations.reference: The officers were treated for minor facial injuries at the scene.

translations.source: जेल सेवा के एक प्रवक्ता ने बताया: "एचएमपी लॉन्ग लार्टिन में हो रही दुर्घटना को ठीक करने के लिए खास तौर पर प्रशिक्षित जेल कर्मचारियों को रखा गया है।
translations.translation: A Prison Service spokesman said: "Specifically trained prison staff have been put in place to repair the accident taking place at HMP Long Lartin.
translations.reference: A Prison Service spokesperson said: "Specially trained prison staff have been deployed to deal with an ongoing incident at HMP Long Lartin.
