translations.source: वेस्ट वर्जीनिया में आज रात ट्रम्प की होनेवाली रैली कब होगी और आप इसे किस प्रकार ऑनलाइन देख पाएंगे?
translations.translation: When is Trump's rally in West Virginia tonight, and how will you be able to watch it online?
translations.reference: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?

translations.source: व्हीलिंग, वेस्ट वर्जीनिया में होनेवाली ट्रम्प की रैली का समय आज रात शनिवार, 29 सितंबर, 2018 को शाम 7 बजे ET तय किया गया है।
translations.translation: Trump's rally in Wheeling, West Virginia is scheduled for Saturday night, September 29, 2018 at 7pm ET.
translations.reference: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.

translations.source: आप YouTube पर लाइव स्ट्रीम के ज़रिए वेस्ट वर्जीनिया में होनेवाली ट्रम्प की रैली ऑनलाइन देख सकते हैं।
translations.translation: You can watch Trump's rally in West Virginia online via a live stream on YouTube.
translations.reference: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.

translations.source: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के उम्मीदवार ब्रेट कवानौघ के लिए इस हफ़्ते की सुनवाई पर ट्रम्प भाषण दे सकते हैं, कवानौघ पर यौन अपराध के लिए लगे आरोपों की वजह से एफआईटी की जांच के दौरान एक हफ़्ते के लिए प्रत्याशित सीनेट वोट की पुष्टि को रोका गया है।
translations.translation: Trump may address this week's hearing for Supreme Court candidate Brett Kavanaugh, who has been prevented from confirming the anticipated Senate vote for a week during the FIT investigation due to allegations of sexual misconduct on Kavanaugh.
translations.reference: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.

translations.source: लेकिन, रैलियों की इस तनावपूर्ण माहाल का मुख्य लक्ष्य नवंबर में होनेवाले चुनावों का सामना करने रिपब्लिकन की सहायता करना है।
translations.translation: But the main goal of this stressful rally is to help the Republicans to cope with the elections to be held in November.
translations.reference: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.

translations.source: रॉयटर्स के मुताबिक, इस प्रकार राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने अभियान के दौरान बताया, “अगले हफ़्ते होनेवाली इन पांचों रैलियों का लक्ष्य सीनेट और प्रतिनिधियों के सदन में उनके रोके गए बहुमत की रक्षा करने और बढ़ाने के रिपब्लिकन प्रयास के तौर पर स्वयंसेवकों और समर्थकों में जोश भरना है।”
translations.translation: According to Reuters, as President Trump explained during the campaign, "The five rallies scheduled to take place next week are aimed at stirring up enthusiasm among volunteers and supporters as a Republican effort to protect and increase their blocked majority in the Senate and House of Representatives".
translations.reference: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.

translations.source: रॉयटर्स के मुताबिक, जिस प्रवक्ता को ट्रम्प के अभियान से हटाया गया है, उसने बताया, “कांग्रेस का नियंत्रण उनके एजेंडे के लिए इतना ज़रूरी हो गया है कि राष्ट्रपति सिर्फ़ उन्हीं राज्यों का दौरा करेंगे, जहां हमारे अभियान का सीजन बहुत व्यस्त होगा।
translations.translation: According to Reuters, a spokesman who has been removed from Trump's campaign has said that congressional control has become so important to his agenda that the president will only visit states where our campaign season will be very busy.
translations.reference: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.

translations.source: वेस्ट वर्जिनिया मेट्रो न्यूज़ के मुताबिक, “व्हीलिंग के वेसबैंको एरिना में निर्धारित, आज रात की रैली से ओहियो और पेन्सिलवेनिया के समर्थकों का ध्यान पिट्सबर्ग मीडिया पर लाया जा सकता है।”
translations.translation: According to West Virginia Metro News, tonight's rally, scheduled at the Wesbank Arena in Wheeling, will draw the attention of supporters from Ohio and Pennsylvania to the Pittsburgh media.
translations.reference: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.

translations.source: शनिवार पिछले महीने का वह दूसरा समय होगा जब ट्रम्प ने वेस्ट वर्जीनिया का दौरा किया है, इस इलाके से 2016 में उन्हें 40 प्रतिशत से ज़्यादा वोट प्राप्त किए थे।
translations.translation: Saturday will be the second time last month that Trump has visited West Virginia, where he won more than 40 percent of the vote in 2016.
translations.reference: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.

translations.source: वेस्ट वर्जीनिया रिपब्लिकन सीनेट के सर्वे में पीछे रहने वाले उम्मीदवार पैट्रिक मोरिस की मदद के प्रयास लिए ट्रम्प आगे आ रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Trump is coming forward in an effort to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morris, who lagged behind in the survey.
translations.reference: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.

translations.source: रॉयटर्स के मुताबिक, वेस्ट वर्जीनिया यूनिवर्सिटी के राजनीतिक वैज्ञानिक साइमन हैदर ने बताया, “अगर चुनाव में मोरिस को बढ़त दिलाने का प्रयास राष्ट्रपति को करना पड़ रहा है, तो यह उनके लिए अच्छा संकेत नहीं है।”
translations.translation: According to Reuters, a West Virginia University political scientist, Simon Hayder, said, "If the president has to try to get Morris an edge in the election, it's not a good sign for him".
translations.reference: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.

translations.source: राइडर कप 2018: टीम यूएसए ने मुकाबला करने की इच्छा दिखाई ताकि सन्डे सिंगल्स में शीर्ष पर रहने की उम्मीदों को बनाए रखा जा सके
translations.translation: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA showed a willingness to compete in order to maintain their expectations of being at the top of the Sunday singles.
translations.reference: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles

translations.source: तीन एकतरफा सेशन के बाद, शनिवार की दोपहर को चौथे सेशन में इस बात का नतीज़ा मिल जाएगा कि इस राइडर कप में क्या होने वाला है।
translations.translation: After three one-sided sessions, the fourth session will be held on Saturday afternoon to decide what will happen in this Ryder Cup.
translations.reference: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.

translations.source: समय का बीतता चक्र खिलाड़ियों के लिए पूरी तरह से नई अवधारणा होती है, लेकिन कब कौन खिलाड़ी आगे निकल जाए और किस खिलाड़ी पर भरोसा किया जाए, इन जैसी प्रतियोगिताओं में इसका अनुमान नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
translations.translation: The passage of time is an entirely new concept for players, but it is unpredictable in competitions like these when which player will advance and which player will be trusted.
translations.reference: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.

translations.source: इसलिए, वे अब इस मोमेंटम के बारे में क्या कहेंगे?
translations.translation: So, what will they say about this momentum now?
translations.reference: So where would they say the momentum is now?

translations.source: दिन को चहलकदमी करते समय जॉर्डन स्पीथ ने बताया, “उनके पास छह पॉइंट अंक की बढ़त थी जो अब चार रह गई है, इसलिए मुझे लगता है हमें अपनी गति को थोड़ा बढ़ाना होगा।”
translations.translation: As he walked during the day, Jordan Speeth said, "He had a six-point lead which has now become four, so I think we need to step up our speed a little bit".
translations.reference: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.

translations.source: निश्चित तौर पर, यूरोप को फ़ायदा मिला और खेल में 12 पॉइंट लेकर चार पॉइंट से आगे हो गया।
translations.translation: Europe, of course, gained an advantage, taking 12 points in the game to four points ahead.
translations.reference: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.

translations.source: स्पिएथ के अनुसार, अमेरिकन को लगता है कि उनके पास थोड़े-बहुत मौके बचे हुए हैं और प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए बहुत कुछ है, न केवल स्पिएथ के फॉर्म से बल्कि जस्टिन थॉमस के फॉर्म से भी, जिन्होंने पूरे दिन एक साथ खेला और दोनों ने अपने खेल से चार में से तीन पॉइंट प्राप्त किए।
translations.translation: According to Spyth, the Americans feel they have a few more chances left and a lot to encourage, not only from the form of Spyth but also from the form of Justin Thomas, who played together all day and both scored three of their four points from their game.
translations.reference: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.

translations.source: स्पिएथ टी से लेकर ग्रीन तक सबके लिए घातक है और खेल में सबसे बेहतर भी है।
translations.translation: Spyth is deadly to everyone from T to Green and is also the best in the game.
translations.reference: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.

translations.source: उनके खेल के आगे बढ़ते ही लोगों ने उत्साह दिखाते हुए खुशी से जोरदार तालियां बजाईं, जब वे और थॉमस दो के बाद दो और पॉइंट नीचे चले गए, तो चार ऑल-स्क्वायर पूरा करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण पुट किया।
translations.translation: As his game progressed, the crowd cheered with enthusiastic applause, as he and Thomas went two points down after two, making a significant putt to complete the four all-squares.
translations.reference: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.

translations.source: उनके पुट की वजह से ही उनकी टीम समान स्क्रीम के साथ 15वीं पोजीशन में आई, सॉर्ट जो आपको बताता है कि आप अमेरिकन टीम को इससे बाहर नहीं मानते।
translations.translation: It was because of his puts that his team came in 15th place with the same scream, a sort that tells you that you don't consider the American team out of it.
translations.reference: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.

translations.source: स्पिएथ ने कहा, “आपको वाकई सिर्फ़ बढ़िया खेलना है और इसका ध्यान रखना है कि जीत आपकी है।”
translations.translation: "You have to play really well and keep in mind that the win is yours".
translations.reference: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.

translations.source: ऐसा वे सभी खिलाड़ी कहते हैं जो खेल से बाहर हो गए हैं।
translations.translation: This is what all the players who are out of the game say.
translations.reference: It is all each of these players has left now.

translations.source: एक मार्क बनाने के लिए 18 होल।
translations.translation: 18 holes to make a mark.
translations.reference: 18 holes to make a mark.

translations.source: पिछले दो दिनों में स्पिएथ और थॉमस से ज़्यादा पॉइंट वाले सिर्फ़ दो ही खिलाड़ी हैं जिनके नाम फ्रांसेस्को मोलिनारी और टॉमी फ्लीटवुड हैं, वे राइडर कप में नया इतिहास बना रहे हैं।
translations.translation: In the last two days, only two players with more points than Spyth and Thomas, Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, are making new history in the Ryder Cup.
translations.reference: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.

translations.source: यूरोप के अलग-अलग शैली वाले लेकिन बेहतर कपल ने चार में चार पॉइंट पॉइंट प्राप्त किया और सबसे आगे हैं।
translations.translation: The pair, with different European styles but better, scored four points out of four and led the way.
translations.reference: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.

translations.source: शनिवार दोपहर को "मोलिवुड" है अकेली जोड़ी थी जिसने कोई बोगी शूट नहीं किया, लेकिन उन्होंने शनिवार सुबह, शुक्रवार दोपहर और शुक्रवार सुबह नौ बजे से पहले तक बोगी से दूर रही।
translations.translation: On Saturday afternoon, "Mollywood" was the only couple who did not shoot a bogie, but they stayed away from the bogie until before 9 am on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and Friday morning.
translations.reference: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.

translations.source: रविवार को वह रन और उस रन को पाने तरीका इस प्रबल भीड़ में और इस प्रबल भीड़ से ऐसे मिला जैसे कि वे बीट करने वाले खिलाड़ी हैं, और ऐसा कोई खिलाड़ी नहीं है जो यूरोपियन टीम की संभावी जीत को हार में बदल सके ऐसा लगा कि फ्लीटवुड या मोलिनरी की तुलना में ले गोल्फ नेशनल का सूर्यास्त पहले होगा।
translations.translation: The way to get that run and that run on Sunday was in this overwhelming crowd and in this overwhelming crowd as if they were beating players, and there is no player who could turn a possible European team victory into a defeat. It seemed that the sunset of the Le Golf National would be sooner than that of Fleetwood or Molinary.
translations.reference: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.

translations.source: अच्छा हो कि दोनों अलग-अलग तरीकों से अलग-अलग होल पर हों।
translations.translation: It would be nice if both of them were on different holes in different ways.
translations.reference: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.

translations.source: हालांकि, यूरोपियन की गरिमा की बात काफ़ी पहले से की जाती रही है।
translations.translation: However, the dignity of Europeans has long been discussed.
translations.reference: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.

translations.source: बुब्बा वाटसन और वेब सिम्पसन ने सुबह में फोरबॉल के हीरो सर्जियो गार्सिया के लिए थोड़ा आसान बनाया, उस समय उनकी जोड़ी एलेक्स नोरेन के साथ बनाई गई थी।
translations.translation: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made it a little easier for Foreball's hero Sergio Garcia in the morning, which was created with his partner Alex Noren at the time.
translations.reference: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.

translations.source: नौ डग के सामने एक बोगी और दो डबल में स्पैनियार्ड और स्वेड ने होल किया, इससे पहले वे कभी भी यहां तक नहीं पहुँच पाए थें।
translations.translation: In front of nine dogs, a bogie and two doubles, the Spaniards and the Swedes drilled a hole, as they had never been able to get there before.
translations.reference: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.

translations.source: हालांकि, रविवार को ऐसा कोई व्यक्ति मौजूद नहीं था जो आपके होल तक आपको पहुंचाने में मदद करे।
translations.translation: On Sunday, however, no one was present to help you get to your hole.
translations.reference: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.

translations.source: देखने पर फोरबॉल और फोरसम बहुत बेहतरीन थें क्योंकि पेयरिंग के बीच इंटरेक्शन काफ़ी बेहतरीन रहा, उन्होंने सलाह दिया कि उन्हें सलाह लेने की ज़रूरत नहीं और रणनीति को बदलने के तरीके से वे भली-भाँती परिचित हैं।
translations.translation: The foreballs and the forums were superb in appearance because the interaction between the pairings was superb, they advised that they didn't have to ask for advice and they were well acquainted with how to change the strategy.
translations.reference: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.

translations.source: एक टीम के तौर पर यूरोप ने बहुत बढ़िया खेला और आखिरी दिन में महत्वपूर्ण बढ़त ली, लेकिन इस फोरसम सेशन ने यह भी दिखाया कि टीम यूएसए के पास वैसा मुकाबला करने की क्षमता है जो, खास तौर पर स्टेटसाइड में, संदेहात्मक है।
translations.translation: As a team, Europe played very well and took an important lead on the final day, but this forums session also showed that Team USA has the ability to compete in a way that is, in particular, questionable in the Stateside.
translations.reference: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.

translations.source: राइडर कप के आखिरी दिन यूरोप ने 10-6 की बढ़त ली
translations.translation: On the last day of the Ryder Cup, Europe took a 10-6 lead.
translations.reference: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day

translations.source: शनिवार को यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स पर 10-6 की बढ़त वाले फोरबॉल और फोरसम मैच के होने बाद राइडर कप के आखिरी दिन यूरोप अच्छे तरीके से इसका फ़ायदा उठाएगा।
translations.translation: Europe will take advantage of this on the final day of the Ryder Cup, following a 10-6 draw against the United States on Saturday.
translations.reference: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.

translations.source: बेहतरीन जोड़ी टॉमी फ्लीटवुड और फ्रांसेस्को मोलिनारी ने दो जीत के साथ संघर्ष कर रहे टाइगर वुड्स पर बढ़त ले ली ताकि वे अपने मिलान को ले गोल्फ़ नेशनल के चार पॉइंट से बहुत आगे निकल सकें।
translations.translation: The best pair, Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari, took the lead over two-win-struggle Tiger Woods to put their match far ahead of the Le Golf National's four points.
translations.reference: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.

translations.source: हेज़लटाइन में दो साल पहले ट्रॉफी की अपनी हार का बदला लेने के लिए थॉमस बीजोर्न के यूरोपियन साइड मॉर्निंग फोरबॉल में अमेरिकन साइड की मिसफायरिंग की वजह से हावी हो गया जिससे सीरीज में उसे 3-1 से बढ़त मिल गई।
translations.translation: In retaliation for his loss of the trophy two years earlier at Hazeltine, Thomas Beazorn was overwhelmed by the misfiring of the American side in the European side of the morning forball, giving him a 3-1 lead in the series.
translations.reference: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.

translations.source: यू.एस. ने दो मैच में जीत दर्ज़ करते हुए फोरसम में ज़्यादा प्रतिरोध दिखाया, लेकिन वे हारने से नहीं बच सके।
translations.translation: The U.S. showed more resistance in the Fourth, winning two matches, but they could not avoid defeat.
translations.reference: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.

translations.source: ट्रॉफी की जीत को बनाए रखने के लिए जिम फ्यूरीक की साइड को रविवार के 12 सिंगल मैच में आठ पॉइंट की ज़रूरत है।
translations.translation: To keep the trophy win, Jim Furyk's side needs eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches.
translations.reference: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.

translations.source: फ्लीटवुड लगातार चार पॉइंट जीतने वाले पहले यूरोपीय रूकी हैं, जबकि उन्होंने और मोलिनरी ने सेंसेशनल वीकेंड के बाद "मोलीवुड" से शुरुआत की थी, वे ऐसी दूसरी जोड़ी हैं जिसने राइडर कप के इतिहास में अपने शुरुआती चार मैच में चार पॉइंट जीता है।
translations.translation: Fleetwood are the first European rookie to win four consecutive points, while he and Molinari started with "Mollywood" after a sensational weekend, they are the second pair to win four points in their first four Ryder Cup matches in history.
translations.reference: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.

translations.source: फोरबॉल में वुड्स और पैट्रिक रीड को हारने के बाद, उन्होंने फिर से बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी वुड्स और अमेरिकी रुकी ब्रायसन डेशाम्बू को हारने के लिए पहले से ज़्यादा बढ़िया प्रदर्शन करते हुए 5 और 4 पॉइंट से हरा दिया।
translations.translation: After defeating Woods and Patrick Reid in the Foorball, he once again outperformed the best players, Woods and American rookie Bryson DeShambu, by 5 and 4 points.
translations.reference: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.

translations.source: शनिवार को दो मैचों के ज़रिए खुद को आगे रखने वाले वुड्स ने  अपना बेहतरीन प्रदर्शन दिखाया, लेकिन अब वे फोरबॉल तथा फोरसम के अपने 29 मैच और रो के सात मैच में 19 बार हार का सामना कर चुके हैं।
translations.translation: The two-match forward showed his best performance on Saturday, but he has now lost 19 of his 29 for-ball and for-sum matches and seven for-row matches.
translations.reference: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.

translations.source: बाकी बचे मॉर्निंग फोरबॉल में जस्टिन रोज़ अपने पार्टर हेनरिक स्टेंसन के साथ फिर से फोरसम में वापस आएं और दुनिया के रैंक एक और तीन के खिलाड़ी डस्टिन जॉनसन और ब्रूक्स कोपेका को 2-1 से हराया।
translations.translation: In the remainder of the Morning Forball, Justin Rose, along with his partner Henrik Stenson, returned to the forums again, defeating the world's number one and third-placed players Dustin Johnson and Brooks Kopeca, 2-1.
translations.reference: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.

translations.source: हालांकि, पेरिस के साउथ वेस्ट में प्लीजेंट, ब्रीज़ी दिन को यूरोप के पास इसका कोई तोड़ नहीं था।
translations.translation: However, on a pleasant, breezy day in the southwest of Paris, Europe had no break.
translations.reference: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.

translations.source: शनिवार को तीन बार विजयी होने वाले प्रमुख खिलाड़ी जॉर्डन स्पिएथ और जस्टिन थॉमस ने दो पॉइंट प्राप्त करके अमेरिकिन के लिए बेंचमार्क स्थापित किया।
translations.translation: The three-time winners on Saturday, key players Jordan Spyth and Justin Thomas, set the benchmark for the Americans by scoring two points.
translations.reference: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.

translations.source: उन्होंने फोरबॉल में स्पेन के जॉन रहम और इयान पॉल्टर पर 2-1 से शानदार जीत पाई और पॉल्स और रोरी मैक्लेरॉय को शुरूआती दो होल में 4-3 से हराकर वापस भेजा।
translations.translation: He won a spectacular 2-1 victory over the Spaniards, John Rahm and Ian Polter, in the Forball, and sent Pauls and Rory McLeary back after a 4-3 defeat in the first two holes.
translations.reference: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.

translations.source: राइडर कप के इतिहास में ऐसा सिर्फ़ दो बार हुआ है जब कोई टीम चार पॉइंट प्राप्त करके सिंगल तक पहुँचने वाले मैच से वापस आई, हालांकि जिस तरह की ज़रूरत फ्यूरीक की साइड को थी उसी ने ट्रॉफी में सबका ध्यान आकर्षित करके रखा।
translations.translation: This is only the second time in the history of the Ryder Cup that a team has returned from a single-elimination match with four points, although the need for the Furic side kept everyone's attention in the trophy.
translations.reference: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.

translations.source: हालांकि, दो दिनों तक सेकंड-बेस्ट बने रहने के बाद रविवार को होने वाला काउंटर-अटैक ऐसा होने वाला है, जैसा कि उनके पुराने खेल से अलग हो।
translations.translation: However, after being second-best for two days, the Sunday counter-attack is going to be different from their old game.
translations.reference: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.

translations.source: उत्तर कोरिया ने कहा कि 'कोई रास्ता नहीं है' कहने से निरस्त्रीकरण सिर्फ़ एक पक्ष का होगा जिस पर भरोसा नहीं किया जा सकता
translations.translation: North Korea has said that by saying 'there is no way' disarmament will only be on one side that cannot be trusted.
translations.reference: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust

translations.source: उत्तर कोरिया के विदेश मंत्री ने बताया कि शनिवार को संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने उन प्रतिबंधों को जारी रखा है जो यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स में अपने अविश्वास पर निर्भर थे और ऐसा कोई तरीका नहीं दिखा जिससे देश ऐसी परिस्थितियों में सिर्फ़ अपनी ओर से परमाणु बम का निरीक्षण करना छोड़ दे।
translations.translation: North Korea's foreign minister said on Saturday that the United Nations has continued to impose sanctions that were based on its disbelief in the United States and has not shown a way for the country to abandon its nuclear bomb inspection on its own merely in such circumstances.
translations.reference: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.

translations.source: री योंग हो ने वर्ल्ड बॉडी की एनुअल जनरल असेंबली में कहा कि पिछले साल उत्तर कोरिया ने कई तरीके आजमाए थें जो “महत्वपूर्ण सद्भावना तरीके" से जुड़े थें, जैसे कि, परमाणु बम और मिसाइल के परीक्षण को रोकना, परमाणु बम के परीक्षण वाली जगह को ध्वस्त करना, और परमाणु हथियारों और परमाणु प्रौद्योगिकी का कार्य आगे न बढ़ाने का वादा करना।
translations.translation: Re Yong Ho told the World Body's Annual General Assembly that last year, North Korea had tried a number of ways that were related to the 'Important Goodwill Way', such as stopping nuclear bomb and missile testing, demolishing a nuclear bomb testing site, and pledging not to pursue the work of nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
translations.reference: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, “हालांकि, हमें अमेरिका से इसके लिए कोई जवाब नहीं मिल पाया है।”
translations.translation: He said, "However, we have not been able to get an answer from the US for this.
translations.reference: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.

translations.source: "यू.एस. पर किसी भी तरीके से भरोसा किए बिना हमारी राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा के लिए कोई विश्वास नहीं रह जाएगा और इस तरह की स्थितियों में ऐसा कोई तरीका नहीं है जिससे हम एकतरफा निरस्त्रीकरण की शुरुआत हम करें।"
translations.translation: "There will be no confidence in our national security without trusting the U.S. in any way, and there is no way we can begin unilateral disarmament in these circumstances".
translations.reference: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."

translations.source: जबकि री ने दोहराया कि उत्तर कोरिया द्वारा की गई शिकायतें निरस्त्रीकरण को देखते हुए वाशिंगटन के "चरणबद्ध" दृष्टिकोण के बारे में हैं जिसके तहत धीरे-धीरे उत्तर कोरिया को क्रमिक रूप से फ़ायदा मिलने लगेगा, उनके कथन से यह बात पूरी तरह से स्पष्ट है कि इस एकतरफा निरस्त्रीकरण को केवल एक पक्ष द्वारा नहीं छोड़ा जा सकता क्योंकि प्योंगयांग ने पहले भी ऐसा किया है।
translations.translation: While Re reiterated that the complaints made by North Korea are about Washington's "step-by-step" approach to disarmament under which North Korea will gradually benefit, his statement makes it quite clear that this unilateral disarmament cannot be left to one side only as Pyongyang has done before.
translations.reference: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.

translations.source: पहली बार जून 12 को सिंगापुर में सेवारत यू.एस. प्रेसिडेंट और उत्तर कोरिया के नेता के बीच हुए शिखर सम्मेलन में री ने किम जोंग उन और डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से कहे गए कथन का सन्दर्भ दिया, उस समय किम ने "कोरियाई प्रायद्वीप के निरस्त्रीकरण" की दिशा में काम करने का प्रण लिया था जबकि ट्रम्प ने  उत्तर कोरिया की सुरक्षा की गारंटी का वचन लिया था।
translations.translation: For the first time, at a summit between the serving U.S. president and the North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, Lee referred to a statement made jointly by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump, when Kim pledged to work toward "the disarmament of the Korean Peninsula", while Trump pledged to guarantee the security of North Korea.
translations.reference: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.

translations.source: उत्तर कोरिया 1950-53 में हुए कोरिया युद्ध को औपचारिक रूप से खत्म करने की मांग कर रहा है, लेकिन यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स का कहना है कि प्योंगयांग को सबसे पहले अपने परमाणु हथियार बनाने छोड़ देने चाहिए।
translations.translation: North Korea is seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korean War, but the United States says that Pyongyang should give up building its nuclear weapons first.
translations.reference: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.

translations.source: उत्तर कोरिया पर सख्त अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिबंधों को खत्म करने के लिए वाशिंगटन ने कॉल का भी विरोध किया है।
translations.translation: Washington has also opposed the call for lifting strict international sanctions on North Korea.
translations.reference: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.

translations.source: री ने कहा, “यू.एस. सबसे पहले निरस्त्रीकरण पर जोर दिया है और प्रतिबंधों के दबाव का स्तर बढ़ाया है ताकि वह बलपूर्वक अपने उद्देश्य को प्राप्त कर सके, और साथ ही, उसने "युद्ध के खत्म होने की घोषणा" पर भी आपत्ति जताई है।”
translations.translation: "The U.S. has first emphasized disarmament and increased the level of sanctions pressure to achieve its objective by force, and at the same time, it has also objected to the "declaration of an end to the war", he said.
translations.reference: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.

translations.source: "प्रतिबंद हमें झुका सकता है, ऐसी धारणा उन लोगों का एक पाइप ड्रीम है जो हमें अनदेखा कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: "The barrier can bend us, such a perception is a pipe dream of those who are ignoring us.
translations.reference: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.

translations.source: लेकिन दिक्कत यह है कि लगातार प्रतिबंध से हमारा भरोसा और भी कम होता जा रहा है।”
translations.translation: But the problem is that our confidence is being weakened by continuing restrictions.
translations.reference: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."

translations.source: री ने किम और ट्रम्प के बीच दूसरे शिखर सम्मेलन की योजना पर कोई चर्चा नहीं की, उन्होंने कहा कि यू.एस. नेता ने पिछले हफ़्ते संयुक्त राष्ट्र की खूबियों का बखान किया था।
translations.translation: Re did not discuss the plan for a second summit between Kim and Trump, adding that the U.S. leader had spoken of the virtues of the United Nations last week.
translations.reference: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.

translations.source: इसके बजाय मंत्री ने किम और साउथ कोरिया के नेता मून जे-इन के बीच पिछले पांच महीनों में हुई तीन मीटिंग पर चर्चा की और आगे बताते हुए कहा: “अगर निरस्त्रीकरण की इस समस्या के लिए पार्टी साउथ कोरिया है और यू.एस. नहीं है, तो कोरियाई प्रायद्वीप का निरस्त्रीकरण ऐसे गतिरोध में शामिल नहीं होगा।”
translations.translation: Instead, the minister discussed three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in over the past five months, adding: "If the party to this disarmament problem is South Korea and not the US, the disarmament of the Korean Peninsula will not be involved in such a standoff".
translations.reference: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."

translations.source: फिर भी, री का भाषण पिछले साल के भाषण से बहुत अलग था, जब उन्होंने यू.एन. नेशनल असेंबली के बारे में कहा कि सुसाइड मिशन पर “राकेट मैन” कहलाने वाले “मि. ईविल प्रेसिडेंट” ट्रम्प के बाद उत्तर कोरिया के रॉकेट के साथ यू.एस. मेनलैंड को टारगेट करना अपरिहार्य था।
translations.translation: Nevertheless, Re's speech was very different from his last year's speech to the U.N. National Assembly, when he said that it was inevitable to target the U.S. mainland with North Korean rockets after Mr.
translations.reference: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.

translations.source: इस साल यूनाइटेड नेशंस में, पिछले साल उत्तर कोरिया को "पूरी तरह से नष्ट" करने की धमकी देने वाले ट्रम्प ने निरस्त्रीकरण के लिए उठाए जाने वाले किम के साहस की प्रशंसा की थी लेकिन कहा कि अभी भी बहुत काम करना है और प्रतिबंध तब तक लागू रहेंगे जब तक उत्तर कोरिया निरस्त्रीकरण नहीं करता।
translations.translation: At this year's United Nations, Trump, who had threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea last year, praised Kim's courage in pushing for disarmament but said there was still much work to be done and the sanctions would remain in place until North Korea disarms.
translations.reference: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.

translations.source: बुधवार को, ट्रम्प ने बताया कि इसके लिए उनके पास कोई समय-सीमा निर्धारित नहीं है, “अगर इसमें दो साल, तीन साल या पांच साल भी लग जाते हैं - तो इससे कोई फ़र्क नहीं पड़ता।”
translations.translation: On Wednesday, Trump said that he has no deadline for it, it doesn't matter if it takes two years, three years, or five years.
translations.reference: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."

translations.source: चीन और रूस इस बात पर बहस कर रहे हैं कि यू.एन.  सिक्यूरिटी काउंसिल को उठाए जाने वाले कदमों के लिए प्योंगयांग को इनाम दिया जाना चाहिए।
translations.translation: China and Russia are arguing that Pyongyang should be rewarded for the steps taken by the UN Security Council.
translations.reference: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.

translations.source: हालांकि, गुरुवार को राज्य के यू.एस. सेक्रेटरी माइक पोम्पिओ ने यू.एन. सिक्यूरिटी काउंसिल से कहा कि: "सिक्यूरिटी काउंसिल के प्रतिबंध तब तक लागू रहने चाहिए जब तक कि बिना किसी विफलता के हमें यह एहसास न हो जाए कि हम पूरी तरह से, आखिरी और सत्यापित निरस्त्रीकरण कर रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: However, on Thursday, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council: "The Security Council's sanctions should remain in place until we realize without any fail that we are making a complete, final and verified disarmament".
translations.reference: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."

translations.source: सिक्यूरिटी काउंसिल ने प्योंगयांग के परमाणु और बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल प्रोग्राम हेतु फंड जमा करने के लिए 2006 में पूरी सहमति के साथ उत्तर कोरिया पर प्रतिबंध बढाएं हैं।
translations.translation: The Security Council has extended the sanctions on North Korea with full agreement in 2006 to raise funds for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
translations.reference: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.

translations.source: यू.एन. जनरल असेंबली में पोम्पेओ ने री से मुलाकात की और फिर बताया कि वे अगले महीने दूसरे शिखर सम्मेलन के लिए फिर से प्योंगयांग जाएंगे।
translations.translation: At the U.N. General Assembly, Pompeo met with Ri and then informed him that he would return to Pyongyang for the second summit next month.
translations.reference: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.

translations.source: इस साल पोम्पेओ ने पहले ही उत्तर कोरिया का दौरा तीन बार कर लिया है, लेकिन उनका पिछ्ला दौरा बढ़िया नहीं रहा।
translations.translation: This year, Pompeo has already visited North Korea three times, but his last visit was not a good one.
translations.reference: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.

translations.source: वे जुलाई में प्योंगयांग से वापस और कहा कि काम आगे बढ़ा था, केवल कुछ ही घंटों के भीतर उत्तर कोरिया ने "गैंगस्टर-जैसी मांगों" के लिए उनकी निंदा की।
translations.translation: He returned from Pyongyang in July and said the work had progressed, with North Korea in just a few hours denouncing him for "gangster-like demands".
translations.reference: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."

translations.source: इस महीने मून वाली मीटिंग में उत्तर कोरिया ने मिसाइल साइट को नष्ट करने का संकल्प लिया और अगर यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स “संगत उपाय” अपनाता है, तो वह परमाणु परिसर को भी नष्ट कर देगा।
translations.translation: At a monthly meeting this month, North Korea pledged to destroy the missile site and, if the United States takes appropriate measures, it will also destroy the nuclear compound.
translations.reference: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि किम ने उनसे "संगत उपाय" के लिए वादा किया था, वे इस बात के सुरक्षा की गारंटी मांग रहे थे कि सिंगापुर में ट्रम्प संकल्प लें और वे वाशिंगटन के साथ सामान्य संबंध बनाने की ओर आगे बढ़े।
translations.translation: He said that Kim had promised him "conforming measures", they were seeking security guarantees that Trump would make a resolution in Singapore and they were moving towards a normal relationship with Washington.
translations.reference: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.

translations.source: हार्वर्ड के विद्यार्थी पर्याप्त आराम वाली नौकरी के लिए कोर्स कर रहे हैं
translations.translation: Harvard students are taking courses for a comfortable job.
translations.reference: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest

translations.source: हार्वर्ड विश्वविद्यालय में इस साल एक नए कोर्स की शुरुआत की है जो इसके उन सभी अंडरग्रेजुएट के लिए है जो कैफीन-ईंधन वाले 'ऑल-नाइटर्स' के ज़रिए अध्ययन के लिए बढ़ते माचो कल्चर में मुकाबला करते वक्त ज़्यादा-से-ज़्यादा आराम पाना चाहते हैं।
translations.translation: This year, a new course has been launched at Harvard University for all of its undergraduates who want to get more and more relaxed while coping with the growing macho culture of studying with caffeine-fueled 'all-nighters'.
translations.reference: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'

translations.source: दुनिया की नंबर एक यूनिवर्सिटी के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाने वाले शिक्षक के पास अक्सर तब कोई विकल्प नहीं होता जब ऐसी बिल्कुल आम बातें आती हैं कि खुद को आराम देने के लिए क्या करें।
translations.translation: A teacher who teaches students at the number one university in the world often has no choice when it comes to the most basic things about what to do to relax himself.
translations.reference: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.

translations.source: हार्वर्ड मेडिकल स्कूल में स्लीप मेडिसिन के प्रोफेसर और ब्रिघम तथा विमेंस हॉस्पिटल के विशेषज्ञ चार्ल्स कज़ीस्लर ने एक ऐसा कोर्स बनाया है जिसके लिए उनका मानना है कि यू.एस. में यह अपनी तरह का पहला कोर्स है।
translations.translation: Professor of Sleep Medicine at Harvard Medical School and specialist at Brigham and Women's Hospital, Charles Kaizler, has created a course for which he believes it is the first of its kind in the U.S.
translations.reference: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.

translations.source: शिक्षण के समय कम नींद के असर पर बात करने के बाद उन्हें इस कोर्स को शुरू करने का विचार आया।
translations.translation: After talking about the effect of low sleep during teaching, he came up with the idea of starting this course.
translations.reference: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.

translations.source: उन्होंने द टेलीग्राफ को बताया, 'मेरे पास साल के अंत में एक लड़की आई और उसने कहा: 'मैं क्यों हर बार यही कहती हूं कि मुझे अगले साल अगली क्लास में जाना है?'
translations.translation: He told The Telegraph, 'I had a girl come to me at the end of the year and she said, 'Why do I always say that I have to go to the next class next year?'
translations.reference: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'

translations.source: उसने बताया कि किसी भी व्यक्ति ने उसे नींद की महत्ता के बारे में नहीं बताया - जिससे मैं चौंक गया।’
translations.translation: She said that no one told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me.
translations.reference: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.

translations.source: इस साल पहली बार इस कोर्स के आने पर विद्यार्थियों को पता चलेगा कि पढ़ाई-लिखाई और एथलेटिक परफॉरमेंस में सोने की अच्छी आदत किस तरह महत्वपूर्ण है, इसके अलावा इससे उनके सामान्य स्वास्थ्य को भी बेहतर बनाया जाएगा।
translations.translation: On entering the course for the first time this year, the students will learn the importance of good sleeping habits in reading and athletic performance, and it will also improve their overall health.
translations.reference: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.

translations.source: हार्वर्ड मेडिकल स्कूल में मनोचिकित्सा के प्रोफेसर और यूनिवर्सिटी के हेल्थ सर्विसेज के एग्जीक्यूटिव डायरेक्टर पॉल बर्रेरा ने बताया कि विद्यार्थी हर हफ़्ते पर्याप्त रूप से नहीं सोते हैं जिसके लिए यूनिवर्सिटी ने इस कोर्स  को शुरू करने का फैसला किया।
translations.translation: Paul Barrera, a professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and the university's executive director of health services, said that students don't get enough sleep every week for which the university decided to start the course.
translations.reference: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.

translations.source: घंटों तक चलने वाले कोर्स में इंटरैक्टिव टास्क की एक सीरीज शामिल की गई है।
translations.translation: The hour-long course includes a series of interactive tasks.
translations.reference: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.

translations.source: एक सेक्शन में, एक डोर्मिटरी रूम की छवि होगी, जहां विद्यार्थी कॉफी कप, पर्दे, प्रशिक्षकों और किताबों पर क्लिक करके यह बताएंगे कि कैफीन और लाइट पर क्या असर होगा और इस बारे में बताया जाएगा कि नींद की कमी से एथलेटिक परफॉरमेंस पर किस तरह का असर होता है, साथ ही, दिनचर्या में सोने के समय के महत्व के बारे में भी बताया जाएगा।
translations.translation: In one section, there will be an image of a dormitory room where students will, by clicking on coffee cups, curtains, instructors and books, explain the effect of caffeine and light and how the lack of sleep affects athletic performance, as well as the importance of sleep time in routine.
translations.reference: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.

translations.source: दूसरे सेक्शन में, प्रतिभागियों को बताया जाएगा कि पर्याप्त नींद की कमी से दिल के दौरे, स्ट्रोक, डिप्रेशन और कैंसर का ख़तरा बढ़ सकता है।
translations.translation: In the second section, participants will be told that a lack of adequate sleep can increase the risk of heart attack, stroke, depression and cancer.
translations.reference: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.

translations.source: इंटरेक्टिव आइकन वाले कैंपस का मानचित्र दिखाया जाएगा, फिर प्रतिभागियों को उनकी दैनिक दिनचर्या के बारे में सोचने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: A map of the campus with an interactive icon will be shown, then the participants will be encouraged to think about their daily routine.
translations.reference: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.

translations.source: प्रोफेसर ज़ेसलर ने कहा, ‘हमें पता है कि इससे विद्यार्थियों का व्यवहार तुरंत नहीं बदलेगा।
translations.translation: "We know that this will not change the behaviour of the students immediately", said Professor Zessler.
translations.reference: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.

translations.source: लेकिन, हमारा मानना है कि उनके पास इस बात की जानकारी होनी चाहिए - ठीक वैसे ही जैसा कि सिगरेट पीने से स्वास्थ्य पर होने वाले असर के बारे जानकारी होती है।’
translations.translation: But we believe that they should be aware of this - just as they are aware of the health effects of smoking.
translations.reference: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि 'पूरी रात जागकर पढ़ने' पर गर्व का अनुभव करने की संस्कृति अभी भी मौजूद है, आधुनिक तकनीक और विद्यार्थियों पर बढ़ते दबाव का अर्थ है कि उन्हें कम सोना पड़ता है जो एक बढ़ती हुई समस्या बन गई है।
translations.translation: He said that the culture of feeling proud of 'wake up to read all night' is still present, modern technology and the increasing pressure on students means that they have to sleep less which has become a growing problem.
translations.reference: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.

translations.source: आप पर्याप्त और अच्छी नींद में सोते हैं या नहीं, यह सुनिश्चित करना विद्यार्थियों के ‘गुप्त हथियार’ की तरह है, इससे वे तनाव, थकावट और चिंता का मुकाबला कर सकते हैं, उन्होंने कहा - यह वजन पर भी पड़ने वाले असर से बचाता है क्योंकि नींद की कमी से उनका मस्तिष्क हमेशा भूख के बारे में सोचता रहता है जिससे उन्हें लगातार भूख लगती है।
translations.translation: Ensuring that you get enough and a good night's sleep is like a student's secret weapon to help them cope with stress, fatigue and anxiety, he said. It also protects them from the effects on weight because lack of sleep keeps their brain always thinking about hunger which makes them feel hungry all the time.
translations.reference: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.

translations.source: केमिकल और फिजिकल बायोलॉजी का अध्ययन करने वाले कैलिफोर्निया के 19 वर्षीय रेमंड सो ने प्रोफेसर जेसलर की मदद कोर्स के निर्माण में की, पिछले साल के दौरान हार्वर्ड में उन्होंने अपने लास्ट इयर का क्लास पूरा किया।
translations.translation: Raymond So, a 19-year-old from California who studied chemical and physical biology, assisted Professor Jessler in building the course, completing his last year's class at Harvard during the past year.
translations.reference: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया कि कोर्स की वजह से वे जागरूक हुए और कैंपस-वाइड कोर्स के लिए प्रेरित हुए।
translations.translation: He said that the course brought them awareness and inspiration for the campus-wide course.
translations.reference: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.

translations.source: भविष्य में, उन्हें उम्मीद है कि प्रतिस्पर्धी संस्थान में शामिल होने से पहले सभी पोस्टग्रेजुएट विद्यार्थियों के लिए इस कोर्स को पूरा करना ज़रूरी माना जाएगा।
translations.translation: In the future, they hope that it will be deemed necessary for all postgraduate students to complete this course before joining a competitive institution.
translations.reference: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.

translations.source: प्रो जेसलर ने सुझाव दिया कि विद्यार्थियों को सोने से पहले अलार्म सेट करने पर विचार करना चाहिए, साथ ही, उन्हें यह भी तय करना चाहिए कि उन्हें कब जागना है, और उन्हें इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्क्रीन और एलईडी लाइट से निकलने वाली 'ब्लू लाइट' के हानिकारक असर की जानकारी होनी चाहिए, जो उनपर बहुत ज़्यादा सर्कडियन डाल सकती है जिससे नींद की समस्या होती है।
translations.translation: Professor Jessler suggested that students should consider setting an alarm before going to bed, as well as deciding when to wake up, and they should be aware of the harmful effects of the 'blue light' emitted from electronic screens and LED lights, which can put too much circadian on them causing sleep problems.
translations.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

translations.source: लिविंगस्टन का रेंजर्स के विरुद्ध 1 - 0: मेंगा ने गेरार्ड के विरुद्ध गोल किया
translations.translation: Livingston 1 - 0 against Rangers: Menga scored against Gerard
translations.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

translations.source: डॉली मेंगा की स्ट्राइक की वजह से रेंजर्स को एक और मैच में परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ा, लिविंगस्टन के 1-0 की जीत का जिम्मेदारी स्टीवन गेरार्ड के गलत साइड पर डाली गई।
translations.translation: The strikes of Dolly Menga caused the Rangers to run into trouble in another match, leaving the responsibility of Livingston's 1-0 win to the wrong side of Steven Gerrard.
translations.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

translations.source: फरवरी में सेंट जॉनस्टोन में खेले गए मैच में 4-1 की जीत के बाद इब्रो साइड अपनी पहली जीत की तलाश कर रहे थें, लेकिन गैरी होल्ट की टीम ने 18 गेम में गेरार्ड से दूसरी हार के लिए प्रबंधक के तौर पर उकसाया, ताकि लैंडब्रोक्स प्रीमियरशिप के लीडर हर्ट्स को आठ पॉइंट की मदद से बाहर किया जा सके।
translations.translation: The Ebro side were looking for their first win after a 4-1 victory at St Johnstone in February, but Gary Holt's team was challenged as a manager for a second loss to Gerard in 18 games to knock out Landbrooks Premiership leader Hertz by eight points.
translations.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

translations.source: हाफ-टाइम से पहले मेंगा ने सात मिनट तक स्ट्राइक किया और उसके बाद रेंजर्स की लाइन-अप शार्ट को गेम को बराबर करने का मौका एक बार भी नहीं मिला।
translations.translation: Before half-time, Menga strikes for seven minutes and after that, the Rangers' line-up shorts never got a chance to level the game.
translations.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

translations.source: हालांकि, रेंजर्स अब रैंकिंग में गिरकर छठे स्थान पर पहुंच गए हैं, लिविंगस्टन तीसरे स्थान पर पहुँच गया है और गोल डिफरेंस की वजह से केवल हाइबरियन से पीछे है।
translations.translation: However, the Rangers have now dropped to sixth in the standings, Livingston has moved up to third and is only behind the Hibernians due to the goal difference.
translations.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, ऑब्जेक्ट के स्पष्ट रूप से दूसरे छोर पर फेंके जाने के बाद जब से लाइन्समैन कैलम स्पेंस के सिर के घाव का इलाज किया गया है, तब से रेंजर्स के लिए गेम और भी ज़्यादा परेशानी हो सकती है।
translations.translation: In addition, the game may be even more troublesome for the Rangers since Lineman Calm Spence's head wound has been treated after the object is clearly thrown at the other end.
translations.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

translations.source: गेरार्ड के साइड में किए गए आठ बदलावों की वजह से पिछले आयर को बेटफ्रेड कप के सेमीफाइनल में जाने का मौका मिला।
translations.translation: The eight changes made to Gerard 's side gave last year's Ayr an opportunity to reach the semifinals of the Betfred Cup.
translations.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

translations.source: दूसरी ओर, होल्ट को उसी लिवी 11 में शामिल किया गया जिसने पिछले हफ़्ते हर्ट्स का एक पॉइंट ले लिया और जिस तरह से उन्होंने बढ़िया तरीके से ड्रिल किए उससे विपक्षी टीम को हर मोड़ पर परेशानी हुई।
translations.translation: On the other hand, Holt was included in the same Levi 11 that took a point of injuries last week and the way he drilled well caused the opposing team to struggle at every turn.
translations.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

translations.source: रेंजर्स मैच को जीत सकते थे, लेकिन लिविंगस्टन ने उनकी तुलना में ज़्यादा बढ़िया खेला।
translations.translation: The Rangers could have won the game, but Livingston played better than them.
translations.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

translations.source: जब मेंगा ने पहली बार लेट-ऑफ करके स्कॉट पीटमैन को एलन मैकग्रेगर के गोल की तरफ भेजा, तो उन्हें सिर्फ़ दो मिनट का समय देना चाहिए था, लेकिन मिडफील्डर ने अपने पाए गए इस बड़े मौके को भुनाया।
translations.translation: When Menga first sent Scott Pittman to Alan McGregor's goal with a late-off, he should have given him just two minutes, but the midfielder reaped the great opportunity he had.
translations.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

translations.source: डीप में मौजूद कीगन जैकब्स ने जब फ़्री-किक किया, तो यह किक कप्तान क्रेग हलकेट के पास गया, लेकिन बैक पोस्ट पर मौजूद उनके डिफेंसिव पार्टनर एलन लिथगो सिर्फ़ स्टैब वाइड कर सकते थें।
translations.translation: When Keegan Jacobs in the Deep took a free kick, the kick went to Captain Craig Halkett, but his defensive partner, Alan Lithgow, on the back post, could only take a stab.
translations.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

translations.source: रेंजर्स ने कंट्रोल तो प्राप्त कर लिया, लेकिन फाइनल थर्ड में अपने खेल पर भरोसे से ज़्यादा उन्हें उम्मीद पर भरोसा था।
translations.translation: The Rangers gained control, but in the final third they were more confident in hope than they were in their game.
translations.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

translations.source: निश्चित तौर पर अल्फ्रेडो मोरेलोस को अनुभव हुआ कि उन्हें क्वार्टर-ऑवर मार्क पर पेनाल्टी लगाना चाहिए था क्योंकि वे और स्टीवन लॉलेस एक-दूसरे से टकरा गए थे, लेकिन रेफरी स्टीवन थॉमसन ने कोलंबियन की अपील को नकार दिया था।
translations.translation: Certainly, Alfredo Morelos felt that he should have been penalized for the quarter-over mark because he and Steven Lawless had collided, but the referee, Steven Thompson, denied the Columbian's appeal.
translations.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

translations.source: रेंजर्स ने फर्स्ट-हाफ में टारगेट पर दो शॉट को बचा लिया, लेकिन आइब्रो के पूर्व गोलकीपर लियाम केली को लसाना कोलीबली के हेडर और ट्वी ओवी एजारिया के स्ट्राइक से मुश्किलों का सामना करना पड़ा।
translations.translation: The Rangers saved two shots at the target in the first half, but Ibrou's former goalkeeper Liam Kelly had to contend with strikes from Lasana Colliby's header and Twie O.V. Azaria.
translations.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

translations.source: हालांकि, 34वें मिनट में लिवि के ओपनर रन ऑफ खेल के विरुद्ध जा सकते थें, लेकिन कोई भी व्यक्ति इससे इनकार नहीं कर सकता कि इस ग्राफ्ट के वे अकेले ही हकदार हैं।
translations.translation: However, in the 34th minute, Levi's opener could have gone against the run of the game, but no one can deny that they alone are entitled to the graft.
translations.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

translations.source: इसके बाद भी रेंजर्स डीप में मौजूद बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी जैकब को नहीं छका सके।
translations.translation: Even so, the best player in the Rangers Deep could not defeat Jacob.
translations.reference: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.

translations.source: जब डेक्कन गलाघेर ने स्कॉट रॉबिन्सन को बॉल पास की, तो स्कॉट अर्फील्ड ने उसमें कोई दिलचस्पी नहीं दिखाई, स्कॉट रॉबिन्सन ने मेंगा को सिंपल फिनिश हेतु पिक करने के लिए शांत रखा था।
translations.translation: When Deccan Gallagher passed the ball to Scott Robinson, Scott Orfield showed no interest in it, Scott Robinson had kept the manga quiet to pick it up for a simple finish.
translations.reference: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.

translations.source: जब गेरार्ड ने रयान केंट के लिए कॉलीबेल को स्वैप किया और मोरेलोस में विंगर द्वारा स्लॉट करते ही तुरंत प्रभाव दिखाने के लिए स्विच किया, उस समय उन्होंने ब्रेक लिया था, लेकिन केली ने बढ़िया दौड़ लगाते हुए अपने लाइन को ब्लॉक किया।
translations.translation: When Gerard swapped Collibel for Ryan Kent and switched to show immediate effect as soon as he was slapped by the winger in Morelos, he had taken a break at the time, but Kelly blocked his line with a good run.
translations.reference: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.

translations.source: लेकिन, लिविंगस्टोन ने विज़िटर को वैसा ही खेल दिखाया जिस तरह के खेल का आनंद वे वाकई ले सकते थें, उन्होंने लॉन्ग बॉल के बाद लिथगो और हल्केट के साथ लॉन्ग बॉल को स्वीप किया।
translations.translation: But Livingstone showed the visitor the same game they could really enjoy, he swept the long ball with a litho and a halcyon after the long ball.
translations.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

translations.source: फाइनल स्टेज में होल्ट का साइड उनकी बढ़त को बढ़ा सकता था, लेकिन लिथ्गोव द्वारा कोने से वाइड करने से पहले मैक्ग्रेगर ने जैकब्स को अच्छी तरह से स्टूड अप से रोक दिया।
translations.translation: Holt's side in the final stage could have boosted his lead, but MacGregor prevented Jacobs from studing up well before being cornered by Lithgow.
translations.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

translations.source: रेंजर्स ने विकल्प के तौर पर मौजूद ग्लेन मिडलटन को बुलाया, उन्होंने पेनाल्टी के लिए एक और लेट क्लेम किया क्योंकि वे जैकब्स के साथ उलझ गए थें, लेकिन थॉमसन ने उन्हें फिर से कामयाब नहीं होने दिया।
translations.translation: The Rangers summoned Glen Middleton as an alternate, he made another late claim for the penalty because he was confused with the Jacobs, but Thompson did not allow him to succeed again.
translations.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

translations.source: एल्मनैक: गीजर काउंटर के आविष्कारक
translations.translation: Elmanac: Inventor of the geyser counter
translations.reference: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter

translations.source: अब हमारे "संडे मॉर्निंग" पंचांग का एक पेज: आज से 136 साल पहले, 30 सितंबर, 1882 और उसके बाद का समय... वह दिन जब जर्मनी में भविष्य के भौतिक विज्ञानी जोहान्स विल्हेम "हंस" गीजर का जन्म हुआ था।
translations.translation: Now a page of our "Sunday Morning" calendar: 136 years ago today, September 30, 1882 and beyond... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiser was born in Germany.
translations.reference: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.

translations.source: रेडियोधर्मिता का पता लगाने और मापने की विधि के लिए गीजर ने  एक डिवाइस का आविष्कार किया जिसे बाद गीजर काउंटर के नाम से जाना गया।
translations.translation: For the method of detecting and measuring radioactivity, Geyser invented a device later known as the Geyser counter.
translations.reference: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.

translations.source: गीजर काउंटर विज्ञान का एक मुख्य आधार है, यह पॉप संस्कृति का मुख्य आधार बन गया है, साथ ही, 1950 में इस पर एक फिल्म "Bells of Coronado" बनी, जिसमें पहली बार वैज्ञानिक रॉय रोजर्स और डेल इवांस ने एक्टिंग की:
translations.translation: Geyser is a staple of counter-science, it has become a staple of pop culture, as well as a film "Bells of Coronado" in 1950, starring for the first time scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
translations.reference: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:

translations.source: मैन: "वह दुनिया के लिए क्या करता है?"
translations.translation: Man: "What does he do for the world?"
translations.reference: Man: "What in the world is that?"

translations.source: रोजर्स: "यह यूरेनियम जैसे रेडियोधर्मी खनिजों का पता लगाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला गीजर काउंटर है।
translations.translation: Rogers: "This is a geyser counter used to detect radioactive minerals such as uranium.
translations.reference: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.

translations.source: इन इयरफ़ोन को चालू करने के बाद आप निश्चित रूप से खनिजों में रेडियोधर्मिता की वजह से  छुपे हुए परमाणुओं के असर को सुन सकते हैं।"
translations.translation: Once you turn on these headphones, you can certainly hear the effect of the atoms hidden in the minerals by radiation".
translations.reference: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."

translations.source: इवांस: "बताइए, अभी यह सुनिश्चित रूप से पॉप कर रहा है!"
translations.translation: "Tell me, it's definitely popping up right now!"
translations.reference: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"

translations.source: "हंस" गीजर का निधन 1945 में हुआ, उस समय वे 63 वर्ष के होने वाले थें।
translations.translation: "Hans" Geiser passed away in 1945 at the age of 63.
translations.reference: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.

translations.source: लेकिन, उनके आविष्कार की वजह से उनका नाम अभी भी जीवित है।
translations.translation: But because of his invention, his name is still alive.
translations.reference: But the invention that bears his name lives on.

translations.source: कैंसर का नए टीके से प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली की खराब कोशिकाओं को ‘देखा’ जा सकता है
translations.translation: The new cancer vaccine can detect defective cells of the immune system.
translations.reference: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells

translations.source: कैंसर का नए टीके से प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली की खराब कोशिकाओं को ‘देखा’ जा सकता है और उन्हें खत्म किया जा सकता है
translations.translation: The new cancer vaccine can detect and eliminate damaged cells of the immune system.
translations.reference: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them

translations.source: उपचार के दौरान खराब कोशिकाओं की पहचान करने के लिए टीका प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली को निर्देश देता है
translations.translation: The vaccine instructs the immune system to identify defective cells during treatment.
translations.reference: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment

translations.source: इस विधि के ज़रिए प्रयोगशाला में किसी रोगी की प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं को निकाला और उन्हें बदला जा सकता है
translations.translation: This method can be used in a laboratory to extract and replace a patient's immune cells.
translations.reference: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab

translations.source: उसके बाद, उनसे कई कैंसर के लिए आम प्रोटीन को ‘देखा' जा सकता है और फिर उसे निकालकर फिर से लगाया जा सकता है
translations.translation: After that, they can identify a common protein for many cancers and then remove it and re-inject it.
translations.reference: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected

translations.source: टीके के लिए एक ट्रायल में अलग-अलग तरह के कैंसर के मरीजों में आशाजनक नतीजे देखे जा रहे हैं।
translations.translation: In a trial for the vaccine, promising results are being seen in patients with different types of cancer.
translations.reference: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.

translations.source: एक महिला को यह टीका लगाया गया, जिससे प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली में मौजूद उसकी खराब कोशिकाओं को देखा गया, फिर यह देखा गया कि 18 महीने से ज़्यादा समय से मौजूद उसके डिम्बग्रंथि का कैंसर खत्म हो गया है।
translations.translation: A woman was given the vaccine, which examined her defective cells in her immune system, and then found that her ovarian cancer, which had been present for more than 18 months, had been eliminated.
translations.reference: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.

translations.source: इस विधि से प्रयोगशाला में किसी रोगी की प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं को निकाला जा सकता है और उन्हें बदला जा सकता है, ताकि वे HER2 नामक कई कैंसर में पाए जाने वाले कॉमन प्रोटीन को "देखा" जा सके, और फिर कोशिकाओं को निकालकर दुबारा लगाया जा सके।
translations.translation: This method can be used in a laboratory to extract and replace a patient's immune cells so that they can "see" a common protein found in many cancers, called HER2, and then remove the cells and reapply them.
translations.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

translations.source: बेथेस्डा, मैरीलैंड में यू.एस. नेशनल कैंसर इंस्टिट्यूट के प्रोफेसर जे बर्ज़ोफ़स्की ने कहा: "हमारे नतीजों से पता चलता है कि यह टीका बहुत ही आशाजनक है।"
translations.translation: "Our results suggest that this vaccine is very promising", said Jay Berzowski, a professor at the U.S. National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland.
translations.reference: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."

translations.source: प्रो बर्ज़ोफ़स्की ने कहा कि HER2 की वजह से “कई प्रकार के कैंसर का विकास होता है”, जिसमें स्तन, डिम्बग्रंथि, फेफड़े और कोलोरेक्टल कैंसर शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: Prof Berzofsky said that HER2 leads to the development of many types of cancers, including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers.
translations.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

translations.source: मरीजों की प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं को निकालना और कैंसर वाली कोशिकाओं का पता लगाने के लिए उन्हें “निर्देश देना” एक तरह की ल्यूकेमिया के उपचार में फ़ायदेमंद है।
translations.translation: It is useful in the treatment of a type of leukaemia by removing the immune cells of patients and directing them to detect cancer cells.
translations.reference: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.

translations.source: अपनी एसएनएल मौजूदगी के बाद, एमएजीए हैट पर कान्ये वेस्ट ने ट्रम्प के पुराने विवादित भाषण की निंदा की।
translations.translation: Following his SNL appearance, Kanye West on the MAGA Hat denounced Trump's longstanding controversial speech.
translations.reference: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.

translations.source: यह ठीक नहीं हुआ
translations.translation: It didn't work out.
translations.reference: It Didn't Go Well

translations.source: कान्ये वेस्ट की बेहतरीन परफॉरमेंस के बाद, जिसमें उसने अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प की प्रशंसा की और कहा कि 2020 में भी उन्हीं की सरकार बनेगी, शनिवार की नाईट लाइव के दौरान उसने स्टूडियो में निंदा की।
translations.translation: After Kanye West's brilliant performance, in which she praised US President Donald Trump and said that he would form a government in 2020, she denounced him in the studio during Saturday Night Live.
translations.reference: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.

translations.source: घोस्ट टाउन नामक रात के अपने तीसरे गाने के परफॉरमेंस के बाद, जिसमें उन्होंने मेक अमेरिका ग्रेट कैप पहनी हुई थी, उसने डेमोक्रेट के विरुद्ध निंदा की और ट्रम्प को अपना समर्थन देने की बात दुहराई।
translations.translation: After a performance of her third song of the night, Ghost Town, in which she wore a Make America Great Cap, she denounced the Democrats and reiterated her support for Trump.
translations.reference: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.

translations.source: उन्होंने बताया, "इसलिए, मैं कई बार गोर लोगों से बात करता हूं और वे कहते हैं: "ट्रम्प को पसंद करने के लिए आपसे क्या वजह है, वे नस्लवादी हैं?"
translations.translation: "So, I often talk to white people and they say, 'What makes you like Trump, they're racist?'
translations.reference: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"

translations.source: फिर भी, अगर मुझे नस्लवाद की चिंता थी, तो मैं काफ़ी समय पहले ही अमेरिका को छोड़ कर चला जाता।”
translations.translation: Still, if I was concerned about racism, I would have left America a long time ago.
translations.reference: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.

translations.reference: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."

translations.translation: A knife-wielding attempt was made at a restaurant in Belfast.
translations.reference: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing

translations.source: एक 45 वर्षीय व्यक्ति पर हत्या करने की कोशिश का आरोप लगाया गया है, उस पर संदेह है कि उसने शुक्रवार को ईस्ट बेलफास्ट के एक रेस्टोरेंट में एक व्यक्ति को चाकू घोंपा था।

translations.reference: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.

translations.translation: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
