translations.translation: But we are working on it.
translations.reference: But we are working on it.

translations.source: मेरा विश्वास करें, जब यह बदलाव हुआ तब बहुत सारे टेक्स्ट की आवाजाही हो रही थी और वे सब अनुकूल नहीं थे।
translations.translation: Believe me, there was a lot of text movement going on when this change happened and not all of them were compatible.
translations.reference: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.

translations.source: हम इसे ठीक करने की कोशिश कर रहे थे, हमें लगा कि यह कोई तकनीकी गड़बड़ है।
translations.translation: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
translations.reference: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.

translations.source: लेकिन ऐसा नहीं था, यह एक सरकारी मुद्दा था।
translations.translation: But it wasn't, it was a government issue.
translations.reference: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.

translations.source: मैं आपसे वादा कर सकता हूँ कि अगली बार ऐसा नहीं होगा।
translations.translation: I can promise you this won't happen next time.
translations.reference: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.

translations.source: हम इसे छह के बजाय पाँच मुक़ाबले तक सीमित रखेंगे - जैसे हम आम तौर पर करते हैं - और जब हमने प्रशंसकों के लिए कुछ ज़्यादा डिलीवर करने की कोशिश की, तब यह कुछ ज़्यादा ही हो गया।
translations.translation: We'll limit it to five matches instead of six - as we usually do - and when we tried to deliver a little more for the fans, it got a little more.
translations.reference: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.

translations.source: यह एक दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण स्थिति है।"
translations.translation: This is an unfortunate situation".
translations.reference: It's an unfortunate situation."

translations.source: डेजर्ट आइलैंड डिस्क: टॉम डेली को कामुकता के मामले में 'हीनता' महसूस हुई
translations.translation: Desert Island Disc: Tom Daly feels 'without' in terms of sexuality
translations.reference: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley felt 'inferior' over sexuality

translations.source: ओलंपिक गोताखोर टॉम डेली का कहना है कि वह अपनी कामुकता के कारण सभी के प्रति हीन भावना से ग्रसित हो गया - लेकिन उसे इससे सफल बनने की प्रेरणा मिली।
translations.translation: Olympic diver Tom Daley says that his sexuality made him feel inferior to everyone - but it inspired him to succeed.
translations.reference: Olympic diver Tom Daley says he grew up feeling inferior to everyone because of his sexuality - but that gave him the motivation to become a success.

translations.source: 24 वर्षीय डेली ने कहा कि उसे एहसास ही नहीं हुआ जब तक कि वह माध्यमिक विद्यालय में पहुँच नहीं गया कि "हर कोई मेरे जैसा नहीं है।"
translations.translation: The 24-year-old said he didn't realize until he got to secondary school that "not everyone is like me".
translations.reference: The 24-year-old said he did not realise until he went to secondary school that "not everyone is like me."

translations.source: लॉरेन लावर्न द्वारा प्रस्तुत पहले रेडियो 4 डेजर्ट आइलैंड डिस्क पर बोलते हुए, उसने कहा कि वह दूसरों को "उम्मीद" देने के लिए समलैंगिक अधिकारों के बारे में बात करता है।
translations.translation: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Disc presented by Lauren Laverne, she said she talks about gay rights to give "hope" to others.
translations.reference: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Discs presented by Lauren Laverne, he said he spoke out about gay rights to give others "hope."

translations.source: उसने यह भी कहा कि पिता बनने पर उसे ओलंपिक जीतने के बारे में कम परवाह रही।
translations.translation: He also said that when he became a father, he was less concerned about winning the Olympics.
translations.reference: He also said becoming a parent made him care less about winning the Olympics.

translations.source: लंबे समय से चल रहे शो के नियमित प्रस्तुतकर्ता, कर्स्टी यंग ने बीमारी के कारण कई महीने की छुट्टी ले ली है।
translations.translation: The long-running show's regular presenter, Kirsty Young has taken several months off due to illness.
translations.reference: The regular presenter of the long-running show, Kirsty Young, has taken a number of months off because of illness.

translations.source: लावर्न के पहले कार्यक्रम में एक समाज-च्युत व्यक्ति के रूप में दिखाई देने पर, डेली ने कहा कि उसे हर किसी की तुलना में खुद में "कमी" महसूस हो रही थी क्योंकि "लड़के और लड़कियों को पसंद करना सामाजिक रूप से स्वीकार्य नहीं था।"
translations.translation: Appearing as a socialite at Laverne's first event, Daley said she felt "lower" than anyone else because "liking boys and girls was socially unacceptable".
translations.reference: Appearing as a castaway on Laverne's first programme, Daley said he felt "less than" everyone else growing up because "it wasn't socially acceptable to like boys and girls."

translations.source: उसने कहा: "आज भी, दूसरों की तुलना में खुद को कमतर महसूस करने की वे भावनाएँ, और अलग महसूस करना, वास्तविक चीजें हैं जिसने मुझे सफल होने में सक्षम होने के लिए शक्ति और ताकत दी हैं।"
translations.translation: She said: "Even today, those feelings of feeling inferior to others, and feeling different, are real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed".
translations.reference: He said: "To this day, those feelings of feeling less than, and feeling different, have been the real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed."

translations.source: वह साबित करना चाहता था कि वह भी "ख़ास" हैं, उसने कहा, ताकि वह हर किसी को निराश न करें जब उनको अंततः उसकी कामुकता के बारे में पता चले।
translations.translation: He wanted to prove that he was "special" too, he said, so as not to disappoint everyone when they finally find out about his sexuality.
translations.reference: He wanted to prove that he was "something," he said, so that he did not disappoint everyone when they eventually found out about his sexuality.

translations.source: दो बार के कांस्य ओलंपिक पदक विजेता हाई-प्रोफ़ाइल LGBT प्रचारक बन गया है तथा और अधिक देशों से समलैंगिकता को कम करने के लिए अपील करने हेतु ऑस्ट्रेलिया में इस साल के राष्ट्रमंडल खेलों में अपनी मौजूदगी का इस्तेमाल किया।
translations.translation: The two-time Olympic bronze medalist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his presence at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal to more countries to reduce homosexuality.
translations.reference: The two-time bronze Olympic medallist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his appearance at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal for more countries to decriminalise homosexuality.

translations.source: उसने कहा कि उसने खुलकर इसलिए बात की क्योंकि उसने बिना किसी परेशानी के खुलकर जीने में सक्षम होने पर खुद को भाग्यशाली महसूस किया और वह दूसरों को "उम्मीद" देना चाहता था।
translations.translation: He said that he spoke openly because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without any problems and he wanted to give "hope" to others.
translations.reference: He said he spoke out because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without ramifications and wanted to give others "hope."

translations.source: तीन बार के विश्व चैंपियन ने कहा कि एक पुरुष - अमेरिकी फिल्म निर्माता डस्टिन लांस ब्लैक, जिनसे 2013 में उसकी मुलाक़ात हुई - से जब उसे प्यार हुआ तो - "मैं आश्चर्यचकित हो गया।"
translations.translation: The three-time world champion said that when she fell in love with a man - American filmmaker Dustin Lance Black, whom she met in 2013 - "I was surprised".
translations.reference: The three-time world champion said falling in love with a man - US film-maker Dustin Lance Black, who he met in 2013 - "caught me by surprise."

translations.source: डेली ने ऑस्कर विजेता से शादी की, जो उनसे उम्र में  20 साल बड़े हैं, लेकिन उसने कहा कि उम्र का अंतर कभी भी एक मुद्दा नहीं था।
translations.translation: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years older than her, but she said the age difference was never an issue.
translations.reference: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years his senior, last year but he said the age gap had never been an issue.

translations.source: "जब आप इतनी कम उम्र में इतने ज़्यादा अनुभवों से गुज़रते हैं" - वह 14 साल की उम्र में अपने पहले ओलंपिक में गया था और उसके पिता की तीन साल बाद कैंसर से मृत्यु हो गई - उसने कहा कि इतनी कम उम्र में इसी प्रकार के अनुभवों के उतार-चढ़ाव से गुज़रने वाले किसी हमउम्र वाले को पाना मुश्किल था।
translations.translation: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he attended his first Olympics at the age of 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find a peer who went through the ups and downs of similar experiences at such a young age.
translations.reference: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he went to his first Olympics aged 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find someone the same age who had experienced similar highs and lows.

translations.source: जून में दंपति रॉबर्ट रे ब्लैक-डेली नामक एक बेटे के माता-पिता बन गए, और डेली ने कहा कि उसका "संपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण" बदल गया था।
translations.translation: In June the couple became the parents of a son named Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "total attitude" had changed.
translations.reference: The couple became parents in June, to a son called Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "whole perspective" had changed.

translations.source: "अगर आपने मुझसे पिछले साल पूछा होता, तो यह सब 'मुझे स्वर्ण पदक जीतने की ज़रूरत है" से जुड़ा होता," उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: "If you had asked me last year, it would have been all about 'I need to win a gold medal,'" he said.
translations.reference: "If you had asked me last year, it was all about 'I need to win a gold medal'," he said.

translations.source: "आप जानते ही होंगे, ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदकों से बढ़कर कई चीज़ें हैं।
translations.translation: "You know, there's a lot more to it than an Olympic gold medal.
translations.reference: "You know what, there are bigger things than Olympic gold medals.

translations.source: मेरा ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदक रॉबी है।"
translations.translation: My Olympic gold medal is Robby".
translations.reference: My Olympic gold medal is Robbie."

translations.source: उनके बेटे का नाम उसके पिता रॉबर्ट जैसा ही है, जिनकी मृत्यु 2011 में 40 वर्ष की आयु में मस्तिष्क कैंसर से पीड़ित होने के निदान के बाद हुई थी।
translations.translation: His son is named after his father, Robert, who died in 2011 at the age of 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.
translations.reference: His son has the same name as his father Robert, who died in 2011 aged 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.

translations.source: डेली ने कहा कि उनके पिता ने स्वीकार ही नहीं किया कि वे मरने जा रहे हैं और उन्होंने जो अंतिम बार जानना चाहा था वो था कि क्या उनके पास लंदन 2012 की टिकटें आ गई हैं - क्योंकि वे सामने की पंक्ति में बैठना चाहते थे।
translations.translation: Daley said that his father did not acknowledge that he was going to die and the last thing he wanted to know was if he had London 2012 tickets - because he wanted to sit in the front row.
translations.reference: Daley said his dad did not accept he was going to die and one of the last things he had asked was if they had their tickets yet for London 2012 - as he wanted to be on the front row.

translations.source: उसने कहा, "मैं उनसे यह नहीं कह सका कि आप आगे की पंक्ति में बैठने के लिए नहीं रहेंगे, डैड।"
translations.translation: He said, "I couldn't tell them you wouldn't be sitting in the front row, Dad".
translations.reference: "I couldn't say to him 'you're not going to be around to be on the front row dad'," he said.

translations.source: उसने कहा, "जब वे साँस नहीं ले पा रहे थे तब मैं उनके हाथ को थामे था और तब तक पकड़े रहा जब तक कि उनकी साँसें बंद नहीं हो गई और वे मर चुके थे, तब जाकर मैंने माना कि वे अजेय नहीं थे।"
translations.translation: He said, "When they could not breathe, I held their hands and held them until their breathing stopped and they were dead, and I thought they were not to be defeated".
translations.reference: "I was holding his hand as he stopped breathing and it wasn't until he'd actually stopped breathing and he was dead that I finally acknowledged he wasn't invincible," he said.

translations.source: अगले वर्ष डेली ने 2012 ओलंपिक में भाग लिया और कांस्य पदक जीता।
translations.translation: The following year, Daly participated in the 2012 Olympics and won a bronze medal.
translations.reference: The following year Daley competed at the 2012 Olympics and won bronze.

translations.source: "मैं सिर्फ़ इतना जानता था कि यही है जिसका मैंने अपने जीवन भर सपना देखा था - ओलंपिक खेलों में स्वदेश की भीड़ के सामने गोता लगाना, इससे बेहतर कोई भावना नहीं थी," उसने कहा।
translations.translation: "All I knew was that this is what I had dreamed of all my life - to dive in front of my homeland's crowd in the Olympic Games, there was no better feeling", she said.
translations.reference: "I just knew that this is what I had dreamt of my whole life - to dive in front of a home crowd at an Olympic Games, there was no better feeling," he said.

translations.source: इसने उनकी पसंदीदा पहले गीत - प्राउड बाय हीथर स्मॉल को भी प्रेरित किया - जो कि ओलंपिक की तैयारी के दौरान उनके साथ प्रतिध्वनित होती रही थी और जिसे सुनकर अभी भी उनके रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते हैं।
translations.translation: It also inspired his favourite first song - Proud by Heather Small - which was echoed with him during the preparation for the Olympics and which still makes him stand up.
translations.reference: It also inspired his first song choice - Proud by Heather Small - which had resonated with him in the build up to the Olympics and still gave him goosebumps.

translations.source: डेजर्ट आइलैंड डिस्क रविवार को BBC रेडियो 4 पर 11:15 BST पर प्रसारित होगा।
translations.translation: Desert Island Disc will be broadcast on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.
translations.reference: Desert Island Discs is on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.

translations.source: शनिवार के रायडर कप से आउट-ऑफ-फ़ॉर्म मिकेलसन बाहर
translations.translation: Out-of-form Mickelson out of the Ryder Cup on Saturday
translations.reference: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday

translations.source: अमेरिकन फ़िल मिकेलसन रविवार को रिकॉर्ड स्थापित करेंगे जब वे अपना 47वाँ राइडर कप मैच खेलेंगे, लेकिन इसे दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण मील का पत्थर बनने से बचाने के लिए उन्हें अपना फ़ॉर्म बदलना होगा।
translations.translation: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to change his form to keep it from becoming an unfortunate milestone.
translations.reference: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.

translations.source: 12वीं बार रिकॉर्ड के लिए द्विवार्षिक कार्यक्रम में खेल रहे, मिकेलसन को  शनिवार के फ़ोरबॉल्स और फ़ोरसम के लिए कप्तान जिम फ़्यूरिक ने खेल से बाहर बिठा दिया।
translations.translation: Playing in the biennial event for the 12th time for a record, Mickelson was ejected from the game by Captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's Foreballs and Foresum.
translations.reference: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.

translations.source: आकर्षण केंद्र बनने के बजाय, जैसा कि वह अक्सर संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के लिए बने रहे हैं, पाँच बार के प्रमुख विजेता ने अपने दिन को जयजयकार करने वालों के बीच रहते हुए और अपने खेलने के तरीक़े की कमज़ोरियों में सुधार करने की आशा में काम करते हुए बिताया।
translations.translation: Rather than becoming a center of attraction, as he has often been for the United States, the five-time major winner spent his day living among the cheerleaders and working in the hope of improving the flaws of his playing style.
translations.reference: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.

translations.source: अपने कैरियर के चरम पर भी कभी सीधे ड्राइव नहीं करने वाले, 48 वर्षीय खिलाड़ी टाइट ले गोल्फ नेशनल कोर्स के लिए आदर्श फ़िट नहीं रहा, जहाँ लंबे समय तक सक्रिय न रहने वालों को नियमित रूप से ग़लत शॉट्स की सज़ा मिलती है।
translations.translation: Never driving straight at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old was not an ideal fit for the Tight Le Golf National Course, where long-time offenders are routinely punished with false shots.
translations.reference: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.

translations.source: और जहाँ वैसे ही कोर्स इतना आसान नहीं, वहीं रविवार के नौवें मैच में, मिकेलसन का सामना ब्रिटिश ओपन चैंपियन फ्रांसेस्को मोलिनारी से होगा, जिन्होंने इस सप्ताह अपने सभी चार मैच जीतने के लिए रूकी टॉमी फ्लीटवुड के साथ मिलकर खेला है।
translations.translation: And whereas the course is not so easy, in Sunday's ninth match, Mickelson will face British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has played alongside rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of his matches this week.
translations.reference: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.

translations.source: अगर 12 सिंगल्स मैचों में चार अंक नीचे रहते हुए शुरुआत करने वाले अमेरिकी खिलाड़ी, ज़ोरदार शुरुआत करते हैं, तो मिकेलसन का मैच काफ़ी महत्वपूर्ण साबित हो सकता है।
translations.translation: If the American player who started four points down in 12 singles matches got off to a strong start, Mikelson's game could prove to be quite important.
translations.reference: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.

translations.source: फ़्यूरिक ने अपने आदमी पर भरोसा जताया, ऐसा नहीं कि वे और कुछ कह सकते थे।
translations.translation: Furyk trusted his man, not that they could say anything else.
translations.reference: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.

translations.source: "उन्होंने अपनी भूमिका को पूरी तरह समझा, मेरी पीठ थपथपाई और अपनी बाँहों में मुझे घेरा और कहा कि वे कल तैयार रहेंगे," फ़्यूरिक ने कहा।
translations.translation: "They fully understood their role, patted my back and wrapped me in their arms and said they would be ready tomorrow", said Furyk.
translations.reference: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.

translations.source: "उसे खुद पर बहुत भरोसा है।
translations.translation: "He has a lot of confidence in himself.
translations.reference: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.

translations.source: वह हॉल ऑफ़ फ़ेमर है और उसने अतीत में इन टीमों के लिए और इस सप्ताह में बहुत कुछ योगदान दिया है।
translations.translation: He's a Hall of Famer and he's contributed a lot to these teams in the past and this week.
translations.reference: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.

translations.source: मैंने शायद उसके दो मैच खेलने की कल्पना नहीं की थी।
translations.translation: I may not have imagined him playing two games.
translations.reference: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.

translations.source: मैंने और अधिक कल्पना की थी, लेकिन यह जिस तरह से काम किया और जिस तरह से हमने सोचा था कि हमें आगे बढ़ना होगा।
translations.translation: I'd imagined more, but it worked the way we thought we'd have to move on.
translations.reference: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.

translations.source: वह हर किसी की तरह ही वहाँ बाहर जाना चाहता है।"
translations.translation: He wants to go out there, just like everybody else".
translations.reference: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."

translations.source: मिकेलसन रविवार को सबसे ज्यादा खेले गए राइडर कप मैचों के लिए निक फालडो के रिकॉर्ड को पार करेंगे।
translations.translation: Mickelson will surpass Nick Faldo's record for most Ryder Cup games played on Sunday.
translations.reference: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.

translations.source: यह राइडर कप कैरियर के अंत को चिह्नित कर सकता है जिसने कभी भी उनके व्यक्तिगत रिकॉर्ड की ऊँचाइयों को छू नहीं पाया है।
translations.translation: This may mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never reached his personal record highs.
translations.reference: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.

translations.source: मिकेलसन ने 18 जीत, 20 हार और सात हाफ़ पाए हैं, हालांकि फ़्यूरिक ने कहा कि उसकी उपस्थिति टीम में कुछ अंतरंगता लाती है।
translations.translation: Mickelson has a record of 18 wins, 20 losses and seven ties, although Furyk said his presence brings some intimacy to the team.
translations.reference: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.

translations.source: "वह मज़ाकिया है, वह व्यंग्यात्मक है, हाज़िरजवाब है, लोगों का मज़ाक उड़ाना पसंद करता है, और टीम रूम में उसकी मौजूदगी ख़ास होती है," उन्होंने समझाया।
translations.translation: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, he's casual, he likes to make fun of people, and his presence in the team room is special", he explained.
translations.reference: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.

translations.source: "मुझे लगता है कि युवा खिलाड़ियों को भी इस सप्ताह, उनके पास जाने में मज़ा आया, जिसे देखना मज़ेदार रहा।
translations.translation: "I think the young players also enjoyed going to them this week, which was fun to watch.
translations.reference: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.

translations.source: वह सिर्फ़ खेलने के अलावा बहुत कुछ देता है।"
translations.translation: He gives so much more than just playing".
translations.reference: He provides a lot more than just play."

translations.source: यूरोप के कप्तान थॉमस ब्योर्न जानते हैं कि बड़ी बढ़त जल्द ही गायब हो सकती है
translations.translation: The captain of Europe, Thomas Bjorn, knows that the big edge may soon disappear.
translations.reference: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear

translations.source: थॉमस ब्योर्न, यूरोपीय कप्तान, अपने अनुभव से जानते हैं कि राइडर कप में आखिरी दिन के एकल में काफ़ी बड़ी बढ़त आसानी से असहज चाल में बदल सकती है।
translations.translation: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from his experience that a large lead in the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable move.
translations.reference: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.

translations.source: डेन ने वलडेरामा में 1997 के मैच में अपना पहला प्रदर्शन किया, जहाँ सीव बैल्लेस्टिरोस की कप्तानी में एक पक्ष ने अमेरिकियों पर पाँच अंकों की बढ़त हासिल की थी, लेकिन 14½-13½ की जीत के साथ, सबसे कम मार्जिन लेकर, बस फिनिशिंग लाइन पर पहुँचे थे।
translations.translation: Dan made his debut in a 1997 match at Walderauma, where a side under the captaincy of Seve Ballesteros had gained a five-point lead over the Americans, but with a win of 141⁄2-131⁄2, with the lowest margin, had just reached the finish line.
translations.reference: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.

translations.source: "आप अपने आप को याद दिलाते रहते हैं कि हमारे पास वलडेरामा में बड़ी लीड थी; ब्रुकलीन में हमारी बड़ी लीड थी, जहाँ हम हारे थे, और वलडेरामा में, हम बस जीत पाए थे," 2018 की क्लास को शुक्रवार 5-3 से और कल ले गोल्फ़ नेशनल में 10-6 की बढ़त को देखने के बाद, मन ही मन सोचते हुए, ब्योर्न ने कहा।
translations.translation: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Voldemort; we had a big lead at Brooklyn, where we lost, and at Voldemort, we just won", Björn said, reflecting on seeing the 2018 class take a 5-3 lead on Friday and a 10-6 lead at Le Golf National yesterday.
translations.reference: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.

translations.source: इसलिए इतिहास मुझे और उस टीम के सभी लोगों को दिखाएगा कि यह खत्म नहीं हुआ है।
translations.translation: So history will show me and all of the people on that team that it is not over.
translations.reference: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.

translations.source: तुम कल पूरे दाम चुकाओगे।
translations.translation: You will pay the full price tomorrow.
translations.reference: You go full bore tomorrow.

translations.source: वहाँ निकलें और सभी सही काम करें।
translations.translation: Get out there and do all the right things.
translations.reference: Get out there and do all the right things.

translations.source: यह तब तक खत्म नहीं होता जब तक आपको बोर्ड पर अंक नहीं मिल जाते।
translations.translation: It doesn't end until you get points on the board.
translations.reference: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.

translations.source: हमारे पास एक लक्ष्य है, और वह है इस ट्रॉफी को जीतने की कोशिश करना और यही वह जगह है जहाँ फ़ोकस बनाए रखना है।
translations.translation: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy and that is where the focus is to stay.
translations.reference: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.

translations.source: मैंने हमेशा कहा है, मैं उन 12 खिलाड़ियों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता हूँ जो हमारे पक्ष में हैं, लेकिन हम इस बात से अच्छी तरह वाकिफ़ हैं कि दुनिया भर के सबसे महान खिलाड़ी - दूसरी तरफ़ खड़े हैं।"
translations.translation: I've always said, I'm focused on the 12 players who are on our side, but we're well aware that the greatest players in the world are on the other side".
translations.reference: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."

translations.source: ब्योर्न ने आगे कहा कि उनके खिलाड़ियों ने किस प्रकार कठिन गोल्फ़ कोर्स पर प्रदर्शन किया: "इसमें मैं कभी खुद से आगे नहीं निकल पाऊँगा।
translations.translation: Speaking of how his players performed on the difficult golf course, Björn added: "I will never be able to outdo myself in this.
translations.reference: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.

translations.source: कल एक अलग कठोर समय है।
translations.translation: Tomorrow is a different hard time.
translations.reference: Tomorrow's a different beast.

translations.source: कल व्यक्तिगत प्रदर्शन आगे आएँगे, और यह एक अलग बात है।
translations.translation: There will be individual exhibitions tomorrow, and that is a different matter.
translations.reference: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.

translations.source: जब सबकुछ ठीक चल रहा हो तब पार्टनर के साथ वहाँ जाना बढ़िया रहता है, लेकिन जब आप वहाँ व्यक्तिगत रूप से बाहर निकलते हैं, तो एक गोल्फ़र के रूप में आपकी क्षमता का पूरा परीक्षण किया जाता है।
translations.translation: It's great to go out there with a partner when everything is going well, but when you go out there in person, your ability as a golfer is put to the test.
translations.reference: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.

translations.source: यही संदेश है जिसे आपको खिलाड़ियों तक पहुँचाने की ज़रूरत है कि कल अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शित करें।
translations.translation: This is the message you need to convey to the players to show their best tomorrow.
translations.reference: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.

translations.source: अब, आप अपने साथी को पीछे छोड़ देते हैं और उसे जाना पड़ता है और उसे भी अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन देना पड़ता है।"
translations.translation: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and he has to do his best".
translations.reference: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."

translations.source: ब्योर्न के विपरीत, विपरीत खड़े जिम फ़्यूरिक अपने खिलाड़ियों के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से बेहतर प्रदर्शन की तमन्ना कर रहे होंगे जो उन्होंने पार्टनर के रूप में किया था, अपवाद जॉर्डन स्पीथ और जस्टिन थॉमस थे, जिन्होंने चार में से तीन अंक पाए थे।
translations.translation: As opposed to Björn, opposite-looking Jim Furyk would have been longing for a better performance for his players personally than he did as a partner, with the exception of Jordan Speeth and Justin Thomas, who scored three of the four points.
translations.reference: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.

translations.source: यूरोप द्वारा "मदीना में चमत्कार" कर दिखाने की वजह से हार का सामना करने से पहले, ब्रूकलीन में विजेता टीम का हिस्सा होने के कारण, फ़्यूरिक खुद उन बड़े अंतिम दिनों के प्रतिवर्तन के दोनों छोर पर रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: Before facing defeat because of Europe's "miracle in Medina", as part of the winning team in Brooklyn, Furich himself has been on both ends of the reversal of those great last days".
translations.reference: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."

translations.source: "मुझे उसका हर लफ्ज़ याद है," उन्होंने यह पूछे जाने के जवाब में कहा कि 1999 में कप्तान बेन क्रैनशॉ ने किस तरह अपने खिलाड़ियों को आख़िरी दिन संभाला था।
translations.translation: "I remember every word of it", he said in response to a question about how captain Ben Cranshaw handled his players on his final day in 1999.
translations.reference: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.

translations.source: “हमारे पास कल 12 महत्वपूर्ण मैच हैं, लेकिन आप उस तरह की तेज़ शुरुआत करना चाहेंगे जैसे आपने ब्रूकलीन में देखा था, जैसे आपने मदीना में देखा था।
translations.translation: We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'll want to get off to a fast start like you saw in Brooklyn, like you saw in Medina.
translations.reference: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.

translations.source: जब यह गति एकतरफ़ा होती है, तो यह उन बीच के मैचों पर बहुत दबाव डालती है।
translations.translation: When this speed is one-way, it puts a lot of pressure on the matches between them.
translations.reference: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.

translations.source: हमने अपने लाइन-अप को अपने हिसाब से सेट किया और लोगों को इस तरह शामिल किया, जैसा हमने महसूस किया, आप जानते हैं, हम कल कुछ और चमत्कार करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: We set up our own line-up and got people involved like this, as we felt, you know, we're trying to do something more miraculous tomorrow".
translations.reference: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."

translations.source: थॉमस को शीर्ष मैच में रोरी मैक्लेरो के साथ जवाबी हमले की अगुआई की कोशिश करने का काम सौंपा गया है, जहाँ पॉल केसी, जस्टिन रोज़, जॉन रहम, टॉमी फ्लीटवुड और इयान पॉल्टर अन्य यूरोपीय क्रम के शीर्ष अर्ध भाग हैं।
translations.translation: Thomas is tasked with trying to lead a counterattack with Rory McClureau in the top match, where Paul Casey, Justin Rose, John Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Polter are the top half of the other European order.
translations.reference: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.

translations.source: "मैंने इस क्रम में इनका समूह बनाया था क्योंकि मुझे लगता है कि यह सभी को कवर करता है," ब्योर्न ने अपने एकल चयनों के बारे में कहा।
translations.translation: "I grouped them in this order because I think it covers them all", Björn said of her singles selections.
translations.reference: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.

translations.source: जर्मनी का नया युद्धपोत फिर से स्थगित हो गया
translations.translation: Germany's new warship was postponed again.
translations.reference: Germany's new warship postponed yet again

translations.source: 2014 में काल-प्रभावित शीत युद्ध-युग के युद्धपोतों को बदलने के लिए जर्मन नौसेना के नए युद्धपोतों को कमीशन किया जाना चाहिए था, लेकिन दोषपूर्ण प्रणालियों और तेज़ी से बढ़ती लागत के कारण, कम से कम अगले साल तक ऐसा नहीं होगा, स्थानीय मीडिया ने बताया।
translations.translation: New warships of the German Navy should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace the era-affected Cold War-era warships, but due to faulty systems and rapidly rising costs, this will not be the case until at least next year, local media reported.
translations.reference: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.

translations.source: एक सैन्य प्रवक्ता के हवाले से डाई ज़ेट अख़बार के अनुसार, "रेइनलैंड-पफ़ल्ज़" की कमीशनिंग, जोकि बिल्कुल नई बाडेन-वुर्टेमबर्ग-श्रेणी के युद्धपोतों का प्रमुख जहाज़ है, अब 2019 की पहली छमाही तक स्थगित की गई है।
translations.translation: According to a military spokesman, the commissioning of the "Rhineland-Pfalz", the flagship of the all-new Baden-Wurttemberg-class battleships, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper.
translations.reference: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.

translations.source: पोत को 2014 में नौसेना में शामिल हो जाना चाहिए था, लेकिन डिलीवरी के बाद परेशान करने वाले मुद्दों ने महत्वाकांक्षी परियोजना के भाग्य को प्रभावित किया।
translations.translation: The vessel was to have joined the Navy in 2014, but post-delivery troubling issues affected the fate of the ambitious project.
translations.reference: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.

translations.source: चार बैडेन-वुर्टेमबर्ग श्रेणी के जहाजों को नौसेना ने 2007 में वापस आदेश दिया था कि वे काल-प्रभावित ब्रेमेन-श्रेणी के युद्धपोतों के प्रतिस्थापन के रूप में लाए जाएँगे।
translations.translation: The four Baden-Wurttemberg-class ships had been ordered back by the Navy in 2007 to be brought in as a replacement for the time-influenced Bremen-class battleships.
translations.reference: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.

translations.source: यह समझा जाता है कि वे शक्तिशाली तोप, एंटी-एयरक्राफ्ट और एंटी-शिप मिसाइलों की एक सरणी के साथ-साथ कुछ स्टेल्थ तकनीक जैसे कि कम रडार, अवरक्त और ध्वनिक प्रभाग की सुविधा प्रदान करेंगे।
translations.translation: It is understood that they will provide an array of powerful artillery, anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies such as low radar, infrared and acoustic divisions.
translations.reference: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.

translations.source: अन्य महत्वपूर्ण विशेषताओं में लंबे समय तक रखरखाव अवधि शामिल है - स्वदेशी बंदरगाहों से दो साल तक के लिए नवीनतम युद्धपोतों को तैनात करना संभव है।
translations.translation: Other important features include long maintenance period - it is possible to deploy the latest warships from indigenous ports for up to two years.
translations.reference: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.

translations.source: हालांकि, निरंतर देरी का मतलब है कि अत्याधुनिक युद्धपोत - जिससे जर्मनी को विदेशों में बिजली परियोजना का मौक़ा मिल सकता है - सेवा में प्रवेश करने की अवधि तक कालातीत हो जाएँगे, डाइ ज़ीन ने टिप्पणी की।
translations.translation: However, the continued delay means that the state-of-the-art warship - which will give Germany an opportunity to power projects abroad - will be out of date by the time it enters service, Di Zinn commented.
translations.reference: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.

translations.source: दुर्दांत F125 युद्धपोत ने पिछले साल तब सुर्खियाँ बटोरी थीं, जब जर्मन नौसेना ने आधिकारिक तौर पर पोत को कमीशन करने से इनकार कर दिया था और हैम्बर्ग में ब्लोह्म और वॉस शिपयार्ड को वापस कर दिया था।
translations.translation: The Durdant F125 warship made headlines last year when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to the Blohm and Voss shipyards in Hamburg.
translations.reference: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.

translations.source: यह पहली बार था जब नौसेना ने किसी जहाज़ को डिलीवरी के बाद जहाज़ के निर्माता को लौटाया था।
translations.translation: This was the first time the Navy had returned a ship to the ship's manufacturer after delivery.
translations.reference: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.

translations.source: बहुत कम लोग वापसी के कारणों के बारे में जानते थे, लेकिन जर्मन मीडिया ने कई महत्वपूर्ण "सॉफ़्टवेयर और हार्डवेयर दोष" का हवाला दिया, जो युद्ध के मिशन पर तैनात किए जाने पर युद्धपोत को बेकार कर देते थे।
translations.translation: Few people knew the reasons for the withdrawal, but the German media cited a number of important "software and hardware defects" that rendered a warship useless when deployed on a war mission.
translations.reference: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.

translations.source: सॉफ़्टवेयर की कमियाँ विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण थीं क्योंकि बैडेन-वुर्टेमबर्ग-श्रेणी के जहाज़ों को कुछ 120 नाविकों के चालक दल द्वारा संचालित किया जाएगा - जोकि पुराने ब्रेमेन श्रेणी के युद्धपोतों की जनशक्ति का सिर्फ़ आधा है।
translations.translation: The software deficiencies were particularly significant as the Baden-Wurttemberg-class ships would be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - only half the manpower of the older Bremen-class warships.
translations.reference: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.

translations.source: इसके अलावा, यह बात भी उभरी कि जहाज़ नाटकीय रूप से अधिक वज़न वाला है जो उसके प्रदर्शन को कम करता है और भावी उन्नयन को जोड़ने की नौसेना की क्षमता को सीमित करता है।
translations.translation: In addition, it also emerged that the vessel is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.
translations.reference: Also, it emerged that the ship is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.

translations.source: 7,000 टन के "रीनलैंड-पफ़ल्ज़" को द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध में जर्मनों द्वारा इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले समान श्रेणी के जहाज़ों से दोगुना भारी माना जाता है।
translations.translation: The 7,000 - tonne "Rhineland - Pfalz" is considered to be twice as heavy as the ships of the same class used by the Germans in World War II.
translations.reference: The 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" is believed to be twice as heavy as similar-class ships used by the Germans in the Second World War.

translations.source: दोषपूर्ण हार्डवेयर के अलावा, पूरी परियोजना का मूल्य टैग - जिसमें चालक दल का प्रशिक्षण भी शामिल है - एक मुद्दा बन रहा है।
translations.translation: In addition to defective hardware, the value tag of the entire project - including crew training - is becoming an issue.
translations.reference: Aside from faulty hardware, the price tag of the entire project - including the training of the crew - is also becoming an issue.

translations.source: ऐसा कहा जाता है कि यह शुरुआती €2.2 बिलियन से €3.1  बिलियन ($3.6bn) तक पहुँच गया है।
translations.translation: It is said to have risen from an initial €2.2 billion to €3.1 billion ($3.6bn).
translations.reference: It is said to have reached staggering €3.1billion ($3.6bn) - up from initial €2.2 billion.

translations.source: हालिया चेतावनियों के प्रकाश में विशेष रूप से महत्त्वपूर्ण बन गए नए युद्धपोतों की समस्या जर्मनी की नौसैनिक शक्ति को जकड़ रही है।
translations.translation: The problem of new warships, which have become particularly important in the light of recent warnings, is stifling Germany's naval power.
translations.reference: Problems gripping the newest frigates become especially of importance in light of recent warnings that Germany's naval power is shrinking.

translations.source: इस साल की शुरुआत में, जर्मन संसद की रक्षा समिति के प्रमुख हैंस-पीटर बार्टेल्स ने स्वीकार किया कि नौसेना में दरअसल "तैनाती-सक्षम जहाज़ खत्म हो रहे हैं।"
translations.translation: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, head of the German parliament's defence committee, admitted that the navy was in fact "dead of deployment-capable vessels".
translations.reference: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, chief of the German parliament's defense committee, acknowledged the Navy is actually "running out of deployment-capable ships."

translations.source: अधिकारी ने कहा कि समय के साथ यह मुद्दा गंभीर होता गया है, क्योंकि पुराने जहाजों को उपयोग से हटाया गया, लेकिन कोई प्रतिस्थापन जहाज़ उपलब्ध नहीं कराए गए।
translations.translation: The officer said that over time the issue has become more serious, as the old vessels have been removed from use, but no replacement vessels have been made available.
translations.reference: The official said the issue has snowballed over time, because old ships were decommissioned but no replacement vessels were provided.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि बाडेन-वुर्टेमबर्ग-श्रेणी के युद्धपोतों में से कोई भी नौसेना में शामिल होने में सक्षम नहीं था।
translations.translation: He said that none of the Baden-Wurttemberg-class warships were able to join the Navy.
translations.reference: He lamented that none of the of the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates were able to join the Navy.

translations.source: नेशनल ट्रस्ट चमगादड़ों के गुप्त जीवन को छिपकर सुन रहा है
translations.translation: The National Trust is covering up the secret life of bats.
translations.reference: National Trust eavesdrops on secret life of bats

translations.source: स्कॉटिश हाइलैंड्स के एक एस्टेट में किए जा रहे नए शोध का उद्देश्य यह खुलासा करना है कि चमगादड़ भोजन के लिए अपने शिकार में प्राकृतिक परिदृश्य का उपयोग कैसे करते हैं।
translations.translation: The new research, being conducted at an estate in the Scottish Highlands, aims to reveal how bats use the natural landscape in their prey for food.
translations.reference: New research being carried out at an estate in the Scottish Highlands aims to reveal how bats use the landscape in their hunt for food.

translations.source: यह आशा की जा रही है कि निष्कर्ष उड़ने वाले अद्वितीय  स्तनधारियों के व्यवहार पर नई रोशनी डालेंगे और भविष्य की संरक्षण गतिविधियों को निर्देशित करने में मदद करेंगे।
translations.translation: It is hoped that the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.
translations.reference: It is hoped the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of the unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.

translations.source: स्कॉटलैंड के नेशनल ट्रस्ट के वैज्ञानिकों द्वारा किए गए अध्ययन में सामान्य और सोप्रानो पाइपिस्ट्रेल्स के साथ-साथ भूरे रंग के लंबे कान वाले और वेस्टन रॉस के इन्वरवे गार्डन में बसे डॉबेंटन चमगादड़ों का अनुसरण किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: The study, carried out by scientists from the National Trust of Scotland, will follow the normal and soprano pipistrels, as well as the brown long-eared and brown-eared Dobenton bats inhabiting the Inverway Gardens of Weston Ross.
translations.reference: The study by scientists at the National Trust for Scotland will follow common and soprano pipistrelles as well as brown long-eared and Daubenton bats at Inverewe Gardens in Wester Ross.

translations.source: पूरे मौसम में चमगादड़ों की गतिविधियों को ट्रैक करने के लिए संपदा के आसपास के प्रमुख स्थानों पर विशेष रिकॉर्डर लगाए जाएँगे।
translations.translation: Special recorders will be installed at key locations around the property to track the activities of bats throughout the season.
translations.reference: Special recorders will be placed at key locations around the property to track bat activities throughout the season.

translations.source: NHS कर्मचारी और स्वयंसेवक हस्तधारित डिटेक्टरों का उपयोग करके मोबाइल सर्वेक्षण भी करेंगे।
translations.translation: NHS staff and volunteers will also conduct mobile surveys using handheld detectors.
translations.reference: NHS staff and volunteers will also carry out mobile surveys using hand-held detectors.

translations.source: सभी रिकॉर्डिंग के विशेषज्ञ ध्वनि विश्लेषण से बैट कॉल की आवृत्ति और इस बात का पता चलता है कि कौन सी प्रजातियाँ क्या कर रही हैं।
translations.translation: All of the recording expert sound analysis shows the frequency of the bat call and what species are doing.
translations.reference: Expert sound analysis of all recordings will ascertain the frequency of the bat calls and which species are doing what.

translations.source: फिर उनके व्यवहार की एक विस्तृत परिदृश्य-पैमाने पर चित्रण के लिए प्राकृतिक-वास का नक्शा और रिपोर्ट तैयार की जाएगी।
translations.translation: A map and report of their natural habitat will then be prepared to illustrate their behaviour on a detailed landscape-scale.
translations.reference: A habitat map and report will then be produced to create a detailed landscape-scale picture of their behaviour.

translations.source: रॉब देवर, NTS के प्रकृति संरक्षण सलाहकार, आशा करते हैं कि परिणामों से पता चलेगा कि प्राकृतिक-वास का कौन-सा क्षेत्र चमगादड़ों के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण हैं और प्रत्येक प्रजाति द्वारा उनका कैसे उपयोग किया जाता है।
translations.translation: Rob Dever, NTS's Nature Conservation Advisor, hopes the results will reveal which areas of natural habitat are most important to bats and how they are used by each species.
translations.reference: Rob Dewar, nature conservation adviser for NTS, hopes the results will reveal which areas of habitat are most important to the bats and how they are used by each of the species.

translations.source: यह जानकारी प्राकृतिक-वास प्रबंधन कार्यों के लाभों को निर्धारित करने में मदद करेगी जैसे कि घास के मैदान का निर्माण और किस प्रकार चमगादड़ों और अन्य संबंधित प्रजातियों के लिए वुडलैंड्स को अच्छी तरह बनाए रखें।
translations.translation: This information will help to determine the benefits of natural habitat management functions such as the creation of grassland and how to maintain the woodlands well for bats and other related species.
translations.reference: This information will help determine the benefits of habitat management work such as meadow creation and how best to maintain woodlands for bats and other associated species.

translations.source: स्कॉटलैंड और पूरे यू.के. में चमगादड़ की आबादी में पिछली सदी में काफ़ी गिरावट आई है
translations.translation: In Scotland and across the UK, the bat population has declined dramatically over the past century.
translations.reference: Bat populations in Scotland and across the UK have declined considerably over the past century.

translations.source: उन्हें निर्माण और विकास कार्यों से ख़तरा है, जो पक्षियों के अड्डों को प्रभावित करते हैं और प्राकृतिक-वास को नुकसान पहुँचाते हैं।
translations.translation: They are threatened by construction and development work, which affects the nesting of birds and damages the natural habitat.
translations.reference: They are under threat from building and development work that affects roosts and loss of habitat.

translations.source: पवन टर्बाइन और प्रकाश व्यवस्था भी जोखिम पैदा कर सकती है, क्योंकि फ्लाईपेपर और निर्माण सामग्री के कुछ रासायनिक उपचार, साथ ही पालतू बिल्लियों द्वारा हमला भी ख़तरा बन सकता है।
translations.translation: Wind turbines and lighting systems can also pose a risk, as some chemical treatments of flypaper and building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats, can also pose a risk.
translations.reference: Wind turbines and lighting can also pose a risk, as can flypapers and some chemical treatments of building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats.

translations.translation: Bats are not really blind.
translations.reference: Bats are not actually blind.

translations.source: हालांकि, उनके शिकार की आदतों के कारण जब शिकार को पकड़ने की बात आती है तो उनके कान उनकी आँखों की तुलना में अधिक उपयोगी होते हैं।
translations.translation: However, because of their hunting habits, their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.
translations.reference: However, due to their nocturnal hunting habits their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.

translations.source: वे अपने उड़ान पथ में दोषों और बाधाओं को इंगित करने के लिए एक परिष्कृत इको-लोकेशन तकनीक का उपयोग करते हैं।
translations.translation: They use a sophisticated eco-location technique to pinpoint flaws and obstacles in their flight path.
translations.reference: They use a sophisticated echo-location technique to pinpoint bugs and obstacles in their flight path.

translations.source: NTS, जो 270 से अधिक ऐतिहासिक इमारतों, 38 महत्वपूर्ण उद्यानों और देश भर में 76,000 हेक्टेयर भूमि की देखभाल के लिए जिम्मेदार है, चमगादड़ को बहुत गंभीरता से लेता है।
translations.translation: NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historic buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land across the country, takes bats very seriously.
translations.reference: The NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historical buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land around the country, takes bats very seriously.

translations.source: इसके पास दस प्रशिक्षित विशेषज्ञ हैं, जो नियमित रूप से सर्वेक्षण, पक्षियों के अड्डों का निरीक्षण करते हैं और कभी-कभी उन्हें बचाते हैं।
translations.translation: It has ten trained specialists, who regularly survey, inspect and sometimes rescue the nesting of birds.
translations.reference: It has ten trained experts, who regularly carry out surveys, roost inspections and sometimes rescues.

translations.source: संगठन ने स्कॉटलैंड के डमफ्रीज़ और गैलोवे के थ्रीव एस्टेट में स्कॉटलैंड का पहला और एकमात्र समर्पित बैट रिजर्व स्थापित किया है, जो स्कॉटलैंड की दस चमगादड़ प्रजातियों में से आठ का घर है।
translations.translation: The organisation has set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve in the Three Estates of Dumfries and Galloway, Scotland, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.
translations.reference: The organisation has even set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve at Threave estate in Dumfries and Galloway, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.

translations.source: एस्टेट मैनेजर डेविड थॉम्पसन का कहना है कि एस्टेट उनके लिए बेहतरीन जगह है।

translations.reference: But there is much about bats that is still unknown, so the work we do here and at other properties will help us understand more about what they need to thrive."

translations.translation: If the UK leaves the EU on 29 March without a deal, border disruption could arise, depending on the industry, which could lead to delays and spare parts shortages.
translations.reference: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.

translations.source: कंपनी ने कहा कि टोयोटा के लिए अपने डर्बीशायर प्लांट में एक दिन से ज्यादा की इनवेंटरी रखना असंभव होगा, इसलिए उत्पादन बंद कर दिया जाएगा।
translations.translation: The company said that it would be impossible for Toyota to have more than one day's inventory at its Derbyshire plant, so production would be discontinued.
translations.reference: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.

translations.source: मि. क्लार्क ने कहा कि यूरोपीय संघ के साथ भावी संबंधों के लिए थेरेसा मे की चेकर्स योजना "विशुद्ध रूप से सीमा पर उन जाँचों से बचने के लिए कैलिब्रेट की गई है।"
translations.translation: Mr. Clark said that Theresa May's checkers plan for future relations with the European Union is "purely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border".
translations.reference: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."

translations.source: "हमें सौदे की आवश्यकता है। हम ऐसा बेहतरीन सौदा चाहते हैं जिससे मेरे विचार में न केवल वर्तमान में सफलता का आनंद लिया जा सकता है, बल्कि जो इस मौक़े को हासिल करने के लिए भी ज़रूरी है," उन्होंने बीबीसी रेडियो 4 के टुडे कार्यक्रम को बताया।
translations.translation: "We need a deal. We want the best deal that, in my opinion, can be enjoyed not only at the moment, but also what is needed to get this opportunity", he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
translations.reference: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.

translations.source: "न केवल टोयोटा बल्कि अन्य निर्माताओं से सबूत मिला है कि हमें पूरी तरह से इसे जारी रखने में सक्षम होना चाहिए जो आपूर्ति शृंंखलाओं का अत्यधिक सफल सेट रहा है।"
translations.translation: "Not only Toyota but other manufacturers have provided evidence that we should be able to fully continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains".
translations.reference: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."

translations.source: टोयोटा यह कहने में असमर्थ थी कि कब तक उत्पादन बंद कर दिया जाएगा, लेकिन लंबी अवधि में, चेतावनी दी कि अतिरिक्त लागत से संयंत्र की प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता कम हो जाएगी और अंततः नौकरियाँ चली जाएँगी।
translations.translation: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be discontinued, but in the long run, warned that the additional cost would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually lead to job losses.
translations.reference: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.

translations.source: पीटर साउवैलरीस ने, जो 24 साल बर्नस्टोन में काम कर चुके हैं और संयंत्र में यूनाइट संघ के संयोजक हैं, कहा कि उनके सदस्य अत्यधिक चिंतित हैं: "मेरे अनुभव में एक बार जब ये नौकरियाँ चली जाएँगी, तो बैद में बाद वे कभी वापस नहीं आती हैं।
translations.translation: Peter Sauvelloris, who has worked at Barnstone for 24 years and is the union coordinator at the plant, said that his members are deeply concerned: "In my experience, once these jobs are gone, they never come back after bed.
translations.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.

translations.source: एक सरकारी प्रवक्ता ने कहा: "हमने यूरोपीय संघ के साथ अपने भावी संबंधों के लिए एक सटीक और विश्वसनीय योजना को आगे बढ़ाया है।"
translations.translation: A government spokesman said: "We have put forward an accurate and reliable plan for our future relations with the European Union".
translations.reference: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."

translations.source: व्हाइट हाउस के मुताबिक, रोसेनस्टीन के साथ ट्रम्प की मुलाकात में फिर देरी हो सकती है
translations.translation: According to the White House, Trump's meeting with Rosenstein could be delayed again.
translations.reference: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House

translations.source: व्हाइट हाउस ने रविवार को कहा कि डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प की डिप्टी अटॉर्नी जनरल रॉड रोसेनस्टीन के साथ उच्च दाँव वाली बैठक "एक और सप्ताह बाद" के लिए टल सकती है क्योंकि सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के उम्मीदवार ब्रेट कैवना का संघर्ष जारी है।
translations.translation: The White House said on Sunday that Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein could be postponed for "another week" as Supreme Court candidate Brett Kavanagh's struggle continues.
translations.reference: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.

translations.source: रोसेनस्टीन विशेष वकील रॉबर्ट म्यूलर के काम की देखरेख करते हैं, जो रूसी चुनाव हस्तक्षेप, ट्रम्प सहायक और रूस के बीच संबंध और राष्ट्रपति द्वारा न्याय की संभावित बाधा की जाँच कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: Rosenstein oversees the work of Special Counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, the relationship between Trump's assistant and Russia, and possible obstruction of justice by the president.
translations.reference: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.

translations.source: ट्रम्प डिप्टी अटॉर्नी जनरल को निकालेंगे या नहीं निकालेंगे, और जिससे मुलर की स्वतंत्रता ख़तरे में पड़ जाती है, इस ख़बर ने महीनों तक वाशिंगटन की अफ़वाहों के बाज़ार को गरम किया है।
translations.translation: Whether Trump fires the deputy attorney general or not, and putting Mueller's freedom in jeopardy, the news has warmed Washington's rumour market for months.
translations.reference: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.

translations.source: इस महीने की शुरुआत में, न्यूयॉर्क टाइम्स ने बताया कि रोसेनस्टीन ने ट्रम्प के साथ बातचीत रिकॉर्ड करने के लिए वायर लगाने और 25वें संशोधन के माध्यम से राष्ट्रपति को हटाने की संभावना पर चर्चा की।
translations.translation: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed the possibility of wiring to record conversations with Trump and removing the president through the 25th Amendment.
translations.reference: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.

translations.source: रोसेनस्टीन ने रिपोर्ट का खंडन किया।
translations.translation: Rosenstein denied the report.
translations.reference: Rosenstein denied the report.

translations.source: लेकिन पिछले सोमवार को वे इन ख़बरों के बीच व्हाइट हाउस गए, कि वे इस्तीफ़ा देने वाले हैं।
translations.translation: But last Monday, he went to the White House amid the news that he was going to resign.
translations.reference: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.

translations.source: इसके बजाय, ट्रम्प के साथ गुरुवार को एक बैठक की घोषणा की गई, जो तब न्यूयॉर्क में संयुक्त राष्ट्र में थे।
translations.translation: Instead, a meeting with Trump was announced on Thursday, who was then at the United Nations in New York.
translations.reference: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.

translations.source: ट्रम्प ने कहा कि वे रोसेनस्टीन को हटाना "पसंद नहीं करेंगे" लेकिन फिर सीनेट न्यायपालिका समिति की उस सुनवाई से टकराव को टालने के लिए बैठक में देरी की गई, जिसमें कैवाना और उन पर यौन दुराचार का आरोप लगाने वाली महिला, डॉ क्रिस्टीन ब्लेसी फ़ोर्ड, दोनों ने गवाही दी थी।
translations.translation: Trump said he would "not like" the removal of Rosenstein, but then the Senate Judiciary Committee postponed the meeting to avoid a conflict with that hearing in which Kavanagh and the woman accusing him of sexual misconduct, Dr. Christine Blessy Ford, both testified.
translations.reference: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.

translations.source: शुक्रवार को ट्रम्प ने कैवना के खिलाफ़ दावों की एक सप्ताह की FBI जाँच का आदेश दिया, जिससे सीनेट के पूर्ण मतदान में देरी हुई।
translations.translation: On Friday, Trump ordered a week-long FBI investigation of claims against Kavanagh, delaying the full Senate vote.
translations.reference: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.

translations.source: ट्रंप की प्रेस सचिव सारा सैंडर्स, फ़ॉक्स न्यूज़ पर रविवार को नज़र आईं।
translations.translation: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, made an appearance on Fox News on Sunday.
translations.reference: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.

translations.source: रोसेनस्टीन बैठक के बारे में पूछे जाने पर उसने कहा: "इसके लिए तिथि निर्धारित नहीं की गई है, यह इस सप्ताह हो सकता है, मैं देख सकती हूँ कि सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के साथ चल रहे अन्य सभी मामलों के मद्दे नज़र एक और सप्ताह आगे धकेला जा सकता है।
translations.translation: When asked about the Rosenstein meeting she said: "The date for this has not been set, it may be this week, I can see that the subject of all other cases pending with the Supreme Court can be pushed back another week.
translations.reference: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.

translations.source: लेकिन हम देखेंगे और मैं हमेशा प्रेस को अपडेट रखना पसंद करती हूँ।"
translations.translation: But we'll see, and I always like to keep the press up to date".
translations.reference: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."

translations.source: कुछ पत्रकारों ने दावा किया है कि: सैंडर्स ने 10 सितंबर से व्हाइट हाउस की प्रेस वार्ता नहीं की है।
translations.translation: Some journalists have claimed that: Sanders has not held a White House press conference since September 10.
translations.reference: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.

translations.source: मेजबान क्रिस वालेस ने पूछा कि क्यों।
translations.translation: The host, Chris Wallace, asked why.
translations.reference: Host Chris Wallace asked why.

translations.source: सैंडर्स ने कहा कि ब्रीफ़िंग की कमी टीवी संवाददाताओं की "भव्यता"  के प्रति अरुचि के कारण नहीं थी, हालांकि उन्होंने कहा: "मैं इस तथ्य से असहमत नहीं हूँ कि वे भव्य हैं।"
translations.translation: Sanders said that the lack of briefing was not because of the TV reporters' interest in "glory", although he said: "I don't disagree with the fact that they're gorgeous".
translations.reference: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."

translations.source: उसने फिर ट्रम्प और प्रेस के बीच सीधा संपर्क बढ़ाने का सुझाव दिया।
translations.translation: He then suggested to increase direct contact between Trump and the press.
translations.reference: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.

translations.source: उसने कहा, "राष्ट्रपति किसी और राष्ट्रपति की तुलना में अधिक प्रश्नोत्तर सत्र करते हैं," सबूतों का हवाला न देते हुए उसने कहा: "हमने उन नंबरों को देखा है।"
translations.translation: He said, "The president does more Q&A sessions than any other president", not citing the evidence, he said, "We've seen those numbers".
translations.reference: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."

translations.source: ब्रीफ़िंग अभी भी होगी, सैंडर्स ने कहा, लेकिन "अगर प्रेस के पास संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति से सीधे सवाल पूछने का मौक़ा मिलता है, तो यह मुझसे बात करने से बेहतर है।
translations.translation: The briefing will still take place, Sanders said, but "If the press gets a chance to ask a question directly from the president of the United States, it's better than talking to me".
translations.reference: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.

translations.source: हम ऐसा करने की बहुत कोशिश करते हैं और आपने हमें पिछले कुछ हफ्तों में ऐसा करते हुए बहुत देखा है और जब आप संयुक्त राज्य के राष्ट्रपति से बात कर सकते हैं तो वह प्रेस वार्ता की जगह लेने जा रहा है।"
translations.translation: We're trying hard to do this, and you've seen us do a lot of it in the past few weeks, and when you can talk to the president of the United States, he's going to take the place of the press conference".
translations.reference: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."

translations.source: व्हाइट हाउस छोड़ते समय या खुले सत्रों में भाग लेते समय या गणमान्य लोगों के साथ प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस में ट्रम्प नियमित रूप से सवालों का जवाब देते हैं।
translations.translation: Trump regularly answers questions while leaving the White House or attending open sessions or at a press conference with dignitaries.
translations.reference: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.

translations.source: एकल प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस दुर्लभ हैं।
translations.translation: Single press conferences are rare.
translations.reference: Solo press conferences are rare.

translations.source: इस सप्ताह न्यूयॉर्क में राष्ट्रपति ने उपस्थित पत्रकारों के समक्ष बेबाक और कई बार अनोखी मौजूदगी का प्रदर्शन करते हुए शायद यह प्रदर्शित किया कि क्यों।
translations.translation: This week in New York, the President, in front of the press, demonstrated a bold and often unusual presence, perhaps demonstrating why.
translations.reference: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.

translations.source: स्वास्थ्य सचिव NHS स्कॉटलैंड में यूरोपीय संघ के कार्यकर्ताओं को ब्रेक्सिट की आशंकाओं के बारे में लिखते हैं
translations.translation: Health Secretary NHS Scotland writes to EU workers about the fears of Brexit
translations.reference: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears

translations.source: स्वास्थ्य सचिव ने देश की कृतज्ञता को व्यक्त करने और ब्रेक्सिट के बाद उनके बने रहने की कामना के साथ स्कॉटलैंड के NHS में काम करने वाले यूरोपीय संघ के कर्मचारियों को  लिखा है।
translations.translation: The Secretary of Health has written to the EU staff working in Scotland's NHS expressing the country's gratitude and wishes for their survival after Brexit.
translations.reference: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.

translations.source: जीन फ्रीमैन MSP ने यूरोपीय संघ से यू.के. के पीछे हटने को लेकर छह महीने से भी कम समय के चलते एक पत्र भेजा।
translations.translation: In less than six months, Jean Freeman MSP sent a letter calling for the UK to withdraw from the European Union.
translations.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.

translations.source: स्कॉटिश सरकार पहले से ही अपने अवक्रमित सार्वजनिक सेवाओं में काम कर रहे यूरोपीय संघ के नागरिकों के लिए निपटान स्थिति के आवेदनों की लागत को पूरा करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।
translations.translation: The Scottish Government is committed to covering the cost of settlement status applications for EU nationals already working in its disadvantaged public services.
translations.reference: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.

translations.source: अपने पत्र में, मिस फ्रीमैन ने लिखा: "गर्मियों में, यू.के. और यूरोपीय संघ के बीच परस्पर-वार्ता जारी रही, इस शरद ऋतु में अपेक्षित फैसलों की ओर बढ़ रहे हैं।
translations.translation: In her letter, Miss Freeman wrote: "In the summer, the UK and the EU continue to negotiate, moving towards the decisions expected this autumn.
translations.reference: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.

translations.source: लेकिन यू.के. सरकार भी संभावित नो-डील परिदृश्य के लिए अपनी तैयारियों को आगे बढ़ा रही है।
translations.translation: But the UK government is also moving forward with its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
translations.reference: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.

translations.source: मुझे पता है कि यह आप सभी के लिए बहुत ही अनिश्चितता का समय रहा होगा।
translations.translation: I know that this must have been a time of great uncertainty for all of you.
translations.reference: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.

translations.source: यही कारण है कि मैं अब दोहराना चाहता था कि मैं प्रत्येक स्टाफ़ सदस्य की राष्ट्रीयता की परवाह किए बिना, उनके योगदान को कितना महत्व देता हूँ।
translations.translation: That is why I would now like to reiterate how much I value the contributions of each of the staff members, regardless of their nationality.
translations.reference: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.

translations.source: यूरोपीय संघ, और उससे परे के सहकर्मी, मूल्यवान अनुभव और कौशल साथ लाते हैं जो स्वास्थ्य सेवा के काम को मजबूत करते हैं और उनमें सुधार लाते हैं, तथा उन रोगियों और समुदायों को लाभान्वित करते हैं जिनकी हम सेवा करते हैं।
translations.translation: Colleagues from the European Union, and beyond, bring together valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of healthcare, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
translations.reference: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
