translations.translation: Scotland is your home, and we want you to stay".
translations.reference: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."

translations.source: सिर में चोट लगने के बाद क्रिस्टियन एबरक्रॉम्बी की आपातकालीन सर्जरी
translations.translation: Emergency surgery for Christian Abercrombie after suffering a head injury
translations.reference: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury

translations.source: टेनेसी माइक ऑर्गन ने बताया कि वैंडरबिल्ट कमोडोर से शनिवार को 31-27 से हार का सामना करने वाले टेनेसी स्टेट टाइगर्स लाइनबैकर क्रिस्टियन एबरक्रॉम्बी ने सिर में लगने वाले चोट के बाद आपातकालीन सर्जरी करवाई।
translations.translation: Tennessee Mike Organ reports that Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christian Abercrombie, who suffered a 31-27 loss to Vanderbilt Commodore on Saturday, underwent emergency surgery following a head injury.
translations.reference: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.

translations.source: टेनेसी राज्य के मुख्य कोच रॉड रीड ने संवाददाताओं को बताया कि चोट हॉफ़टाइम से ठीक कुछ समय पहले लगी थी।
translations.translation: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters that the injury occurred just before halftime.
translations.reference: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.

translations.source: "वह किनारे पर आया और बस वहाँ गिर गया," रीड ने कहा।
translations.translation: "He came to the shore and just fell there", Reed said.
translations.reference: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.

translations.source: प्रशिक्षकों और चिकित्सा कर्मियों ने उसे स्ट्रेचर पर रखने और आगे के मूल्यांकन के लिए वापस ले जाने से पहले एबरक्रॉम्बी को साइडलाइन पर ऑक्सीजन दी।
translations.translation: The instructors and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
translations.reference: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.

translations.source: टेनेसी राज्य के एक अधिकारी ने नैशविले, टेनेसी में WSMV के क्रिस हैरिस को बताया कि एबरड्रोम्बी वैंडरबिल्ट मेडिकल सेंटर में सर्जरी से बाहर आ चुका है।
translations.translation: An official from the state of Tennessee told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee that Aberdromby had emerged from surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
translations.reference: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.

translations.source: हैरिस ने कहा कि "अभी तक चोट के प्रकार/सीमा पर कोई विवरण उपलब्ध नहीं है" और टेनेसी स्टेट यह पता लगाने की कोशिश कर रहा है कि चोट कब लगी थी।
translations.translation: "As of now, there is no information available on the type/ extent of the injury", Harris said, and Tennessee State is trying to find out when the injury occurred.
translations.reference: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.

translations.source: एबरक्रॉम्बी, जोकि रेडशर्ट सोफ़ोमोर है, इलिनोइस से स्थानांतरित होने के बाद टेनेसी राज्य के साथ अपने पहले सीज़न में है।
translations.translation: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after moving from Illinois.
translations.reference: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.

translations.source: खेल से बाहर निकलने से पहले उन्होंने शनिवार को कुल पाँच टैकल किए, जिससे उनका सीज़न कुल 18 टैकल हो गया।
translations.translation: He made a total of five tackles on Saturday before leaving the game, bringing his season to a total of 18 tackles.
translations.reference: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.

translations.source: यू.के. में संपत्ति खरीदते समय विदेशी खरीदारों से उच्च स्टाम्प ड्यूटी ली जाएगी
translations.translation: High stamp duty will be charged to foreign buyers when buying property in the UK
translations.reference: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK

translations.source: विदेशी खरीदार जब यू.के. में संपत्ति खरीदेंगे, तब उनसे उच्च स्टाम्प ड्यूटी ली जाएगी, जिसका इस्तेमाल नई टोरी योजनाओं के तहत बेघरों की मदद के लिए किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: Foreign buyers will be charged a higher stamp duty when they purchase property in the UK, which will be used to help the homeless under the new Tory Schemes.
translations.reference: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans

translations.source: यह कदम युवा मतदाताओं को आकर्षित करने के लिए कॉर्बिन के अभियान की सफलता को बेअसर कर देगा
translations.translation: This move will undo the success of Corbyn's campaign to attract young voters.
translations.reference: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters

translations.source: वर्धित स्टाम्प ड्यूटी  उन लोगों पर लगाई जाएगी जो यू.के. में कर का भुगतान नहीं कर रहे हैं
translations.translation: The increased stamp duty will be imposed on those who are not paying taxes in the UK.
translations.reference: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK

translations.source: ट्रेजरी को उम्मीद है कि यह बेघरों की मदद करने के लिए - एक साल में £ 120 मिलियन तक जुटाएगा
translations.translation: The Treasury hopes it will raise up to £120 million a year to help the homeless
translations.reference: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless

translations.source: विदेशी खरीदारों से यू.के. में संपत्ति खरीदने पर उच्च स्टैम्प ड्यूटी दर वसूलने की तैयारी की जा रही है - जिस अतिरिक्त नकदी को बेघर लोगों की मदद के लिए उपयोग किया जाएगा,  थेरेसा मे आज घोषणा करेगी।
translations.translation: It is being prepared to levy a higher stamp duty rate on the purchase of property in the UK from foreign buyers - the additional cash to be used to help the homeless will be announced today by Theresa May.
translations.reference: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.

translations.source: इस कदम को अधिक किफायती आवास प्रदान करने और उच्च कमाई करने वालों को लक्षित करने के वचन के साथ युवा मतदाताओं को आकर्षित करने वाले जेरेमी कॉर्बिन के अभियान की सफलता को बेअसर करने के प्रयास के रूप में देखा जा रहा है।
translations.translation: The move is seen as an attempt to undermine the success of Jeremy Corbyn's campaign to attract young voters with the promise of providing more affordable housing and targeting higher-income earners.
translations.reference: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.

translations.source: स्टैम्प ड्यूटी वृद्धि यू.के. में कर का भुगतान न करने वाले व्यक्तियों और फ़र्मों पर लगाई जाएगी, जिस अतिरिक्त धन के साथ सरकार द्वारा विषम परिस्थितियों में सोने वालों से निपटने के अभियान को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
translations.translation: The stamp duty increases will be imposed on non-taxpaying individuals and firms in the UK, with additional funds to boost the government's campaign to deal with those who fall asleep in extreme circumstances.
translations.reference: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.

translations.source: अधिभार - जो वर्तमान स्टाम्प ड्यूटी के अतिरिक्त है, जिसमें दो साल पहले शुरू किए गए दो घरों और किराये पर देने की खरीदारियाँ शामिल हैं, अधिकतम तीन प्रतिशत हो सकता है।
translations.translation: Surcharge - which is in addition to the current stamp duty, which includes two houses and rental purchases started two years ago, can be a maximum of three percent.
translations.reference: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.

translations.source: ट्रेज़री को एक साल में  £120 मिलियन तक उगाही की उम्मीद है।
translations.translation: The Treasury is expected to generate up to £120 million a year.
translations.reference: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.

translations.source: अनुमानित तौर पर 13 प्रतिशत नव-निर्मित लंदन संपत्तियों को गैर-यू.के. के निवासियों द्वारा खरीदा जाता है, जिससे कीमतों में वृद्धि होती है और पहली बार के खरीदारों के लिए आवास की सीढ़ी पर पैर रखना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
translations.translation: An estimated 13 per cent of newly built London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it difficult for first-time buyers to get their foot in the door.
translations.reference: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.

translations.source: देश के कई धनी क्षेत्र - विशेष रूप से राजधानी में - "भूतहा शहर" बन गए हैं क्योंकि ऐसे विदेशी खरीदारों की संख्या अधिक है, जो अपना अधिकांश समय देश से बाहर बिताते हैं।
translations.translation: Many of the rich areas of the country - especially in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time outside the country.
translations.reference: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.

translations.source: नई नीति बोरिस जॉनसन द्वारा अधिक युवाओं को अपना पहला घर बनाने में मदद करने के इरादे से स्टाम्प ड्यूटी में कटौती का आह्वान दिए जाने के कुछ ही हफ़्ते बाद सामने आई है।
translations.translation: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a reduction in stamp duty with the intention of helping more young people build their first home.
translations.reference: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.

translations.source: उन्होंने बड़ी निर्माण फ़र्मों पर ज़मीनें हड़पकर लेकिन उनका उपयोग न करते हुए संपत्ति की क़ीमतों में उछाल लाने का आरोप लगाया, और मिसेज मे से ब्रिटेन के "आवास बेकद्री" को ठीक करने के लिए किफायती घरों पर कोटा छोड़ने का आग्रह किया।
translations.translation: He accused large construction firms of plundering land but not using it to boost property prices, and urged Ms. May to leave a quota on affordable housing to fix Britain's "homelessness".
translations.reference: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."

translations.source: मि. कॉर्बिन ने प्रस्तावित आवास सुधारों की आकर्षक शृंखला की घोषणा की है, जिसमें किराया नियंत्रण और "नो-फॉल्ट" विवादों का अंत शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: Mr. Corbin has announced an appealing series of proposed housing reforms, including a rental control and an end to "no-fault" disputes.
translations.reference: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.

translations.source: वे नए घरों के निर्माण के लिए परिषदों को अधिक अधिकार देना चाहते हैं।
translations.translation: They want to give councils more power to build new houses.
translations.reference: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.

translations.source: मिसेज़ मे ने कहा: "पिछले साल मैंने कहा था कि मैं अपने प्रीमियर को ब्रिटिश सपने को बहाल करने के लिए समर्पित करूँगी - कि जीवन प्रत्येक नई पीढ़ी के लिए बेहतर होनी चाहिए।
translations.translation: "Last year I had said that I would dedicate my premiere to restore the British dream - that life should be better for every new generation.
translations.reference: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.

translations.source: और इसका मतलब है कि हमारे विच्छिन्न आवास बाज़ार को ठीक करना।
translations.translation: And that means fixing our fragmented housing market.
translations.reference: And that means fixing our broken housing market.

translations.source: ब्रिटेन हमेशा उन लोगों के लिए खुला रहेगा जो यहाँ रहना, काम करना और जीवन का निर्माण करना चाहते हैं।
translations.translation: The UK will always be open to those who want to live, work and build a life here.
translations.reference: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.

translations.source: हालांकि, यह सही नहीं है कि ब्रिटेन में न रहने वाले व्यक्तियों के साथ-साथ विदेश-आधारित कंपनियों के लिए भी उतना ही आसान है, जितना मेहनत करने वाले ब्रिटिश निवासियों के लिए घर खरीदना।
translations.translation: However, it is not true that it is as easy for non-UK residents as it is for foreign-based companies to buy a home as it is for hardworking British residents.
translations.reference: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.

translations.source: बहुत से लोगों के लिए घर के स्वामित्व का सपना बहुत दूर की बात हो गई है, और विषम परिस्थितियों में सोने का रोष अत्यंत वास्तविक है।"
translations.translation: For many people, the dream of owning a home has become a long one, and in extreme circumstances, the desire for gold is a very real one".
translations.reference: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."

translations.source: जैक रॉस: 'मेरी अंतिम महत्वाकांक्षा स्कॉटलैंड का प्रबंधन करना है'
translations.translation: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
translations.reference: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'

translations.source: संडरलैंड के बॉस जैक रॉस का कहना है कि उनकी "अंतिम महत्वाकांक्षा" किसी चरण में स्कॉटलैंड प्रबंधक बनना है।
translations.translation: Sunderland's boss, Jack Ross, says his "ultimate ambition" is to become a Scotland manager at some point.
translations.reference: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.

translations.source: 42 वर्षीय स्कॉट, नॉर्थ-ईस्ट क्लब को पुनर्जीवित करने की चुनौती को दोहरा रहे हैं, जो इस समय लीग वन में तीसरे स्थान पर है, और जो शीर्ष से तीन अंक दूर है।
translations.translation: The 42-year-old Scott is repeating the challenge of reviving the Northeast Club, which is currently third in League One, and which is three points from the top.
translations.reference: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.

translations.source: वे पिछले साल स्कॉटिश प्रीमियरशिप के लिए सेंट मिरेन का मार्गदर्शन करने के बाद इस साल की गर्मियों में स्टेडियम ऑफ़ लाइट चले गए थे।
translations.translation: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren to the Scottish Premiership last year.
translations.reference: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.

translations.source: "मैं एक खिलाड़ी के रूप में अपने देश के लिए खेलना चाहता था।
translations.translation: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
translations.reference: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.

translations.source: मुझे B कैप मिली और बस यही बात थी," रॉस ने बीबीसी स्कॉटलैंड के स्पोर्ट्साउंड को बताया।
translations.translation: I got a B cap and that was it", Ross told BBC Scotland's SportsSound.
translations.reference: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.

translations.source: "लेकिन मैं बचपन से अपने पिता के साथ हैम्पडेन में स्कॉटलैंड को देखकर बड़ा हुआ, और यह हमेशा ही कुछ ऐसा रहा है जो मुझे वापस खींच लाता है।
translations.translation: "But I grew up seeing Scotland in Hampden with my father as a child, and it's always been something that brings me back.
translations.reference: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.

translations.source: यह अवसर तभी आएगा, जब मैं क्लब प्रबंधन में सफल होऊंगा।"
translations.translation: This opportunity will come only when I succeed in the management of the club".
translations.reference: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."

translations.source: संडरलैंड के प्रबंधक के रूप में रॉस के पूर्ववर्तियों में डिक एडवोकेट, डेविड मोयस, सैम अलार्डिस, मार्टिन ओ'नील, रॉय कीन, गूस पोएट और पाउलो डि कैनियो शामिल हैं।
translations.translation: Ross's predecessors as manager of Sunderland include Dick Advocate, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neal, Roy Keane, Gus Poet and Paolo di Canio.
translations.reference: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.

translations.source: पूर्व एलोआ एथलेटिक बॉस का कहना है कि उन्हें ऐसे बड़े क्लब में ऐसे स्थापित नामों का अनुसरण करने में कोई घबराहट महसूस नहीं हुई, जो पहले बार्न्सले और इप्सविच टाउन की पहल को अस्वीकार कर चुके थे।
translations.translation: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he had no qualms about following established names at a large club that had previously rejected Barnsley and Ipswich Town's initiative.
translations.reference: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.

translations.source: "फिलहाल मेरे लिए सफलता का अनुमान इस बात से लगाया जा सकता है कि क्या मैं इस क्लब को प्रीमियर लीग में लौटा सकता हूँ?"
translations.translation: "For now, can my success be predicted by whether I can bring this club back to the Premier League?"
translations.reference: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'

translations.source: इस क्लब की संरचना और सुविधाओं के कारण, यह निस्संदेह प्रीमियर लीग में आता है," उन्होंने कहा।
translations.translation: Due to the structure and facilities of this club, it is undoubtedly in the Premier League", he said.
translations.reference: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.

translations.source: "इसे वहाँ पहुँचाना कोई आसान काम नहीं है, लेकिन मैं शायद खुद को यहाँ सफल होने के रूप में देखूँगा अगर मैं क्लब को वहाँ पहुँचा सकूँ।"
translations.translation: "It's not an easy task to get it there, but I'll probably see myself as a success here if I can get the club there".
translations.reference: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."

translations.source: डंबर्टन के सहायक बॉस के रूप में और हार्ट्स के कोचिंग स्टाफ़ में 15 महीने गुज़ारने के बाद, रॉस के प्रबंधन कैरियर को बस तीन साल हुए हैं।
translations.translation: After spending 15 months on the coaching staff at Dumbarton as an assistant manager, Ross's managerial career has spanned just three years.
translations.reference: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.

translations.source: फिर उन्होंने एलोआ को तीसरे टियर की अवनति से उबरने में मदद की, और सेंट मिरेन को अगले सत्र में चैम्पियनशिप खिताब विजेताओं की अवनति के कगार से उबार कर बदल दिया।
translations.translation: He then helped Alloa overcome third-tier relegation, and replaced St. Mirren on the brink of winning the championship title the following season.
translations.reference: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.

translations.source: और रॉस का कहना है कि वे क्लाइड, हार्टलपूल, फाल्किर्क, सेंट मिरेन और हैमिल्टन अकादमिक में अपने कैरियर के दौरान किए गए काम की तुलना में अब अधिक सहज महसूस करते हैं।
translations.translation: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he did during his career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St. Mirren and Hamilton Academic.
translations.reference: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.

translations.source: अलोआ का पदभार संभालने के मामले में उन्होंने कहा, "यह शायद असली चौराहा था।"
translations.translation: In the case of Alloa taking office, he said, "It was probably a real crossroads".
translations.reference: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.

translations.source: "मैं वास्तव में विश्वास करता था कि खेलने की तुलना में प्रबंधन मेरे लिए ज़्यादा सही फिट था।
translations.translation: "I really believed that management was more fit for me than playing.
translations.reference: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.

translations.source: यह विचित्र लगता है क्योंकि मैंने ठीक-ठाक काम किया, उससे उचित कमाई की, और कुछ यथोचित ऊँचाइयों का आनंद लिया।
translations.translation: It sounds strange because I did a good job, earned a decent income, and enjoyed some decent heights.
translations.reference: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.

translations.source: लेकिन खेलना कठिन हो सकता है।
translations.translation: But it can be hard to play.
translations.reference: But playing can be tough.

translations.source: साप्ताहिक आधार पर आपको बहुत सी चीजें प्राप्त करनी होती हैं।
translations.translation: You have to get a lot of things on a weekly basis.
translations.reference: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.

translations.source: मैं अभी भी नौकरी के तनाव और दबाव के मामले में उनसे गुजरता हूँ लेकिन प्रबंधन के मामले में सब ठीक लगता है।
translations.translation: I still go through them when it comes to job stress and pressure, but everything seems fine when it comes to management.
translations.reference: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.

translations.source: मैं हमेशा प्रबंधन करना चाहता था और अब मैं यह कर रहा हूँ, यह मुझे अपने पूरे वयस्क जीवन में सर्वाधिक आरामदायक महसूस कराता है।"
translations.translation: I've always wanted to manage, and now I'm doing it, it makes me feel most comfortable in my entire adult life".
translations.reference: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."

translations.source: आप 30 सितंबर, रविवार को स्पोर्ट्साउंड पर पूरा इंटरव्यू 12:00 और 13:00 BST के बीच रेडियो स्कॉटलैंड पर सुन सकते हैं
translations.translation: You can listen to the entire interview on Sunday, September 30th, at SportsSound on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST.
translations.reference: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST

translations.source: एक पिंट के लिए सही समय शनिवार शाम 5.30 बजे है, सर्वेक्षण में पाया गया
translations.translation: The perfect time for a pint is Saturday at 5.30 pm, the survey found.
translations.reference: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds

translations.source: गर्मियों की तपिश ने ब्रिटेन के संघर्षशील पबों को बढ़ावा दिया है, लेकिन रेस्तराँ की शृंंखलाओं पर इसने अधिक दबाव डाला है।
translations.translation: The heat of summer has boosted Britain's struggling pubs, but it has put more pressure on restaurant chains.
translations.reference: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.

translations.source: पब और बार समूह ने जुलाई में बिक्री में 2.7 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि देखी - लेकिन रेस्तराँ में उतार-चढ़ाव 4.8 प्रतिशत नीचे थे, आँकड़ों से पता चला।
translations.translation: The pub and bar group saw a 2.7 per cent increase in sales in July - but the ups and downs in the restaurants were 4.8 per cent lower, statistics showed.
translations.reference: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.

translations.source: पीटर मार्टिन, बिज़नेस कंसल्टेंसी CGA, जो आँकड़ों को संकलित करता है, ने कहा: "लगातार धूप और इंग्लैंड की विश्व कप में अपेक्षित भागीदारी की तुलना में जुलाई का मतलब है कि पिछले जून के महीने में इसी तरह के पैटर्न का अनुसरण किया था, जब पब 2.8 प्रतिशत ऊपर थे, सिवाय इसके कि रेस्तराँ को और भी मुश्किलों का सामना करना पड़ा।
translations.translation: Peter Martin, of the business consultancy CGA, which compiles the statistics, said: "In comparison to the continuous sunshine and England's expected participation in the World Cup, July means a similar pattern followed in the month of June last, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants faced further difficulties.
translations.reference: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.

translations.source: रेस्तराँ व्यापार में जून में 1.8 प्रतिशत की गिरावट जुलाई में और खराब हो गई।
translations.translation: The restaurant trade declined by 1.8 per cent in June to further deterioration in July.
translations.reference: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.

translations.source: शराब बेचने वाले पब और बार ने रेस्तराँ की तुलना में अधिक पसंदगी के साथ सबसे मजबूत प्रदर्शन किया।
translations.translation: The pubs and bars that sold alcohol performed the strongest with more fanaticism than the restaurants.
translations.reference: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.

translations.source: खाद्य-संचालित पबों को भी धूप में नुकसान उठाना पड़ा, हालांकि रेस्तरां संचालकों की तरह नाटकीय रूप से नहीं।
translations.translation: Food-powered pubs also had to suffer from sun damage, though not as dramatically as restaurant operators.
translations.reference: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.

translations.source: ऐसा लगता है कि लोग केवल पीने के लिए बाहर जाना चाहते थे।
translations.translation: It seems that people just wanted to go out for a drink.
translations.reference: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.

translations.source: महीने के लिए सारे पब और बार मे ड्रिंक्स की बिक्री में 6.6 फीसदी बढ़ोतरी हुई, जब कि खाद्य के मामले में तीन फीसदी की गिरावट दर्ज की गई।''
translations.translation: The sales of all pubs and bars for the month increased by 6.6 per cent, while the sales of food decreased by 3 per cent.'
translations.reference: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."

translations.source: पॉल न्यूमैन, अवकाश और आतिथ्य विश्लेषक RSM ने कहा: "इन परिणामों ने अप्रैल के अंत से हमारे द्वारा देखे गए रुझान को जारी रखा है।
translations.translation: Paul Newman, Leisure and Hospitality Analyst RSM said: "These results have continued the trend we have seen since the end of April.
translations.reference: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.

translations.source: मौसम और प्रमुख सामाजिक या खेल आयोजनों का प्रभाव घर के बाहर के बाजार में बिक्री के लिए सबसे बड़ा कारक बनता है।
translations.translation: The impact of the weather and major social or sporting events makes it the biggest factor for sales in the outdoor market.
translations.reference: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.

translations.source: यह कोई आश्चर्य की बात नहीं है कि रेस्तराँ समूहों ने संघर्ष करना जारी रखा, हालांकि बिक्री में साल-दर-साल 4.8 प्रतिशत की गिरावट, विशेष रूप से चालू लागत दबाव के चलते, दर्दनाक होगी।
translations.translation: It is not surprising that restaurant groups continued to struggle, although a year-on-year 4.8 percent drop in sales, especially due to current cost pressures, will be painful.
translations.reference: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.

translations.source: लंबी गर्मियों का मौसम खाद्य-सामग्री के संचालकों के समय और बुरा वक़्त नहीं हो सकता था और समय ही बताएगा कि क्या अगस्त में जिस अधिक मध्यम तापमान का हमने अनुभव किया है वह बेहद ज़रूरी राहत प्रदान करेगा।"
translations.translation: The long summer could not have been a bad time for food service operators, and time will tell if the more moderate temperatures we have experienced in August will provide much needed relief".
translations.reference: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."

translations.source: जुलाई में नए खुलने वालों सहित पब और रेस्तराँ में कुल बिक्री में वृद्धि 2.7 प्रतिशत थी, जो ब्रांड रोल-आउट में धीमी गति को दर्शाती है।
translations.translation: Total sales in pubs and restaurants, including new entrants, increased by 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting a slowdown in brand roll-out.
translations.reference: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.

translations.source: कॉफ़र पीच ट्रैकर यूके पब, बार और रेस्तराँ क्षेत्र के लिए उद्योग की बिक्री की निगरानी £9 बिलियन के संयुक्त कारोबार के साथ प्रदर्शन करने वाले 47 ऑपरेटिंग समूहों से डेटा एकत्र और विश्लेषण करती है, और यह स्थापित उद्योग बेंचमार्क है।
translations.translation: Coffer Peach Tracker collects and analyses data from 47 operating groups performing a combined turnover of £9 billion to monitor industry sales for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector, and is an established industry benchmark.
translations.reference: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.

translations.source: पाँच बच्चों में से एक के पास गुप्त सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट होता है जिसे वे अपने माता-पिता से छिपाते हैं
translations.translation: One in five children has a secret social media account that they hide from their parents.
translations.reference: One in five children have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents

translations.source: सर्वेक्षण से पता चलता है कि पाँच बच्चों में से एक के पास -  जिनमें कुछ 11 की कम उम्र वाले  युवा हैं- गुप्त सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट है जो वे अपने माता-पिता और शिक्षकों से छिपाते है
translations.translation: The survey shows that one in five children - some of whom are younger than 11 - has a secret social media account that they hide from their parents and teachers.
translations.reference: One in five children - some as young as 11 - have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents and teachers, survey reveals

translations.source: 20,000 माध्यमिक विद्यालय के छात्रों के सर्वेक्षण में "फर्जी इंस्टा" पन्नों में वृद्धि का पता चला
translations.translation: A survey of 20,000 secondary school students revealed an increase in "false Insta" pages.
translations.reference: Survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed growth in "fake Insta" pages

translations.source: इस खबर से आशंका बढ़ गई है कि यौन सामग्री पोस्ट की जा रही है
translations.translation: The news has raised concerns that sexual content is being posted.
translations.reference: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted

translations.source: बीस प्रतिशत छात्रों ने कहा कि उनके पास माता-पिता को दिखाने के लिए एक "मुख्य" खाता है
translations.translation: Twenty percent of the students said they had a "main" account to show the parents.
translations.reference: Twenty per cent of pupils said they have a "main" account to show parents

translations.source: पाँच बच्चों में से एक - जिनमें कुछ 11 की कम उम्र वाले  युवा हैं - सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट बना रहे हैं कि वे वयस्कों से गुप्त रहते हैं।
translations.translation: One in five children - some of them under the age of 11 - is creating social media accounts that they keep a secret from adults.
translations.reference: One in five children - some as young as 11 - are creating social media accounts that they keep secret from adults.

translations.source: 20,000 सेकेंडरी स्कूल के छात्रों के एक सर्वेक्षण में "फर्जी इंस्टा" खातों में तेजी से वृद्धि हुई - फोटो-शेयरिंग साइट इंस्टाग्राम का एक संदर्भ।
translations.translation: A survey of 20,000 secondary school students showed a rapid increase in "false Insta" accounts - a reference to the photo-sharing site Instagram.
translations.reference: A survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed a rapid growth in "fake Insta" accounts - a reference to photo-sharing site Instagram.

translations.source: इस खबर से आशंका बढ़ गई है कि यौन सामग्री पोस्ट की जा रही है।
translations.translation: The news has raised concerns that sexual content is being posted.
translations.reference: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted.

translations.source: बीस प्रतिशत विद्यार्थियों ने कहा कि वे माता-पिता को दिखाने के लिए एक साफ़ "मुख्य" खाता संचालित करते हैं, जबकि उनके पास निजी खाता भी होता है।
translations.translation: Twenty percent of students said they operate a clean "main" account to show their parents, while they also have a personal account.
translations.reference: Twenty per cent of pupils said they operate a sanitised "main" account to show parents, while also having private ones.

translations.source: एक माँ जिसने अचानक अपनी 13 वर्षीय बेटी के गुप्त साइट को देखा, उसने पाया कि उसमें एक किशोरी ने दूसरों से "मेरा बलात्कार करें" का आग्रह कर रही है।
translations.translation: A mother who suddenly visited the secret site of her 13-year-old daughter found that a teenage girl was urging others to "rape me".
translations.reference: One mother who stumbled across her 13-year-old's daughter's secret site found a teenager urging others to "rape me."

translations.source: डिजिटल अवेयरनेस यू.के. तथा द हेडमास्टर्स" एंड हेडमिस्ट्रेस" कॉन्फ्रेंस (HMC) द्वारा स्वतंत्र स्कूलों के शोध में पाया गया कि 11 से 18 साल के बच्चों में से 40 प्रतिशत के दो प्रोफाइल थे, जिनमें से आधे निजी खातों को रखने के लिए स्वीकार किए गए थे।
translations.translation: Research from independent schools by Digital Awareness UK and The Headmasters' and Headmistresses' Conference (HMC) found that 40 per cent of children aged 11 to 18 had two profiles, half of which were accepted to hold private accounts.
translations.reference: The research, by Digital Awareness UK and the Headmasters" and Headmistresses" Conference (HMC) of independent schools, found 40 per cent of 11 to 18-year-olds had two profiles, with half of those admitting to keeping private accounts.

translations.source: HMC के प्रमुख माइक बुकानन ने कहा: "यह बहुत परेशान करने वाली बात है कि बहुत से किशोरों को ऑनलाइन जगह बनाने के लिए लुभाया जाता है जहाँ माता-पिता और शिक्षक उन्हें नहीं ढूँढ़ सकते।"
translations.translation: Mike Buchanan, head of HMC, said: "It is very disturbing that so many teens are tempted to create an online space where parents and teachers can't find them".
translations.reference: HMC chief Mike Buchanan said: "It's disturbing so many teenagers are tempted into creating online spaces where parents and teachers cannot find them."

translations.source: ईलिध डॉयल स्कॉटिश एथलेटिक्स बोर्ड में "एथलीटों के लिए आवाज़" होंगी
translations.translation: Elidh Doyle will be a "voice for athletes" on the Scottish Athletics Board.
translations.reference: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board

translations.source: ईलिध डॉयल को गवर्निंग बॉडी की वार्षिक आम बैठक में एक गैर-कार्यकारी निदेशक के रूप में स्कॉटिश एथलेटिक्स  बोर्ड में चुना गया है।
translations.translation: Elidh Doyle has been elected to the Scottish Athletics Board as a non-executive director at the Annual General Meeting of the Governing Body.
translations.reference: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.

translations.source: डॉयल स्कॉटलैंड की सबसे सुशोभित ट्रैक और फील्ड एथलीट हैं तथा चेयरमैन इयान बीट्टी ने पिछले एक दशक में अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर अपने व्यापक अनुभव से लाभ उठाने हेतु खेल का मार्गदर्शन करने वालों के लिए इस कदम को शानदार अवसर बताया।
translations.translation: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and Chairman Ian Beatty described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to take advantage of their extensive international experience over the past decade.
translations.reference: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.

translations.source: बीट्टी ने कहा, "ईलीध के मन में स्कॉटिश, यू.के. और विश्व एथलेटिक्स समुदाय के लिए बहुत सम्मान है और हमें यकीन है कि स्कॉटलैंड में एथलेटिक्स को उन्हें बोर्ड में लाने की वजह से काफ़ी फ़ायदा पहुँचेगा।"
translations.translation: "He has great respect for the Scottish, UK and world athletics community, and we are confident that athletics in Scotland will benefit greatly from bringing him on board", said Betty.
translations.reference: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.

translations.source: डॉयल ने कहा: "मैं एथलीटों की आवाज़ के रूप में काम करने के लिए उत्सुक हूँ और मुझे उम्मीद है कि मैं स्कॉटलैंड में खेल के लिए मार्गदर्शन करने में वास्तव में योगदान दे सकती हूँ और मदद कर सकती हूँ।"
translations.translation: "I am eager to serve as an athlete's voice and I hope I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland", said Doyle.
translations.reference: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."

translations.source: अपने चार ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदकों के अलावा, अटलांटा में 1996 के खेलों में 200 मीटर और 400 मीटर की दौड़ जीतने वाले अमेरिकी और अब जो नियमित रूप से बीबीसी पंडित हैं, एक क्षणिक इस्केमिक हमले के बाद चलने में असमर्थ हो गए।
translations.translation: In addition to his four Olympic gold medals, the American, who won the 200m and 400m races at the 1996 Games in Atlanta and is now a regular BBC pundit, was unable to walk after a brief ischemic attack.
translations.reference: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.

translations.source: उन्होंने ट्विटर पर लिखा: "एक महीने पहले आज मुझे एक आघात लगा।
translations.translation: He wrote on Twitter: "One month ago today I had a stroke.
translations.reference: He wrote on Twitter: "A month ago today I suffered a stroke.

translations.source: मैं चल नहीं पा रहा हूँ।
translations.translation: I can't walk.
translations.reference: I could not walk.

translations.source: डॉक्टरों ने कहा कि समय ही बताएगा कि मैं ठीक हो जाऊँगा या नहीं और ठीक किस हद तक हो सकता हूँ।
translations.translation: The doctors said that time will tell whether I will recover or not and to what extent I can recover.
translations.reference: Doctors said only time will tell if I will recover or to what degree.

translations.source: यह भीषण काम था, लेकिन पूरी तरह से ठीक हो जाना, फिर से चलना और आज चपलता अभ्यास करना सीखा!
translations.translation: It was a tremendous amount of work, but I learned to heal completely, to walk again, and to exercise agility today!
translations.reference: Its been grueling work but made a full recovery, re-learned how to walk and today doing agility drills!

translations.source: प्रोत्साहन के संदेशों के लिए धन्यवाद!"
translations.translation: Thank you for the encouraging messages!"
translations.reference: Thanks for the messages of encouragement!"

translations.source: स्तन पंप विज्ञापन द्वारा माताओं की गायों से तुलना ने ऑनलाइन लोगों की राय में मतभेद पैदा किया
translations.translation: Comparison of mothers to cows by breast pump advertising has led to disagreements in the opinions of people online.
translations.reference: Breast pump advert comparing mothers to cows divides opinion online

translations.source: एक स्तन पंप कंपनी ने एक विज्ञापन द्वारा ऑनलाइन राय विभाजित की जो स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं की तुलना गायों के दूध को दुहने से करती है।
translations.translation: A breast pump company split opinions online by an ad that compares breastfeeding mothers to milking cows' milk.
translations.reference: A breast pump company has divided opinion online with an advert that compares nursing mothers to cows being milked.

translations.source: "दुनिया का पहला मूक पहनने योग्य ब्रेस्ट बम्प" कहलाने वाले उत्पाद की लॉन्चिंग को चिह्नित करने के लिए, उपभोक्ता टेक कंपनी Elvie ने एक नया मज़ाकिया म्यूज़िक वीडियो-प्रेरित विज्ञापन जारी किया, जिसमें नया पंप माताओं को व्यक्त करने की स्वतंत्रता देता है।
translations.translation: To mark the launch of a product called "the world's first silent wearable breast pump", consumer tech company Elvie released a new humorous music video-inspired ad in which the new pump gives mothers the freedom to express themselves.
translations.reference: To mark the launch of what is said to be the "world's first silent wearable breast bump," consumer tech company Elvie released a tongue-in-cheek music video-inspired advert to showcase the freedom the new pump gives to expressing mothers.

translations.source: गायों के घास से भरे खलिहान में चार असली माताएँ एक गाने पर नृत्य करती हैं जिसमें कुछ इस प्रकार के बोल शामिल हैं: "हाँ, मैं खुद दूध दुहती हूँ, लेकिन आपको कोई पूँछ नहीं दिखती" और "अगर आपने ग़ौर नहीं किया है तो ये थन नहीं हैं, ये तो मेरे स्तन हैं।"
translations.translation: In a barn full of cows' grass, four real mothers dance to a song with some of the lyrics: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see a tail" and "If you haven't noticed, these aren't thongs, these are my breasts".
translations.reference: Four real mothers dance in a hay-filled barn of cows to a track that includes lyrics like: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see no tail" and "In case you hadn't noticed these are not udders, they're my boobs."

translations.source: कोरस जारी है: "पंप इट आउट, पंप इट आउट, आई ऐम फ़ीडिंग देम बेबीज़, पंप इट आउट, पंप इट आउट, आई ऐम मिल्किंग माई लेडीज़।"
translations.translation: The chorus continues: "Pump It Out, Pump It Out, I Am Feeding Them Babies, Pump It Out, Pump It Out, I Am Milking My Ladies".
translations.reference: The chorus continues: "Pump it out, pump it out, I'm feeding them babies, pump it out, pump it out, I'm milking my ladies."

translations.source: जो भी हो, विज्ञापन, जिसे फ़र्म के Facebook पेज पर प्रकाशित किया गया है, ऑनलाइन विवाद का कारण बना है।
translations.translation: In any case, the ad, which has been posted on the firm's Facebook page, has caused an online controversy.
translations.reference: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.

translations.source: 77,000 अवलोकनों और सैकड़ों टिप्पणियों के साथ, वीडियो को दर्शकों से मिश्रित प्रतिक्रियाएँ मिली हैं, कई लोगों ने कहा कि यह डेयरी उद्योग की "भयावहता" को हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से पेश करती है।
translations.translation: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it presents the "terror" of the dairy industry lightly.
translations.reference: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.

translations.source: "इस उत्पाद के विज्ञापन के लिए गायों का उपयोग करना बहुत खराब निर्णय है।
translations.translation: "Using cows to advertise this product is a very bad decision.
translations.reference: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.

translations.source: हमारे जैसे ही उन्हें गर्भवती होने और दूध उत्पन्न करने के लिए जन्म देने की आवश्यकता है, सिवाय इस बात के कि उनके शिशुओं को जन्म देने के बाद चंद दिनों में ही उनसे चुरा लिया जाता है," एक ने लिखा।
translations.translation: Just like us, they need to get pregnant and give birth to produce milk, except that their babies are stolen from them within a few days of giving birth", one wrote.
translations.reference: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.

translations.source: Elvie ब्रेस्ट पंप नर्सिंग ब्रा (Elvie/मदर) के भीतर सूझ-बूझ से फ़िट हो जाती है
translations.translation: The Elvie Breast Pump is intuitively fitted inside the nursing bra.
translations.reference: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)

translations.source: एक और टिप्पणी: "ज़ाहिर है माँ और शिशु दोनों के लिए दुखदायी।
translations.translation: Another comment: "Obviously painful for both mother and baby.
translations.reference: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.

translations.source: लेकिन हाँ क्यों नहीं उन्हें ऐसी माताओं के लिए ब्रेस्ट पंप के विज्ञापन के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाए जिन्हें अपने बच्चों को रखने का अवसर मिलता है?"
translations.translation: But why not use them to advertise breast pumps for mothers who have the opportunity to take care of their children?"
translations.reference: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"

translations.source: किसी और ने जोड़ा: "कैसा अप्रासंगिक विज्ञापन है।"
translations.translation: Another added: "How irrelevant is advertising".
translations.reference: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."

translations.source: अन्य लोगों ने विज्ञापन का बचाव किया, जिसमें से एक औरत ने कहा कि उन्हें उस विज्ञापन का गाना "हास्यप्रद" लगा।
translations.translation: Others defended the advertisement, one of whom said she found the song "humorous".
translations.reference: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."

translations.source: "मुझे लगता है कि यह एक बहुत बढ़िया विचार है।
translations.translation: "I think this is a great idea.
translations.reference: "I think this is a genus idea.

translations.source: मेरे पास भी यह होता, यदि मैं अभी भी स्तनपान करा रही होती।
translations.translation: I would have it, too, if I were still breastfeeding.
translations.reference: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.

translations.source: पंपिंग से मुझे बिल्कुल एक गाय होने का अनुभव होता है।
translations.translation: Pumping makes me feel like a cow.
translations.reference: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.

translations.source: यह विज्ञापन थोड़ा अजीब है, लेकिन मैंने इसे उस तरह से ही देखा जैसा वह है।
translations.translation: This ad is a little weird, but I saw it the way it is.
translations.reference: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.

translations.source: एक ने लिखा कि यह एक बढ़िया उत्पाद है"।
translations.translation: One wrote, "This is a great product".
translations.reference: This is a genius product," one wrote.

translations.source: दूसरे ने टिप्पणी की: "यह उन माताओं के लिए एक मज़ेदार विज्ञापन है, जो पंप करती हैं (अक्सर उनके कार्यस्थल या शौचालय में) और "गाय" जैसा अनुभव करती हैं।
translations.translation: Another commented: "It's a fun ad for mothers who pump (often in their workplace or bathroom) and feel like a "gay".
translations.reference: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."

translations.source: यह डेयरी उद्योग को बढ़ावा देने वाला या निर्णायक विज्ञापन नहीं है।"
translations.translation: This is not a promotional or decisive advertisement for the dairy industry".
translations.reference: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."

translations.source: वीडियो के अंत में, महिलाओं के एक समूह ने बताया कि वे अपनी ब्रा में सावधानी से पंप लगाकर नाचती रहीं।
translations.translation: At the end of the video, a group of women reported that they were dancing with carefully pumped into their bra.
translations.reference: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.

translations.source: इस अभियान के पीछे की अवधारणा इस ज्ञान पर आधारित है कि कई महिलाएँ स्तन को पंप करने वाली महिलाएँ कहती हैं कि उन्हें ऐसे लगता है जैसे कि वे एक गाय हैं।
translations.translation: The concept behind this campaign is based on the knowledge that many women who pump their breasts say they feel as if they are a cow.
translations.reference: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.

translations.source: हालांकि, एल्वी पंप अच्छी तरह से छिपा रहता है, उसमें कोई वायर या ट्यूब नहीं है और सीधे सावधानी पूर्वक एक नर्सिंग ब्रा में फिट हो जाता है, महिलाओं को पंपिंग किए बिना घूमने, अपने बच्चों को पकड़ने और यहाँ तक की बाहर जाने की भी आज़ादी देता है।
translations.translation: However, the LV pump is well concealed, has no wires or tubes and is carefully fitted directly into a nursing bra, also giving women the freedom to walk around, hold their children and even go outside without pumping.
translations.reference: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.

translations.source: एना बैलेरिन, भागीदार और Mother में ECD ने टिप्पणी कीः "एल्वी पंप एक क्रांतिकारी उत्पाद है, जो एक धमाकेदार और शानदार लॉन्च का हकदार है।
translations.translation: Ana Balerin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The LV pump is a revolutionary product, deserving of an explosive and brilliant launch.
translations.reference: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.

translations.source: महिलाओं और डेरी की गायों के बारे में बताते हुए उनके बीच समानांतर रेखांकित करके, हम स्तन पंपिंग और इसकी चुनौतियों को स्पॉटलाइट में लाना चाहते हैं, एक मनोरंजक और संबंधित तरीके से आज़ादी की भावना को प्रदर्शित करते हुए, जो नया पंप लाएगा।
translations.translation: By outlining the parallels between women and dairy cows, we want to bring breast pumping and its challenges to the spotlight, showing a sense of freedom in an entertaining and relevant way, which will bring a new pump.
translations.reference: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.

translations.source: यह पहली बार नहीं है जब एल्वी पंप सुर्खियों में रहा है।
translations.translation: This is not the first time that an LV pump has made headlines.
translations.reference: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.

translations.source: लंदन फ़ैशन सप्ताह के दौरान, उत्पाद का उपयोग करने वाली दो बच्चों की एक माँ, डिज़ाइनर मार्टा जैक्यूबोस्की के लिए कैटवॉक करती हुई दिखाई दी थीं।
translations.translation: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two who used the product, was seen catwalking for designer Marta Jakubosky.
translations.reference: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.

translations.source: सैकड़ों प्रवासी बच्चे चुपके से टेक्सास की सीमा पर एक टेंट कैंप में चले गए
translations.translation: Hundreds of immigrant children secretly moved to a tent camp near the Texas border.
translations.reference: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border

translations.source: पकड़े गए प्रवासी बच्चों पर जासूसी की जाती थी, तब भी जब मासिक सीमा क्रॉसिंग में सापेक्ष रूप से कोई बदलाव नहीं होता, कुछ हद तक इसलिए क्योंकि ट्रंप प्रशासन द्वारा पेश किए गए कठोर वक्रपटुता और नीतियों ने प्रायोजकों के साथ बच्चों को नियुक्त करना मुश्किल बना दिया है।
translations.translation: Trapped migrant children were spied on even when the monthly border crossing was relatively unchanged, in part because the rigid curvature and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it difficult to recruit children with sponsors.
translations.reference: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.

translations.source: पारंपरिक रूप से, अधिकतम प्रायोजकों ने खुद ही बिना दस्तावेज़ के प्रवासियों को नियुक्त किया था और उन्हें आगे बढ़कर किसी भी बच्चे पर दावा करके देश में रहने की अपनी खुद की क्षमता को खतरे में डालने का डर था।
translations.translation: Traditionally, the maximum sponsors had hired undocumented immigrants themselves and they were afraid of jeopardizing their own ability to stay in the country by claiming any child.
translations.reference: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.

translations.source: जून में खतरा और भी बढ़ गया, जब संघीय अधिकारों ने घोषणा की कि संभावित प्रायोजकों और घर के अन्य व्यस्क या बड़े सदस्यों को अपने फ़िंगरप्रिंट देने होंगे और डेटा को फिर अप्रवासी अधिकारियों के साथ साझा किया जाएगा।
translations.translation: The threat escalated in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult or older members of the household would have to give their fingerprints and the data would then be shared with immigration officials.
translations.reference: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.

translations.source: पिछले सप्ताह, मैथ्यू एल्बेंस, अप्रवास और सीमा शुल्क प्रवर्तन के एक वरिष्ठ अधिकारी ने कांग्रेस के समक्ष प्रमाण प्रस्तुत किए कि एजेंसी ने ऐसे दर्जनों लोगों को गिरफ़्तार किया है, जिन्होंने संगहीन नाबालिगों को प्रायोजित करने के लिए आवेदन किया था।
translations.translation: Last week, a senior official at Matthew Albens, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, presented evidence to Congress that the agency has arrested dozens of individuals who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
translations.reference: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.

translations.source: एजेंसी ने बाद में यह पुष्टि की कि गिरफ़्तार किए गए लोगों में से 70 प्रतिशत का पहले से कोई आपराधिक रिकॉर्ड नहीं है।
translations.translation: The agency later confirmed that 70 per cent of those arrested had no prior criminal record.
translations.reference: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.

translations.source: "लगभग 80 प्रतिशत व्यक्ति जो या तो प्रायोजक हैं या प्रायोजक के घर के सदस्य हैं, वह देश में अवैध रूप से रहते हैं और उनमें से अधिकतम अपराधी हैं।
translations.translation: "Approximately 80 per cent of persons who are either sponsors or members of the sponsors' household are living in the country illegally and the majority of them are criminals.
translations.reference: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.

translations.source: इसलिए हम उन व्यक्तियों की खोज करना जारी रखते हैं," श्री एल्बेंस ने कहा।
translations.translation: So we continue to look for those individuals", said Mr. Albanes.
translations.reference: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.

translations.source: बच्चों को जल्दी से तैयार करने की मांग करते हुए, अधिकारियों ने नए नियम पेश किए, जिसके अनुसार बच्चों को 60 दिन के बजाय पकड़े जाने के एक माह के भीतर न्यायालय में पेश होना आवश्यक था, जो शरण लिए गए कर्मचारियों के अनुसार पिछला मानक था।
translations.translation: Calling for the early preparation of the children, the authorities introduced new rules requiring the children to appear in court within one month of their capture instead of 60 days, which was the previous standard according to the asylum-seeking staff.
translations.reference: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.

translations.source: कई लोग किसी अप्रवासी न्यायाधीश के समक्ष कानूनी स्थिति के लिए अपने मामले को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से पेश रहने के बजाय वीडियो कॉन्फ़्रेंस कॉल के ज़रिए प्रकट होते हैं।
translations.translation: Many people appear by videoconference call rather than appear in person to present their case to an immigrant judge for legal status.
translations.reference: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.

translations.source: वह जिन्हें मुक्त करने के लिए अयोग्य समझा जाता है, उन्हें तत्काल निकाल दिया जाता है।
translations.translation: Those who are deemed unfit to be released are expelled immediately.
translations.reference: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.

translations.source: बच्चे जितने लंबे समय के लिए बंदी बने रहते हैं, उतनी ही उनके बैचेन या उदास रहने की संभावना है, जो संरक्षण कर्मचारियों और हाल ही के महीनों में सिस्टम की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार हिंसक आवेग या भागने के प्रयासों में परिमाणित हो सकता है।
translations.translation: The longer the children remain in captivity, the more likely they are to be battered or depressed, which can be demonstrated in violent impulses or escape attempts, as preservation personnel and the system has reported in recent months.
translations.reference: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.

translations.source: वकीलों या अधिवक्ताओं ने कहा कि उन मामलों को टॉर्निल्लो जैसी उच्च सुविधा पर ले जाया जाता है, जहाँ यह संकेत कि बच्चा संघर्ष कर रहा है, उन्हें उनके आकार के कारण अनदेखा कर दिया जाता है।
translations.translation: Lawyers or advocates have said that cases are taken to a higher facility like Turnillo, where the sign that the child is struggling is ignored because of their size.
translations.reference: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.

translations.source: साथ ही उन्होंने कहा कि बच्चों को भावनात्मक रूप से तैयार होने के लिए पर्याप्त समय दिए बिना या मित्रों को अलविदा कहे बिना उन्हें टेंट शहर में ले जाना उस सदमे को और भी अधिक बढ़ा देगा, जिसके साथ वह पहले से ही संघर्ष कर रहे हैं।
translations.translation: At the same time, he said that taking the children to the tent city without giving them enough time to prepare themselves emotionally or saying goodbye to friends would only add to the shock they are already struggling with.
translations.reference: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.

translations.source: सीरिया ने अमेरिका, फ़्रेंच और तुर्की पर कब्जा करने वाले सैन्य बलों को तत्काल वापस जाने के लिए कहा
translations.translation: Syria has asked the US, French and Turkish occupation forces to withdraw immediately.
translations.reference: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately

translations.source: संयुक्त राष्ट्र की महासभा को संबोधित करते हुए, विदेशी मंत्री वालिद अल-मौलेम ने भी सीरिया के शरणार्थियों को वापस घर आने के लिए कहा, तब भी जब देश में युद्ध का अब आठवां वर्ष था।
translations.translation: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Ma'ullam also called on Syrian refugees to return home, even as the country is now in its eighth year of war.
translations.reference: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.

translations.source: मौलम, जो एक उप प्रधान मंत्री के रूप में भी काम करते हैं, उन्होंने कहा कि विदेशी सैन्य बल आंतकवाद से लड़ने के बहाने से अवैध रूप से सिरियाई की धरती पर रहते हैं और "उनके साथ उसी के अनुसार व्यवहार किया जाएगा।"
translations.translation: Maullam, who also serves as a deputy prime minister, said that foreign military forces are living illegally on Syrian soil under the pretext of fighting terrorism and "will be treated as such".
translations.reference: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."

translations.source: "उन्हें तत्काल और बिना किसी शर्त के युद्ध भूमि से वापस चले जाना चाहिए," उन्होंने असेंबली को बताया।
translations.translation: "They must withdraw from the battlefield immediately and unconditionally", he told the assembly.
translations.reference: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.

translations.source: मौलम ने ज़ोर देकर कहा कि सीरिया में “युद्ध लगभग समाप्त हो गया है" जहाँ 2011 से 360,000 से अधिक लोग मर चुके हैं और कई लाखों लोगों को उनके घरों से जड़ से उखाड़ कर फ़ेक दिया गया।
translations.translation: Maullam stressed that the war in Syria is almost over", where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011 and many millions have been uprooted from their homes.
translations.reference: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा कि दमासकस तब तक इस "अलौकिक युद्ध को लड़ना जारी रखेगा जब तक हम दोनों सभी आतंकवादी समूहों और "किसी विदेशी की उपस्थिति" के सभी सीरियाई क्षेत्रों को साफ़ नहीं कर देते।"
translations.translation: He said that Damascus will continue to fight this "extraordinary war until we both clear all of the terrorist groups and all of the Syrian territories of "the presence of an alien".
translations.reference: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."

translations.source: संयुक्त राज्य के पास सीरिया में कुछ 2,000 सैन्य बल है, मुख्य रूप से राष्ट्रपति बशर अल-अस्सद के विपक्ष में दोनों खुर्दिश और सीरिया के सैन्य बलों को प्रशिक्षण और सलाह देना।
translations.translation: The United States has some 2,000 military forces in Syria, primarily training and advising both Kurdish and Syrian military forces in opposition to President Bashar al-Assad.
translations.reference: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.

translations.source: फ्रांस के पास युद्ध के कारण विनाश हुए देश में भूमि पर 1,000 से अधिक सैन्य बल हैं।
translations.translation: France has more than 1,000 military forces on the ground in the war-torn country.
translations.reference: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.

translations.source: शरणार्थियों के मामले पर, मौलम ने कहा कि उनके वापस लौटने के लिए परिस्थितियां ठीक थीं और उन्होंने "बेकार के डर फ़ैलाने" के लिए "कुछ पश्चिमी देशों" को ज़िम्मेदार ठहराया, जिसने शरणार्थियों को दूर रहने के लिए प्रेरित किया।
translations.translation: In the case of the refugees, Maullam said that the conditions were right for their return and he blamed "some Western countries" for "spreading fear of needlessness", which prompted the refugees to stay away.
translations.reference: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.

translations.source: उन्होंने कहा, "हमने इस वापसी को सरल बनाने के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय समुदाय और मानवीय संगठनों को बुलाया।"
translations.translation: "We have called on the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate this withdrawal", he said.
translations.reference: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.

translations.source: "वे एक पूरी तरह से मानवीय मामले पर राजनीतिकरण कर रहे थे।"
translations.translation: "They were politicizing an entirely human issue".
translations.reference: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."

translations.source: संयुक्त राज्य और यूरोपीय संघ ने चेतावनी दी कि सीरिया को पुनः निर्माण हेतु तब तक कोई सहायता प्राप्त नहीं होगी, जब तक युद्ध को समाप्त करने के लिए असद और विपक्ष के बीच कोई राजनीतिक समझौता नहीं हो जाता।
translations.translation: The United States and the European Union warned that no aid for rebuilding Syria will be received until a political agreement between Assad and the opposition is reached to end the war.
translations.reference: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.

translations.source: संयुक्त राज्य राजनीतिज्ञ कहते हैं कि, इडलिब के अंतिम प्रमुख विद्रोह के गढ़ में एक बफ़र ज़ोन सेट अप करने के लिए रूस और तुर्की के बीच हाल ही में किया गया एक समझौता राजनीतिक बातचीत पर आगे दबाव डालने के लिए एक अवसर बनाता है।
translations.translation: A recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the stronghold of the last major uprising in Idlib provides an opportunity to put further pressure on political dialogue, the United States politician says.
translations.reference: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.

translations.source: रूसी-तुर्की डील या समझौते ने उस प्रांत में रूसी-समर्थित सीरियाई बलों द्वारा बड़े पैमाने पर होने वाले एक हमले को टाल दिया, जहाँ तीन लाख लोग रहते थे।
translations.translation: The Russian-Turkish deal or agreement prevented a large-scale attack by Russian-backed Syrian forces in the province, where three million people lived.
translations.reference: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.

translations.source: हालांकि, मौलम ने कहा कि समझौते में "स्पष्ट समयसीमा" होती है और साथ ही आशा व्यक्त की कि सैन्य कार्रवाई नुसरा फ्रंट से जुड़े अल-काएदा से योद्धाओं सहित जिहादियों को लक्षित करेगा, जिन्हें "मिटा दिया जाएगा।"
translations.translation: However, Maullam said that the agreement has a "clear timeline" and also expressed hope that the military action will target jihadists, including al-Qaeda fighters from the Nusra Front, who will be "reduced".
translations.reference: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."

translations.source: संयुक्त राज्य का प्रतिनिधि स्ताफ़ां दी मिस्तुरा जल्द ही सीरिया और चुनाव के मार्ग को ठीक करने के लिए युद्ध के बाद के संविधान को तैयार करने के लिए सरकार और विपक्ष के सदस्यों के साथ एक नई समिति की पहली मीटिंग आयोजित करने की उम्मीद करता है।
translations.translation: United States Representative Staffan Di Mistura hopes to hold the first meeting of a new committee with the government and members of the opposition to prepare a post-war constitution to fix the path of Syria and elections soon.
translations.reference: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.

translations.source: मौलम ने सीरिया सरकार की भागीदारी के लिए समिति में कुछ शर्तें रखी, जिसमें कहा गया है कि "वर्तमान संविधान के आलेखों की समीक्षा करने" और हस्तक्षेप के खिलाफ़ चेतावनी देने के लिए पैनल के कार्य को प्रतिबंधित किया जाना चाहिए।
translations.translation: Maullam made certain conditions in the committee for the involvement of the Syrian government, stating that the work of the panel should be banned to "review the articles of the current constitution" and warn against interference.
translations.reference: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.

translations.source: ट्रंप दूसरे कार्यकाल में क्यों जीतेंगे
translations.translation: Why will Trump win a second term?
translations.reference: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term

translations.source: उस तर्क से, श्री ट्रंप 2020 में फिर से चुनाव जीतेंगे, जब तक कि कई उदार या कुलीन व्यक्ति समय से पहले उनके कार्यकाल को समाप्त करने के लिए किसी दोषारोपण और घोटाले की उम्मीद न कर रहे हों।
translations.translation: With that rationale, Mr. Trump will win re-election in 2020 unless a number of liberal or elite individuals are expecting any blame and scandal to end his tenure prematurely.
translations.reference: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.

translations.source: निस्संदेह "यह राष्ट्रीय पद का अब तक का सबसे नाटकीय समापन होगा!"
translations.translation: "This will undoubtedly be the most dramatic end of a national title ever!"
translations.reference: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"

translations.source: अब तक, दर्शकों में कोई थकावट दिखाई नहीं दे रही थी।
translations.translation: Until now, there was no exhaustion in the audience.
translations.reference: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
